## Get a trace of a specific job of a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdJobsJobIdTrace"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/jobs/88/trace \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/jobs/{job_id}/trace`

Retrieves a log file for a job.

<h3 id="get-a-trace-of-a-specific-job-of-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|job_id|path|integer|true|ID of the job.|
|byte_offset|query|integer \| null|false|Byte offset to start reading the trace from.|
|byte_limit|query|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of bytes to return.|

## Cancel a job

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdJobsJobIdCancel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/1/jobs/88/cancel \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "force": true
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/jobs/{job_id}/cancel`

Cancels a specified job in a project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "force": true
}
```

<h3 id="cancel-a-job-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|job_id|path|integer|true|ID of the job.|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdJobsJobIdCancelRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidjobsjobidcancelrequest)|false|none|
|» force|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, [forces cancellation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/jobs/#force-cancel-a-job) of a job in `canceling` state.|

## Retry a job

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdJobsJobIdRetry"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/1/jobs/88/retry \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "inputs": {
      "environment": "production"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/jobs/{job_id}/retry`

Retries a specified job in a project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "inputs": {
    "environment": "production"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="retry-a-job-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|job_id|path|integer|true|ID of the job.|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdJobsJobIdRetryRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidjobsjobidretryrequest)|false|none|
|» inputs|body|object \| null|false|Input values for the job.|

## Erase a job

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdJobsJobIdErase"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/1/jobs/88/erase \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/jobs/{job_id}/erase`

<h3 id="erase-a-job-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|job_id|path|integer|true|ID of the job.|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|

## Run a job

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdJobsJobIdPlay"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/1/jobs/88/play \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "job_variables_attributes": [
      {
        "key": "foo",
        "value": "bar"
      }
    ],
    "job_inputs": {
      "environment": "production"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/jobs/{job_id}/play`

Runs a specified job. For a job in manual status, triggers an action to start the job.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "job_variables_attributes": [
    {
      "key": "foo",
      "value": "bar"
    }
  ],
  "job_inputs": {
    "environment": "production"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="run-a-job-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|job_id|path|integer|true|ID of the job.|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdJobsJobIdPlayRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidjobsjobidplayrequest)|false|none|
|» job_variables_attributes|body|[object]|false|User-defined variables to include when running the job.|
|» » key|body|string \| null|true|Name of the variable.|
|» » value|body|string \| null|true|Value of the variable.|
|» job_inputs|body|object \| null|false|Hash of [job input](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/jobs/job_inputs/) values to use when playing the job. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-org/-/work_items/17833) in GitLab 18.10.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-ci-lint">CI lint</h1>

Use this API to [validate a GitLab CI/CD configuration](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/yaml/lint/).

These endpoints take JSON-encoded YAML content. To preserve the formatting of your CI/CD
configuration, it can help to escape and encode the YAML with a third-party tool such as
[`jq`](https://jqlang.org/) before you make the request.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/lint/">External documentation</a>

## Validate existing CI/CD configuration

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdCiLint"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/ci/lint \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/ci/lint`

Validates the `.gitlab-ci.yml` configuration for a specified project.

<h3 id="validate-existing-cicd-configuration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|sha|query|string \| null|false|Commit SHA, branch, or tag that the CI/CD configuration content is taken from. Defaults to the head of the project's default branch. Deprecated. Use `content_ref` instead. Mutually exclusive with `content_ref`.|
|content_ref|query|string \| null|false|Commit SHA, branch, or tag that the CI/CD configuration content is taken from. Defaults to the head of the project's default branch. Mutually exclusive with `sha`.|
|dry_run|query|boolean|false|If `true`, runs a [pipeline creation simulation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/yaml/lint/#simulate-a-pipeline). If `false`, runs only a static check.|
|include_jobs|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes the list of jobs that would exist in a static check or pipeline simulation.|
|ref|query|string \| null|false|If `dry_run` is `true`, sets the branch or tag to use to validate the CI/CD YAML configuration. Defaults to the project's default branch. Deprecated. Use `dry_run_ref` instead. Mutually exclusive with `dry_run_ref`.|
|dry_run_ref|query|string \| null|false|If `dry_run` is `true`, sets the branch or tag to use to validate the CI/CD YAML configuration. Defaults to the project's default branch. Mutually exclusive with `ref`.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "valid": true,
  "errors": [
    "variables config should be a hash of key value pairs"
  ],
  "warnings": [
    "jobs:job may allow multiple pipelines ..."
  ],
  "merged_yaml": "---\\n:another_test:\\n  :stage: test\\n\n          :script: echo 2\\n:test:\\n  :stage: test\\n  :script: echo 1\\n",
  "includes": [
    {
      "blob": "https://gitlab.com/root/example-project/-/blob/..."
    }
  ],
  "jobs": [
    {
      "name": "test",
      "script": [
        "ls"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="validate-existing-cicd-configuration-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesCiLintResult](#schemaapientitiescilintresult)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Validate a CI/CD configuration

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdCiLint"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/ci/lint \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "content": "string",
    "dry_run": false,
    "include_jobs": true,
    "ref": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/ci/lint`

Validates a provided CI/CD configuration in the context of a specified project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "content": "string",
  "dry_run": false,
  "include_jobs": true,
  "ref": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="validate-a-cicd-configuration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdCiLintRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidcilintrequest)|true|none|
|» content|body|string \| null|true|CI/CD configuration content.|
|» dry_run|body|boolean|false|If `true`, runs a [pipeline creation simulation](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/yaml/lint/#simulate-a-pipeline). If `false`, runs only a static check.|
|» include_jobs|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes the list of jobs that would exist in a static check or pipeline simulation.|
|» ref|body|string \| null|false|If `dry_run` is `true`, sets the branch or tag to use to validate the CI/CD YAML configuration. Defaults to the project's default branch.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "valid": true,
  "errors": [
    "variables config should be a hash of key value pairs"
  ],
  "warnings": [
    "jobs:job may allow multiple pipelines ..."
  ],
  "merged_yaml": "---\\n:another_test:\\n  :stage: test\\n\n          :script: echo 2\\n:test:\\n  :stage: test\\n  :script: echo 1\\n",
  "includes": [
    {
      "blob": "https://gitlab.com/root/example-project/-/blob/..."
    }
  ],
  "jobs": [
    {
      "name": "test",
      "script": [
        "ls"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="validate-a-cicd-configuration-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesCiLintResult](#schemaapientitiescilintresult)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-ci-minutes">CI minutes</h1>

> [!warning]
> These endpoints are [deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/515371) and were used
> only by the GitLab subscription portal.

Use this API to record a purchase of
[compute minutes](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/pipelines/compute_minutes/) for a namespace, and to
transfer purchased packs to another namespace.

## Create a compute minutes purchase record for the namespace

<a id="opIdpostApiV4NamespacesIdMinutes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/namespaces/string/minutes \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "packs": [
      {
        "number_of_minutes": 0,
        "expires_at": "1970-01-01",
        "purchase_xid": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/namespaces/{id}/minutes`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Deprecated in GitLab 17.7

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "packs": [
    {
      "number_of_minutes": 0,
      "expires_at": "1970-01-01",
      "purchase_xid": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-compute-minutes-purchase-record-for-the-namespace-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID of the namespace.|
|body|body|[postApiV4NamespacesIdMinutesRequest](#schemapostapiv4namespacesidminutesrequest)|true|none|
|» packs|body|[object]|true|Array of additional purchased minute packs.|
|» » number_of_minutes|body|integer \| null|true|Number of additional minutes purchased.|
|» » expires_at|body|string(date) \| null|true|Date when the purchase expires.|
|» » purchase_xid|body|string \| null|true|Purchase ID for the additional minutes.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
[
  {
    "namespace_id": 123,
    "expires_at": "2012-05-28",
    "number_of_minutes": 10000,
    "purchase_xid": "46952fe69bebc1a4de10b2b4ff439d0c"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="create-a-compute-minutes-purchase-record-for-the-namespace-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<h3 id="create-a-compute-minutes-purchase-record-for-the-namespace-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesCiMinutesAdditionalPack](#schemaapientitiesciminutesadditionalpack)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Update a resource group

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdResourceGroupsKey"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/resource_groups/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "process_mode": "unordered"
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/resource_groups/{key}`

Updates the properties for a specified resource group. It returns `200` if the resource group was successfully updated. In case of an error, a status code `400` is returned.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "process_mode": "unordered"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-resource-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|key|path|string|true|URL-encoded key of the resource group, for example `resource%5Fa` instead of `resource_a`.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdResourceGroupsKeyRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidresourcegroupskeyrequest)|false|none|
|» process_mode|body|string \| null|false|Process mode of the resource group. Read [process modes](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/resource_groups/#process-modes) for more information.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» process_mode|unordered|
|» process_mode|oldest_first|
|» process_mode|newest_first|
|» process_mode|newest_ready_first|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "key": "production",
  "process_mode": "unordered",
  "created_at": "2021-09-01T08:04:59.650Z",
  "updated_at": "2021-09-01T08:04:59.650Z"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-resource-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesCiResourceGroup](#schemaapientitiesciresourcegroup)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-ci-runners">CI runners</h1>

> [!warning]
> Registering a runner with a registration token is
> [deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/380872) and disabled by default in
> GitLab 17.0 and later.

Use this API to register a [runner](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/runners/) with an instance, verify its
authentication, reset its authentication token, and unregister it. GitLab Runner uses these endpoints
itself.

To create a runner, or to manage runners that already exist, use the Runners endpoints.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/runners/">External documentation</a>

## Create a runner

<a id="opIdpostApiV4Runners"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/runners \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "token": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "maintainer_note": "string",
    "maintenance_note": "string",
    "info": {
      "name": "string",
      "version": "string",
      "revision": "string",
      "platform": "string",
      "architecture": "string"
    },
    "active": true,
    "paused": true,
    "locked": true,
    "access_level": "not_protected",
    "run_untagged": true,
    "tag_list": [
      "string"
    ],
    "maximum_timeout": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/runners`

Creates a runner.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "token": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "maintainer_note": "string",
  "maintenance_note": "string",
  "info": {
    "name": "string",
    "version": "string",
    "revision": "string",
    "platform": "string",
    "architecture": "string"
  },
  "active": true,
  "paused": true,
  "locked": true,
  "access_level": "not_protected",
  "run_untagged": true,
  "tag_list": [
    "string"
  ],
  "maximum_timeout": 0
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-runner-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4RunnersRequest](#schemapostapiv4runnersrequest)|true|none|
|» token|body|string \| null|true|Registration token.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the runner.|
|» maintainer_note|body|string \| null|false|Free-form maintenance notes for the runner. Deprecated. Use `maintenance_note` instead. Mutually exclusive with `maintenance_note`.|
|» maintenance_note|body|string \| null|false|Free-form maintenance notes for the runner (1024 characters). Mutually exclusive with `maintainer_note`.|
|» info|body|object \| null|false|Runner's metadata|
|» » name|body|string \| null|false|Runner's name|
|» » version|body|string \| null|false|Runner's version|
|» » revision|body|string \| null|false|Runner's revision|
|» » platform|body|string \| null|false|Runner's platform|
|» » architecture|body|string \| null|false|Runner's architecture|
|» active|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the runner is allowed to receive new jobs. Deprecated. Use `paused` instead. Mutually exclusive with `paused`.|
|» paused|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the runner ignores new jobs. Mutually exclusive with `active`.|
|» locked|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the runner is locked for the current project.|
|» access_level|body|string \| null|false|Access level of the runner.|
|» run_untagged|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the runner handles untagged jobs.|
|» tag_list|body|[string]|false|List of runner tags.|
|» maximum_timeout|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum time, in seconds, that runners can spend running a job.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» access_level|not_protected|
|» access_level|ref_protected|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "token": "string",
  "token_expires_at": "string"
}
```

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-ci-triggers">CI triggers</h1>

Use this API to [trigger pipelines](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/triggers/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_triggers/">External documentation</a>

## Trigger a pipeline with a token

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdTriggerPipeline"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/18/trigger/pipeline \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "token": "6d056f63e50fe6f8c5f8f4aa10edb7",
    "variables": {
      "VAR1": "value1",
      "VAR2": "value2"
    },
    "inputs": {}
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/trigger/pipeline`

Triggers a pipeline with a token. With a CI/CD job token, the triggered pipeline is a multi-project pipeline. The job that authenticates the request becomes associated with the upstream pipeline, which is visible on the pipeline graph. If you use a trigger token in a job, the job is not associated with the upstream pipeline.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "token": "6d056f63e50fe6f8c5f8f4aa10edb7",
  "variables": {
    "VAR1": "value1",
    "VAR2": "value2"
  },
  "inputs": {}
}
```

<h3 id="trigger-a-pipeline-with-a-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdTriggerPipelineRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidtriggerpipelinerequest)|true|none|
|» token|body|string \| null|true|Trigger token or CI/CD job token.|
|» variables|body|object \| null|false|Map of pipeline variables, as key-value pairs, for example `{ VAR1: "value1", VAR2: "value2" }`.|
|» inputs|body|object \| null|false|Map of inputs, as key-value pairs, to use when creating the pipeline. [Generally available](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/536548) in GitLab 18.1. Feature flag `ci_inputs_for_pipelines` removed.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response


<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-ci-variables">CI variables</h1>

Use this API to manage CI/CD variables for a [project](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/variables/#for-a-project),
a [group](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/variables/#for-a-group), or an
[instance](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/variables/#for-an-instance).

Managing project variables requires the Maintainer role for the project.
Managing group variables requires the Owner role for the group.
Managing instance variables requires administrator access.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_level_variables/">External documentation</a>

## List all group variables

## Create a group variable

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdVariables"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/variables \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "key": "string",
    "value": "string",
    "protected": true,
    "masked_and_hidden": true,
    "masked": true,
    "raw": true,
    "variable_type": "env_var",
    "environment_scope": "string",
    "description": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/variables`

Creates a group variable.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "key": "string",
  "value": "string",
  "protected": true,
  "masked_and_hidden": true,
  "masked": true,
  "raw": true,
  "variable_type": "env_var",
  "environment_scope": "string",
  "description": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-group-variable-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdVariablesRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidvariablesrequest)|true|none|
|» key|body|string \| null|true|Key of the group variable. Must be 255 characters or fewer and contain only `A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, and `_`.|
|» value|body|string \| null|true|Value of the variable.|
|» protected|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the variable is protected.|
|» masked_and_hidden|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the variable is masked and hidden.|
|» masked|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the variable is masked.|
|» raw|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the variable is treated as a raw string. If `false`, the value is [expanded](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/variables/#allow-cicd-variable-expansion).|
|» variable_type|body|string|false|The type of the variable.|
|» environment_scope|body|string \| null|false|The environment scope of the variable|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the variable. Limited to 255 characters.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» variable_type|env_var|
|» variable_type|file|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "variable_type": "env_var",
  "key": "TEST_VARIABLE_1",
  "value": "TEST_1",
  "hidden": true,
  "protected": true,
  "masked": true,
  "raw": true,
  "environment_scope": "*",
  "description": "This variable is being used for ..."
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-group-variable-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesCiVariable](#schemaapientitiescivariable)|
|400|Bad Request|400 Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

</aside>

|» environment_scope|body|string \| null|false|Environment scope of the variable. Defaults to `*`.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-clusters">Clusters</h1>

> [!warning]
> These certificate-based cluster endpoints are [deprecated](https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-org/configure/-/work_items/8).

Use this API to manage and discover the certificate-based Kubernetes clusters of an
[instance](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/instance/clusters/), a
[group](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/clusters/), or a
[project](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/clusters/). Connecting a cluster to a group or an
instance lets you use the same cluster across multiple projects.

Instance endpoints require administrator access. Group and project endpoints require the Maintainer
or Owner role.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/instance_clusters/">External documentation</a>

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdClustersClusterId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/clusters/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "domain": "string",
    "environment_scope": "string",
    "namespace_per_environment": true,
    "management_project_id": 0,
    "enabled": true,
    "managed": true,
    "platform_kubernetes_attributes": {
      "api_url": "string",
      "token": "string",
      "ca_cert": "string",
      "namespace": "string"
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/clusters/{cluster_id}`

Updates a cluster in a specified project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "domain": "string",
  "environment_scope": "string",
  "namespace_per_environment": true,
  "management_project_id": 0,
  "enabled": true,
  "managed": true,
  "platform_kubernetes_attributes": {
    "api_url": "string",
    "token": "string",
    "ca_cert": "string",
    "namespace": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-cluster-in-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|cluster_id|path|integer|true|ID of the cluster.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdClustersClusterIdRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidclustersclusteridrequest)|false|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|Name of the cluster.|
|» domain|body|string \| null|false|[Base domain](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/clusters/gitlab_managed_clusters/#base-domain) of the cluster.|
|» environment_scope|body|string \| null|false|Associated environment to the cluster. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|» namespace_per_environment|body|boolean|false|If `true`, deploys each environment to a separate Kubernetes namespace.|
|» management_project_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the [management project](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/clusters/management_project/) for the cluster.|
|» enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the cluster is active and GitLab's connection to the Kubernetes cluster is enabled.|
|» managed|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, GitLab manages namespaces and service accounts for this cluster.|
|» platform_kubernetes_attributes|body|object \| null|false|Platform Kubernetes data.|
|» » api_url|body|string \| null|false|URL to access the Kubernetes API.|
|» » token|body|string \| null|false|Token to authenticate against Kubernetes.|
|» » ca_cert|body|string \| null|false|TLS certificate (needed if API is using a self-signed TLS certificate).|
|» » namespace|body|string \| null|false|Kubernetes namespace that environments deploy to. If `managed` and `namespace_per_environment` are `true`, the environment slug is appended.|

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/clusters/user`

Adds a cluster to a specified project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "enabled": true,
  "domain": "string",
  "environment_scope": "*",
  "namespace_per_environment": true,
  "management_project_id": 0,
  "managed": true,
  "platform_kubernetes_attributes": {
    "api_url": "string",
    "token": "string",
    "ca_cert": "string",
    "namespace": "string",
    "authorization_type": "rbac"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-cluster-to-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdClustersUserRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidclustersuserrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the cluster.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the cluster is active and GitLab's connection to the Kubernetes cluster is enabled.|
|» domain|body|string \| null|false|[Base domain](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/clusters/gitlab_managed_clusters/#base-domain) of the cluster.|
|» environment_scope|body|string|false|Associated environment to the cluster. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|» namespace_per_environment|body|boolean|false|If `true`, deploys each environment to a separate Kubernetes namespace.|
|» management_project_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the [management project](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/clusters/management_project/) for the cluster.|
|» managed|body|boolean|false|If `true`, GitLab manages namespaces and service accounts for this cluster.|
|» platform_kubernetes_attributes|body|object \| null|true|Platform Kubernetes data.|
|» » api_url|body|string \| null|true|URL to access the Kubernetes API.|
|» » token|body|string \| null|true|Token to authenticate against Kubernetes.|
|» » ca_cert|body|string \| null|false|TLS certificate (needed if API is using a self-signed TLS certificate).|
|» » namespace|body|string \| null|false|Kubernetes namespace that environments deploy to. If `managed` and `namespace_per_environment` are `true`, the environment slug is appended.|
|» » authorization_type|body|string|false|Cluster authorization type.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » authorization_type|unknown_authorization|
|» » authorization_type|rbac|
|» » authorization_type|abac|

```json
{
  "name": "string",
```
```bash
  "enabled": true,
```
```bash
  "environment_scope": "*",
  "namespace_per_environment": true,

  }
```
```json
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-group-cluster-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdClustersUserRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidclustersuserrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the cluster.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the cluster is active and GitLab's connection to the Kubernetes cluster is enabled.|
|» environment_scope|body|string|false|Associated environment to the cluster. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|» namespace_per_environment|body|boolean|false|If `true`, deploys each environment to a separate Kubernetes namespace.|
|» domain|body|string \| null|false|[Base domain](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/clusters/#base-domain) of the cluster.|
|» management_project_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the [management project](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/clusters/management_project/) for the cluster.|
|» managed|body|boolean|false|If `true`, GitLab manages namespaces and service accounts for this cluster.|
|» platform_kubernetes_attributes|body|object \| null|true|Platform Kubernetes data.|
|» » api_url|body|string \| null|true|URL to access the Kubernetes API.|
|» » token|body|string \| null|true|Token to authenticate against Kubernetes.|
|» » ca_cert|body|string \| null|false|TLS certificate (needed if API is using a self-signed TLS certificate).|
|» » namespace|body|string \| null|false|Kubernetes namespace that environments deploy to. Allowed only when `managed` is `false`.|
|» » authorization_type|body|string|false|Cluster authorization type.|

|» » authorization_type|abac|

|» managed|body|boolean|false|If `true`, GitLab manages namespaces and service accounts for this cluster.|
|» platform_kubernetes_attributes|body|object \| null|true|Platform Kubernetes data.|
|» » api_url|body|string \| null|true|URL to access the Kubernetes API.|
|» » token|body|string \| null|true|Token to authenticate against Kubernetes.|
|» » ca_cert|body|string \| null|false|TLS certificate (needed if API is using a self-signed TLS certificate).|
|» » namespace|body|string \| null|false|Kubernetes namespace that environments deploy to. Allowed only when `managed` is `false`.|
|» » authorization_type|body|string|false|Cluster authorization type.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-code-suggestions">Code Suggestions</h1>

Operations related to Code Suggestions.

## Generate code completions

<a id="opIdpostApiV4CodeSuggestionsCompletions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/code_suggestions/completions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "current_file": {
      "file_name": "string",
      "content_above_cursor": "string",
      "content_below_cursor": "string"
    },
    "intent": "completion",
    "generation_type": "comment",
    "stream": false,
    "project_path": "namespace/project",
    "user_instruction": "string",
    "context": [
      {
        "type": "file",
        "name": "string",
        "content": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/code_suggestions/completions`

Generates code completions. Uses the AI abstraction layer to generate code completions. Requests to this endpoint are proxied to the AI Gateway.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "current_file": {
    "file_name": "string",
    "content_above_cursor": "string",
    "content_below_cursor": "string"
  },
  "intent": "completion",
  "generation_type": "comment",
  "stream": false,
  "project_path": "namespace/project",
  "user_instruction": "string",
  "context": [
    {
      "type": "file",
      "name": "string",
      "content": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="generate-code-completions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4CodeSuggestionsCompletionsRequest](#schemapostapiv4codesuggestionscompletionsrequest)|true|none|
|» current_file|body|object \| null|true|Attributes of the file that suggestions are generated for.|
|» » file_name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the current file.|
|» » content_above_cursor|body|string \| null|true|Content above cursor.|
|» » content_below_cursor|body|string \| null|false|Content below cursor.|
|» intent|body|string \| null|false|Intent of the completion request.|
|» generation_type|body|string \| null|false|Type of event for generation requests.|
|» stream|body|boolean|false|If `true`, streams the response as smaller chunks as they are ready, if applicable.|
|» project_path|body|string \| null|false|Path of the project.|
|» user_instruction|body|string \| null|false|User's instructions for Code Suggestions. [Generally available](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/462750) in GitLab 18.6. Feature flag `code_suggestions_context` removed.|
|» context|body|[object]|false|Additional context to use for Code Suggestions. [Generally available](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/462750) in GitLab 18.6. Feature flag `code_suggestions_context` removed.|
|» » type|body|string|true|Type of the context part.|
|» » name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the context part.|
|» » content|body|string \| null|true|Content of the context part.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» intent|completion|
|» intent|generation|
|» generation_type|comment|
|» generation_type|empty_function|
|» generation_type|small_file|
|» » type|file|
|» » type|snippet|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-code-search">Code search</h1>

Use this API to administer the [Zoekt](https://docs.gitlab.com/integration/zoekt/) nodes that power
[exact code search](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/search/exact_code_search/), including which
namespaces each node indexes, replica overrides, and triggering indexing for a project.

These endpoints require administrator access to the instance.

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /api/v4/admin/zoekt/projects/{project_id}/index`

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-commit-statuses">Commit statuses</h1>

Use this API to list the statuses recorded against a
[commit](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/repository/commits/), and to add or update the status
that an external [CI/CD job](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/jobs/) reports for a commit.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/commits/">External documentation</a>

## List all commit statuses

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdRepositoryCommitsShaStatuses"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/repository/commits/18f3e63d05582537db6d183d9d557be09e1f90c8/statuses \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/repository/commits/{sha}/statuses`

Lists all commit statuses for a specified project.

<h3 id="list-all-commit-statuses-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|sha|path|string|true|Commit SHA.|
|ref|query|string \| null|false|Name of the branch or tag. Defaults to the default branch.|
|stage|query|string \| null|false|Filter statuses by [build stage](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/yaml/#stages). For example, `test`.|
|name|query|string \| null|false|Filter statuses by [job name](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/yaml/#job-keywords).|
|pipeline_id|query|integer \| null|false|Filter statuses by pipeline ID.|
|all|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes all statuses instead of only the latest.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string \| null|false|Sort statuses in ascending or descending order. Defaults to `asc`.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|order_by|id|
|order_by|pipeline_id|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 93,
    "sha": "18f3e63d05582537db6d183d9d557be09e1f90c8",
    "ref": "develop",
```

## Create or update a commit pipeline status

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdStatusesSha"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/statuses/18f3e63d05582537db6d183d9d557be09e1f90c8 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "state": "pending",
    "ref": "develop",
    "target_url": "https://gitlab.example.com/janedoe/gitlab-foss/builds/91",
    "description": "string",
    "name": "coverage",
    "context": "coverage",
    "coverage": 100,
    "pipeline_id": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/statuses/{sha}`

Creates or updates the status of a commit represented by a job in an `external` stage. If the commit is associated with a merge request, target the commit in the merge request source branch.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "state": "pending",
  "ref": "develop",
  "target_url": "https://gitlab.example.com/janedoe/gitlab-foss/builds/91",
  "description": "string",
  "name": "coverage",
  "context": "coverage",
  "coverage": 100,
  "pipeline_id": 0
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-update-a-commit-pipeline-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|sha|path|string|true|Commit SHA.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdStatusesShaRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidstatusessharequest)|true|none|
|» state|body|string|true|State of the status.|
|» ref|body|string \| null|false|Branch or tag that the status refers to. Must be 255 characters or fewer.|
|» target_url|body|string \| null|false|Target URL to associate with this status. Must be 255 characters or fewer.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Short description of the status. Must be 255 characters or fewer.|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|String label to differentiate this status from the status of other systems.|
|» context|body|string \| null|false|String label to differentiate this status from the status of other systems.|
|» coverage|body|number \| null|false|Total code coverage.|
|» pipeline_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the pipeline to set the status for. Use when multiple pipelines exist for the same commit SHA.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» state|pending|
|» state|running|
|» state|success|
|» state|failed|
|» state|canceled|
|» state|skipped|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-commits">Commits</h1>

Use this API to manage [Git commits](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/repository/commits/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/commits/">External documentation</a>

## List all repository commits

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdRepositoryCommits"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/repository/commits \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/repository/commits`

Lists all commits for a specified project repository.

<h3 id="list-all-repository-commits-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|ref_name|query|string \| null|false|Name of a repository branch, tag, or revision range. Uses the default branch if not given.|
|since|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Only commits after or on this date are returned.|
|until|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Only commits before or on this date are returned.|
|path|query|string \| null|false|File path relative to the repository.|
|follow|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, follows file renames when filtering commits by `path` and returns commits for the file even if it was renamed. If `false`, returns only commits where the file existed at its current path. Used only when `path` specifies a single file.|
|author|query|string \| null|false|Filter commits by commit author.|
|all|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, retrieves every commit from the repository and ignores the `ref_name` parameter.|
|with_stats|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes statistics for each commit in the response.|
|first_parent|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, follows only the first parent commit upon seeing a merge commit.|
|order|query|string|false|Order in which to list commits, either reverse chronological or [topological](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-log#Documentation/git-log.txt---topo-order).|
|trailers|query|boolean|false|If `true`, parses and includes [Git trailers](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-interpret-trailers) for every commit.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|pagination|query|string|false|Specify the pagination method.|
|page_token|query|string \| null|false|Record from which to start the keyset pagination.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|order|default|
|order|topo|
|pagination|legacy|
|pagination|keyset|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": "2695effb5807a22ff3d138d593fd856244e155e7",
    "short_id": "2695effb",
    "created_at": "2017-07-26T11:08:53.000+02:00",
```

## Create a comment on a commit

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdRepositoryCommitsShaComments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/repository/commits/string/comments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "note": "Nice code!",
    "path": "doc/update/5.4-to-6.0.md",
    "line": 11,
    "line_type": "new"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/repository/commits/{sha}/comments`

Creates a comment on a commit. To comment on a specific line in a file, specify the full commit SHA, `path`, `line`, and set `line_type` to `new`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "note": "Nice code!",
  "path": "doc/update/5.4-to-6.0.md",
  "line": 11,
  "line_type": "new"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-comment-on-a-commit-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|sha|path|string|true|Commit SHA or name of a repository branch or tag.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdRepositoryCommitsShaCommentsRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidrepositorycommitsshacommentsrequest)|true|none|
|» note|body|string \| null|true|Text of the comment.|
|» path|body|string \| null|false|File path relative to the repository.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-compliance-policy-settings">Compliance policy settings</h1>

Use this API to manage the security policy settings for an instance, and to set the status of
compliance controls that are evaluated by an external service.

Managing security policy settings requires administrator access to the instance, and security policies
require the Ultimate tier.
Setting the status of a compliance control requires HMAC, Timestamp, and Nonce authentication.

External controls support periodic ping functionality. When ping is enabled, which is the default,
GitLab resets the control status to `pending` every 12 hours. When ping is disabled, the control
status changes only through API calls.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/compliance_policy_settings/">External documentation</a>

## Set status of an external control

<a id="opIdpatchApiV4ProjectsIdComplianceExternalControlsControlIdStatus"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/1/compliance_external_controls/0/status \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "status": "pass"
  }'
```

`PATCH /api/v4/projects/{id}/compliance_external_controls/{control_id}/status`

Sets the status of a specified external control. Use this operation to inform GitLab that a control has passed or failed a check by an external service.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "status": "pass"
}
```

<h3 id="set-status-of-an-external-control-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|control_id|path|integer|true|ID of the control.|
|body|body|[patchApiV4ProjectsIdComplianceExternalControlsControlIdStatusRequest](#schemapatchapiv4projectsidcomplianceexternalcontrolscontrolidstatusrequest)|true|none|
|» status|body|string|true|Status of the control.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|pass|
|» status|fail|
|» status|not_applicable|

<h3 id="set-status-of-an-external-control-responses">Responses</h3>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-container-registry">Container registry</h1>

Use this API to manage the [GitLab container registry](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/container_registry/):
list the registry repositories in a project or a group, retrieve or delete individual repositories and
their tags, and receive registry events.

To authenticate with these endpoints from a CI/CD job, pass the [`$CI_JOB_TOKEN`](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/jobs/ci_job_token/)
variable as the `JOB-TOKEN` header. The job token only has access to the container registry
of the project that created the pipeline.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/container_registry/">External documentation</a>

## List all registry repositories for a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdRegistryRepositories"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/registry/repositories \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/registry/repositories`

Lists all registry repositories for a specified project. Responses are paginated and return 20 results by default.

<h3 id="list-all-registry-repositories-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|tags|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes an array of `tags` in the response.|
|tags_count|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes `tags_count` in the response.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "releases",
    "path": "group/project/releases",
    "project_id": 9,
    "location": "gitlab.example.com/group/project/releases",
    "created_at": "2019-01-10T13:39:08.229Z",
    "cleanup_policy_started_at": "2020-08-17T03:12:35.489Z",
    "tags_count": 3,
    "tags": {
      "name": "latest",
      "path": "namespace1/project1/test_image_1:latest",
      "location": "registry.dev/namespace1/project1/test_image_1:latest"
    },
    "delete_api_path": "delete/api/path",
    "size": 12345,
    "status": "delete_scheduled"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-registry-repositories-for-a-project-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<h3 id="list-all-registry-repositories-for-a-project-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesContainerRegistryRepository](#schemaapientitiescontainerregistryrepository)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey

## Delete multiple registry repository tags

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4ProjectsIdRegistryRepositoriesRepositoryIdTags"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/registry/repositories/0/tags \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/projects/{id}/registry/repositories/{repository_id}/tags`

Deletes multiple registry repository tags based on the specified criteria.

<h3 id="delete-multiple-registry-repository-tags-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|repository_id|path|integer|true|ID of the container registry repository.|
|name_regex_delete|query|string \| null|false|[RE2](https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax) regular expression of the tag names to delete. Specify `.*` to delete all tags. At least one of `name_regex`, `name_regex_delete` must be provided.|
|name_regex|query|string \| null|false|[RE2](https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax) regular expression of the tag names to delete. Specify `.*` to delete all tags. Deprecated. Use `name_regex_delete` instead. At least one of `name_regex`, `name_regex_delete` must be provided.|
|name_regex_keep|query|string \| null|false|[RE2](https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax) regular expression of the tag names to keep. Overrides any matches from `name_regex_delete`. Setting to `.*` results in a no-op.|
|keep_n|query|integer \| null|false|Number of most recent tags with a matching name to keep.|
|older_than|query|string \| null|false|Delete tags older than this age, such as `1h`, `1d`, or `1month`.|

<h3 id="delete-multiple-registry-repository-tags-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Success|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-dora-metrics">DORA metrics</h1>

Use this API to retrieve [DORA metrics](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/analytics/dora_metrics/) for
groups and projects. Additional metrics are available through the
[GraphQL API](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/graphql/reference/).

These endpoints require the Reporter, Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/dora/metrics/">External documentation</a>

## Retrieve project-level DORA metrics

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdDoraMetrics"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/dora/metrics?metric=deployment_frequency' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/dora/metrics`

Retrieves DORA metrics for a specified project.

<h3 id="retrieve-project-level-dora-metrics-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|metric|query|string|true|The DORA metric to fetch.|
|start_date|query|string(date) \| null|false|Start date of the date range. Defaults to 3 months ago.|
|end_date|query|string(date) \| null|false|End date of the date range. Defaults to the current date.|
|interval|query|string|false|The bucketing interval.|
|environment_tiers|query|[string]|false|The tiers of the environments.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|metric|deployment_frequency|
|metric|lead_time_for_changes|
|metric|time_to_restore_service|
|metric|change_failure_rate|
|interval|all|
|interval|monthly|
|interval|daily|
|environment_tiers|production|
|environment_tiers|staging|
|environment_tiers|testing|
|environment_tiers|development|
|environment_tiers|other|

<h3 id="retrieve-project-level-dora-metrics-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|successful operation|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-data-management">Data management</h1>

> [!note]
> These endpoints are an [experiment](https://docs.gitlab.com/policy/development_stages_support/).

Use this API to inspect and checksum the records that an instance stores for a given model.

These endpoints require administrator access to the instance.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/admin/data_management/">External documentation</a>

## Retrieve information about a model record

<a id="opIdgetApiV4AdminDataManagementModelNameRecordIdentifier"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/admin/data_management/uploads/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/admin/data_management/{model_name}/{record_identifier}`

Retrieves information about a specified model record. Only available to administrators.

<h3 id="retrieve-information-about-a-model-record-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|model_name|path|string|true|See https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/admin_area/#data-management for the list of allowed values|
|record_identifier|path|integer \| string|true|Unique identifier of the record. Can be an integer or a Base64-encoded string, as returned by the list endpoint.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "record_identifier": "abc123",
  "model_class": "Project",
  "created_at": "2025-01-31T15:10:45.080Z",
  "file_size": 123,
  "checksum_information": {
    "checksum": "string",
    "last_checksum": "string",
    "checksum_state": "string",
    "checksum_retry_count": "string",
    "checksum_retry_at": "string",
    "checksum_failure": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-information-about-a-model-record-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesAdminModel](#schemaapientitiesadminmodel)|
|400|Bad Request|400 Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|404 Model Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Recalculate the checksum of a model record

<a id="opIdputApiV4AdminDataManagementModelNameRecordIdentifierChecksum"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/admin/data_management/uploads/0/checksum \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`PUT /api/v4/admin/data_management/{model_name}/{record_identifier}/checksum`

Recalculates the checksum of a specified model record. The checksum value is a representation of the queried model hashed with the md5 or sha256 algorithm. Only available to administrators on primary Geo sites.

<h3 id="recalculate-the-checksum-of-a-model-record-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|model_name|path|string|true|See https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/admin_area/#data-management for the list of allowed values|
|record_identifier|path|integer|true|Unique identifier of the record, as returned by the list endpoint.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "record_identifier": "abc123",
  "model_class": "Project",
  "created_at": "2025-01-31T15:10:45.080Z",
  "file_size": 123,
  "checksum_information": {
    "checksum": "string",
    "last_checksum": "string",
    "checksum_state": "string",
    "checksum_retry_count": "string",
    "checksum_retry_at": "string",
    "checksum_failure": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="recalculate-the-checksum-of-a-model-record-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesAdminModel](#schemaapientitiesadminmodel)|
|400|Bad Request|400 Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|404 Model Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Retrieve model information

<a id="opIdgetApiV4AdminDataManagementModelName"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/admin/data_management/uploads \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/admin/data_management/{model_name}`

Retrieves information about a data model in an instance. Only available to administrators.

<h3 id="retrieve-model-information-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|model_name|path|string|true|See https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/admin_area/#data-management for the list of allowed values|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|identifiers|query|[integer] \| [string]|false|Filter results with an array of unique identifiers of the requested model, which can be integers or base64 encoded strings.|
|checksum_state|query|string \| null|false|Filter by checksum status.|
|cursor|query|string \| null|false|Cursor for obtaining the next set of records.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|checksum_state|pending|
|checksum_state|started|
|checksum_state|succeeded|
|checksum_state|failed|
|checksum_state|disabled|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

```json
  {
    "record_identifier": "abc123",
    "model_class": "Project",
    "created_at": "2025-01-31T15:10:45.080Z",
    "file_size": 123,
    "checksum_information": {
      "checksum": "string",
      "last_checksum": "string",
      "checksum_state": "string",
      "checksum_retry_count": "string",
      "checksum_retry_at": "string",
      "checksum_failure": "string"
    }
  }
]
```

<h3 id="retrieve-model-information-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|

|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|404 Model Not Found|None|

<h3 id="retrieve-model-information-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesAdminModel](#schemaapientitiesadminmodel)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Recalculate checksums for model records

<a id="opIdputApiV4AdminDataManagementModelNameChecksum"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/admin/data_management/uploads/checksum \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "identifiers": [
      0
    ],
    "checksum_state": "started"
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/admin/data_management/{model_name}/checksum`

Recalculates checksums for selected records of a specified model, filtered by `checksum_state` and `identifiers` parameters if provided. The request enqueues a background job to perform the recalculation. Only available to administrators on primary Geo sites.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "identifiers": [
    0
  ],
  "checksum_state": "started"
}
```

<h3 id="recalculate-checksums-for-model-records-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|model_name|path|string|true|See https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/admin_area/#data-management for the list of allowed values|
|body|body|[putApiV4AdminDataManagementModelNameChecksumRequest](#schemaputapiv4admindatamanagementmodelnamechecksumrequest)|false|none|
|» identifiers|body|[integer] \| [string]|false|Filter results with an array of unique identifiers of the requested model, which can be integers or base64 encoded strings.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[integer]|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[string]|false|none|
|» checksum_state|body|string \| null|false|Filter by checksum status.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» checksum_state|started|
|» checksum_state|succeeded|
|» checksum_state|failed|
|» checksum_state|disabled|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "record_identifier": "abc123",
  "model_class": "Project",
  "created_at": "2025-01-31T15:10:45.080Z",
  "file_size": 123,
  "checksum_information": {
    "checksum": "string",
    "last_checksum": "string",
    "checksum_state": "string",
    "checksum_retry_count": "string",
    "checksum_retry_at": "string",
    "checksum_failure": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="recalculate-checksums-for-model-records-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesAdminModel](#schemaapientitiesadminmodel)|
|400|Bad Request|400 Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|404 Model Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-database-dictionary">Database dictionary</h1>

Use this API to list the tables in a GitLab database and retrieve the
[database dictionary](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/database/database_dictionary/) entry for a
single table.

Retrieving the entry for a single table requires administrator access to the instance.

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/databases/{database_name}/dictionary/tables`

Returns database dictionary tables filtered by database and optional table size

|database_name|path|string|true|Name of the database.|
|table_size|query|string \| null|false|Filter by table size classification.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-dependency-management">Dependency management</h1>

Use this API to retrieve a project's dependencies and to export
[dependency lists](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/application_security/dependency_list/) for a project,
group, or pipeline.

Every call to these endpoints requires authentication. To retrieve a project's dependencies, the user
must be authorized to read the repository. To see vulnerabilities in a response, the user must also be
authorized to read the [project security dashboard](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/application_security/security_dashboard/).
To create or download a dependency list export, the user must have the `read_dependency` permission,
and exports can be downloaded only by the user who created them.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/dependency_list_export/">External documentation</a>

## Create a dependency list export

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdDependencyListExports"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/dependency_list_exports \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "send_email": false,
    "export_type": "dependency_list"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/dependency_list_exports`

Creates a CycloneDX JSON export for all the project dependencies detected in a pipeline. If an authenticated user does not have the read_dependency permission, this request returns a `403 Forbidden` status code.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "send_email": false,
  "export_type": "dependency_list"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-dependency-list-export-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdDependencyListExportsRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsiddependencylistexportsrequest)|false|none|
|» send_email|body|boolean|false|If `true`, sends an email notification to the requesting user when the export completes.|
|» export_type|body|string|false|Format of the export.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» export_type|dependency_list|
|» export_type|csv|
|» export_type|cyclonedx_1_6_json|

<h3 id="create-a-dependency-list-export-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Create a deployment

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdDeployments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/deployments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "environment": "string",
    "sha": "string",
    "ref": "string",
    "tag": true,
    "status": "running"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/deployments`

Creates a deployment.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "environment": "string",
  "sha": "string",
  "ref": "string",
  "tag": true,
  "status": "running"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-deployment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdDeploymentsRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsiddeploymentsrequest)|true|none|
|» environment|body|string \| null|true|Name of the [environment](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/environments/) to create the deployment for.|
|» sha|body|string \| null|true|SHA of the commit that is deployed.|
|» ref|body|string \| null|true|Name of the branch or tag that is deployed.|
|» tag|body|boolean \| null|true|If `true`, the deployed ref is a tag.|
|» status|body|string|true|Status of the deployment that is created.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|running|
|» status|success|
|» status|failed|
|» status|canceled|

## Retrieve a deployment

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdDeploymentsDeploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/deployments/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/deployments/{deployment_id}`

Retrieves a specified deployment.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-deployment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|deployment_id|path|integer|true|ID of the deployment.|

## Update a deployment

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdDeploymentsDeploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/deployments/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "status": "running"
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/deployments/{deployment_id}`

Updates a specified deployment.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "status": "running"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-deployment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|deployment_id|path|integer|true|ID of the deployment.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdDeploymentsDeploymentIdRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsiddeploymentsdeploymentidrequest)|true|none|
|» status|body|string|true|New status of the deployment.|

|---|---|
|» status|running|
|» status|success|
|» status|failed|
|» status|canceled|
