## Delete a deployment

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4ProjectsIdDeploymentsDeploymentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/deployments/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/projects/{id}/deployments/{deployment_id}`

Deletes a specified deployment that is not currently the last deployment for an environment or in a `running` state.

<h3 id="delete-a-deployment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|deployment_id|path|integer|true|ID of the deployment.|

<h3 id="delete-a-deployment-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Deployment destroyed|None|
|400|Bad Request|"Cannot destroy running deployment" or "Deployment currently deployed to environment"|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## List all merge requests associated with a deployment

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdDeploymentsDeploymentIdMergeRequests"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/deployments/0/merge_requests \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/deployments/{deployment_id}/merge_requests`

Lists all merge requests shipped with a specified deployment.

<h3 id="list-all-merge-requests-associated-with-a-deployment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|deployment_id|path|integer|true|ID of the deployment.|
|author_id|query|integer \| null|false|Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`.|
|author_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.|
|assignee_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`.|
|assignee_username|query|[string]|false|Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`.|
|reviewer_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_id`.|
|labels|query|[string]|false|Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|milestone|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.|
|my_reaction_emoji|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction.|
|reviewer_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_username`.|
|state|query|string|false|Filter merge requests by state.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Returns merge requests ordered by `created_at`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `title`, `updated_at` or `merged_at` fields. Introduced in GitLab 14.8.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|with_labels_details|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response returns more details for each label in the labels field: `name`, `color`, `description`, `description_html`, `text_color`.|
|with_merge_status_recheck|query|boolean|false|If `true`, this projection requests (but does not guarantee) an asynchronous recalculation of the `merge_status` field. Enable the `restrict_merge_status_recheck` [feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) to ignore this attribute when requested by users without the Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests created on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests updated on or after the specified time.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests updated on or before the specified time.|
|merged_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests merged on or after the specified time.|
|merged_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests merged on or before the specified time.|
|view|query|string \| null|false|If `simple`, returns the `iid`, URL, title, description, and basic state of merge request.|
|scope|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests for the given scope. `reviews_for_me` returns merge requests where the current user is assigned as a reviewer.|
|source_branch|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given source branch.|
|source_project_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given source project ID.|
|target_branch|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given target branch.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Search merge requests against their `title` and `description`. Combine with the `in` attribute.|
|in|query|string \| null|false|Modify the scope of the `search` attribute to `title`, `description`, or `title,description`. If omitted, defaults to `title,description`.|
|wip|query|string \| null|false|Filter merge requests by their `wip` status. `yes` returns only draft merge requests, `no` returns non-draft merge requests. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/234098) in GitLab 19.0. Use `draft` instead. Mutually exclusive with `draft`.|
|draft|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only draft merge requests. If `false`, returns only non-draft merge requests. Mutually exclusive with `wip`.|
|not|query|object \| null|false|Return merge requests that do not match the parameters supplied. Accepts: `labels`, `milestone`, `author_id`, `author_username`, `assignee_id`, `assignee_username`, `reviewer_id`, `reviewer_username`, `my_reaction_emoji`.|
|not[author_id]|query|integer \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`.|
|not[author_username]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`.|
|not[assignee_id]|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`.|
|not[assignee_username]|query|[string]|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`.|
|not[reviewer_username]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_id]`.|
|not[labels]|query|[string]|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|not[milestone]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.|
|not[my_reaction_emoji]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction.|
|not[reviewer_id]|query|integer \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_username]`.|
|deployed_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed before the specified time.|
|deployed_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed after the specified time.|
|environment|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed to the given environment.|
|merge_user_id|query|integer \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given user `id`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_username`.|
|merge_user_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_id`.|

|state|closed|

|scope|created_by_me|
|scope|assigned_to_me|

|wip|yes|
|wip|no|

## Create a project deploy token

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdDeployTokens"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/deploy_tokens \
  -X POST \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "scopes": [
      "read_repository"
    ],
    "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "username": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/deploy_tokens`

Creates a project deploy token.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "scopes": [
    "read_repository"
  ],
  "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "username": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-project-deploy-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdDeployTokensRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsiddeploytokensrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the deploy token.|
|» scopes|body|[string]|true|Scopes of the deploy token. Must include at least one scope.|
|» expires_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Date when the deploy token expires. If omitted, the deploy token does not expire.|
|» username|body|string \| null|false|Username for the deploy token. Defaults to `gitlab+deploy-token-{n}`.|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» scopes|read_repository|
|» scopes|read_registry|
|» scopes|write_registry|
|» scopes|read_package_registry|
|» scopes|write_package_registry|
|» scopes|read_virtual_registry|
|» scopes|write_virtual_registry|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json

  "id": 1,
  "name": "MyToken",
  "username": "gitlab+deploy-token-1",
  "expires_at": "2020-02-14T00:00:00.000Z",
  "scopes": [
    "read_repository"
  ],
  "revoked": true,
  "expired": true,
  "token": "jMRvtPNxrn3crTAGukpZ"
}
```

## Add a deploy key for a project

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdDeployKeys"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/deploy_keys \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "key": "string",
    "title": "string",
    "can_push": true,
    "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/deploy_keys`

Adds a deploy key for a specified project. If the deploy key already exists in another project, it is joined to the current project only if the original one is accessible by the same user.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "key": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "can_push": true,
  "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-deploy-key-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdDeployKeysRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsiddeploykeysrequest)|true|none|
|» key|body|string \| null|true|Public key value of the deploy key.|
|» title|body|string \| null|true|Title of the deploy key.|
|» can_push|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the deploy key can push to the project's repository.|
|» expires_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Date when the deploy key expires. If omitted, the deploy key does not expire.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-discussions">Discussions</h1>

Use this API to manage [discussions](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/discussions/). This includes
[comments, threads](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/discussions/), and system notes about changes to an object
(for example, when a milestone changes).

To manage label notes, use the [resource label events API](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/resource_label_events/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/">External documentation</a>

## List all discussions for an issue

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesNoteableIdDiscussions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues/0/discussions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues/{noteable_id}/discussions`

## Create a commit discussion

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdRepositoryCommitsNoteableIdDiscussions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/repository/commits/string/discussions \

  -d '{
    "body": "string",
    "created_at": "string",
    "position": {
      "base_sha": "string",
      "start_sha": "string",
      "head_sha": "string",
      "position_type": "text",
      "new_path": "string",
      "new_line": 0,
      "old_path": "string",
      "old_line": 0,
      "width": 0,
      "height": 0,
      "x": 0,
      "y": 0
    }
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/repository/commits/{noteable_id}/discussions`

Creates a discussion for a specified commit. Replies can be added to it later.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "body": "string",
  "created_at": "string",
  "position": {
    "base_sha": "string",
    "start_sha": "string",
    "head_sha": "string",
    "position_type": "text",
    "new_path": "string",
    "new_line": 0,
    "old_path": "string",
    "old_line": 0,
    "width": 0,
    "height": 0,
    "x": 0,
    "y": 0
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-commit-discussion-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|noteable_id|path|string|true|ID of the commit.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdRepositoryCommitsNoteableIdDiscussionsRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidrepositorycommitsnoteableiddiscussionsrequest)|true|none|
|» body|body|string \| null|true|Content of the note or reply.|
|» created_at|body|string \| null|false|Date and time the note was created, in ISO 8601 format such as `2016-03-11T03:45:40Z`. Requires administrator or project/group owner rights.|
|» position|body|object \| null|false|Position when creating a note|
|» » base_sha|body|string \| null|true|Base commit SHA in the source branch|
|» » start_sha|body|string \| null|true|SHA referencing commit in target branch|
|» » head_sha|body|string \| null|true|SHA referencing HEAD of this merge request|
|» » position_type|body|string|true|Type of the position reference|
|» » new_path|body|string \| null|false|File path after change|
|» » new_line|body|integer \| null|false|Line number after change|
|» » old_path|body|string \| null|false|File path before change|
|» » old_line|body|integer \| null|false|Line number before change|
|» » width|body|integer \| null|false|Width of the image|
|» » height|body|integer \| null|false|Height of the image|
|» » x|body|integer \| null|false|X coordinate in the image|
|» » y|body|integer \| null|false|Y coordinate in the image|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » position_type|text|
|» » position_type|image|
|» » position_type|file|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-draft-notes">Draft notes</h1>

Use this API to manage draft notes. These notes are pending, unpublished comments on merge requests.
Draft notes can start a discussion, or continue an existing discussion as a reply.

Before publishing, draft notes are visible only to the author.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/draft_notes/">External documentation</a>

## List all merge request draft notes

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidDraftNotes"></a>

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

Lists all merge request draft notes.

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-enterprise-users">Enterprise users</h1>

Use this API to manage the [enterprise users](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/enterprise_user/) of a
top-level group, including disabling two-factor authentication for them.

These endpoints work only for top-level groups, and require the Owner role for that group. The users
themselves do not have to be members of the group.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_enterprise_users/">External documentation</a>

## List all enterprise users

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdEnterpriseUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/enterprise_users \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/enterprise_users`

Lists all enterprise users for a specified top-level group. Use the `page` and `per_page` pagination parameters to filter the results.

<h3 id="list-all-enterprise-users-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|username|query|string \| null|false|Return a user with the given username.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return users with a matching name, email, or username. Use partial values to increase results.|
|active|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only active users.|
|blocked|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only blocked users.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return users created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return users created on or before the specified time.|
|two_factor|query|string \| null|false|Filter users by two-factor authentication (2FA). Filter values are `enabled` or `disabled`. By default it returns all users.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

## Delete an enterprise user

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4GroupsIdEnterpriseUsersUserId"></a>


`DELETE /api/v4/groups/{id}/enterprise_users/{user_id}`

Deletes a specified enterprise user.

<h3 id="delete-an-enterprise-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|user_id|path|integer|true|ID of the user.|
|hard_delete|query|boolean|false|If `true`, deletes the user, their associated contributions, and any groups owned solely by the user. If `false`, deletes the user and moves their contributions to a [ghost user](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/profile/account/delete_account/#associated-records).|

<h3 id="delete-an-enterprise-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Resource deleted|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

`PATCH /api/v4/groups/{id}/enterprise_users/{user_id}`

Updates a specified enterprise user.

```json

  "name": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "projects_limit": 0,
  "can_create_group": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-enterprise-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|body|body|[patchApiV4GroupsIdEnterpriseUsersUserIdRequest](#schemapatchapiv4groupsidenterpriseusersuseridrequest)|false|none|

|» projects_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of projects the user can create.|
|» can_create_group|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the user can create groups.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-environments">Environments</h1>

Use this API to interact with [GitLab environments](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/environments/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/">External documentation</a>

## List all environments

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdEnvironments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/environments \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/environments`

Lists all environments for a specified project.

<h3 id="list-all-environments-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|name|query|string \| null|false|Return the environment with this name. Mutually exclusive with `search`.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return list of environments matching the search criteria. Must be at least 3 characters. Mutually exclusive with `name`.|
|states|query|string \| null|false|Filter environments by state. If omitted, returns all environments.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|states|stopped|
|states|stopping|
|states|available|

## Create an environment

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdEnvironments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/environments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "external_url": "string",
    "tier": "production",
    "cluster_agent_id": 0,
    "kubernetes_namespace": "string",
    "flux_resource_path": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "auto_stop_setting": "always"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/environments`

Creates an environment for a specified project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "external_url": "string",
  "tier": "production",
  "cluster_agent_id": 0,
  "kubernetes_namespace": "string",
  "flux_resource_path": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "auto_stop_setting": "always"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-environment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdEnvironmentsRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidenvironmentsrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the environment.|
|» external_url|body|string \| null|false|URL to link to for the environment.|
|» tier|body|string \| null|false|Tier of the environment.|
|» cluster_agent_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the cluster agent to associate with the environment. When updating an environment, set to `null` to remove it.|
|» kubernetes_namespace|body|string \| null|false|Kubernetes namespace to associate with the environment. When updating an environment, set to `null` to remove it.|
|» flux_resource_path|body|string \| null|false|Flux resource path to associate with the environment, for example `helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2/namespaces/gitlab-agent/helmreleases/gitlab-agent`. When updating an environment, set to `null` to remove it.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the environment.|
|» auto_stop_setting|body|string \| null|false|Auto stop setting for the environment.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» tier|production|
|» tier|staging|
|» tier|testing|
|» tier|development|
|» tier|other|
|» auto_stop_setting|always|
|» auto_stop_setting|with_action|

## Update an existing environment

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdEnvironmentsEnvironmentId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/environments/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "external_url": "string",
    "tier": "production",
    "cluster_agent_id": 0,
    "kubernetes_namespace": "string",
    "flux_resource_path": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "auto_stop_setting": "always"
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/environments/{environment_id}`

Updates an existing environment for a project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "external_url": "string",
  "tier": "production",
  "cluster_agent_id": 0,
  "kubernetes_namespace": "string",
  "flux_resource_path": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "auto_stop_setting": "always"
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-existing-environment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|environment_id|path|integer|true|ID of the environment.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdEnvironmentsEnvironmentIdRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidenvironmentsenvironmentidrequest)|false|none|
|» external_url|body|string \| null|false|New URL to link to for the environment.|
|» tier|body|string \| null|false|Tier of the environment.|
|» cluster_agent_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the cluster agent to associate with the environment. When updating an environment, set to `null` to remove it.|
|» kubernetes_namespace|body|string \| null|false|Kubernetes namespace to associate with the environment. When updating an environment, set to `null` to remove it.|
|» flux_resource_path|body|string \| null|false|Flux resource path to associate with the environment, for example `helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2/namespaces/gitlab-agent/helmreleases/gitlab-agent`. When updating an environment, set to `null` to remove it.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the environment.|
|» auto_stop_setting|body|string \| null|false|Auto stop setting for the environment.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» tier|production|
|» tier|staging|
|» tier|testing|
|» tier|development|
|» tier|other|
|» auto_stop_setting|always|
|» auto_stop_setting|with_action|

## Schedule multiple stopped review apps for deletion

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4ProjectsIdEnvironmentsReviewApps"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/environments/review_apps \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/projects/{id}/environments/review_apps`

Schedules multiple stopped review apps for deletion. The deletion is performed after 1 week. By default, only environments 30 days or older are deleted.

<h3 id="schedule-multiple-stopped-review-apps-for-deletion-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|before|query|string(date-time)|false|Date before which environments can be deleted. Defaults to 30 days ago.|
|limit|query|integer|false|Maximum number of environments to delete.|
|dry_run|query|boolean|false|If `true`, performs a dry run where no deletion is actually performed. If `false`, deletes the environment.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "deploy",
  "slug": "deploy",
  "external_url": "https://deploy.gitlab.example.com",
  "created_at": "2019-05-25T18:55:13.252Z",
  "updated_at": "2019-05-25T18:55:13.252Z"
}
```

<h3 id="schedule-multiple-stopped-review-apps-for-deletion-responses">Responses</h3>

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesEnvironmentBasic](#schemaapientitiesenvironmentbasic)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|
|409|Conflict|Conflict|None|

http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

```bash
  -d '{

  }'
```

## Stop stale environments

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdEnvironmentsStopStale"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/environments/stop_stale \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/environments/stop_stale`

Stops all environments that were last modified or deployed to before a specified date. Excludes protected environments.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "before": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<h3 id="stop-stale-environments-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdEnvironmentsStopStaleRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidenvironmentsstopstalerequest)|true|none|
|» before|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|Stop environments that were modified or deployed to before the specified date. Valid inputs are between 10 years ago and 1 week ago.|

<h3 id="stop-stale-environments-responses">Responses</h3>

|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|None|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-epics">Epics</h1>

> [!warning]
> The Epics REST API was [deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/460668) in GitLab 17.0
> and is planned for removal in v5 of the API. From GitLab 17.4 to 18.0, if
> [the new look for epics](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/epics/#epics-as-work-items) is enabled,
> or in GitLab 18.1 and later, use the Work Items API instead. For more information, see
> [migrate epic APIs to work items](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/graphql/epic_work_items_api_migration_guide/).
> This change is a breaking change.

Use this API to manage [epics](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/epics/), the issues assigned to
them, their child and [related epics](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/epics/linked_epics/), and
[group epic boards](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/epics/epic_boards/).

Every call to this API must be authenticated. If a user is not a member of a private group, a `GET`
request on that group results in a `404` status code.

Epics are available only in GitLab [Premium and Ultimate](https://about.gitlab.com/pricing/). If the
Epics or Related Epics feature is not available, a `403` status code is returned.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_epic_boards/">External documentation</a>

## List all related epic links for a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdRelatedEpicLinks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/1/related_epic_links \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/related_epic_links`

Lists all related epic links for a specified group and its subgroups. The user needs to have access to both the `source_epic` and `target_epic` to view the related epic link.

<h3 id="list-all-related-epic-links-for-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return related epic links updated on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return related epic links updated on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return related epic links created on or before the specified time.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return related epic links created on or after the specified time.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

## Create a related epic link

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdEpicsEpicIidRelatedEpics"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/1/epics/1/related_epics \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "target_group_id": "1",
    "target_epic_iid": 1,
    "link_type": "relates_to"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/epics/{epic_iid}/related_epics`

Creates a two-way relation between two epics. The user must have the Guest, Planner, Reporter, Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role for both groups.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "target_group_id": "1",
  "target_epic_iid": 1,
  "link_type": "relates_to"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-related-epic-link-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|epic_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the epic.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdEpicsEpicIidRelatedEpicsRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidepicsepiciidrelatedepicsrequest)|true|none|
|» target_group_id|body|string \| null|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the target group.|
|» target_epic_iid|body|integer \| null|true|Internal ID of the target group's epic.|
|» link_type|body|string \| null|false|Type of the relation. Defaults to `relates_to`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» link_type|relates_to|
|» link_type|blocks|
|» link_type|is_blocked_by|

## List all epic boards in a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdEpicBoards"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/1/epic_boards \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/epic_boards`

Lists all epic boards for a specified group. This feature was introduced in GitLab 15.9.

<h3 id="list-all-epic-boards-in-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Team Board",
    "hide_backlog_list": false,
    "hide_closed_list": true,
    "group": {
      "id": 0,
      "web_url": "http://gitlab.example.com/groups/diaspora",
      "name": "Diaspora"
    },
    "labels": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "bug",
        "description": "Bug reported by user",
        "text_color": "#FFFFFF",
        "description_html": "<p>Bug reported by user</p>",
        "color": "#FF0000",
        "archived": false
      }
    ],
    "lists": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "label": {
          "id": 1,
          "name": "bug",
          "description": "Bug reported by user",
          "text_color": "#FFFFFF",
          "description_html": "<p>Bug reported by user</p>",
          "color": "#FF0000",
          "archived": false
        },
        "position": 1,
        "list_type": "backlog"
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

## List all group epics

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdEpics"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/epics \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/epics`

Lists all epics for a specified group and its subgroups. Responses are paginated and return 20 results by default.

<h3 id="list-all-group-epics-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Search epics for text present in the title or description.|
|state|query|string|false|Filter epics by state.|
|author_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return epics authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`.|
|author_username|query|string \| null|false|Return epics authored by the given username. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.|
|labels|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names. Label names from the epic group or a parent group can be used.|
|with_labels_details|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response returns more details for each label in the labels field: `name`, `color`, `description`, `description_html`, `text_color`.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return epics created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return epics created on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return epics updated on or after the specified time.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return epics updated on or before the specified time.|
|include_ancestor_groups|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes epics from the requested group's ancestors.|
|include_descendant_groups|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes epics from the requested group's descendants.|
|my_reaction_emoji|query|string \| null|false|Return epics reacted to by the authenticated user with the given emoji. `None` returns epics with no reaction and `Any` returns epics with at least one reaction.|
|confidential|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only confidential epics. If `false`, returns only non-confidential epics.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|not|query|object \| null|false|Return epics that do not match the specified parameters.|
|not[labels]|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names.|
|not[author_id]|query|integer \| null|false|Return epics not authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`.|
|not[author_username]|query|string \| null|false|Return epics not authored by the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`.|

|order_by|created_at|
|order_by|updated_at|
|order_by|title|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|
|state|opened|
|state|closed|
|state|all|

## Create a new epic

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdDashEpics"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/(-/)epics' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "title": "My Epic",
    "description": "Epic description",
    "color": "#1068bf",
    "confidential": true,
    "created_at": "2016-03-11T03:45:40Z",
    "start_date": "2018-07-31",
    "start_date_fixed": "2018-07-31",
    "start_date_is_fixed": true,
    "end_date": "2019-08-11",
    "due_date_fixed": "2019-08-11",
    "due_date_is_fixed": true,
    "labels": [
      "string"
    ],
    "parent_id": 12
```

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdDashEpicsEpicIidIssuesIssueId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/1/(-/)epics/5/issues/{epic_issue_id}' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/(-/)epics/{epic_iid}/issues/{epic_issue_id}`

Adds a specified issue to an epic. If the issue already belongs to another epic, it is removed from the original epic.

<h3 id="add-an-issue-to-an-epic-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer \| string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|epic_iid|path|integer \| string|true|Internal ID of the epic.|
|issue_id|path|integer \| string|true|ID of the issue.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-error-tracking">Error tracking</h1>

and client keys for a project.

These endpoints require the Maintainer or Owner role.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/error_tracking/">External documentation</a>

```json
  "active": true,
  "integrated": true
}
```

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-events">Events</h1>

Use this API to review event activity for a user, a project, or an instance. Events cover a wide
range of actions, such as joining a project, commenting on an issue, pushing changes to a merge
request, or closing an epic.

Activity is subject to retention limits. For more information, see the
[user activity time period limit](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/profile/contributions_calendar/#event-time-period-limit)
and the [project activity time period limit](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/working_with_projects/#view-project-activity).

These endpoints have some limitations:

- Some epic features, such as child items, linked items, start dates, due dates, and health statuses, are not returned.
- Some merge request notes use the `DiscussionNote` type instead, which is [not supported](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#understand-note-types-in-the-api).
- Bulk push events, created when a push exceeds the [push event activities limit](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/settings/push_event_activities_limit/), are returned with limited details.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/events/">External documentation</a>

## List all visible events for a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdEvents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/events \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/events`

Lists all visible events for a specified project. When a push exceeds the Push event activities limit, a single bulk push event is returned instead of individual commit events. Bulk push events have limited commit details: `commit_count` is `0`, `ref_count` shows the number of refs pushed, and individual commit attributes are `null`.

<h3 id="list-all-visible-events-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|action|query|string \| null|false|Filter events by the specified [action type](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/profile/contributions_calendar/#user-contribution-events).|
|target_type|query|string \| null|false|Filter events by target type.|
|before|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return events created before the specified date.|
|after|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return events created after the specified date.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order by creation date.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|
|target_type|issue|
|target_type|milestone|
|target_type|merge_request|
|target_type|note|
|target_type|project|
|target_type|snippet|
|target_type|user|
|target_type|wiki|
|target_type|design|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

## Retrieve contribution events for a user

<a id="opIdgetApiV4UsersIdEvents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/users/string/events \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/users/{id}/events`

Retrieves the contribution events for a specified user. Does not return events associated with epics or merge requests. Returns bulk push events with limited commit details.

<h3 id="retrieve-contribution-events-for-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or username of the user.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|action|query|string \| null|false|Filter events by the specified [action type](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/profile/contributions_calendar/#user-contribution-events).|
|target_type|query|string \| null|false|Filter events by target type.|
|before|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return events created before the specified date.|
|after|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return events created after the specified date.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order by creation date.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|target_type|issue|
|target_type|milestone|
|target_type|merge_request|
|target_type|note|
|target_type|project|
|target_type|snippet|
|target_type|user|
|target_type|wiki|
|target_type|design|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-experiments">Experiments</h1>

Use this API to retrieve the A/B experiments running on an instance. This API is for internal use
only, requires you to be a [GitLab team member](https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-com/-/group_members),
and cannot be used with anonymous or unauthenticated users. For experiments involving anonymous users,
use the [`glex_force` query parameter](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/experiment_guide/implementing_experiments/#client-side-glex_force-query-parameter)
instead.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/experiments/">External documentation</a>

## List all experiments

<a id="opIdgetApiV4Experiments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/experiments \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/experiments`

Lists all experiments on the GitLab instance. Each experiment has an `enabled` status that indicates whether the experiment is enabled globally, or only in specific contexts.

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "key": "code_quality_walkthrough",
    "context": [
      "user"
    ],
    "definition": {
      "name": "string",
      "feature_issue_url": "string",
      "introduced_by_url": "string",
      "rollout_issue_url": "string",
      "milestone": "string",
      "log_state_changes": true,
      "type": "string",
      "group": "string",
      "default_enabled": true,
      "intended_to_rollout_by": "string"
    },
    "current_status": {
      "state": "on",
      "gates": {
        "key": "percentage_of_actors",
        "value": 34
      }
    }
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-experiments-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<h3 id="list-all-experiments-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesExperiment](#schemaapientitiesexperiment)]|false|none|none|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Delete cached assignments for an experiment

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4ExperimentsNameCache"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/experiments/string/cache \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/experiments/{name}/cache`

Removes all cached variant assignments for the experiment with the given cache key. Useful for cleaning up completed experiments whose code has been removed from the codebase.

<h3 id="delete-cached-assignments-for-an-experiment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|Cache key of the experiment to clear.|

<h3 id="delete-cached-assignments-for-an-experiment-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|No Content|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Get current variant assignment for an experiment context

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ExperimentsExperimentNameAssignments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/experiments/string/assignments \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/experiments/{experiment_name}/assignments`

Returns the currently cached variant assignment for the given experiment and context. Defaults to current user if no context is provided.

<h3 id="get-current-variant-assignment-for-an-experiment-context-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|experiment_name|path|string|true|The experiment name|
|context|query|object \| null|false|Context parameters (user, namespace, project). Pass every key the experiment declares in `context_keys`. Experiments can declare multiple keys. An actor context is resolved from the user. The user defaults to the current user.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "experiment": "lightweight_trial_registration_redesign",
  "variant": "candidate",
  "context_key": "abc123def456",
  "cached": true
}
```

<h3 id="get-current-variant-assignment-for-an-experiment-context-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesExperimentsAssignment](#schemaapientitiesexperimentsassignment)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Force a variant assignment for an experiment context

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ExperimentsExperimentNameAssignments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/experiments/string/assignments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "variant": "string",
    "context": {}
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/experiments/{experiment_name}/assignments`

Forces a specific variant assignment for the given experiment and context. The assignment is stored in Redis cache and will persist until overwritten. Defaults to current user if no context is provided.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "variant": "string",
  "context": {}
}
```

<h3 id="force-a-variant-assignment-for-an-experiment-context-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|experiment_name|path|string|true|The experiment name|
|body|body|[postApiV4ExperimentsExperimentNameAssignmentsRequest](#schemapostapiv4experimentsexperimentnameassignmentsrequest)|true|none|
|» variant|body|string \| null|true|Variant name to assign, for example `control` or `candidate`.|
|» context|body|object \| null|false|Context parameters (user, namespace, project). An actor context is resolved from the user. Defaults to current user.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "experiment": "lightweight_trial_registration_redesign",
  "variant": "candidate",
  "context_key": "abc123def456",
  "cached": true
}
```

<h3 id="force-a-variant-assignment-for-an-experiment-context-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesExperimentsAssignment](#schemaapientitiesexperimentsassignment)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Clear a variant assignment for an experiment context

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4ExperimentsExperimentNameAssignments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/experiments/string/assignments \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/experiments/{experiment_name}/assignments`

Removes the cached variant assignment for the given experiment and context, returning the actor to normal rollout assignment. Defaults to current user if no context is provided.

<h3 id="clear-a-variant-assignment-for-an-experiment-context-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|experiment_name|path|string|true|The experiment name|
|context|query|object \| null|false|Context parameters (user, namespace, project). An actor context is resolved from the user. Defaults to current user.|

|---|---|---|---|

|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-external-status-checks">External status checks</h1>

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/status_checks/">External documentation</a>

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/external_status_checks`

```bash
      0
    ]
```

## Update status of an external status check

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidStatusCheckResponses"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/1/merge_requests/1/status_check_responses \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "external_status_check_id": 1,
    "sha": "5957a570eee0ac4580ec027fb874ad7514d1e576",
    "status": "passed"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/status_check_responses`

Updates the status of an external status check for a specified merge request, informing GitLab that a merge request has passed a check by an external service. To set the status of an external check, the personal access token used must belong to a user with the Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role on the target project of the merge request. Any user with permission to approve the merge request can use this operation.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "external_status_check_id": 1,
  "sha": "5957a570eee0ac4580ec027fb874ad7514d1e576",
  "status": "passed"
}
```

<h3 id="update-status-of-an-external-status-check-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidStatusCheckResponsesRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidmergerequestsmergerequestiidstatuscheckresponsesrequest)|true|none|
|» external_status_check_id|body|integer \| null|true|ID of the external status check.|
|» sha|body|string \| null|true|SHA at `HEAD` of the source branch.|
|» status|body|string|true|Status of the check.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|passed|
|» status|failed|
|» status|pending|

## Retry failed status check for a merge request

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidStatusChecksExternalStatusCheckIdRetry"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/1/merge_requests/1/status_checks/0/retry \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/status_checks/{external_status_check_id}/retry`

Retries a specified failed external status check for a merge request. Even though the merge request has not changed, this endpoint resends the current state of merge request to the defined external service.

<h3 id="retry-failed-status-check-for-a-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|external_status_check_id|path|integer|true|ID of the failed external status check.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|Accepted|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-feature-flags">Feature flags</h1>

Use this API to manage a project's [feature flags](https://docs.gitlab.com/operations/feature_flags/)
and the [user lists](https://docs.gitlab.com/operations/feature_flags/#user-list) that scope them to
particular users.

These endpoints require the Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/feature_flag_user_lists/">External documentation</a>

Creates a feature flag user list in a specified project.

```json
{
  "name": "string",

}
```

<h3 id="create-a-feature-flag-user-list-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-features">Features</h1>

Use this API to manage the Flipper-based feature flags used in the development of GitLab itself.

These endpoints support only boolean and percentage-of-time gate values, and require administrator
authorization.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/features/">External documentation</a>

## List all feature flags

<a id="opIdgetApiV4Features"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/features \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/features`

Lists all feature flags for the instance.

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "name": "experimental_feature",
    "state": "off",
    "gates": {
      "key": "percentage_of_actors",
      "value": 34
    },
    "definition": {
      "name": "string",
      "feature_issue_url": "string",
      "introduced_by_url": "string",
      "rollout_issue_url": "string",
      "milestone": "string",
      "log_state_changes": true,
      "type": "string",
      "group": "string",
      "default_enabled": true,
      "intended_to_rollout_by": "string"
    }
  }
]
```

## Create or update a feature flag

<a id="opIdpostApiV4FeaturesName"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/features/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "value": "string",
    "key": "percentage_of_actors",
    "feature_group": "string",
    "user": "string",
    "group": "string",
    "namespace": "string",
    "project": "string",
    "organization": "string",
    "repository": "string",
    "runner": "string",
    "endpoint": "string",
    "force": true
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/features/{name}`

Creates or updates a feature flag value. If a feature with the given name doesn't exist yet, the operation creates one. The value can be a boolean or an integer to indicate percentage of time.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "value": "string",
  "key": "percentage_of_actors",
  "feature_group": "string",
  "user": "string",
  "group": "string",
  "namespace": "string",
  "project": "string",
  "organization": "string",
  "repository": "string",
  "runner": "string",
  "endpoint": "string",
  "force": true
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-update-a-feature-flag-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|path|string|true|Name of the feature flag.|
|body|body|[postApiV4FeaturesNameRequest](#schemapostapiv4featuresnamerequest)|true|none|
|» value|body|string \| null \| integer \| null|true|Value to set for the feature flag. Use `true` or `false` to enable or disable it, or an integer for the percentage of time it should be enabled.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» key|body|string \| null|false|Rollout strategy for a percentage `value`. Omit it to apply the percentage to time. Mutually exclusive with `feature_group`, `user`, `group`, `namespace`, `project`, `organization`, `repository`, `runner`, `endpoint`.|
|» feature_group|body|string \| null|false|Name of the feature group. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|» user|body|string \| null|false|GitLab username or a comma-separated list of usernames. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|» group|body|string \| null|false|GitLab group path, for example `gitlab-org`, or a comma-separated list of group paths. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|» namespace|body|string \| null|false|GitLab group or user namespace path, for example `john-doe`, or a comma-separated list of namespace paths. Introduced in GitLab 15.0. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|» project|body|string \| null|false|Project path, for example `gitlab-org/gitlab-foss`, or a comma-separated list of project paths. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|» organization|body|string \| null|false|Organization ID or path, for example `1` or `default`, or a comma-separated list of organization IDs or paths. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|» repository|body|string \| null|false|Repository path, for example `gitlab-org/gitlab-test.git`, `gitlab-org/gitlab-test.wiki.git`, or `snippets/21.git`. Use commas to separate multiple repository paths. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|» runner|body|string \| null|false|Runner ID or a comma-separated list of runner IDs. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|» endpoint|body|string \| null|false|Caller ID identifying a code path, for example `GET /api/v4/projects/:id` or `ProjectsController#show`. Use a comma to separate multiple endpoint paths. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|» force|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, skips feature flag validation checks, such as a YAML definition.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» key|percentage_of_actors|
|» key|percentage_of_time|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "name": "experimental_feature",
  "state": "off",
  "gates": {
    "key": "percentage_of_actors",
    "value": 34
  },
  "definition": {
    "name": "string",
    "feature_issue_url": "string",
    "introduced_by_url": "string",
    "rollout_issue_url": "string",
    "milestone": "string",
    "log_state_changes": true,
    "type": "string",
    "group": "string",
    "default_enabled": true,
    "intended_to_rollout_by": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-update-a-feature-flag-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesFeature](#schemaapientitiesfeature)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Retrieve file blame history from a repository

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdRepositoryFilesFilePathBlame"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/gitlab-org%2Fgitlab/repository/files/lib%252Fclass%252Erb/blame?ref=main&range%5Bstart%5D=1&range%5Bend%5D=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/repository/files/{file_path}/blame`

Retrieves blame history for a specified file in a repository. Each blame range contains lines and their corresponding commit information. This endpoint is rate-limited for each authenticated user for a given project, and for each IP address for unauthenticated requests. On GitLab Self-Managed and GitLab Dedicated, an administrator can change these limits in the application settings.

<h3 id="retrieve-file-blame-history-from-a-repository-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|file_path|path|string|true|URL-encoded full path to the file, for example `lib%2Fclass%2Erb`.|
|ref|query|string \| null|true|Commit SHA or name of a repository branch or tag.|
|range|query|object \| null|false|Range of lines to return blame information for.|
|range[start]|query|integer|true|First line number of the range to blame.|
|range[end]|query|integer|true|Last line number of the range to blame.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "commit": {
    "id": "2695effb5807a22ff3d138d593fd856244e155e7",
    "parent_ids": [
      "2a4b78934375d7f53875269ffd4f45fd83a84ebe"
    ],
    "message": "Initial commit",
    "authored_date": "2012-05-28T04:42:42-07:00",
    "author_name": "John Smith",
    "author_email": "john@example.com",
    "committed_date": "2012-05-28T04:42:42-07:00",
    "committer_name": "Jack Smith",
    "committer_email": "jack@example.com"
  },
  "lines": [
    "lorem ipsum"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-file-blame-history-from-a-repository-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesBlameRange](#schemaapientitiesblamerange)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-glql">GLQL</h1>

Use this API to execute [GitLab Query Language (GLQL)](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/glql/) queries
programmatically. GLQL provides a simplified query language to search and filter
[GitLab resources](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/glql/#supported-areas) such as issues, merge requests,
and epics across projects and groups.

The group or project must allow access to its data. For private groups and projects, you must
authenticate with a [personal access token](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/profile/personal_access_tokens/)
that has the appropriate permissions.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/glql/">External documentation</a>

## Execute a GLQL query

<a id="opIdpostApiV4Glql"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/glql \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "glql_yaml": "string",
    "after": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/glql`

Executes a GLQL query to search and filter GitLab resources.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "glql_yaml": "string",
  "after": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="execute-a-glql-query-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4GlqlRequest](#schemapostapiv4glqlrequest)|true|none|
|» glql_yaml|body|string \| null|true|GLQL query that may include YAML configuration. Maximum size is 10,000 bytes. See [query formats](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/glql/#query-formats) for details.|
|» after|body|string \| null|false|Cursor for pagination. Use the `data.pageInfo.endCursor` value from a previous query to fetch the next page of results.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "count": 42,
    "nodes": [],
    "pageInfo": {
      "endCursor": "eyJpZCI6IjE3In0",
      "hasNextPage": true,
      "hasPreviousPage": false,
      "startCursor": "eyJpZCI6IjE3In0"
    }
  },
  "error": "string",
  "fields": [
    {
      "key": "title",
      "label": "Title",
      "name": "title",
      "field": "title",
      "type": "dimension",
      "parameters": {
        "granularity": "weekly"
      }
    }
  ],
  "success": true
}
```

<h3 id="execute-a-glql-query-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesGlqlResult](#schemaapientitiesglqlresult)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too Many Requests|None|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal server error|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-geo">Geo</h1>

Use this API to manage [Geo sites](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/geo/). All of these
endpoints require administrator access.

> [!warning]
> The Geo Nodes endpoints are [deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/369140) and
> are planned for removal in v5 of the API. Use the
> [Geo Sites API](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/geo_sites/) instead. This change is a breaking change.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/geo_nodes/">External documentation</a>

## List all Geo sites

## Create a Geo site

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GeoSites"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo_sites \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "primary": false,
    "enabled": true,
    "name": "string",
    "url": "string",
    "internal_url": "string",
    "files_max_capacity": 10,
    "repos_max_capacity": 10,
    "verification_max_capacity": 10,
    "container_repositories_max_capacity": 2,
    "sync_object_storage": false,
    "selective_sync_type": "string",
    "selective_sync_shards": [
      "string"
    ],
    "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "selective_sync_organization_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
    "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
    "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0,
    "blob_download_timeout": 28800
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/geo_sites`

Creates a Geo site.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "primary": false,
  "enabled": true,
  "name": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "internal_url": "string",
  "files_max_capacity": 10,
  "repos_max_capacity": 10,
  "verification_max_capacity": 10,
  "container_repositories_max_capacity": 2,
  "sync_object_storage": false,
  "selective_sync_type": "string",
  "selective_sync_shards": [
    "string"
  ],
  "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "selective_sync_organization_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0,
  "blob_download_timeout": 28800
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-geo-site-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4GeoSitesRequest](#schemapostapiv4geositesrequest)|true|none|
|» primary|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the site is the primary Geo site.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the Geo site is enabled.|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|Unique identifier for the Geo site. Must match `geo_node_name` if it is set in `gitlab.rb`, otherwise it must match `external_url`.|
|» url|body|string \| null|true|User-facing URL of the Geo site.|
|» internal_url|body|string \| null|false|URL defined on the primary site that secondary sites use to contact it. Returns `url` if not set.|
|» files_max_capacity|body|integer|false|Maximum concurrency of LFS and attachment backfill for the secondary site.|
|» repos_max_capacity|body|integer|false|Maximum concurrency of repository backfill for the secondary site.|
|» verification_max_capacity|body|integer|false|Maximum concurrency of verification for the site.|
|» container_repositories_max_capacity|body|integer|false|Maximum concurrency of container repository sync for the site.|
|» sync_object_storage|body|boolean|false|If `true`, the secondary Geo site replicates blobs in object storage.|
|» selective_sync_type|body|string \| null|false|Limit syncing to only specific groups, or shards. Valid values: `"namespaces"`, `"shards"`, or `null`|
|» selective_sync_shards|body|[string]|false|Repository storages to sync projects from if `selective_sync_type` is `shards`.|
|» selective_sync_namespace_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of groups to sync if `selective_sync_type` is `namespaces`.|
|» selective_sync_organization_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of organizations to sync if `selective_sync_type` is `organizations`.|
|» minimum_reverification_interval|body|integer \| null|false|Interval, in days, after which verification expires and is repeated. Has no effect when set on a secondary site.|
|» checksum_mismatch_report_threshold|body|integer \| null|false|Number of consecutive checksum mismatches on a secondary site before it reports the resource to the primary for self-heal re-verification. Read from the secondary site, and has no effect when set on the primary.|
|» checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes|body|integer \| null|false|Minimum time, in minutes, between self-heal re-verification triggers for the same resource. The primary and each secondary site use their own value. Secondary sites use it to throttle re-reporting the same resource, and the primary uses it to throttle re-verifying an already-verified resource.|
|» blob_download_timeout|body|integer|false|Maximum time (in seconds) for blob downloads during Geo sync.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 0,
  "name": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "internal_url": "string",
  "primary": true,
  "enabled": true,
  "current": true,
  "files_max_capacity": 0,
  "repos_max_capacity": 0,
  "verification_max_capacity": 0,
  "container_repositories_max_capacity": 0,
  "selective_sync_type": "string",
  "selective_sync_shards": [],
  "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [],
  "selective_sync_organization_ids": [],
  "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
  "blob_download_timeout": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0,
  "sync_object_storage": true,
  "web_edit_url": "string",
  "web_geo_replication_details_url": "string",
  "_links": {
    "self": "string",
    "status": "string",
    "repair": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-geo-site-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesGeoSite](#schemaapientitiesgeosite)|
|400|Bad Request|Validation error|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>
