## Update a Geo site

<a id="opIdputApiV4GeoSitesId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo_sites/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "enabled": true,
    "name": "string",
    "url": "string",
    "internal_url": "string",
    "files_max_capacity": 0,
    "repos_max_capacity": 0,
    "verification_max_capacity": 0,
    "container_repositories_max_capacity": 0,
    "sync_object_storage": true,
    "selective_sync_type": "string",
    "selective_sync_shards": [
      "string"
    ],
    "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "selective_sync_organization_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
    "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
    "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0,
    "blob_download_timeout": 1
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/geo_sites/{id}`

Updates a specified Geo site.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "name": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "internal_url": "string",
  "files_max_capacity": 0,
  "repos_max_capacity": 0,
  "verification_max_capacity": 0,
  "container_repositories_max_capacity": 0,
  "sync_object_storage": true,
  "selective_sync_type": "string",
  "selective_sync_shards": [
    "string"
  ],
  "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "selective_sync_organization_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0,
  "blob_download_timeout": 1
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-geo-site-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|The ID of the site|
|body|body|[putApiV4GeoSitesIdRequest](#schemaputapiv4geositesidrequest)|false|none|
|» enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the Geo site is enabled.|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|Unique identifier for the Geo site. Must match `geo_node_name` if it is set in `gitlab.rb`, otherwise it must match `external_url`.|
|» url|body|string \| null|false|User-facing URL of the Geo site.|
|» internal_url|body|string \| null|false|URL defined on the primary site that secondary sites use to contact it. Returns `url` if not set.|
|» files_max_capacity|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum concurrency of LFS and attachment backfill for the secondary site.|
|» repos_max_capacity|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum concurrency of repository backfill for the secondary site.|
|» verification_max_capacity|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum concurrency of verification for the site.|
|» container_repositories_max_capacity|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum concurrency of container repository sync for the site.|
|» sync_object_storage|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the secondary Geo site replicates blobs in object storage.|
|» selective_sync_type|body|string \| null|false|Limit syncing to only specific groups, or shards. Valid values: `"namespaces"`, `"shards"`, or `null`|
|» selective_sync_shards|body|[string]|false|Repository storages to sync projects from if `selective_sync_type` is `shards`.|
|» selective_sync_namespace_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of groups to sync if `selective_sync_type` is `namespaces`.|
|» selective_sync_organization_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of organizations to sync if `selective_sync_type` is `organizations`.|
|» minimum_reverification_interval|body|integer \| null|false|Interval, in days, after which verification expires and is repeated. Has no effect when set on a secondary site.|
|» checksum_mismatch_report_threshold|body|integer \| null|false|Number of consecutive checksum mismatches on a secondary site before it reports the resource to the primary for self-heal re-verification. Read from the secondary site, and has no effect when set on the primary.|
|» checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes|body|integer \| null|false|Minimum time, in minutes, between self-heal re-verification triggers for the same resource. The primary and each secondary site use their own value. Secondary sites use it to throttle re-reporting the same resource, and the primary uses it to throttle re-verifying an already-verified resource.|
|» blob_download_timeout|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum time (in seconds) for blob downloads during Geo sync.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 0,
  "name": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "internal_url": "string",
  "primary": true,
  "enabled": true,
  "current": true,
  "files_max_capacity": 0,
  "repos_max_capacity": 0,
  "verification_max_capacity": 0,
  "container_repositories_max_capacity": 0,
  "selective_sync_type": "string",
  "selective_sync_shards": [],
  "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [],
  "selective_sync_organization_ids": [],
  "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
  "blob_download_timeout": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0,
  "sync_object_storage": true,
  "web_edit_url": "string",
  "web_geo_replication_details_url": "string",
  "_links": {
    "self": "string",
    "status": "string",
    "repair": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-geo-site-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesGeoSite](#schemaapientitiesgeosite)|
|400|Bad Request|400 Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|404 GeoSite Not Found|None|

<h3 id="retrieve-a-geo-site-status-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesGeoSiteStatus](#schemaapientitiesgeositestatus)|
|400|Bad Request|400 Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|404 GeoSite Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Repair a Geo site

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GeoSitesIdRepair"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo_sites/0/repair \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/geo_sites/{id}/repair`

Repairs the OAuth authentication of a Geo site if there is an OAuth synchronization problem between the primary or secondary Geo sites.

<h3 id="repair-a-geo-site-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|The ID of the site|

|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesGeoSiteStatus](#schemaapientitiesgeositestatus)|

</aside>

## List all Geo nodes

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GeoNodes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo_nodes \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/geo_nodes`

Lists all Geo nodes for the instance.

<h3 id="list-all-geo-nodes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 0,
    "name": "string",
    "url": "string",
    "internal_url": "string",
    "primary": true,
    "enabled": true,
    "current": true,
    "files_max_capacity": 0,
    "repos_max_capacity": 0,
    "verification_max_capacity": 0,
    "container_repositories_max_capacity": 0,
    "selective_sync_type": "string",
    "selective_sync_shards": [],
    "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [],
    "selective_sync_organization_ids": [],
    "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
    "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
    "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0,
    "sync_object_storage": true,
    "clone_protocol": "string",
    "web_edit_url": "string",
    "web_geo_replication_details_url": "string",
    "_links": {
      "self": "string",
      "status": "string",
      "repair": "string"
    }
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-geo-nodes-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|400 Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|

<h3 id="list-all-geo-nodes-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesGeoNode](#schemaapientitiesgeonode)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Create a Geo node

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GeoNodes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo_nodes \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "primary": false,
    "enabled": true,
    "name": "string",
    "url": "string",
    "internal_url": "string",
    "files_max_capacity": 10,
    "repos_max_capacity": 10,
    "verification_max_capacity": 10,
    "container_repositories_max_capacity": 2,
    "sync_object_storage": false,
    "selective_sync_type": "string",
    "selective_sync_shards": [
      "string"
    ],
    "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "selective_sync_organization_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
    "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
    "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0
  }'
```

```json
  "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-geo-node-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4GeoNodesRequest](#schemapostapiv4geonodesrequest)|true|none|
|» primary|body|boolean|false|Specifying whether this node will be primary.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Specifying whether this node will be enabled.|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|Unique identifier for the Geo node. Must match `geo_node_name` if it is set in `gitlab.rb`, otherwise it must match `external_url`.|
|» url|body|string \| null|true|User-facing URL of the Geo node.|
|» internal_url|body|string \| null|false|URL defined on the primary node that secondary nodes use to contact it. Returns `url` if not set.|
|» files_max_capacity|body|integer|false|Control the maximum concurrency of LFS/attachment backfill for this secondary node.|
|» repos_max_capacity|body|integer|false|Control the maximum concurrency of repository backfill for this secondary node.|
|» verification_max_capacity|body|integer|false|Control the maximum concurrency of repository verification for this node.|
|» container_repositories_max_capacity|body|integer|false|Control the maximum concurrency of container repository sync for this node.|
|» sync_object_storage|body|boolean|false|Flag indicating if the secondary Geo node will replicate blobs in Object Storage.|
|» selective_sync_type|body|string \| null|false|Limit syncing to only specific groups or shards. Possible values are `namespaces`, `shards`, and `null`.|
|» selective_sync_shards|body|[string]|false|Repository storages to sync projects from if `selective_sync_type` is `shards`.|
|» selective_sync_namespace_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of groups to sync if `selective_sync_type` is `namespaces`.|
|» selective_sync_organization_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of organizations to sync if `selective_sync_type` is `organizations`.|
|» minimum_reverification_interval|body|integer \| null|false|Interval, in days, after which repository verification expires and is repeated. Has no effect when set on a secondary node.|
|» checksum_mismatch_report_threshold|body|integer \| null|false|Number of consecutive checksum mismatches on a secondary node before it reports the resource to the primary for self-heal re-verification. Read from the secondary node, and has no effect when set on the primary.|
|» checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes|body|integer \| null|false|Minimum time, in minutes, between self-heal re-verification triggers for the same resource. The primary and each secondary node use their own value. Secondary nodes use it to throttle re-reporting the same resource, and the primary uses it to throttle re-verifying an already-verified resource.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 0,
  "name": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "internal_url": "string",
  "primary": true,
  "enabled": true,
  "current": true,
  "files_max_capacity": 0,
  "repos_max_capacity": 0,
  "verification_max_capacity": 0,
  "container_repositories_max_capacity": 0,
  "selective_sync_type": "string",
  "selective_sync_shards": [],
  "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [],
  "selective_sync_organization_ids": [],
  "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0,
  "sync_object_storage": true,
  "clone_protocol": "string",
  "web_edit_url": "string",
  "web_geo_replication_details_url": "string",
  "_links": {
    "self": "string",
    "status": "string",
    "repair": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-geo-node-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesGeoNode](#schemaapientitiesgeonode)|
|400|Bad Request|Validation error|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## List all Geo node statuses

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GeoNodesStatus"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo_nodes/status \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

## Retrieve a single Geo node

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GeoNodesId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo_nodes/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/geo_nodes/{id}`

Retrieves a single Geo Node.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-single-geo-node-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|The ID of the node|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 0,
  "name": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "internal_url": "string",
  "primary": true,
  "enabled": true,
  "current": true,
  "files_max_capacity": 0,
  "repos_max_capacity": 0,
  "verification_max_capacity": 0,
  "container_repositories_max_capacity": 0,
  "selective_sync_type": "string",
  "selective_sync_shards": [],
  "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [],
  "selective_sync_organization_ids": [],
  "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0,
  "sync_object_storage": true,
  "clone_protocol": "string",
  "web_edit_url": "string",
  "web_geo_replication_details_url": "string",
  "_links": {
    "self": "string",
    "status": "string",
    "repair": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-a-single-geo-node-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesGeoNode](#schemaapientitiesgeonode)|
|400|Bad Request|400 Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|404 GeoNode Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Update a Geo node

<a id="opIdputApiV4GeoNodesId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo_nodes/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "enabled": true,
    "name": "string",
    "url": "string",
    "internal_url": "string",
    "files_max_capacity": 0,
    "repos_max_capacity": 0,
    "verification_max_capacity": 0,
    "container_repositories_max_capacity": 0,
    "sync_object_storage": true,
    "selective_sync_type": "string",
    "selective_sync_shards": [
      "string"
    ],
    "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "selective_sync_organization_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
    "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
    "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/geo_nodes/{id}`

Updates a specified Geo node.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "name": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "internal_url": "string",
  "files_max_capacity": 0,
  "repos_max_capacity": 0,
  "verification_max_capacity": 0,
  "container_repositories_max_capacity": 0,
  "sync_object_storage": true,
  "selective_sync_type": "string",
  "selective_sync_shards": [
    "string"
  ],
  "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "selective_sync_organization_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-geo-node-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|The ID of the node|
|body|body|[putApiV4GeoNodesIdRequest](#schemaputapiv4geonodesidrequest)|false|none|
|» enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the Geo node is enabled.|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|Unique identifier for the Geo node. Must match `geo_node_name` if it is set in `gitlab.rb`, otherwise it must match `external_url`.|
|» url|body|string \| null|false|User-facing URL of the Geo node.|
|» internal_url|body|string \| null|false|URL defined on the primary node that secondary nodes use to contact it. Returns `url` if not set.|
|» files_max_capacity|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum concurrency of LFS and attachment backfill for the secondary node.|
|» repos_max_capacity|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum concurrency of repository backfill for the secondary node.|
|» verification_max_capacity|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum concurrency of repository verification for the node.|
|» container_repositories_max_capacity|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum concurrency of container repository sync for the node.|
|» sync_object_storage|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the secondary Geo node replicates blobs in object storage.|
|» selective_sync_type|body|string \| null|false|Limit syncing to only specific groups or shards. Possible values are `namespaces`, `shards`, and `null`.|
|» selective_sync_shards|body|[string]|false|Repository storages to sync projects from if `selective_sync_type` is `shards`.|
|» selective_sync_namespace_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of groups to sync if `selective_sync_type` is `namespaces`.|
|» selective_sync_organization_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of organizations to sync if `selective_sync_type` is `organizations`.|
|» minimum_reverification_interval|body|integer \| null|false|Interval, in days, after which repository verification expires and is repeated. Has no effect when set on a secondary node.|
|» checksum_mismatch_report_threshold|body|integer \| null|false|Number of consecutive checksum mismatches on a secondary node before it reports the resource to the primary for self-heal re-verification. Read from the secondary node, and has no effect when set on the primary.|
|» checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes|body|integer \| null|false|Minimum time, in minutes, between self-heal re-verification triggers for the same resource. The primary and each secondary node use their own value. Secondary nodes use it to throttle re-reporting the same resource, and the primary uses it to throttle re-verifying an already-verified resource.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 0,
  "name": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "internal_url": "string",
  "primary": true,
  "enabled": true,
  "current": true,
  "files_max_capacity": 0,
  "repos_max_capacity": 0,
  "verification_max_capacity": 0,
  "container_repositories_max_capacity": 0,
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|400|Bad Request|400 Bad request|None|

</aside>

## Delete a Geo node

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4GeoNodesId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo_nodes/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/geo_nodes/{id}`

Deletes a specified Geo node.

<h3 id="delete-a-geo-node-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|The ID of the node|

<h3 id="delete-a-geo-node-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|204 No Content|None|
|400|Bad Request|400 Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|404 GeoNode Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Retrieve metrics for a Geo node

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GeoNodesIdStatus"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo_nodes/0/status \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/geo_nodes/{id}/status`

Retrieves metrics for a specified Geo node.

<h3 id="retrieve-metrics-for-a-geo-node-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|The ID of the node|
|refresh|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, fetches the latest status from the Geo node directly, ignoring the cache.|

<h3 id="retrieve-metrics-for-a-geo-node-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesGeoNodeStatus](#schemaapientitiesgeonodestatus)|
|400|Bad Request|400 Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|404 GeoNode Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Repair authentication of the Geo node

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GeoNodesIdRepair"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo_nodes/0/repair \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/geo_nodes/{id}/repair`

Repairs the OAuth authentication of a primary Geo node.

<h3 id="repair-authentication-of-the-geo-node-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|The ID of the node|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesGeoNodeStatus](#schemaapientitiesgeonodestatus)|
|400|Bad Request|400 Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|404 GeoNode Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Returns a Geo proxy response

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GeoProxy"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo/proxy \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/geo/proxy`

Determines if the current Geo site should proxy requests.

<h3 id="returns-a-geo-proxy-response-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Retrieve a replicable file

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GeoRetrieveReplicableNameReplicableId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo/retrieve/package_file/0 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/geo/retrieve/{replicable_name}/{replicable_id}`

Retrieves a replicable file for a Geo secondary site. Serves the file through a CDN or sendfile.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-replicable-file-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|replicable_name|path|string|true|Name of the replicable type, for example `package_file`.|
|replicable_id|path|integer|true|ID of the replicable.|

<h3 id="retrieve-a-replicable-file-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|404 Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## List all pipeline refs for a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GeoRepositoriesGlRepositoryPipelineRefs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo/repositories/string/pipeline_refs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/geo/repositories/{gl_repository}/pipeline_refs`

Lists all pipeline refs for a project. Secondary runners use them to check the site is up to date.

<h3 id="list-all-pipeline-refs-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|gl_repository|path|string|true|Repository to check.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "pipeline_refs": [
      "refs/pipelines/1"
    ]
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-pipeline-refs-for-a-project-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|404 Not found|None|

<h3 id="list-all-pipeline-refs-for-a-project-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesGeoPipelineRefs](#schemaapientitiesgeopipelinerefs)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Create a report of persistent verification failures

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GeoFailures"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/geo/failures \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "geo_node_id": 0,
    "failures": [
      {
        "error_type": "checksum_mismatch",
        "replicable_name": "upload",
        "replicable_id": 0,
        "verification_retry_count": 0,
        "context": {}
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/geo/failures`

Creates a report on the primary site of resources that persistently fail verification on a secondary site.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "geo_node_id": 0,
  "failures": [
    {
      "error_type": "checksum_mismatch",
      "replicable_name": "upload",
      "replicable_id": 0,
      "verification_retry_count": 0,
      "context": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-report-of-persistent-verification-failures-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4GeoFailuresRequest](#schemapostapiv4geofailuresrequest)|true|none|
|» geo_node_id|body|integer \| null|true|The Geo node ID of the reporting secondary|
|» failures|body|[object]|true|Persistent verification failures reported by the secondary|
|» » error_type|body|string \| null|true|The type of verification error being reported|
|» » replicable_name|body|string \| null|true|The replicable name of a replicator instance|
|» » replicable_id|body|integer \| null|true|The model record ID|
|» » verification_retry_count|body|integer \| null|true|The number of consecutive verification failures|
|» » context|body|object \| null|false|Additional error-type-specific data|

<h3 id="create-a-report-of-persistent-verification-failures-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

|404|Not Found|404 Not found|None|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-gitlab-duo">GitLab Duo</h1>

Use this API to generate responses for [GitLab Duo Chat](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/gitlab_duo_chat/)
and other GitLab Duo features.

On GitLab.com, these endpoints are for internal use only. On GitLab Self-Managed, you can enable them
[with a feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) named `access_rest_chat`.
You must be a [GitLab team member](https://gitlab.com/groups/gitlab-com/-/group_members) to use these endpoints.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/chat/">External documentation</a>

## Generate a Chat response

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ChatCompletions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/chat/completions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "content": "string",
    "resource_type": "issue",
    "resource_id": "string",
    "referer_url": "string",
    "client_subscription_id": "string",
    "with_clean_history": true,
    "project_id": 0,
    "current_file": {
      "file_name": "string",
      "content_above_cursor": "string",
      "content_below_cursor": "string",
      "selected_text": "string"
    },
    "additional_context": [
      {
        "category": "file",
        "id": "string",
        "content": "string",
        "metadata": {}
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/chat/completions`

Generates a response for a GitLab Duo Chat question.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "content": "string",
  "resource_type": "issue",
  "resource_id": "string",
  "referer_url": "string",
  "client_subscription_id": "string",
  "with_clean_history": true,
  "project_id": 0,
  "current_file": {
    "file_name": "string",
    "content_above_cursor": "string",
    "content_below_cursor": "string",
    "selected_text": "string"
  },
  "additional_context": [
    {
      "category": "file",
      "id": "string",
      "content": "string",
      "metadata": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="generate-a-chat-response-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4ChatCompletionsRequest](#schemapostapiv4chatcompletionsrequest)|true|none|
|» content|body|string \| null|true|Question sent to Chat.|
|» resource_type|body|string \| null|false|Type of resource sent with the chat question.|
|» resource_id|body|string \| null \| integer \| null|false|ID of the resource. Can be a numeric ID or a commit SHA.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» referer_url|body|string \| null|false|Referer URL.|
|» client_subscription_id|body|string \| null|false|Client subscription ID.|
|» with_clean_history|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, resets history before and after the request.|
|» project_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the project. Required when `resource_type` is `commit`.|
|» current_file|body|object \| null|false|Object that contains information about the current file.|
|» » file_name|body|string \| null|false|Name of the current file.|
|» » content_above_cursor|body|string \| null|false|Content above cursor.|
|» » content_below_cursor|body|string \| null|false|Content below cursor.|
|» » selected_text|body|string \| null|false|Content currently selected by the user.|
|» additional_context|body|[object]|false|Additional context to pass to the chat request. See [Context attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/chat/#context-attributes) for the parameters this attribute accepts.|
|» » category|body|string|true|Category of the additional context.|
|» » id|body|string \| null|true|ID of the additional context.|
|» » content|body|string \| null|true|Content of the additional context.|
|» » metadata|body|object \| null|false|Metadata of the additional context.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-gitlab-duo-workflows">GitLab Duo workflows</h1>

Use this API to create and manage [flows](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/duo_agent_platform/flows/) in the
[GitLab Duo Agent Platform](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/duo_agent_platform/).
Flows are combinations of AI agents that work together to complete developer tasks,
such as fixing bugs, writing code, or resolving vulnerabilities.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/duo_agent_platform_flows/">External documentation</a>

## Ingest AI audit events from Duo Workflow Service

<a id="opIdpostApiV4AiDuoWorkflowsWorkflowsIdAuditEvents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/ai/duo_workflows/workflows/0/audit_events \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "events": [
      {
        "id": "string",
        "type": "string",
        "source": "string",
        "time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "data": {}
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/ai/duo_workflows/workflows/{id}/audit_events`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "events": [
    {
      "id": "string",
      "type": "string",
      "source": "string",
      "time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "data": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="ingest-ai-audit-events-from-duo-workflow-service-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|ID of the workflow.|
|body|body|[postApiV4AiDuoWorkflowsWorkflowsIdAuditEventsRequest](#schemapostapiv4aiduoworkflowsworkflowsidauditeventsrequest)|true|none|
|» events|body|[object]|true|Array of CloudEvents v1.0 envelopes.|
|» » id|body|string \| null|true|ID of the CloudEvent, as a UUID.|
|» » type|body|string \| null|true|Type of the event, for example `ai_llm_input_sent`.|
|» » source|body|string \| null|true|CloudEvent source.|
|» » time|body|string(date-time) \| null|true|Event timestamp from the gateway.|
|» » data|body|object \| null|false|Event-specific payload.|

<h3 id="ingest-ai-audit-events-from-duo-workflow-service-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|Accepted|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Submit risk assessment results for a merge request

<a id="opIdpostApiV4AiDuoWorkflowsToolsRiskAssessmentResults"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/ai/duo_workflows/tools/risk_assessment/results \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "project_id": "string",
    "merge_request_iid": 0,
    "diff_sha": "string",
    "workflow_id": 0,
    "claims": [
      {
        "name": "string",
        "value": "string",
        "evidence": "string"
      }
    ],
    "summary": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/ai/duo_workflows/tools/risk_assessment/results`

Submits the categorical claims and summary produced by the risk assessment tool.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "project_id": "string",
  "merge_request_iid": 0,
  "diff_sha": "string",
  "workflow_id": 0,
  "claims": [
    {
      "name": "string",
      "value": "string",
      "evidence": "string"
    }
  ],
  "summary": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="submit-risk-assessment-results-for-a-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4AiDuoWorkflowsToolsRiskAssessmentResultsRequest](#schemapostapiv4aiduoworkflowstoolsriskassessmentresultsrequest)|true|none|
|» project_id|body|string \| null|true|The ID or path of the project|
|» merge_request_iid|body|integer \| null|true|The IID of the merge request|
|» diff_sha|body|string \| null|true|The full SHA of the diff revision the claims were assessed against|
|» workflow_id|body|integer \| null|true|ID of the Duo workflow session that produced these claims|
|» claims|body|[object]|true|Categorical claims about the merge request|
|» » name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the claim, for example authorization|
|» » value|body|string \| null|true|Categorical answer, for example true, false, or behavioral. Never a score.|
|» » evidence|body|string \| null|false|Where the claim was observed, as a path:line reference|
|» summary|body|string \| null|false|Plain-language explanation of the change and where its risk lies|

<h3 id="submit-risk-assessment-results-for-a-merge-request-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|No Content|None|
|400|Bad Request|Validation failed|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Create workflow persistence (agent-initiated, limited privileges)

<a id="opIdpostApiV4AiDuoWorkflowsAgentWorkflows"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/ai/duo_workflows/agent_workflows \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "project_id": "1",
    "namespace_id": "1",
    "ai_catalog_item_consumer_id": 1,
    "start_workflow": true,
    "goal": "Fix pipeline for merge request 1 in project 1",
    "workflow_definition": "software_developer",
    "allow_agent_to_request_user": true,
    "image": "registry.gitlab.com/gitlab-org/duo-workflow/custom-image:latest",
    "source_branch": "main",
    "environment": "ide",
    "ai_catalog_item_version_id": 1,
    "additional_context": [
      {
        "Category": "string",
        "Content": "string"
      }
    ],
    "issue_id": 123,
    "merge_request_id": 123
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/ai/duo_workflows/agent_workflows`

Accessible via ai_workflows scope token. Does not accept agent_privileges or pre_approved_agent_privileges.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "project_id": "1",
  "namespace_id": "1",
  "ai_catalog_item_consumer_id": 1,
  "start_workflow": true,
  "goal": "Fix pipeline for merge request 1 in project 1",
  "workflow_definition": "software_developer",
  "allow_agent_to_request_user": true,
  "image": "registry.gitlab.com/gitlab-org/duo-workflow/custom-image:latest",
  "source_branch": "main",
  "environment": "ide",
  "ai_catalog_item_version_id": 1,
  "additional_context": [
    {
      "Category": "string",
      "Content": "string"
    }
  ],
  "issue_id": 123,
  "merge_request_id": 123
}
```

<h3 id="create-workflow-persistence-agent-initiated-limited-privileges-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4AiDuoWorkflowsAgentWorkflowsRequest](#schemapostapiv4aiduoworkflowsagentworkflowsrequest)|false|none|
|» project_id|body|string \| null|false|ID or path of the project to associate the flow with.|
|» namespace_id|body|string \| null|false|ID or path of the namespace to associate the flow with.|
|» ai_catalog_item_consumer_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the AI Catalog item consumer that determines which catalog item to run. Requires `project_id`. If `workflow_definition` is also provided, `ai_catalog_item_consumer_id` takes precedence.|
|» start_workflow|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, starts the workflow in a CI pipeline. This feature is experimental.|
|» goal|body|string \| null|false|Goal of the workflow.|
|» workflow_definition|body|string \| null|false|Workflow type based on its capability.|
|» allow_agent_to_request_user|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, Duo Agent Platform may stop to ask the user questions before proceeding. If `false`, Duo Agent Platform runs through the workflow without asking for user input. Defaults to `true`.|
|» image|body|string \| null|false|Container image to use for running the workflow in CI pipeline.|
|» source_branch|body|string \| null|false|Source branch for the CI pipeline. Defaults to the project's default branch.|
|» environment|body|string \| null|false|Environment for the workflow.|
|» ai_catalog_item_version_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the AI Catalog item version that sourced the flow configuration used by the workflow.|
|» additional_context|body|[object]|false|Additional context for the flow. Each element is an object with at least `Category` and `Content` keys. `Content` is a JSON-serialized string.|
|» » Category|body|string \| null|true|Category of the context detail.|
|» » Content|body|string \| null|true|Content of the context detail.|
|» issue_id|body|integer \| null|false|Internal ID of the issue that the workflow is associated with. Requires `project_id`.|
|» merge_request_id|body|integer \| null|false|Internal ID of the merge request that the workflow is associated with. Requires `project_id`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» environment|ide|
|» environment|web|
|» environment|chat_partial|
|» environment|chat|
|» environment|ambient|
|» environment|external|

<h3 id="create-workflow-persistence-agent-initiated-limited-privileges-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|None|
|400|Bad Request|Validation failed|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## List all workflow checkpoints

<a id="opIdgetApiV4AiDuoWorkflowsWorkflowsIdCheckpoints"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/ai/duo_workflows/workflows/0/checkpoints \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/ai/duo_workflows/workflows/{id}/checkpoints`

Lists all checkpoints associated with a specific workflow.

<h3 id="list-all-workflow-checkpoints-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|ID of the workflow.|
|accept_compressed|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns compressed checkpoints.|
|checkpoint_ns|query|string \| null|false|Only return checkpoints belonging to this LangGraph checkpoint namespace (the flow's own top-level lineage if omitted or blank). Unset (the default): return checkpoints from every lineage, unfiltered, preserving prior behavior.|
|channels|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated channels to return in each checkpoint's channel_values, at most 100, each 1 to 255 characters. Omit to return every channel.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": "string",
    "thread_ts": "string",
    "parent_ts": "string",
    "checkpoint_ns": "string",
    "checkpoint": "string",
    "compressed_checkpoint": "string",
    "checkpoint_writes": [
      {
        "id": "string",
        "thread_ts": "string",
        "task": "string",
        "idx": "string",
        "channel": "string",
        "write_type": "string",
        "data": "string"
      }
    ],
    "current_thread": "string",
    "metadata": "string"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-workflow-checkpoints-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<h3 id="list-all-workflow-checkpoints-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesAiDuoWorkflowsCheckpoint](#schemaapientitiesaiduoworkflowscheckpoint)]|false|none|none|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

## Create workflow checkpoint

<a id="opIdpostApiV4AiDuoWorkflowsWorkflowsIdCheckpoints"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/ai/duo_workflows/workflows/0/checkpoints \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "thread_ts": "string",
    "parent_ts": "string",
    "checkpoint_ns": "string",
    "checkpoint": {},
    "compressed_checkpoint": "string",
    "metadata": {},
```

<h3 id="create-workflow-checkpoint-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|ID of the workflow.|
|body|body|[postApiV4AiDuoWorkflowsWorkflowsIdCheckpointsRequest](#schemapostapiv4aiduoworkflowsworkflowsidcheckpointsrequest)|true|none|
|» thread_ts|body|string \| null|true|LangGraph `thread_ts` of the checkpoint.|
|» parent_ts|body|string \| null|false|The parent ts|
|» checkpoint_ns|body|string \| null|false|LangGraph checkpoint namespace this checkpoint belongs to. Omitted (or blank) for the flow's own top-level checkpoint lineage. Set to LangGraph's namespace string for one nested subgraph invocation, for example a delegated subagent dispatched by `DelegationNode`.|
|» checkpoint|body|object \| null|false|Checkpoint content|
|» compressed_checkpoint|body|string \| null|false|Checkpoint content zlib compressed and base64 encoded|
|» metadata|body|object \| null|true|Checkpoint metadata.|
|» model_metadata_json|body|string \| null|false|JSON string of the model metadata.|
|» flow_metadata_json|body|string \| null|false|JSON string of the flow metadata.|
|» current_thread|body|integer|false|Hint used to group blobs by thread during checkpoint reconstruction.|
|» channel_keys|body|[string]|false|Live channel membership of the checkpoint.|
|» channel_blobs|body|[object]|false|Per-channel blobs for incremental checkpoint storage.|
|» » channel|body|string \| null|true|Name of the channel.|
|» » version|body|string \| null|true|Version of the channel.|
|» » write_type|body|string \| null|true|Blob serialization type. The read path decodes zlib-compressed JSON, so producers must send "json".|
|» » step_action|body|string|true|Whether the blob is appended to the stored channel data (`conversation`) or replaces it (`compaction`).|
|» » data|body|string \| null|true|Base64-encoded blob bytes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » step_action|conversation|
|» » step_action|compaction|

## Request Duo Workflows server-side execution connection details

<a id="opIdpostApiV4AiDuoWorkflowsWorkflowsWorkflowIdExecute"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/ai/duo_workflows/workflows/1/execute \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "project_id": "1",
    "namespace_id": "1",
    "root_namespace_id": "1",
    "ai_catalog_item_version_id": 1,
    "client_type": "browser",
    "user_selected_model_identifier": "claude_sonnet_4_5",
    "detached": true
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/ai/duo_workflows/workflows/{workflow_id}/execute`

Workhorse pre-authorization endpoint. Returns the connection details Workhorse needs to run the flow itself over gRPC and stream the actions it receives back to the caller, for callers that cannot execute actions of their own. Requests must arrive through Workhorse.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "project_id": "1",
  "namespace_id": "1",
  "root_namespace_id": "1",
  "ai_catalog_item_version_id": 1,
  "client_type": "browser",
  "user_selected_model_identifier": "claude_sonnet_4_5",
  "detached": true
}
```

<h3 id="request-duo-workflows-server-side-execution-connection-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|workflow_id|path|string|true|The ID of the workflow to execute|
|body|body|[postApiV4AiDuoWorkflowsWorkflowsWorkflowIdExecuteRequest](#schemapostapiv4aiduoworkflowsworkflowsworkflowidexecuterequest)|false|none|
|» project_id|body|string \| null|false|ID or path of the project to associate the flow with.|
|» namespace_id|body|string \| null|false|ID or path of the namespace to associate the flow with.|
|» root_namespace_id|body|string \| null|false|The ID of the root namespace|
|» ai_catalog_item_version_id|body|integer \| null|false|The ID of the AI Catalog ItemVersion that sourced the flow config used by the workflow.|
|» client_type|body|string \| null|false|The type of client starting the session|
|» user_selected_model_identifier|body|string \| null|false|Identifier of the model the user selected for this session|
|» detached|body|boolean \| null|false|When true, asks Workhorse to answer once the run has started and keep it going after the request ends.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-gitlab-pages">GitLab Pages</h1>

Use this API to [administer](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/pages/) and
[use](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/pages/) GitLab Pages, including managing
[custom domains](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/pages/custom_domains_ssl_tls_certification/).

GitLab Pages must be enabled to use these endpoints.

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-gitlab-subscriptions">GitLab subscriptions</h1>

Use this API to create and update the [subscription](https://docs.gitlab.com/subscriptions/) attached
to a namespace.

## Update the subscription for the namespace

<a id="opIdputApiV4NamespacesIdGitlabSubscription"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/namespaces/string/gitlab_subscription \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "start_date": "1970-01-01",
    "end_date": "1970-01-01",
    "plan_code": "string",
    "seats": 0,
    "max_seats_used": 0,
    "auto_renew": true,
    "trial": true,
    "trial_ends_on": "1970-01-01",
    "trial_starts_on": "1970-01-01",
    "trial_extension_type": 0
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/namespaces/{id}/gitlab_subscription`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Deprecated in GitLab 17.7

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "start_date": "1970-01-01",
  "end_date": "1970-01-01",
  "plan_code": "string",
  "seats": 0,
  "max_seats_used": 0,
  "auto_renew": true,
  "trial": true,
  "trial_ends_on": "1970-01-01",
  "trial_starts_on": "1970-01-01",
  "trial_extension_type": 0
}
```

<h3 id="update-the-subscription-for-the-namespace-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the namespace.|
|body|body|[putApiV4NamespacesIdGitlabSubscriptionRequest](#schemaputapiv4namespacesidgitlabsubscriptionrequest)|false|none|
|» start_date|body|string(date) \| null|false|Start date of the subscription.|
|» end_date|body|string(date) \| null|false|End date of the subscription.|
|» plan_code|body|string \| null|false|Subscription tier code.|
|» seats|body|integer \| null|false|Number of seats in the subscription.|
|» max_seats_used|body|integer \| null|false|Highest number of active users in the last month.|
|» auto_renew|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the subscription automatically renews on its end date.|
|» trial|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the subscription is a trial.|
|» trial_ends_on|body|string(date) \| null|false|End date of the trial.|
|» trial_starts_on|body|string(date) \| null|false|Start date of the trial.|
|» trial_extension_type|body|integer \| null|false|Type of trial extension. `1` means the trial was extended, and `2` means it was reactivated.|

```json
}
```

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-group-credentials-inventory">Group credentials inventory</h1>

Use this API to manage the credentials that members of a top-level group hold, including their
personal access tokens, resource access tokens, and SSH keys. You can list these credentials, revoke
them, and rotate the tokens. For more information, see
[credentials inventory](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/credentials_inventory/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/groups/">External documentation</a>

## List all personal access tokens for a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdManagePersonalAccessTokens"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/manage/personal_access_tokens \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/manage/personal_access_tokens`

Lists all personal access tokens associated with enterprise users in a top-level group. This feature was introduced in GitLab 17.8.

<h3 id="list-all-personal-access-tokens-for-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|revoked|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, only returns revoked tokens. If `false`, only returns tokens that are not revoked.|
|state|query|string \| null|false|Return tokens with the specified state.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return tokens created on or before the specified time.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return tokens created on or after the specified time.|
|last_used_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return tokens last used on or before the specified time.|
|last_used_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return tokens last used on or after the specified time.|
|expires_before|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return tokens that expire before the specified date.|
|expires_after|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return tokens that expire on or after the specified date.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return tokens that include the specified value in their name.|
|sort|query|string \| null|false|Sort results by the specified field and direction. Possible values are `created_asc`, `created_desc`, `expires_asc`, `expires_desc`, `last_used_asc`, `last_used_desc`, `name_asc`, and `name_desc`.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|state|all|
|state|active|
|state|inactive|

<h3 id="list-all-personal-access-tokens-for-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Rotate a personal access token for an enterprise user

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdManagePersonalAccessTokensPatIdRotate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/manage/personal_access_tokens/0/rotate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "expires_at": "2021-01-31"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/manage/personal_access_tokens/{pat_id}/rotate`

Rotates a specified personal access token for an enterprise user associated with the top-level group. This revokes the previous token and creates a token that expires after one week.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "expires_at": "2021-01-31"
}
```

<h3 id="rotate-a-personal-access-token-for-an-enterprise-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|pat_id|path|integer|true|ID of the personal access token.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdManagePersonalAccessTokensPatIdRotateRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidmanagepersonalaccesstokenspatidrotaterequest)|false|none|
|» expires_at|body|string(date) \| null|false|Date when the access token expires. If omitted, the new token expires one week after rotation when [token expiry is enforced](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/profile/personal_access_tokens/#access-token-expiration), and does not expire otherwise. When expiry is enforced, the date must be no more than one year after rotation.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": 2,
  "name": "John Doe",
  "revoked": true,
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "description": "Token to manage api",
  "scopes": [
    "api"
  ],
  "user_id": 3,
  "last_used_at": "2020-08-31T15:53:00.073Z",
  "last_used_ips": [
    "127.0.0.1",
    "127.0.0.2",
    "127.0.0.3"
  ],
  "granular_scopes": [
    {
      "access": "personal_projects",
      "permissions": [
        "read_job"
      ],
      "project_id": 3,
      "group_id": 5
    }
  ],
  "active": true,
  "granular": true,
  "expires_at": "2020-08-31T15:53:00.073Z",
  "token": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="rotate-a-personal-access-token-for-an-enterprise-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesPersonalAccessTokenWithToken](#schemaapientitiespersonalaccesstokenwithtoken)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/manage/resource_access_tokens/0/rotate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "expires_at": "2021-01-31"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/manage/resource_access_tokens/{prat_id}/rotate`

Rotates a specified group or project access token associated with a top-level group. This revokes the previous token and creates a new token.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "expires_at": "2021-01-31"
}
```

<h3 id="rotate-a-group-or-project-access-token-for-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|prat_id|path|integer|true|ID of the resource access token.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdManageResourceAccessTokensPratIdRotateRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidmanageresourceaccesstokenspratidrotaterequest)|false|none|
|» expires_at|body|string(date) \| null|false|Date when the access token expires. If omitted, the new token expires one week after rotation when [token expiry is enforced](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/profile/personal_access_tokens/#access-token-expiration), and does not expire otherwise. When expiry is enforced, the date must be no more than one year after rotation.|

http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-group-import-and-export">Group import and export</h1>

Use this API to [migrate a group structure](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/import/) by exporting
and importing a file. When you use it with the
[project import and export API](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_import_export/), you can
preserve relationships that span the group, such as connections between project issues and group
epics. Run the group export and import first, then import the project exports into the group
structure.

A group export includes group milestones, boards, labels, badges, members, events, wikis (Premium
and Ultimate only), and subgroups. Each subgroup includes all of the same data.

To preserve the member list and permissions of an imported group, make sure those users exist on the
destination instance before you import.

Because of [issue 405168](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/405168), imported groups have
a `private` visibility level unless you import them into a parent group. By default, groups imported
into a parent group inherit the visibility of the parent.

The destination instance uses the group relations export endpoints during
[group migration by direct transfer](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/import/). You don't
usually need to call them yourself. In this context, a relation is an exportable item such as an
epic, including any related items such as a label. These endpoints require your instance to meet certain
[prerequisites](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/import/direct_transfer_migrations/#prerequisites),
and can't be used with the file-based export and import endpoints.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_import_export/">External documentation</a>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-groups">Groups</h1>

Use this API to view and manage [groups](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/) and the resources they contain, including:

- Group settings, members, and security settings.
- [Group issues](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/issues/) and issue statistics.
- [Markdown uploads](https://docs.gitlab.com/security/user_file_uploads/) referenced in epics or wiki pages.
- Bulk [reassignment of placeholder users](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/import/mapping/reassignment/#request-reassignment-by-using-a-csv-file) after an import.

Endpoint responses might vary based on the [permissions](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/)
of the authenticated user in the group. If a user isn't a member of a private group, requests to
that group return a `404 Not Found` status code.

For project members, use the [project members API](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_members/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/groups/">External documentation</a>

## List all issues for a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdIssues"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/issues \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/issues`

Lists all issues for a specified group. If the group is private, you must provide credentials to authorize. In most cases, you should authenticate with a personal access token.

<h3 id="list-all-issues-for-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|with_labels_details|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response returns more details for each label in the labels field: `name`, `color`, `description`, `description_html`, `text_color`.|
|state|query|string|false|Filter issues by state.|
|closed_by_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues closed by the user with the given ID.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|due_date|query|string \| null|false|Return issues that have no due date, are overdue, or whose due date is this week, this month, or between two weeks ago and next month.|
|issue_type|query|string \| null|false|The type of the issue. Accepts: issue, incident, test_case, requirement, task, ticket|
|labels|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names. `None` means no labels are assigned. `Any` means at least one label is assigned. `No+Label` (deprecated) means no labels are assigned. Set to an empty string to unassign all labels. If a label does not already exist, this creates a new project label and assigns it to the issue. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|milestone|query|string \| null|false|Milestone title. `None` lists all issues with no milestone. `Any` lists all issues that have an assigned milestone. Support for `None` and `Any` is [planned for removal](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/336044). Use the `milestone_id` attribute instead. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_id`.|
|milestone_id|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to milestones with a given timebox value. `None` lists all issues with no milestone. `Any` lists all issues that have an assigned milestone. `Upcoming` lists all issues assigned to milestones due in the future. `Started` lists all issues assigned to open, started milestones. The logic for `Upcoming` and `Started` differs from the logic used in the [GraphQL API](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/milestones/#special-milestone-filters). Mutually exclusive with `milestone`.|
|iids|query|[integer]|false|Return only the issues having the given `iid`.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Search issues against their `title` and `description`.|
|in|query|string \| null|false|Modify the scope of the `search` attribute to `title`, `description`, or `title,description`. If omitted, defaults to `title,description`.|
|author_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues created by the given user ID. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`.|
|author_username|query|string \| null|false|Return issues created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.|
|assignee_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned issues and `Any` returns issues with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`.|
|assignee_username|query|[string]|false|Return issues assigned to the given username. In GitLab Community Edition, only a single value is accepted. Otherwise, an invalid parameter error is returned. When multiple usernames are given, only issues assigned to all of them are returned. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues created on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues updated on or after the specified time.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues updated on or before the specified time.|
|not|query|object \| null|false|Return issues that do not match the specified parameters.|
|not[labels]|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names.|
|not[milestone]|query|string \| null|false|Milestone title. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone_id]`.|
|not[milestone_id]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to milestones without the specified timebox value. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone]`.|
|not[iids]|query|[integer]|false|Internal IDs of issues to exclude.|
|not[author_id]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues not authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`.|
|not[author_username]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues not authored by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`.|
|not[assignee_id]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`.|
|not[assignee_username]|query|[string]|false|Return issues not assigned to the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`.|
|not[weight]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues that do not have the specified weight.|
|not[iteration_id]|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the iteration with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_title]`.|
|not[iteration_title]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the iteration with the given title. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_id]`.|
|scope|query|string \| null|false|Return issues for the given scope.|
|my_reaction_emoji|query|string \| null|false|Return issues reacted to by the authenticated user with the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues with no reaction and `Any` returns issues with at least one reaction.|
|confidential|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only confidential issues. If `false`, returns only public issues.|
|weight|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|The weight of the issue|
|epic_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues associated with the epic with the given ID. `None` returns issues that are not associated with an epic. `Any` returns issues that are associated with an epic. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|health_status|query|string \| null|false|The health status of the issue. Must be one of: on_track, needs_attention, at_risk, none, any|
|iteration_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the iteration with the given ID. `None` returns issues that do not belong to an iteration. `Any` returns issues that belong to an iteration. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_title`.|
|iteration_title|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the iteration with the given title. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_id`.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|non_archived|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only issues from non-archived projects. If `false`, returns issues from both archived and non-archived projects.|

|---|---|

|search|query|string \| null|false|Search issues against their `title` and `description`.|
|in|query|string \| null|false|Modify the scope of the `search` attribute to `title`, `description`, or `title,description`. If omitted, defaults to `title,description`.|
|author_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues created by the given user ID. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`.|
|author_username|query|string \| null|false|Return issues created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.|
|assignee_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned issues and `Any` returns issues with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`.|
|assignee_username|query|[string]|false|Return issues assigned to the given username. In GitLab Community Edition, only a single value is accepted. Otherwise, an invalid parameter error is returned. When multiple usernames are given, only issues assigned to all of them are returned. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues created on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues updated on or after the specified time.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues updated on or before the specified time.|
|not|query|object \| null|false|Return issues that do not match the specified parameters.|
|not[labels]|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names.|
|not[milestone]|query|string \| null|false|Milestone title. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone_id]`.|
|not[milestone_id]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to milestones without the specified timebox value. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone]`.|
|not[iids]|query|[integer]|false|Internal IDs of issues to exclude.|
|not[author_id]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues not authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`.|
|not[author_username]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues not authored by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`.|
|not[assignee_id]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`.|
|not[assignee_username]|query|[string]|false|Return issues not assigned to the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`.|
|not[weight]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues that do not have the specified weight.|
|not[iteration_id]|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the iteration with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_title]`.|
|not[iteration_title]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the iteration with the given title. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_id]`.|
|scope|query|string \| null|false|Return issues for the given scope.|
|my_reaction_emoji|query|string \| null|false|Return issues reacted to by the authenticated user with the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues with no reaction and `Any` returns issues with at least one reaction.|
|confidential|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only confidential issues. If `false`, returns only public issues.|
|weight|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|The weight of the issue|
|epic_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues associated with the epic with the given ID. `None` returns issues that are not associated with an epic. `Any` returns issues that are associated with an epic. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|health_status|query|string \| null|false|The health status of the issue. Must be one of: on_track, needs_attention, at_risk, none, any|
|iteration_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the iteration with the given ID. `None` returns issues that do not belong to an iteration. `Any` returns issues that belong to an iteration. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_title`.|
|iteration_title|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the iteration with the given title. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_id`.|

## List all groups

<a id="opIdgetApiV4Groups"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups`

Lists all visible groups for the authenticated user. Unauthenticated requests return only public groups.

<h3 id="list-all-groups-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|statistics|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes group statistics. Administrators only.|
|archived|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only archived groups or projects.|
|skip_groups|query|[integer]|false|Skip the specified group IDs.|
|all_available|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns all accessible groups. If `false`, returns only groups where the user is a member. When omitted, administrators receive all groups and other authenticated users receive only their own. Unauthenticated requests always return all public groups. The `owned` and `min_access_level` attributes take precedence.|
|visibility|query|string \| null|false|Return groups with the specified visibility.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return the list of authorized groups matching the search criteria.|
|owned|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only groups explicitly owned by the current user.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|min_access_level|query|integer \| null|false|Return groups where the current user has at least the specified access level. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|top_level_only|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only top-level groups, excluding subgroups.|
|marked_for_deletion_on|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return groups that are marked for deletion on this date. Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/429315) in GitLab 17.1.|
|active|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only groups that are not archived and not marked for deletion.|
|repository_storage|query|string \| null|false|Filter by repository storage used by the group. Administrators only. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|

|» mentions_disabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Disable a group from getting mentioned|

|» » » access_level|body|integer|true|A valid access level|

|» duo_foundational_flows_availability|body|boolean \| null|false|Enable GitLab foundational Duo flows for this group|
|» duo_custom_agents_availability|body|boolean \| null|false|Enable GitLab Duo custom agents for this group|
|» duo_custom_flows_availability|body|boolean \| null|false|Enable GitLab Duo custom flows for this group|

|» experiment_features_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Enable experiment features for this group|

|» » reference|body|string \| null|true|Reference of the foundational agent.|
|» » enabled|body|boolean \| null|true|Whether foundational agent has been enabled or disabled.|
|» ai_settings_attributes|body|object \| null|false|AI-related settings|
|» » duo_agent_platform_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Whether Duo Agent Platform features are enabled|
|» » duo_workflow_mcp_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Enable MCP support for Duo Agent Platform|
|» » ai_usage_data_collection_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Enable AI usage data collection for this namespace|
|» » ai_catalog_restricted_to_group_hierarchy|body|boolean \| null|false|Confine the AI Catalog to items within this top-level group hierarchy|
|» » web_search_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Allow web search in GitLab Duo Chat for this top-level group|
|» » foundational_agents_default_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Whether new foundational agents are enabled by default|
|» » prompt_injection_protection_level|body|string \| null|false|Prompt injection protection level. One of `no_checks`, `log_only` or `interrupt`|
|» » include_recommended_allowed|body|boolean \| null|false|Whether to include recommended domains in the network access allowlist|
|» » allow_all_unix_sockets|body|boolean \| null|false|Whether to allow all Unix sockets for network access|
|» » allow_project_extension|body|boolean \| null|false|Whether to allow projects to extend the network access domain allowlist|
|» » require_sandbox|body|boolean \| null|false|Whether flows that run on GitLab Runner fail when the execution environment sandbox is unavailable|

|» » minimum_access_level_execute_async|body|integer \| null|false|The minimum access level required to execute Duo Agent Platform features in CI/CD. This field is behind a feature flag.|

|» » minimum_access_level_enable_on_projects|body|integer \| null|false|The minimum access level required to enable Duo Agent Platform. This field is behind a feature flag.|

http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Retrieve a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}`

Retrieves a specified group by ID or path.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|
|with_projects|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes details of the projects that belong to the group. Deprecated and [scheduled for removal in API v5](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/213797). To list the projects in a group, use the List all projects in a group operation instead.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
