<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

`PUT /api/v4/groups/{id}`

## Schedule a group for deletion

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4GroupsId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/groups/{id}`

Schedules a group for deletion. Groups are deleted at the end of the retention period (30 days by default). Use the `permanently_remove` param to override the retention period.

<h3 id="schedule-a-group-for-deletion-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|

<h3 id="schedule-a-group-for-deletion-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|Accepted|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Restore a group

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdRestore"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/restore \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/restore`

Restores a specified group that was previously scheduled for deletion. Can not restore groups outside of the retention period (30 days by default).

<h3 id="restore-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/groups/shared`

|search|query|string \| null|false|Return the list of authorized groups matching the search criteria.|

## List all projects in a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdProjects"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/projects \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/projects`

Lists all projects in a specified group accessible to the authenticated user. Unauthenticated requests return only public projects with a limited subset of attributes.

<h3 id="list-all-projects-in-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|active|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns active projects. If `false`, returns projects that are archived or marked for deletion. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/218053) in GitLab 18.8.|
|archived|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only archived groups or projects.|
|visibility|query|string \| null|false|Return groups with the specified visibility.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return the list of authorized projects matching the search criteria.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|simple|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only limited fields for each project. Without authentication, only limited fields are returned regardless of this setting.|
|owned|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only groups explicitly owned by the current user.|
|starred|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects starred by the current user.|
|with_issues_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the issues feature enabled.|
|with_merge_requests_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the merge requests feature enabled.|
|with_shared|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes projects shared with the group.|
|include_subgroups|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes projects in subgroups of this group.|
|include_ancestor_groups|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes projects in the ancestors of this group.|
|min_access_level|query|integer \| null|false|Return projects where the current user has at least the specified access level. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|
|with_security_reports|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have security report artifacts present in any of their builds. Ultimate only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|visibility|private|
|visibility|internal|
|visibility|public|
|order_by|id|
|order_by|name|
|order_by|path|
|order_by|created_at|
|order_by|updated_at|
|order_by|last_activity_at|
|order_by|similarity|
|order_by|star_count|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|
|min_access_level|10|
|min_access_level|15|
|min_access_level|20|
|min_access_level|25|
|min_access_level|30|
|min_access_level|40|
|min_access_level|50|

## List all shared projects

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdProjectsShared"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/projects/shared \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/projects/shared`

Lists all projects shared with a specified group.

<h3 id="list-all-shared-projects-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|archived|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only archived groups or projects.|
|visibility|query|string \| null|false|Return groups with the specified visibility.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return the list of authorized projects matching the search criteria.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|simple|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only limited fields for each project. Without authentication, only limited fields are returned regardless of this setting.|
|starred|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects starred by the current user.|
|with_issues_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the issues feature enabled.|
|with_merge_requests_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the merge requests feature enabled.|
|min_access_level|query|integer \| null|false|Return projects where the current user has at least the specified access level. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|visibility|private|
|visibility|internal|
|visibility|public|
|order_by|id|
|order_by|name|
|order_by|path|
|order_by|created_at|
|order_by|updated_at|
|order_by|last_activity_at|
|order_by|star_count|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|
|min_access_level|10|
|min_access_level|15|
|min_access_level|20|
|min_access_level|25|
|min_access_level|30|
|min_access_level|40|
|min_access_level|50|

## List all subgroups

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdSubgroups"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/subgroups \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/subgroups`

Lists all subgroups for a specified group.

<h3 id="list-all-subgroups-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|statistics|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes group statistics. Administrators only.|
|archived|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only archived groups or projects.|
|skip_groups|query|[integer]|false|Skip the specified group IDs.|
|all_available|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns all accessible groups. If `false`, returns only groups where the user is a member. When omitted, administrators receive all groups and other authenticated users receive only their own. Unauthenticated requests always return all public groups. The `owned` and `min_access_level` attributes take precedence.|
|visibility|query|string \| null|false|Return groups with the specified visibility.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return the list of authorized groups matching the search criteria.|
|owned|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only groups explicitly owned by the current user.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|min_access_level|query|integer \| null|false|Return groups where the current user has at least the specified access level. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|top_level_only|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only top-level groups, excluding subgroups.|
|marked_for_deletion_on|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return groups that are marked for deletion on this date. Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/429315) in GitLab 17.1.|
|active|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only groups that are not archived and not marked for deletion.|
|repository_storage|query|string \| null|false|Filter by repository storage used by the group. Administrators only. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|

## List all descendant groups

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdDescendantGroups"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/descendant_groups \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/descendant_groups`

Lists all descendant groups for a specified group.

<h3 id="list-all-descendant-groups-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|statistics|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes group statistics. Administrators only.|
|archived|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only archived groups or projects.|
|skip_groups|query|[integer]|false|Skip the specified group IDs.|
|all_available|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns all accessible groups. If `false`, returns only groups where the user is a member. When omitted, administrators receive all groups and other authenticated users receive only their own. Unauthenticated requests always return all public groups. The `owned` and `min_access_level` attributes take precedence.|
|visibility|query|string \| null|false|Return groups with the specified visibility.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return the list of authorized groups matching the search criteria.|
|owned|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only groups explicitly owned by the current user.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|min_access_level|query|integer \| null|false|Return groups where the current user has at least the specified access level. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|top_level_only|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only top-level groups, excluding subgroups.|
|marked_for_deletion_on|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return groups that are marked for deletion on this date. Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/429315) in GitLab 17.1.|
|active|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only groups that are not archived and not marked for deletion.|
|repository_storage|query|string \| null|false|Filter by repository storage used by the group. Administrators only. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|

## Transfer a project to a group

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdProjectsProjectId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/projects/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/projects/{project_id}`

Transfers a specified project to another group. Administrators only.

<h3 id="transfer-a-project-to-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|project_id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|

## List all transfer locations for a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdTransferLocations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/transfer_locations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/transfer_locations`

Lists all groups that a specified source group can be transferred to.

<h3 id="list-all-transfer-locations-for-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Group name to search for.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

## Transfer a group

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdTransfer"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/transfer \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "group_id": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/transfer`

Transfers a group to another parent group or transforms a subgroup into a top-level group. You must be an administrator or have the Owner role for the group.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "group_id": 0
}
```

<h3 id="transfer-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdTransferRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidtransferrequest)|false|none|
|» group_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the new parent group. If omitted, the group becomes a top-level group.|

<h3 id="transfer-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Transfer a group to an organization

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdTransferToOrganization"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/transfer_to_organization \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "organization_id": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/transfer_to_organization`

Transfers a group to another organization asynchronously. Requires the Owner role.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "organization_id": 0
}
```

<h3 id="transfer-a-group-to-an-organization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdTransferToOrganizationRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidtransfertoorganizationrequest)|true|none|
|» organization_id|body|integer \| null|true|ID of the organization to transfer the group to.|

<h3 id="transfer-a-group-to-an-organization-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesGroupDetail](#schemaapientitiesgroupdetail)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Group or Organization not found|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Add a group to a group

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdShare"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/share \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "group_id": 0,
    "group_access": 5,
    "expires_at": "1970-01-01",
    "member_role_id": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/share`

Adds a group to a group.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "group_id": 0,
  "group_access": 5,
  "expires_at": "1970-01-01",
  "member_role_id": 0
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-group-to-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdShareRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidsharerequest)|true|none|
|» group_id|body|integer \| null|true|ID of the group to invite.|
|» group_access|body|integer|true|Access level to grant to the invited group. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|» expires_at|body|string(date) \| null|false|Date when the share expires.|
|» member_role_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of a [custom role](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/custom_roles/#assign-a-custom-role-to-an-invited-group) to assign to the invited group. If set, `group_access` must match the base role used to create the custom role.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» group_access|5|
|» group_access|10|
|» group_access|15|
|» group_access|20|
|» group_access|25|
|» group_access|30|
|» group_access|40|
|» group_access|50|

## Remove a group from a group

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4GroupsIdShareGroupId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/share/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/groups/{id}/share/{group_id}`

Removes a group from a group.

<h3 id="remove-a-group-from-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|group_id|path|integer|true|ID of the shared group.|

<h3 id="remove-a-group-from-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Resource deleted|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Remove a shared project from a group

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4GroupsIdSharedProjectsProjectId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/shared_projects/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/groups/{id}/shared_projects/{project_id}`

Removes a shared project targeting this group. The group Owner can remove a shared project without access to the source project.

<h3 id="remove-a-shared-project-from-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|project_id|path|integer|true|ID of the shared project.|

<h3 id="remove-a-shared-project-from-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|No Content|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Retrieve a group audit event

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdAuditEventsAuditEventId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/audit_events/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/audit_events/{audit_event_id}`

Retrieves an audit event for a specified group. Only available to group Owners and administrators.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-group-audit-event-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|audit_event_id|path|integer|true|ID of the audit event.|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 0,
  "author_id": 0,
  "entity_id": 0,
  "entity_type": "string",
  "event_name": "string",
  "details": {},
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-a-group-audit-event-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesAuditEvent](#schemaapientitiesauditevent)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## List all SAML users

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdSamlUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/saml_users \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/saml_users`

Lists all SAML users for a specified top-level group. Use the `page` and `per_page` pagination parameters to filter the results.

<h3 id="list-all-saml-users-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|query|string \| null|false|Return a user with the given username.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return users with a matching name, email, or username. Use partial values to increase results.|
|active|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only active users.|
|blocked|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only blocked users.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return users created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return users created on or before the specified time.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return users created on or before the specified time.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response


<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-hooks">Hooks</h1>

Use this API to manage the hooks that GitLab uses to notify external services about events:

- [Project webhooks](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/integrations/webhooks/) are limited to a single project.
- [Group webhooks](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/integrations/webhooks/#group-webhooks) apply to all projects and subgroups in a group.
- [System hooks](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/system_hooks/) apply to the entire instance.

You can also test a hook, inspect its event log, resend an event, and manage its custom headers and
URL variables.

Managing project webhooks requires administrator access or the Maintainer or Owner role for the
project. Managing group webhooks requires administrator access or the Owner role for the group.
Managing system hooks requires administrator access.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_webhooks/">External documentation</a>

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/hooks`

Creates a hook for a specified group. This endpoint has a rate limit of 10 requests per minute for each authenticated user for a given group. On GitLab Self-Managed and GitLab Dedicated, an administrator can change this limit in the application settings.

<h3 id="create-a-group-hook-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdHooksRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidhooksrequest)|true|none|
|» url|body|string \| null|true|Webhook URL.|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|Name of the group webhook. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/460887) in GitLab 17.1.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the group webhook. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/460887) in GitLab 17.1.|
|» push_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on push events.|
|» push_events_branch_filter|body|string \| null|false|Filter push events by branch name.|
|» issues_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on issue events.|
|» confidential_issues_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on confidential issue events.|
|» merge_requests_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on merge request events.|
|» tag_push_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on tag push events.|
|» note_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on note events.|
|» confidential_note_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on confidential note events.|
|» job_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on job events.|
|» pipeline_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on pipeline events.|
|» project_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on project events.|
|» wiki_page_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on wiki page events.|
|» deployment_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on deployment events.|
|» feature_flag_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on feature flag events.|
|» releases_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on release events.|
|» milestone_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on milestone events.|
|» subgroup_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on subgroup events.|
|» emoji_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on emoji events.|
|» resource_access_token_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on group and project access token expiry events.|
|» member_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on member events.|
|» vulnerability_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on vulnerability events.|
|» enable_ssl_verification|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, verifies the SSL certificate when the group webhook is triggered.|
|» token|body|string \| null|false|Secret token used to validate received payloads. Not returned in the response, and changing the webhook URL resets it.|
|» signing_token|body|string \| null|false|HMAC signing token used to compute the `webhook-signature` header. Must be in `whsec_<base64>` format encoding a 32-byte key, and is not returned in the response. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/231325) in GitLab 19.0.|
|» custom_webhook_template|body|string \| null|false|Custom template for the group webhook request payload.|
|» branch_filter_strategy|body|string \| null|false|Filter push events by branch. Defaults to `wildcard`.|
|» duo_flow_callback_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, allows Duo Agent Platform flows to send lifecycle and progress events to this group webhook. A flow must reference the webhook's ID as `callback_hook_id` when it starts. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/249149) in GitLab 19.4 [with a feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) named `duo_flow_callback_hooks`. Disabled by default.|
|» url_variables|body|[object]|false|URL variables for interpolation.|
|» » key|body|string \| null|true|Name of the variable.|
|» » value|body|string \| null|true|Value of the variable.|
|» custom_headers|body|[object]|false|Custom headers for the hook.|
|» » key|body|string \| null|true|Name of the header.|
|» » value|body|string \| null|true|Value of the header.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» branch_filter_strategy|wildcard|
|» branch_filter_strategy|regex|
|» branch_filter_strategy|all_branches|

|» vulnerability_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the group webhook on vulnerability events.|
|» enable_ssl_verification|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, verifies the SSL certificate when the group webhook is triggered.|
|» token|body|string \| null|false|Secret token used to validate received payloads. Not returned in the response, and changing the webhook URL resets it.|
|» signing_token|body|string \| null|false|HMAC signing token used to compute the `webhook-signature` header. Must be in `whsec_<base64>` format encoding a 32-byte key, and is not returned in the response. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/231325) in GitLab 19.0.|
|» custom_webhook_template|body|string \| null|false|Custom template for the group webhook request payload.|
|» branch_filter_strategy|body|string \| null|false|Filter push events by branch. Defaults to `wildcard`.|
|» duo_flow_callback_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, allows Duo Agent Platform flows to send lifecycle and progress events to this group webhook. A flow must reference the webhook's ID as `callback_hook_id` when it starts. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/249149) in GitLab 19.4 [with a feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) named `duo_flow_callback_hooks`. Disabled by default.|
|» url_variables|body|[object]|false|URL variables for interpolation.|
|» » key|body|string \| null|true|Name of the variable.|
|» » value|body|string \| null|true|Value of the variable.|
|» custom_headers|body|[object]|false|Custom headers for the hook.|
|» » key|body|string \| null|true|Name of the header.|
|» » value|body|string \| null|true|Value of the header.|

## Create a system hook

<a id="opIdpostApiV4Hooks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/hooks \
  -X POST \

  -d '{
    "url": "http://example.com/hook",
    "name": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "token": "string",
    "signing_token": "string",
    "push_events": true,
    "tag_push_events": true,
    "merge_requests_events": true,
    "repository_update_events": true,
    "enable_ssl_verification": true,
    "push_events_branch_filter": "string",
    "branch_filter_strategy": "wildcard",
    "custom_webhook_template": "string",
    "url_variables": [
      {
        "key": "token",
        "value": "123"
      }
    ],
    "custom_headers": [
      {
        "key": "X-Custom-Header",
        "value": "value"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/hooks`

Creates a system hook. This endpoint has a rate limit of five requests per minute for each authenticated user. On GitLab Self-Managed and GitLab Dedicated, an administrator can change this limit in the application settings.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "url": "http://example.com/hook",
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "token": "string",
  "signing_token": "string",
  "push_events": true,
  "tag_push_events": true,
  "merge_requests_events": true,
  "repository_update_events": true,
  "enable_ssl_verification": true,
  "push_events_branch_filter": "string",
  "branch_filter_strategy": "wildcard",
  "custom_webhook_template": "string",
  "url_variables": [
    {
      "key": "token",
      "value": "123"
    }
  ],
  "custom_headers": [
    {
      "key": "X-Custom-Header",
      "value": "value"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-system-hook-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4HooksRequest](#schemapostapiv4hooksrequest)|true|none|
|» url|body|string \| null|true|Webhook URL.|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|Name of the hook. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/460887) in GitLab 17.1.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the hook. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/460887) in GitLab 17.1.|
|» token|body|string \| null|false|Secret token used to validate received payloads. Not returned in the response, and changing the hook URL resets it.|
|» signing_token|body|string \| null|false|HMAC signing token used to compute the `webhook-signature` header. Must be in `whsec_<base64>` format encoding a 32-byte key, and is not returned in the response. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/231325) in GitLab 19.0.|
|» push_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the system hook on push events.|
|» tag_push_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the system hook on tag push events.|
|» merge_requests_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the system hook on merge request events.|
|» repository_update_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the system hook on repository update events.|
|» enable_ssl_verification|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, verifies the SSL certificate when the hook is triggered.|
|» push_events_branch_filter|body|string \| null|false|Filter push events by branch name.|
|» branch_filter_strategy|body|string \| null|false|Filter push events by branch. Defaults to `wildcard`.|
|» custom_webhook_template|body|string \| null|false|Custom template for the system hook request payload.|
|» url_variables|body|[object]|false|URL variables for interpolation.|
|» » key|body|string \| null|true|Name of the variable.|
|» » value|body|string \| null|true|Value of the variable.|
|» custom_headers|body|[object]|false|Custom headers for the hook.|
|» » key|body|string \| null|true|Name of the header.|
|» » value|body|string \| null|true|Value of the header.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» branch_filter_strategy|wildcard|
|» branch_filter_strategy|regex|
|» branch_filter_strategy|all_branches|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "url": "https://webhook.site",
  "name": "Hook name",
  "description": "Hook description",
  "created_at": "2012-05-28T04:42:42-07:00",
  "push_events": true,
  "tag_push_events": true,
  "merge_requests_events": true,
  "repository_update_events": true,
  "enable_ssl_verification": true,
  "organization_id": 1,
  "alert_status": "executable",

    }
  ],
  "push_events_branch_filter": "my-branch-*",
  "branch_filter_strategy": "wildcard",
  "custom_webhook_template": "{\"event\":\"{{object_kind}}\"}",
  "custom_headers": [
    {
      "X-Custom-Header": "value"
    }
  ],
  "token_present": false,
  "signing_token_present": false
}
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/hooks`

Adds a webhook to a specified project. This endpoint has a rate limit of five requests per minute for each authenticated user for a given project. On GitLab Self-Managed and GitLab Dedicated, an administrator can change this limit in the application settings.

> Body parameter

```json
  "url": "http://example.com/hook",
  "name": "string",
```

<h3 id="add-a-webhook-to-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdHooksRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidhooksrequest)|true|none|
|» url|body|string \| null|true|Webhook URL.|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|Name of the project webhook. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/460887) in GitLab 17.1.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the project webhook. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/460887) in GitLab 17.1.|
|» push_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on push events.|
|» issues_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on issue events.|
|» confidential_issues_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on confidential issue events.|
|» merge_requests_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on merge request events.|
|» tag_push_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on tag push events.|
|» note_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on note events.|
|» confidential_note_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on confidential note events.|
|» job_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on job events.|
|» pipeline_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on pipeline events.|
|» wiki_page_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on wiki page events.|
|» deployment_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on deployment events.|
|» feature_flag_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on feature flag events.|
|» releases_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on release events.|
|» milestone_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on milestone events.|
|» emoji_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on emoji events.|
|» resource_access_token_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on project access token expiry events.|
|» resource_deploy_token_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on project deploy token expiry events.|
|» enable_ssl_verification|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, verifies the SSL certificate when the webhook is triggered.|
|» token|body|string \| null|false|Secret token used to validate received payloads. Not returned in the response, and changing the webhook URL resets it.|
|» signing_token|body|string \| null|false|HMAC signing token used to compute the `webhook-signature` header. Must be in `whsec_<base64>` format encoding a 32-byte key, and is not returned in the response. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/231325) in GitLab 19.0.|
|» push_events_branch_filter|body|string \| null|false|Filter push events by branch name.|
|» custom_webhook_template|body|string \| null|false|Custom template for the webhook request payload.|
|» branch_filter_strategy|body|string \| null|false|Filter push events by branch. Defaults to `wildcard`.|
|» vulnerability_events|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers the project webhook on vulnerability events.|
|» duo_flow_callback_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, allows Duo Agent Platform flows to send lifecycle and progress events to this project webhook. A flow must reference the webhook's ID as `callback_hook_id` when it starts. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/249149) in GitLab 19.4 [with a feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) named `duo_flow_callback_hooks`. Disabled by default.|
|» url_variables|body|[object]|false|URL variables for interpolation.|
|» » key|body|string \| null|true|Name of the variable.|
|» » value|body|string \| null|true|Value of the variable.|
|» custom_headers|body|[object]|false|Custom headers for the hook.|
|» » key|body|string \| null|true|Name of the header.|
|» » value|body|string \| null|true|Value of the header.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» branch_filter_strategy|wildcard|
|» branch_filter_strategy|regex|
|» branch_filter_strategy|all_branches|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-imports">Imports</h1>

Use this API to migrate groups and projects by using
[direct transfer](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/import/direct_transfer_migrations/), and to
[import repositories from external sources](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/import/).

Before migrating by direct transfer, see the
[prerequisites](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/import/direct_transfer_migrations/#prerequisites).

> [!note]
> User contribution mapping is not supported when you import projects to a
> [personal namespace](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/namespace/#types-of-namespaces). All
> contributions are assigned to the personal namespace owner and cannot be reassigned.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/bulk_imports/">External documentation</a>

## Import GitHub gists into GitLab snippets

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ImportGithubGists"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/import/github/gists \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "personal_access_token": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/import/github/gists`

Imports personal GitHub gists into GitLab snippets. You can import gists with up to 10 files. GitHub gists with more than 10 files are skipped. You should manually migrate these GitHub gists. If any gists cannot be imported, an email is sent with a list of gists that were not imported.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "personal_access_token": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="import-github-gists-into-gitlab-snippets-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4ImportGithubGistsRequest](#schemapostapiv4importgithubgistsrequest)|true|none|
|» personal_access_token|body|string \| null|true|GitHub personal access token.|

<h3 id="import-github-gists-into-gitlab-snippets-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|Accepted|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable Entity|None|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too Many Requests|None|

## Start a group or project migration

<a id="opIdpostApiV4BulkImports"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/bulk_imports \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d 'configuration=%7B%22url%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22access_token%22%3A%22string%22%7D&entities=%5B%7B%22source_type%22%3A%22group_entity%22%2C%22source_full_path%22%3A%22'\''source%2Ffull%2Fpath'\''%20not%20'\''https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fsource%2Ffull%2Fpath'\''%22%2C%22destination_namespace%22%3A%22'\''destination_namespace'\''%20or%20'\''destination%2Fnamespace'\''%22%2C%22destination_slug%22%3A%22'\''destination_slug'\''%20not%20'\''destination%2Fslug'\''%22%2C%22destination_name%22%3A%22'\''destination_slug'\''%20not%20'\''destination%2Fslug'\''%22%2C%22migrate_projects%22%3Atrue%2C%22migrate_memberships%22%3Atrue%7D%5D'
```

`POST /api/v4/bulk_imports`

Starts a group or project migration. To migrate a project, specify `entities[project_entity]`.

> Body parameter

```yaml
configuration:
  url: string
  access_token: string
entities:
  -
    source_type: group_entity
    source_full_path: "'source/full/path' not 'https://example.com/source/full/path'"
    destination_namespace: "'destination_namespace' or 'destination/namespace'"
    destination_slug: "'destination_slug' not 'destination/slug'"
    destination_name: "'destination_slug' not 'destination/slug'"
    migrate_projects: true
    migrate_memberships: true
```

<h3 id="start-a-group-or-project-migration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4BulkImportsRequest](#schemapostapiv4bulkimportsrequest)|true|none|
|» configuration|body|object \| null|true|The source GitLab instance configuration|
|» » url|body|string \| null|true|Source GitLab instance URL|
|» » access_token|body|string \| null|true|Access token to the source GitLab instance|
|» entities|body|[object]|true|List of entities to import|
|» » source_type|body|string|true|Source entity type|
|» » source_full_path|body|string \| null|true|Relative path of the source entity to import|
|» » destination_namespace|body|string \| null|true|Destination namespace for the entity|
|» » destination_slug|body|string \| null|false|Destination slug for the entity|
|» » destination_name|body|string \| null|false|Deprecated: Use :destination_slug instead. Destination slug for the entity|
|» » migrate_projects|body|boolean|false|Indicates group migration should include nested projects|
|» » migrate_memberships|body|boolean|false|The option to migrate memberships or not|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » source_type|group_entity|
|» » source_type|project_entity|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "status": "finished",
  "source_type": "gitlab",
  "source_url": "https://source.gitlab.com/",
  "created_at": "2012-05-28T04:42:42-07:00",
  "updated_at": "2012-05-28T04:42:42-07:00",
  "has_failures": false
}
```

<h3 id="start-a-group-or-project-migration-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesBulkImport](#schemaapientitiesbulkimport)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|Service unavailable|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## List all failed import records for a migration entity

<a id="opIdgetApiV4BulkImportsImportIdEntitiesEntityIdFailures"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/bulk_imports/0/entities/0/failures \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/bulk_imports/{import_id}/entities/{entity_id}/failures`

Lists all failed import records for a group or project migration entity. This feature was introduced in GitLab 16.6.

<h3 id="list-all-failed-import-records-for-a-migration-entity-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|import_id|path|integer|true|ID of the GitLab Migration.|
|entity_id|path|integer|true|ID of the GitLab Migration entity.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "relation": "label",
  "exception_message": "error message",
  "exception_class": "Exception",
  "correlation_id_value": "dfcf583058ed4508e4c7c617bd7f0edd",
  "source_url": "https://source.gitlab.com/group/-/epics/1",
  "source_title": "title"
}
```

<h3 id="list-all-failed-import-records-for-a-migration-entity-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesBulkImportsEntityFailure](#schemaapientitiesbulkimportsentityfailure)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|Service unavailable|None|

## Cancel a migration

<a id="opIdpostApiV4BulkImportsImportIdCancel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/bulk_imports/0/cancel \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/bulk_imports/{import_id}/cancel`

Cancels a direct transfer migration. This feature was introduced in GitLab 17.1.

<h3 id="cancel-a-migration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|import_id|path|integer|true|ID of the GitLab Migration.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "status": "finished",
  "source_type": "gitlab",
  "source_url": "https://source.gitlab.com/",
  "created_at": "2012-05-28T04:42:42-07:00",
  "updated_at": "2012-05-28T04:42:42-07:00",
  "has_failures": false
}
```

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-instance">Instance</h1>

Use this API to manage an instance's
[appearance](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/appearance/) and
[application settings](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/settings/#available-settings), and to retrieve
statistics about the instance.

Changes to application settings are subject to caching and might not take effect immediately. By
default, GitLab caches application settings for 60 seconds. For more information, see
[application cache interval](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/application_settings_cache/).

All of these endpoints require administrator access to the instance.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/appearance/">External documentation</a>

## Retrieve application settings

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ApplicationSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/application/settings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/application/settings`

<h3 id="retrieve-application-settings-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesApplicationSetting](#schemaapientitiesapplicationsetting)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Update application settings

|» admin_notification_email|body|string \| null|false|If set, [abuse reports](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/review_abuse_reports/) are sent to this address. Abuse reports are always available in the **Admin** area. Deprecated. Use `abuse_notification_email` instead.|

|» after_sign_out_path|body|string \| null|false|Users are redirected to this page after they sign out.|
|» akismet_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, helps prevent bots from creating issues. Requires `akismet_api_key`.|

|» asset_proxy_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Enable proxying of assets|

|» asset_proxy_allowlist|body|[string]|false|Assets that match these domains are not proxied. Wildcards allowed. Your GitLab installation URL is automatically allowlisted. GitLab restart is required to apply changes.|
|» authn_data_retention_cleanup_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, runs cleanup workers that permanently delete authentication login history older than one year, and previously revoked OAuth access tokens and grants older than one month. |» container_registry_token_expire_delay|body|integer \| null|false|Duration, in minutes, that container registry authorization tokens remain valid.|

|» decompress_archive_file_timeout|body|integer \| null|false|Timeout for decompressing archived files, in seconds. Set to `0` to disable the timeout.|

|» default_remove_source_branch_after_merge|body|boolean \| null|false|Enable the delete source branch option by default for new projects|
|» default_branch_protection|body|integer \| null|false|Level of protection for the default branch. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/408314) in GitLab 17.0. Use `default_branch_protection_defaults` instead.|

|» » allowed_to_push|body|[object]|false|Array of access levels allowed to push to the default branch.|
|» » » access_level|body|integer|true|Access level allowed to push to the default branch.|

|» default_project_visibility|body|string \| null|false|What visibility level new projects receive. Default is `private`. Cannot be set to any levels in `restricted_visibility_levels`.|

## Modify appearance

<a id="opIdputApiV4ApplicationAppearance"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/application/appearance \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'title=string' \
  -F 'description=string' \
  -F 'pwa_name=string' \
  -F 'pwa_short_name=string' \
  -F 'pwa_description=string' \
  -F 'logo=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'pwa_icon=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'header_logo=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'favicon=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'member_guidelines=string' \
  -F 'new_project_guidelines=string' \
  -F 'profile_image_guidelines=string' \
  -F 'header_message=string' \
  -F 'footer_message=string' \
  -F 'message_background_color=string' \
  -F 'message_font_color=string' \
  -F 'email_header_and_footer_enabled=true' \
  -F 'site_name=string'
```

`PUT /api/v4/application/appearance`

Updates instance appearance settings like branding, logos, headers, and footer messages.

> Body parameter

```yaml
title: string
description: string
pwa_name: string
pwa_short_name: string
pwa_description: string
logo: string
pwa_icon: string
header_logo: string
favicon: string
member_guidelines: string
new_project_guidelines: string
profile_image_guidelines: string
header_message: string
footer_message: string
message_background_color: string
message_font_color: string
email_header_and_footer_enabled: true
site_name: string
```

<h3 id="modify-appearance-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[putApiV4ApplicationAppearanceRequest](#schemaputapiv4applicationappearancerequest)|false|none|
|» title|body|string \| null|false|Instance title on the sign in / sign up page|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Markdown text shown on the sign in / sign up page|
|» pwa_name|body|string \| null|false|Name of the Progressive Web App|
|» pwa_short_name|body|string \| null|false|Optional, short name for Progressive Web App|
|» pwa_description|body|string \| null|false|An explanation of what the Progressive Web App does|
|» logo|body|string(binary) \| null|false|Instance image used on the sign in / sign up page|
|» pwa_icon|body|string(binary) \| null|false|Icon used for Progressive Web App|
|» header_logo|body|string(binary) \| null|false|Instance image used for the main navigation bar|
|» favicon|body|string(binary) \| null|false|Instance favicon in .ico/.png format|
|» member_guidelines|body|string \| null|false|Markdown text shown on the members page of a group or project|
|» new_project_guidelines|body|string \| null|false|Markdown text shown on the new project page|
|» profile_image_guidelines|body|string \| null|false|Markdown text shown on the profile page below Public Avatar|
|» header_message|body|string \| null|false|Message within the system header bar|
|» footer_message|body|string \| null|false|Message within the system footer bar|
|» message_background_color|body|string \| null|false|Background color for the system header / footer bar|
|» message_font_color|body|string \| null|false|Font color for the system header / footer bar|
|» email_header_and_footer_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Add header and footer to all outgoing emails if enabled|
|» site_name|body|string \| null|false|Last part of the webpage title. Defaults to empty.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "title": "GitLab Community Edition",
  "description": "Open source software to collaborate on code",
  "pwa_name": "GitLab",
  "pwa_short_name": "GitLab",
  "pwa_description": "GitLab as PWA",
  "logo": "/uploads/-/system/appearance/logo/1/logo.png",
  "pwa_icon": "/uploads/-/system/appearance/pwa_icon/1/icon.png",
  "header_logo": "/uploads/-/system/appearance/header_logo/1/header.png",
  "favicon": "/uploads/-/system/appearance/favicon/1/favicon.png",
  "new_project_guidelines": "Please read the FAQs for help.",
  "member_guidelines": "Please read the member guidelines.",
  "profile_image_guidelines": "Custom profile image guidelines",
  "header_message": "This is a header message",
  "footer_message": "This is a footer message",
  "message_background_color": "#e75e40",
  "message_font_color": "#ffffff",
  "email_header_and_footer_enabled": false,
  "site_name": "GitLab"
}
```

<h3 id="modify-appearance-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-integrations">Integrations</h1>

Use this API to manage [integrations](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/integrations/) for a
project, or for a group and its subgroups.

Managing integrations requires the Maintainer or Owner role for the project or group.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_integrations/">External documentation</a>

## Receive Slack events

<a id="opIdpostApiV4IntegrationsSlackEvents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/integrations/slack/events \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "token": "string",
    "team_id": "string",
    "api_app_id": "string",
    "event": {},
    "type": "string",
    "event_id": "string",
    "event_time": 0,
    "authed_users": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/integrations/slack/events`

Receives and processes events sent by the GitLab for Slack app. Requires a valid Slack signature.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "token": "string",
  "team_id": "string",
  "api_app_id": "string",
  "event": {},
  "type": "string",
  "event_id": "string",
  "event_time": 0,
  "authed_users": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="receive-slack-events-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4IntegrationsSlackEventsRequest](#schemapostapiv4integrationsslackeventsrequest)|false|none|
|» token|body|string \| null|false|Request token. Not used by GitLab. Deprecated by Slack.|
|» team_id|body|string \| null|false|ID of the Slack workspace where the event occurred.|
|» api_app_id|body|string \| null|false|ID of the Slack app.|
|» event|body|object \| null|false|Event object with variable properties.|
|» type|body|string \| null|false|Type of the event, usually `event_callback`.|
|» event_id|body|string \| null|false|ID of the event.|
|» event_time|body|integer \| null|false|Unix timestamp, in seconds, of when the event was dispatched.|
|» authed_users|body|[string]|false|Array of Slack user IDs. Deprecated by Slack.|

<h3 id="receive-slack-events-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successfully processed event|None|
|204|No Content|Failed to process event|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

```json
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-update-the-jira-integration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdServicesJiraRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidservicesjirarequest)|true|none|
|» url|body|string \| null|true|The URL to the Jira project which is being linked to this GitLab project (for example, `https://jira.example.com`).|
|» api_url|body|string \| null|false|The base URL to the Jira instance API. Web URL value is used if not set (for example, `https://jira-api.example.com`).|
|» jira_auth_type|body|integer \| null|false|The authentication method to use with Jira. Use `0` for basic authentication, `1` for Jira personal access token, and `2` for Jira Cloud service accounts. Defaults to `0`.|
|» username|body|string \| null|false|The email or username to use with Jira. Use an email for Jira Cloud, and a username for Jira Data Center and Jira Server. Required when using basic authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`).|
|» password|body|string \| null|true|The Jira API token, password, or personal access token to use with Jira. When using Basic Authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`), use an API token for Jira Cloud, and a password for Jira Data Center or Jira Server. For a Jira personal access token (`jira_auth_type` is `1`), use the personal access token.|
|» jira_issue_regex|body|string \| null|false|Regular expression to match Jira issue keys.|
|» jira_issue_prefix|body|string \| null|false|Prefix to match Jira issue keys.|
|» jira_issue_transition_id|body|string \| null|false|The ID of one or more transitions for [custom issue transitions](../integration/jira/issues.md#custom-issue-transitions).Ignored when `jira_issue_transition_automatic` is enabled. Defaults to a blank string,which disables custom transitions.|
|» issues_enabled|body|string \| null|false|Enable viewing Jira issues in GitLab.|
|» project_keys|body|[string]|false|Keys of Jira projects to display. When `issues_enabled` is `true`, this setting filters which Jira projects are shown in GitLab. It does not restrict the API token's access.|
|» vulnerabilities_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Turn on Jira issue creation for GitLab vulnerabilities.|
|» vulnerabilities_issuetype|body|string \| null|false|Jira issue type to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.|
|» project_key|body|string \| null|false|Key of the project to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.This parameter is required if using the integration to create Jira issues from vulnerabilities.|
|» customize_jira_issue_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|When set to `true`, opens a prefilled form on the Jira instancewhen creating a Jira issue from a vulnerability.|
|» jira_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist before allowing the push.|
|» jira_exists_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify the Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist in Jira.|
|» jira_assignee_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify the committer is the assignee of the Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|» jira_status_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify the status of Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|» jira_allowed_statuses_as_string|body|string \| null|false|Comma-separated list of allowed Jira issue statuses.|
|» comment_on_event_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Enable comments inside Jira issues on each GitLab event (commit / merge request)|
|» commit_events|body|boolean \| null|false|Trigger event when a commit is created or updated.|
|» merge_requests_events|body|boolean \| null|false|Trigger event when a merge request is created, updated, or merged.|

```json
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-update-the-jira-integration-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdIntegrationsJiraRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidintegrationsjirarequest)|true|none|
|» url|body|string \| null|true|The URL to the Jira project which is being linked to this GitLab project (for example, `https://jira.example.com`).|
|» api_url|body|string \| null|false|The base URL to the Jira instance API. Web URL value is used if not set (for example, `https://jira-api.example.com`).|
|» jira_auth_type|body|integer \| null|false|The authentication method to use with Jira. Use `0` for basic authentication, `1` for Jira personal access token, and `2` for Jira Cloud service accounts. Defaults to `0`.|
|» username|body|string \| null|false|The email or username to use with Jira. Use an email for Jira Cloud, and a username for Jira Data Center and Jira Server. Required when using basic authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`).|
|» password|body|string \| null|true|The Jira API token, password, or personal access token to use with Jira. When using Basic Authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`), use an API token for Jira Cloud, and a password for Jira Data Center or Jira Server. For a Jira personal access token (`jira_auth_type` is `1`), use the personal access token.|
|» jira_issue_regex|body|string \| null|false|Regular expression to match Jira issue keys.|
|» jira_issue_prefix|body|string \| null|false|Prefix to match Jira issue keys.|
|» jira_issue_transition_id|body|string \| null|false|The ID of one or more transitions for [custom issue transitions](../integration/jira/issues.md#custom-issue-transitions).Ignored when `jira_issue_transition_automatic` is enabled. Defaults to a blank string,which disables custom transitions.|
|» issues_enabled|body|string \| null|false|Enable viewing Jira issues in GitLab.|
|» project_keys|body|[string]|false|Keys of Jira projects to display. When `issues_enabled` is `true`, this setting filters which Jira projects are shown in GitLab. It does not restrict the API token's access.|
|» vulnerabilities_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Turn on Jira issue creation for GitLab vulnerabilities.|
|» vulnerabilities_issuetype|body|string \| null|false|Jira issue type to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.|
|» project_key|body|string \| null|false|Key of the project to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.This parameter is required if using the integration to create Jira issues from vulnerabilities.|
|» customize_jira_issue_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|When set to `true`, opens a prefilled form on the Jira instancewhen creating a Jira issue from a vulnerability.|
|» jira_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist before allowing the push.|
|» jira_exists_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify the Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist in Jira.|
|» jira_assignee_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify the committer is the assignee of the Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|» jira_status_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify the status of Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|» jira_allowed_statuses_as_string|body|string \| null|false|Comma-separated list of allowed Jira issue statuses.|
|» comment_on_event_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Enable comments inside Jira issues on each GitLab event (commit / merge request)|
|» commit_events|body|boolean \| null|false|Trigger event when a commit is created or updated.|
|» merge_requests_events|body|boolean \| null|false|Trigger event when a merge request is created, updated, or merged.|
|» use_inherited_settings|body|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether to inherit the default settings. Defaults to `false`.|

<h3 id="create-or-update-the-jira-integration-2-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|body|body|[putApiV4GroupsIdIntegrationsJiraRequest](#schemaputapiv4groupsidintegrationsjirarequest)|true|none|
|» url|body|string \| null|true|The URL to the Jira project which is being linked to this GitLab project (for example, `https://jira.example.com`).|
|» api_url|body|string \| null|false|The base URL to the Jira instance API. Web URL value is used if not set (for example, `https://jira-api.example.com`).|
|» jira_auth_type|body|integer \| null|false|The authentication method to use with Jira. Use `0` for basic authentication, `1` for Jira personal access token, and `2` for Jira Cloud service accounts. Defaults to `0`.|
|» username|body|string \| null|false|The email or username to use with Jira. Use an email for Jira Cloud, and a username for Jira Data Center and Jira Server. Required when using basic authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`).|
|» password|body|string \| null|true|The Jira API token, password, or personal access token to use with Jira. When using Basic Authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`), use an API token for Jira Cloud, and a password for Jira Data Center or Jira Server. For a Jira personal access token (`jira_auth_type` is `1`), use the personal access token.|
|» jira_issue_regex|body|string \| null|false|Regular expression to match Jira issue keys.|
|» jira_issue_prefix|body|string \| null|false|Prefix to match Jira issue keys.|
|» jira_issue_transition_id|body|string \| null|false|The ID of one or more transitions for [custom issue transitions](../integration/jira/issues.md#custom-issue-transitions).Ignored when `jira_issue_transition_automatic` is enabled. Defaults to a blank string,which disables custom transitions.|
|» issues_enabled|body|string \| null|false|Enable viewing Jira issues in GitLab.|
|» project_keys|body|[string]|false|Keys of Jira projects to display. When `issues_enabled` is `true`, this setting filters which Jira projects are shown in GitLab. It does not restrict the API token's access.|
|» vulnerabilities_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Turn on Jira issue creation for GitLab vulnerabilities.|
|» vulnerabilities_issuetype|body|string \| null|false|Jira issue type to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.|
|» project_key|body|string \| null|false|Key of the project to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.This parameter is required if using the integration to create Jira issues from vulnerabilities.|
|» customize_jira_issue_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|When set to `true`, opens a prefilled form on the Jira instancewhen creating a Jira issue from a vulnerability.|
|» jira_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist before allowing the push.|
|» jira_exists_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify the Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist in Jira.|
|» jira_assignee_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify the committer is the assignee of the Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|» jira_status_check_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Verify the status of Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|» jira_allowed_statuses_as_string|body|string \| null|false|Comma-separated list of allowed Jira issue statuses.|
|» comment_on_event_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|Enable comments inside Jira issues on each GitLab event (commit / merge request)|
|» commit_events|body|boolean \| null|false|Trigger event when a commit is created or updated.|
|» merge_requests_events|body|boolean \| null|false|Trigger event when a merge request is created, updated, or merged.|
|» use_inherited_settings|body|boolean \| null|false|Indicates whether to inherit the default settings. Defaults to `false`.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-invitations">Invitations</h1>

Use this API to manage invitations and add users to a [group](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/#add-users-to-a-group) or [project](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/members/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/invitations/">External documentation</a>

## List all pending invitations for a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdInvitations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/invitations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/invitations`

Lists all pending invitations for a specified group viewable by the authenticated user. Returns invitations to direct members only, and not through inherited ancestor groups. This function takes pagination parameters `page` and `per_page` to restrict the list of members.

<h3 id="list-all-pending-invitations-for-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|query|query|string \| null|false|Return only invitations sent to this email address. Must match exactly. If omitted, returns all invitations.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "access_level": "string",
    "created_at": "string",
    "expires_at": "string",
    "invite_email": "string",
    "invite_token": "string",
    "user_name": "string",
    "created_by_name": "string"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-pending-invitations-for-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<h3 id="list-all-pending-invitations-for-a-group-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesInvitation](#schemaapientitiesinvitation)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Add a member to a group

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdInvitations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/invitations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "access_level": 10,
    "email": [
      "string"
    ],
    "user_id": [
      "string"
    ],
    "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "invite_source": "invitations-api",
    "member_role_id": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/invitations`

Adds a member to a group. You can specify a user ID or invite a user by email.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "access_level": 10,
  "email": [
    "string"
  ],
  "user_id": [
    "string"
  ],
  "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "invite_source": "invitations-api",
  "member_role_id": 0
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-member-to-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdInvitationsRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidinvitationsrequest)|true|none|
|» access_level|body|integer|true|Access level to grant to the invited user. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|» email|body|[string]|false|Email address of the member to invite, or multiple email addresses separated by commas. Required if `user_id` is not provided.|
|» user_id|body|[string]|false|ID of the user to invite, or multiple IDs separated by commas. Required if `email` is not provided.|
|» expires_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Date when the invitation expires.|
|» invite_source|body|string|false|Source of the invitation that starts the member creation process.|
|» member_role_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of a member role to assign to the invited user. Ultimate only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» access_level|10|
|» access_level|15|
|» access_level|20|
|» access_level|25|
|» access_level|30|
|» access_level|40|
|» access_level|50|
|» access_level|5|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "access_level": "string",
  "created_at": "string",
  "expires_at": "string",
  "invite_email": "string",
  "invite_token": "string",
  "user_name": "string",
  "created_by_name": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-member-to-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesInvitation](#schemaapientitiesinvitation)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>
