|email|path|string|true|Email address the invitation was previously sent to.|

<h3 id="delete-an-invitation-to-a-project-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|No Content|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|
|409|Conflict|Could not delete invitation|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-issues">Issues</h1>

Use this API to manage [issues](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/issues/), their
[links to related issues](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/issues/related_issues/), and issue
statistics. You can:

- Create, update, and delete issues.
- Manage issue metadata, like assignees, labels, milestones, and time tracking.
- Cross-reference issues and merge requests.
- Track issue movement and promotion between projects and epics.
- Retrieve statistics about issues.

If a user is not a member of a private project, a `GET` request on that project results in a `404`
status code.

> [!note]
> The `references.relative` attribute is relative to the group or project of the issue being requested.
> When an issue is fetched from its project, the `relative` format is the same as the `short` format.
> When requested across groups or projects, it's expected to be the same as the `full` format.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/issues/">External documentation</a>

## Retrieve issues statistics for the currently authenticated user

<a id="opIdgetApiV4IssuesStatistics"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/issues_statistics \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/issues_statistics`

Retrieves statistics for issues accessible by the currently authenticated user. By default, returns only issues created by the current user. To get all issues, set the `scope` attribute to `all`.

<h3 id="retrieve-issues-statistics-for-the-currently-authenticated-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|labels|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names. `None` means no labels are assigned. `Any` means at least one label is assigned. `No+Label` (deprecated) means no labels are assigned. Set to an empty string to unassign all labels. If a label does not already exist, this creates a new project label and assigns it to the issue. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|milestone|query|string \| null|false|Milestone title. `None` lists all issues with no milestone. `Any` lists all issues that have an assigned milestone. Support for `None` and `Any` is [planned for removal](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/336044). Use the `milestone_id` attribute instead. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_id`.|
|milestone_id|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to milestones with a given timebox value. `None` lists all issues with no milestone. `Any` lists all issues that have an assigned milestone. `Upcoming` lists all issues assigned to milestones due in the future. `Started` lists all issues assigned to open, started milestones. The logic for `Upcoming` and `Started` differs from the logic used in the [GraphQL API](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/milestones/#special-milestone-filters). Mutually exclusive with `milestone`.|
|iids|query|[integer]|false|Return only the issues having the given `iid`.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Search issues against their `title` and `description`.|
|in|query|string \| null|false|Modify the scope of the `search` attribute to `title`, `description`, or `title,description`. If omitted, defaults to `title,description`.|
|author_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues created by the given user ID. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`.|
|author_username|query|string \| null|false|Return issues created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.|
|assignee_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned issues and `Any` returns issues with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`.|
|assignee_username|query|[string]|false|Return issues assigned to the given username. In GitLab Community Edition, only a single value is accepted. Otherwise, an invalid parameter error is returned. When multiple usernames are given, only issues assigned to all of them are returned. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues created on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues updated on or after the specified time.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues updated on or before the specified time.|
|not|query|object \| null|false|Return issues that do not match the specified parameters.|
|not[labels]|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names.|
|not[milestone]|query|string \| null|false|Milestone title. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone_id]`.|
|not[milestone_id]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to milestones without the specified timebox value. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone]`.|
|not[iids]|query|[integer]|false|Internal IDs of issues to exclude.|
|not[author_id]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues not authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`.|
|not[author_username]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues not authored by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`.|
|not[assignee_id]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`.|
|not[assignee_username]|query|[string]|false|Return issues not assigned to the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`.|
|not[weight]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues that do not have the specified weight.|
|not[iteration_id]|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the iteration with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_title]`.|
|not[iteration_title]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the iteration with the given title. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_id]`.|
|scope|query|string|false|Return issues for the given scope.|
|my_reaction_emoji|query|string \| null|false|Return issues reacted to by the authenticated user with the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues with no reaction and `Any` returns issues with at least one reaction.|
|confidential|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only confidential issues. If `false`, returns only public issues.|
|weight|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|The weight of the issue|
|epic_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues associated with the epic with the given ID. `None` returns issues that are not associated with an epic. `Any` returns issues that are associated with an epic. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|health_status|query|string \| null|false|The health status of the issue. Must be one of: on_track, needs_attention, at_risk, none, any|
|iteration_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the iteration with the given ID. `None` returns issues that do not belong to an iteration. `Any` returns issues that belong to an iteration. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_title`.|
|iteration_title|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the iteration with the given title. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_id`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|milestone_id|Any|
|milestone_id|None|
|milestone_id|Upcoming|
|milestone_id|Started|
|not[milestone_id]|Any|
|not[milestone_id]|None|
|not[milestone_id]|Upcoming|
|not[milestone_id]|Started|
|scope|created_by_me|
|scope|assigned_to_me|
|scope|all|
|health_status|on_track|
|health_status|needs_attention|
|health_status|at_risk|
|health_status|none|
|health_status|any|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|

## Set the estimated time for an issue

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidTimeEstimate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues/0/time_estimate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "duration": "3h30m"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues/{issue_iid}/time_estimate`

Sets an estimated time of work for a specified issue.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "duration": "3h30m"
}
```

<h3 id="set-the-estimated-time-for-an-issue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|issue_iid|path|integer|true|The internal ID of the issue.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidTimeEstimateRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidissuesissueiidtimeestimaterequest)|true|none|
|» duration|body|string \| null|true|Duration in human-readable format, for example `3h30m`.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "time_estimate": 12600,
  "total_time_spent": 3600,
  "human_time_estimate": "3h 30m",
  "human_total_time_spent": "1h"
}
```

<h3 id="set-the-estimated-time-for-an-issue-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesIssuableTimeStats](#schemaapientitiesissuabletimestats)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

## Create an issue link

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidLinks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues/0/links \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "target_project_id": "string",
    "target_issue_iid": "string",
    "link_type": "relates_to"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues/{issue_iid}/links`

Creates a two-way relationship between two issues. The user must be allowed to update both issues to succeed.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "target_project_id": "string",
  "target_issue_iid": "string",
  "link_type": "relates_to"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-issue-link-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|issue_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the issue.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidLinksRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidissuesissueiidlinksrequest)|true|none|
|» target_project_id|body|string \| null \| integer \| null|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the target project.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» target_issue_iid|body|string \| null \| integer \| null|true|Internal ID of the issue in the target project.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» link_type|body|string|false|The type of the relation.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» link_type|relates_to|
|» link_type|blocks|
|» link_type|is_blocked_by|

## Retrieve an issue link

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidLinksIssueLinkId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues/0/links/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues/{issue_iid}/links/{issue_link_id}`

Retrieves a specified issue link.

<h3 id="retrieve-an-issue-link-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|issue_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the issue.|
|issue_link_id|path|string \| integer|true|ID of the issue relationship.|

## Delete an issue link


<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-iterations">Iterations</h1>

Use this API to retrieve [iterations](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/iterations/) for a group or
a project.

Projects no longer have their own iterations, but you can use the project endpoint to retrieve the
iterations of a project's ancestor groups.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_iterations/">External documentation</a>

## List all project iterations

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdIterations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/5/iterations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/iterations`

Lists all iterations for a specified project. Iterations created by **Enable automatic scheduling** in iteration cadences return `null` for the `title` and `description` fields. This feature was introduced in GitLab 13.5.

<h3 id="list-all-project-iterations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|state|query|string|false|Filter iterations by state. Filtering by `started` is deprecated. Use `current` instead.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return only iterations with a title matching the provided string.|
|in|query|[string]|false|Fields to search with the `search` query. Possible values are `title` and `cadence_title`.|
|include_ancestors|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes iterations for the parent group and its ancestors.|
|include_descendants|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes iterations for the parent group and its descendants.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones updated before the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones updated after the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|state|opened|
|state|upcoming|
|state|started|
|state|current|
|state|closed|
|state|all|
|in|title|
|in|cadence_title|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "iid": 1,
    "sequence": 1,
    "group_id": 1,
    "title": "Iteration I",
    "description": "Iteration description",
    "state": 1,
    "created_at": "2022-01-31T15:10:45.080Z",
    "updated_at": "2022-01-31T15:10:45.080Z",
    "start_date": "2022-01-01",
    "due_date": "2022-01-31",
    "web_url": "https://gitlab.example.com/groups/gitlab-org/-/iterations/1"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-project-iterations-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<h3 id="list-all-project-iterations-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesIteration](#schemaapientitiesiteration)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-jira-connect-subscriptions">Jira Connect subscriptions</h1>

Use this API to subscribe a namespace to an installation of the
[GitLab for Jira Cloud app](https://docs.gitlab.com/integration/jira/connect-app/).

## Subscribe a namespace to a JiraConnectInstallation

<a id="opIdpostApiV4IntegrationsJiraConnectSubscriptions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/integrations/jira_connect/subscriptions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "jwt": "string",
    "namespace_path": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/integrations/jira_connect/subscriptions`

Subscribes the namespace to the JiraConnectInstallation

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "jwt": "string",
  "namespace_path": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="subscribe-a-namespace-to-a-jiraconnectinstallation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4IntegrationsJiraConnectSubscriptionsRequest](#schemapostapiv4integrationsjiraconnectsubscriptionsrequest)|true|none|
|» jwt|body|string \| null|true|JWT token for authorization with the Jira Connect installation.|
|» namespace_path|body|string \| null|true|Path for the namespace that should be subscribed.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "success": {}
}
```

<h3 id="subscribe-a-namespace-to-a-jiraconnectinstallation-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesBasicSuccess](#schemaapientitiesbasicsuccess)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-jira-forge-installation">Jira forge installation</h1>

Use this API to configure a GitLab for Jira (Forge) installation, by setting the GitLab instance URL
it points to and registering the system token it uses to synchronize development information. For more
information, see the [Jira integrations](https://docs.gitlab.com/integration/jira/).

## Update the GitLab for Jira (Forge) installation instance URL

<a id="opIdputApiV4IntegrationsJiraForgeInstallation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/integrations/jira_forge/installation \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "instance_url": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/integrations/jira_forge/installation`

Sets the GitLab instance the installation points at. Omit instance_url (or send null) for GitLab.com. Requires a Jira site or organization admin.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "instance_url": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-the-gitlab-for-jira-forge-installation-instance-url-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[putApiV4IntegrationsJiraForgeInstallationRequest](#schemaputapiv4integrationsjiraforgeinstallationrequest)|false|none|
|» instance_url|body|string \| null|false|Base URL of the self-managed GitLab instance; null for GitLab.com|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": {}
}
```

<h3 id="update-the-gitlab-for-jira-forge-installation-instance-url-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesBasicSuccess](#schemaapientitiesbasicsuccess)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Destroy the GitLab for Jira (Forge) installation on app uninstall

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4IntegrationsJiraForgeInstallation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/integrations/jira_forge/installation \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/integrations/jira_forge/installation`

Called by the Forge app preUninstall hook. A pure-native install fires no Connect uninstalled event, so this is what removes the installation, its subscriptions, and deactivates the linked jira_cloud_app integrations. FIT authentication carries the same trust as the signed Connect lifecycle event, so no Jira admin check is needed. Succeeds with no change when the installation is already gone.

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": {}
}
```

<h3 id="destroy-the-gitlab-for-jira-forge-installation-on-app-uninstall-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesBasicSuccess](#schemaapientitiesbasicsuccess)|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Register the GitLab for Jira (Forge) system token for direct dev-info sync

<a id="opIdpostApiV4IntegrationsJiraForgeInstallationForgeToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/integrations/jira_forge/installation/forge_token \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/integrations/jira_forge/installation/forge_token`

Stores the Forge app system OAuth token (X-Forge-Oauth-System header) and the Jira apiBaseUrl (from the FIT), so GitLab pushes dev-info directly to Jira. See Atlassian::Forge::SystemTokenClient.

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "success": {}
}
```

<h3 id="register-the-gitlab-for-jira-forge-system-token-for-direct-dev-info-sync-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesBasicSuccess](#schemaapientitiesbasicsuccess)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-jira-forge-subscriptions">Jira forge subscriptions</h1>

Use this API to list, create, and delete the namespace subscriptions of a GitLab for Jira (Forge)
installation. For more information, see the [Jira integrations](https://docs.gitlab.com/integration/jira/).

## List GitLab for Jira (Forge) namespace subscriptions

<a id="opIdgetApiV4IntegrationsJiraForgeSubscriptions"></a>

> Code samples


## Create a GitLab for Jira (Forge) namespace subscription

<a id="opIdpostApiV4IntegrationsJiraForgeSubscriptions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/integrations/jira_forge/subscriptions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "namespace_path": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/integrations/jira_forge/subscriptions`

Subscribes a GitLab namespace to the Forge installation so its development data syncs to Jira. Authenticated by the Forge Invocation Token (app-context call); the GitLab user is bound via the signed delegation token from the user_delegation endpoint, and the Jira site-admin check runs against Jira with the app system token riding the call.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "namespace_path": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-gitlab-for-jira-forge-namespace-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4IntegrationsJiraForgeSubscriptionsRequest](#schemapostapiv4integrationsjiraforgesubscriptionsrequest)|true|none|
|» namespace_path|body|string \| null|true|Path of the namespace to subscribe.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "success": {}
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-gitlab-for-jira-forge-namespace-subscription-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesBasicSuccess](#schemaapientitiesbasicsuccess)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-jira-forge-user-delegation">Jira forge user delegation</h1>

Operations related to jira forge user delegation.

## Create a GitLab for Jira (Forge) user delegation token

<a id="opIdpostApiV4IntegrationsJiraForgeUserDelegation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/integrations/jira_forge/user_delegation \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "account_id": "string",
    "cloud_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/integrations/jira_forge/user_delegation`

Mints a short-lived GitLab-signed token identifying the signed-in GitLab user, scoped to the Jira account and site it is minted for. Accepts only the OAuth token issued to the Forge app at sign-in. The Forge app stores it at config-page sign-in and presents it on the FIT-authenticated subscribe call, which cannot carry the user OAuth token (Forge attaches the FIT only to app-context calls); the scope claims must match that call's FIT.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "account_id": "string",
  "cloud_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-gitlab-for-jira-forge-user-delegation-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4IntegrationsJiraForgeUserDelegationRequest](#schemapostapiv4integrationsjiraforgeuserdelegationrequest)|true|none|
|» account_id|body|string \| null|true|Jira account id the delegation is scoped to|
|» cloud_id|body|string \| null|true|Jira site (cloud) id the delegation is scoped to|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "success": {}
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-gitlab-for-jira-forge-user-delegation-token-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesBasicSuccess](#schemaapientitiesbasicsuccess)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-job-artifacts">Job artifacts</h1>

Use this API to download, keep, and delete [job artifacts](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/jobs/job_artifacts/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/job_artifacts/">External documentation</a>

## Retrieve job artifacts

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdJobsArtifactsRefNameDownload"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/jobs/artifacts/string/download?job=string' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/jobs/artifacts/{ref_name}/download`

Retrieves the artifacts archive for the latest successful job on a specified branch or tag.

<h3 id="retrieve-job-artifacts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|ref_name|path|string|true|Branch or tag name in the repository. `HEAD` or SHA references are not supported. For merge request pipelines, use `refs/merge-requests/:iid/head` instead of the branch name.|
|job|query|string \| null|true|Name of the job.|
|job_token|query|string \| null|false|CI/CD job token for multi-project pipelines. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|search_recent_successful_pipelines|query|boolean|false|If `true`, searches across recent successful pipelines instead of just the latest one. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/515864) in GitLab 18.7 [with a feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) named `ci_search_recent_successful_pipelines`. Disabled by default.|
|download_mode|query|string \| null|false|Requested download transfer mode (`proxy` or `direct`). Only honored when allowed by the object storage configuration.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|download_mode|proxy|
|download_mode|direct|

<h3 id="retrieve-job-artifacts-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

[Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/515864) in GitLab 18.7 [with a feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) named `ci_search_recent_successful_pipelines`. ## Download an artifact from a job

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdJobsJobIdArtifacts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/jobs/0/artifacts \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/jobs/{job_id}/artifacts`

This feature was introduced in GitLab 8.5. The `file_type` attribute was added in GitLab 19.4.

<h3 id="download-an-artifact-from-a-job-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|job_id|path|integer|true|ID of the job.|
|file_type|query|string|false|Type of artifact to download. Set a specific report type to download that report file directly instead of the full artifacts archive. `performance` and `browser_performance` share a report group. If the job uploaded both, the requested type is returned, and if it uploaded only one, that artifact is returned whichever type was requested. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/35805) in GitLab 19.4.|
|job_token|query|string \| null|false|CI/CD job token for multi-project pipelines. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|download_mode|query|string \| null|false|Requested download transfer mode (`proxy` or `direct`). Only honored when allowed by the object storage configuration.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|file_type|accessibility|
|file_type|api_fuzzing|
|file_type|archive|
|file_type|cobertura|
|file_type|jacoco|
|file_type|codequality|
|file_type|container_scanning|
|file_type|dast|
|file_type|dependency_scanning|
|file_type|dotenv|
|file_type|junit|
|file_type|license_scanning|
|file_type|lsif|
|file_type|metrics|
|file_type|performance|
|file_type|browser_performance|
|file_type|load_performance|
|file_type|sast|
|file_type|secret_detection|
|file_type|requirements|
|file_type|requirements_v2|
|file_type|cluster_image_scanning|
|file_type|cyclonedx|
|file_type|sarif|
|download_mode|proxy|
|download_mode|direct|

<h3 id="download-an-artifact-from-a-job-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-jobs">Jobs</h1>

Use this API to run CI/CD jobs on a [runner](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/runners/): request the next
job, update its state, append to its log, and transfer its artifacts.

GitLab Runner uses these endpoints itself.

```bash
    }
  }'
```

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/jobs/0 \

  -d '{

      "bytesize": 0
    },
    "exit_code": 0,
    "runtime_environment_key": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/jobs/{id}`

Updates the state and other attributes of a job. Used by runners while executing a job.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "token": "string",
  "state": "string",
  "checksum": "string",
  "failure_reason": "string",
  "output": {
    "checksum": "string",
    "bytesize": 0
  },
  "exit_code": 0,
  "runtime_environment_key": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-job-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|ID of the job.|
|body|body|[putApiV4JobsIdRequest](#schemaputapiv4jobsidrequest)|true|none|
|» token|body|string \| null|true|Authentication token of the job.|
|» state|body|string \| null|false|Status of the job: `running`, `success`, or `failed`.|
|» checksum|body|string \| null|false|CRC32 checksum of the job trace.|
|» failure_reason|body|string \| null|false|Failure reason of the job.|
|» output|body|object \| null|false|Build log state.|
|» » checksum|body|string \| null|false|CRC32 checksum of the job trace.|
|» » bytesize|body|integer \| null|false|Size of the job's trace output, in bytes.|
|» exit_code|body|integer \| null|false|Exit code of the job.|
|» runtime_environment_key|body|string \| null|false|Runtime environment key emitted by the runner on job suspension|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-keys">Keys</h1>

Use this API to retrieve information about [SSH keys](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/ssh/), manage a
user's SSH and [GPG keys](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/repository/signed_commits/gpg/),
and manage SSH certificates for [top-level groups](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/ssh_certificates/)
and [the instance](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/instance_ssh_certificates/).

Queries about deploy key fingerprints also retrieve information about the projects using that key.
If you use a SHA256 fingerprint in an API call, URL-encode the fingerprint.

Managing group SSH certificates requires the Owner role for a top-level group.

Managing instance SSH certificates requires administrator access.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/user_keys/">External documentation</a>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-knowledge-graph">Knowledge graph</h1>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-ldap">LDAP</h1>

Use this API to search the LDAP groups available to an instance, and to
[manage group memberships with LDAP](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/access_and_permissions/#manage-group-memberships-with-ldap)
by managing a group's LDAP links and triggering an LDAP synchronization.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_ldap_links/">External documentation</a>

## List all LDAP group links

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdLdapGroupLinks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/ldap_group_links \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/ldap_group_links`

Lists all LDAP group links.

<h3 id="list-all-ldap-group-links-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "cn": "ldap-group-1",
    "group_access": 10,
    "provider": "ldapmain",
    "filter": "id >= 500",
    "member_role_id": 12
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-ldap-group-links-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<h3 id="list-all-ldap-group-links-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesLdapGroupLink](#schemaapientitiesldapgrouplink)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

```bash
  -d '{
```

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-labels">Labels</h1>

Use this API to manage [labels](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/labels/) for both projects and
groups. For the difference between the two, see
[types of labels](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/labels/#types-of-labels).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/labels/">External documentation</a>

## List all project labels

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdLabels"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/labels \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/labels`

Lists all labels for a specified project. By default, this request returns 20 results at a time because the API results are paginated.

<h3 id="list-all-project-labels-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|with_counts|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes issue and merge request counts.|
|include_ancestor_groups|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes ancestor groups.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Keyword to filter labels by.|
|archived|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only archived labels. If `false`, returns only non-archived labels. If omitted, returns all labels. Introduced in GitLab 18.10.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "bug",
  "description": "Bug reported by user",
  "text_color": "#FFFFFF",
  "description_html": "<p>Bug reported by user</p>",
  "color": "#FF0000",
  "archived": false,
  "open_issues_count": 1,
  "closed_issues_count": 0,
  "open_merge_requests_count": 1,
  "subscribed": false,
  "priority": 10,
  "is_project_label": true
}
```

<h3 id="list-all-project-labels-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesProjectLabel](#schemaapientitiesprojectlabel)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>


Listens for Model Context Protocol responses

|---|---|---|---|

<aside class="warning">

http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Create MCP request handler

<a id="opIdpostApiV4Mcp"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/mcp \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "method": "string",
    "id": 0,
    "params": {}
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/mcp`

Handles Model Context Protocol requests

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "string",
  "id": 0,
  "params": {}
}
```

<h3 id="create-mcp-request-handler-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4McpRequest](#schemapostapiv4mcprequest)|true|none|
|» jsonrpc|body|string|true|JSON-RPC protocol version identifier. Must be `2.0`.|
|» method|body|string \| null|true|Name of the JSON-RPC method invoked on the MCP server.|
|» id|body|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|ID of the JSON-RPC request returned in the response.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» params|body|object \| null \| array|false|Parameters for the JSON-RPC method specified in `method`.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|array|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» jsonrpc|2.0|

<h3 id="create-mcp-request-handler-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|202|Accepted|Accepted (JSON-RPC notification)|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Method not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-ml-model-registry">ML Model Registry</h1>

Use this API to upload and download the files attached to a version of a machine learning model in
the [model registry](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/ml/model_registry/). To create models and model
versions, use an [MLflow client](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/ml/experiment_tracking/mlflow_client/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/model_registry/">External documentation</a>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-mlops">MLOps</h1>

Use this API to track machine learning experiments, runs, and metrics, and to manage the
[model registry](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/ml/model_registry/). These endpoints implement
the MLflow REST API, so you can point an
[MLflow client](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/ml/experiment_tracking/mlflow_client/) at GitLab.

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-markdown">Markdown</h1>

Use this API to render [Markdown](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/markdown/) content as HTML.

All requests to this API must be [authenticated](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/rest/authentication/).

> [!note]
> The availability of this feature is controlled by a feature flag.
> This feature is available for testing, but not ready for production use.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/markdown/">External documentation</a>

## Render Markdown content

<a id="opIdpostApiV4Markdown"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/markdown \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "text": "string",
    "gfm": false,
    "project": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/markdown`

Renders Markdown content as HTML.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "text": "string",
  "gfm": false,
  "project": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="render-markdown-content-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4MarkdownRequest](#schemapostapiv4markdownrequest)|true|none|
|» text|body|string \| null|true|Markdown text to render.|
|» gfm|body|boolean|false|Render text using GitLab Flavored Markdown.|
|» project|body|string \| null|false|Project used as context when creating references with GitLab Flavored Markdown.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "html": "<p dir=\\\"auto\\\">Hello world!</p>\""
}
```

<h3 id="render-markdown-content-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesMarkdown](#schemaapientitiesmarkdown)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## List all direct members of a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdMembers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/members \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/members`

Lists all direct members of a specified group viewable by the authenticated user. Does not return inherited members from ancestor groups or invited groups.

|show_seat_info|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, shows seat information for members.|
|with_saml_identity|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only members with a linked SAML identity.|

## List all members of a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdMembersAll"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/members/all \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/members/all`

Lists all members of a specified group viewable by the authenticated user. Also returns inherited members from ancestor groups or invited groups. If a user is a member of this group and one or more ancestor groups, only returns the highest `access_level`. Members from an invited group are returned if the invited group is public, the requester is a member of an invited group, or the requester is a member of the shared group or project.

<h3 id="list-all-members-of-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|query|query|string \| null|false|Filter results by name, email, or username. Use partial values to widen the scope of the query.|
|user_ids|query|[integer]|false|Filter results by the given user IDs.|
|show_seat_info|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, shows seat information for members.|
|state|query|string \| null|false|Filter results by member state. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|state|awaiting|
|state|active|

## Update a group member

<a id="opIdputApiV4GroupsIdMembersUserId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/members/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "access_level": 0,
    "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "member_role_id": 0
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/groups/{id}/members/{user_id}`

```json
  "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
```

## Remove a member from a group

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4GroupsIdMembersUserId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/members/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/groups/{id}/members/{user_id}`

Removes a specified user from a group. The user must be a direct member.

<h3 id="remove-a-member-from-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|user_id|path|integer|true|User ID of the member.|
|skip_subresources|query|boolean|false|If `true`, skips deleting direct memberships of the removed member in subgroups and projects.|
|unassign_issuables|query|boolean|false|If `true`, unassigns the member from any issues or merge requests in the group.|

<h3 id="remove-a-member-from-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|Resource deleted|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/members \
  -X POST \

  -d '{
    "access_level": 0,
    "user_id": 0,
    "username": "string",
    "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "invite_source": "members-api"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/members`

Adds a member to a specified project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "access_level": 0,
  "user_id": 0,
  "username": "string",
  "expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "invite_source": "members-api"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-member-to-a-project-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdMembersRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidmembersrequest)|true|none|
|» access_level|body|integer \| null|true|A valid access level.|
|» user_id|body|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|User ID of the new member, or multiple IDs separated by commas. Required if `username` is not provided. Mutually exclusive with `username`. At least one of `user_id`, `username` must be provided.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» username|body|string \| null|false|Username of the new member, or multiple usernames separated by commas. Required if `user_id` is not provided. Mutually exclusive with `user_id`. At least one of `user_id`, `username` must be provided.|
|» expires_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Date string in the format YEAR-MONTH-DAY|
|» invite_source|body|string|false|Source of the invitation that starts the member creation process. GitLab team members can view more information in this confidential issue: `https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/327120`.|

## List all members of a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdMembersAll"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/members/all \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/members/all`

Lists all members of a specified project viewable by the authenticated user. Also returns inherited members from ancestor groups or invited groups. If a user is a member of this project and one or more ancestor groups, only returns the highest `access_level`. Members from an invited group are returned if the invited group is public, the requester is a member of an invited group, or the requester is a member of the shared group or project.

<h3 id="list-all-members-of-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|query|query|string \| null|false|Filter results by name, email, or username. Use partial values to widen the scope of the query.|
|user_ids|query|[integer]|false|Filter results by the given user IDs.|
|show_seat_info|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, shows seat information for members.|
|state|query|string \| null|false|Filter results by member state. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|state|awaiting|
|state|active|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-merge-request-approvals">Merge request approvals</h1>

Use this API to manage [merge request approvals](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/merge_requests/approvals/)
and the group and project [approval settings](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/merge_requests/approvals/settings/)
that govern them. All endpoints require authentication.

Endpoints to approve, unapprove, reset approvals, and retrieve approval state are available on all
tiers, including Free. All other endpoints require Premium or Ultimate, and each one shows its tier.

> [!note]
> The `merge_request_iid` and `id` path parameters must each be a single value.
> Passing multiple space-separated values (for example, `451 454 458`) is not
> supported and returns `400 Bad Request`. To act on multiple merge requests,
> make one request per merge request IID.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_request_approvals/">External documentation</a>

## List all approval rules for a merge request

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidApprovalRules"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/approval_rules \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/approval_rules`

Lists all approval rules and any associated details for a specified merge request. Use the `page` and `per_page` pagination parameters to restrict the list of approval rules.

<h3 id="list-all-approval-rules-for-a-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response


## Create an approval rule for a merge request

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidApprovalRules"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/approval_rules \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "approvals_required": 0,
    "approval_project_rule_id": 0,
    "user_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "group_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "usernames": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/approval_rules`

Creates an approval rule for a specified merge request. If `approval_project_rule_id` is set with the ID of an existing approval rule from the project, this endpoint copies the values for `name`, `users`, and `groups` from the project rule.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "approvals_required": 0,
  "approval_project_rule_id": 0,
  "user_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "group_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "usernames": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-approval-rule-for-a-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidApprovalRulesRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidmergerequestsmergerequestiidapprovalrulesrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the approval rule. Limited to 1024 characters.|
|» approvals_required|body|integer \| null|true|Number of required approvals for the rule.|
|» approval_project_rule_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of a project-level approval rule.|
|» user_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of users to add as approvers. If used with `usernames`, adds both lists of users.|
|» group_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of groups to add as approvers.|
|» usernames|body|[string]|false|Usernames of users to add as approvers. If used with `user_ids`, adds both lists of users.|

## Update an approval rule for a merge request

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidApprovalRulesApprovalRuleId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/approval_rules/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "approvals_required": 0,
    "user_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "group_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "usernames": [
      "string"
    ],
    "remove_hidden_groups": true
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/approval_rules/{approval_rule_id}`

Updates a specified approval rule for a merge request. This endpoint removes any approvers and groups not included in the `group_ids`, `user_ids`, or `usernames` attributes. The `report_approver` or `code_owner` rules are system-generated, and you cannot edit them.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "approvals_required": 0,
  "user_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "group_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "usernames": [
    "string"
  ],
  "remove_hidden_groups": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-approval-rule-for-a-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|approval_rule_id|path|integer|true|ID of the merge request approval rule.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidApprovalRulesApprovalRuleIdRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidmergerequestsmergerequestiidapprovalrulesapprovalruleidrequest)|false|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|Name of the approval rule. Limited to 1024 characters.|
|» approvals_required|body|integer \| null|false|Number of required approvals for the rule.|
|» user_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of users to add as approvers. If used with `usernames`, adds both lists of users.|
|» group_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of groups to add as approvers.|
|» usernames|body|[string]|false|Usernames of users to add as approvers. If used with `user_ids`, adds both lists of users.|
|» remove_hidden_groups|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, removes hidden groups.|

```json
    "retain_approvals_on_push": true,
```

```bash
    "require_password_to_approve": true,
    "require_reauthentication_to_approve": true
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_request_approval_setting`

Updates the merge request approval settings for a specified project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "allow_author_approval": true,
  "allow_committer_approval": true,
  "allow_overrides_to_approver_list_per_merge_request": true,
  "retain_approvals_on_push": true,
  "selective_code_owner_removals": true,
  "require_password_to_approve": true,
  "require_reauthentication_to_approve": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-mr-approval-settings-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestApprovalSettingRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidmergerequestapprovalsettingrequest)|false|none|
|» allow_author_approval|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, authors can self-approve merge requests. At least one of `allow_author_approval`, `allow_committer_approval`, `allow_overrides_to_approver_list_per_merge_request`, `retain_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» allow_committer_approval|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, committers can self-approve merge requests. At least one of `allow_author_approval`, `allow_committer_approval`, `allow_overrides_to_approver_list_per_merge_request`, `retain_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» allow_overrides_to_approver_list_per_merge_request|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, allows overriding approvers per merge request. At least one of `allow_author_approval`, `allow_committer_approval`, `allow_overrides_to_approver_list_per_merge_request`, `retain_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» retain_approvals_on_push|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, retains the approval count on a new push. At least one of `allow_author_approval`, `allow_committer_approval`, `allow_overrides_to_approver_list_per_merge_request`, `retain_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» selective_code_owner_removals|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, resets approvals from Code Owners if their files change. To use this field, `retain_approvals_on_push` must be `true`. At least one of `allow_author_approval`, `allow_committer_approval`, `allow_overrides_to_approver_list_per_merge_request`, `retain_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» require_password_to_approve|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, requires approvers to authenticate before approving. Deprecated in GitLab 16.9. Use `require_reauthentication_to_approve` instead, which takes precedence if both are provided. At least one of `allow_author_approval`, `allow_committer_approval`, `allow_overrides_to_approver_list_per_merge_request`, `retain_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» require_reauthentication_to_approve|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, requires approvers to authenticate before approving. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/431346) in GitLab 17.1. At least one of `allow_author_approval`, `allow_committer_approval`, `allow_overrides_to_approver_list_per_merge_request`, `retain_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "allow_author_approval": true,
  "allow_committer_approval": true,
  "allow_overrides_to_approver_list_per_merge_request": true,
  "retain_approvals_on_push": true,
  "selective_code_owner_removals": true,
  "require_password_to_approve": true,
  "require_reauthentication_to_approve": true
}
```

## Approve merge request

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidApprove"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/approve \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "sha": "string",
    "publish_review": true,
    "approval_password": "secret"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/approve`

Approves a specified merge request. The currently authenticated user must be an eligible approver. The `sha` parameter ensures you are approving the current version of the merge request. If defined, the value must match the merge request’s HEAD commit SHA. A mismatch returns a `409 Conflict` response.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "sha": "string",
  "publish_review": true,
  "approval_password": "secret"
}
```

<h3 id="approve-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidApproveRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidmergerequestsmergerequestiidapproverequest)|false|none|
|» sha|body|string \| null|false|SHA at `HEAD` of the source branch of the merge request.|
|» publish_review|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, submits pending review comments.|
|» approval_password|body|string \| null|false|Current user's password, needed if [user re-authentication to approve](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/merge_requests/approvals/settings/#require-user-re-authentication-to-approve) is enabled in the project settings. Always fails if the group or GitLab Self-Managed instance is configured to force SAML authentication.|

> Example responses

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-merge-requests">Merge requests</h1>

Use this API to manage [merge requests](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/merge_requests/) in a
project, and to list the merge requests across a group or an entire instance. You can:

- Automate any part of the code review process.
- Connect code changes to external tools.
- Send merge request information to non-GitLab systems in your preferred format.
- Update, approve, merge, or block merge requests based on data from external systems.
- Add [commits from previous merge requests](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/merge_requests/commits/#show-commits-from-previous-merge-requests) to a merge request for more context.

All API calls to non-public information require authentication.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/">External documentation</a>

## Create a merge request dependency

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidBlocks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/blocks \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "blocking_merge_request_id": 0,
    "blocking_merge_request_iid": 0,
    "blocking_project_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/blocks`

Creates a merge request dependency between two merge requests. The merge request is blocked until the dependency merges.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "blocking_merge_request_id": 0,
  "blocking_merge_request_iid": 0,
  "blocking_project_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-merge-request-dependency-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request to be blocked.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidBlocksRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidmergerequestsmergerequestiidblocksrequest)|false|none|
|» blocking_merge_request_id|body|integer \| null|false|Global ID of the blocking merge request. Required if `blocking_merge_request_iid` is not provided. Mutually exclusive with `blocking_merge_request_iid`. Exactly one of `blocking_merge_request_id`, `blocking_merge_request_iid` must be provided.|
|» blocking_merge_request_iid|body|integer \| null|false|Internal ID of the blocking merge request. Required if `blocking_merge_request_id` is not provided. Mutually exclusive with `blocking_merge_request_id`. Exactly one of `blocking_merge_request_id`, `blocking_merge_request_iid` must be provided.|
|» blocking_project_id|body|string \| null \| integer \| null|false|ID or URL-encoded path of the project containing the blocking merge request. Required when `blocking_merge_request_iid` refers to a merge request in a different project. Defaults to the current project.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|integer \| null|false|none|

<h3 id="create-a-merge-request-dependency-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

```bash
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/blocks/{block_id}`

Retrieves a specified merge request dependency.

|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|block_id|path|integer|true|ID of the merge request block.|

## Retrieve blocked merge requests

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidBlockees"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/blockees \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/blockees`

Retrieves merge requests blocked by a specified merge request.

<h3 id="retrieve-blocked-merge-requests-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

## Retrieve merge request diff versions

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidVersions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/versions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/versions`

Retrieves merge request diff versions.

<h3 id="retrieve-merge-request-diff-versions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "head_commit_sha": "1234abcd",
    "base_commit_sha": "1234abcd",
    "start_commit_sha": "1234abcd",
    "created_at": "2022-01-31T15:10:45.080Z",
    "merge_request_id": 1,
    "state": "collected",
    "real_size": "1",
    "patch_id_sha": "1234abcd"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="retrieve-merge-request-diff-versions-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<h3 id="retrieve-merge-request-diff-versions-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesMergeRequestDiff](#schemaapientitiesmergerequestdiff)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

</aside>

## Retrieve a merge request diff version

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidVersionsVersionId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/versions/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/versions/{version_id}`

Retrieves a merge request diff version.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-merge-request-diff-version-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|version_id|path|integer|true|ID of the merge request diff version.|
|unidiff|query|boolean|false|If `true`, presents diffs in the [unified diff](https://www.gnu.org/software/diffutils/manual/html_node/Detailed-Unified.html) format.|

## List all merge requests

<a id="opIdgetApiV4MergeRequests"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/merge_requests \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/merge_requests`

Lists all merge requests accessible to the authenticated user. By default, returns only merge requests created by the current user. Use `scope=all` to get all merge requests.

<h3 id="list-all-merge-requests-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|author_id|query|integer \| null|false|Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`.|
|author_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.|
|assignee_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`.|
|assignee_username|query|[string]|false|Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`.|
|reviewer_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_id`.|
|labels|query|[string]|false|Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|milestone|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.|
|my_reaction_emoji|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction.|
|reviewer_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_username`.|
|state|query|string|false|Filter merge requests by state.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Returns merge requests ordered by `created_at`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `title`, `updated_at` or `merged_at` fields. Introduced in GitLab 14.8.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|with_labels_details|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response returns more details for each label in the labels field: `name`, `color`, `description`, `description_html`, `text_color`.|
|with_merge_status_recheck|query|boolean|false|If `true`, this projection requests (but does not guarantee) an asynchronous recalculation of the `merge_status` field. Enable the `restrict_merge_status_recheck` [feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) to ignore this attribute when requested by users without the Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests created on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests updated on or after the specified time.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests updated on or before the specified time.|
|merged_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests merged on or after the specified time.|
|merged_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests merged on or before the specified time.|
|view|query|string \| null|false|If `simple`, returns the `iid`, URL, title, description, and basic state of merge request.|
|scope|query|string|false|Return merge requests for the given scope. `reviews_for_me` returns merge requests where the current user is assigned as a reviewer.|
|source_branch|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given source branch.|
|source_project_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given source project ID.|
|target_branch|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given target branch.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Search merge requests against their `title` and `description`. Combine with the `in` attribute.|
|in|query|string \| null|false|Modify the scope of the `search` attribute to `title`, `description`, or `title,description`. If omitted, defaults to `title,description`.|
|wip|query|string \| null|false|Filter merge requests by their `wip` status. `yes` returns only draft merge requests, `no` returns non-draft merge requests. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/234098) in GitLab 19.0. Use `draft` instead. Mutually exclusive with `draft`.|
|draft|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only draft merge requests. If `false`, returns only non-draft merge requests. Mutually exclusive with `wip`.|
|not|query|object \| null|false|Return merge requests that do not match the parameters supplied. Accepts: `labels`, `milestone`, `author_id`, `author_username`, `assignee_id`, `assignee_username`, `reviewer_id`, `reviewer_username`, `my_reaction_emoji`.|
|not[author_id]|query|integer \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`.|
|not[author_username]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`.|
|not[assignee_id]|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`.|
|not[assignee_username]|query|[string]|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`.|
|not[reviewer_username]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_id]`.|
|not[labels]|query|[string]|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|not[milestone]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.|
|not[my_reaction_emoji]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction.|
|not[reviewer_id]|query|integer \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_username]`.|
|deployed_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed before the specified time.|
|deployed_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed after the specified time.|
|environment|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed to the given environment.|
|merge_user_id|query|integer \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given user `id`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_username`.|
|merge_user_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_id`.|
|approver_ids|query|string \| null \| array|false|Return merge requests that have all specified users as eligible approvers according to the approval rules. `None` returns merge requests with no eligible approvers, and `Any` returns merge requests with at least one eligible approver. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|approved_by_ids|query|string \| null \| array|false|Return merge requests approved by all the users with the given `id`, up to 5 users. `None` returns merge requests with no approvals, and `Any` returns merge requests with an approval. Mutually exclusive with `approved_by_usernames`.|
|approved_by_usernames|query|string \| null \| array|false|Return merge requests approved by all the users with the given `username`, up to 5 users. `None` returns merge requests with no approvals, and `Any` returns merge requests with an approval. Mutually exclusive with `approved_by_ids`.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|non_archived|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns merge requests from non-archived projects only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|state|opened|
|state|closed|
|state|locked|
|state|merged|
|state|all|
|order_by|created_at|
|order_by|label_priority|
|order_by|milestone_due|
|order_by|popularity|
|order_by|priority|
|order_by|title|
|order_by|updated_at|
|order_by|merged_at|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|
|view|simple|
|scope|created-by-me|
|scope|assigned-to-me|
|scope|created_by_me|
|scope|assigned_to_me|
|scope|reviews_for_me|
|scope|all|
|wip|yes|
|wip|no|
