## List all group merge requests

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdMergeRequests"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/merge_requests \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/merge_requests`

Lists all merge requests for a specified group and any subgroups.

<h3 id="list-all-group-merge-requests-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|author_id|query|integer \| null|false|Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`.|
|author_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.|
|assignee_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`.|
|assignee_username|query|[string]|false|Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`.|
|reviewer_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_id`.|
|labels|query|[string]|false|Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|milestone|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.|
|my_reaction_emoji|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction.|
|reviewer_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_username`.|
|state|query|string|false|Filter merge requests by state.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Returns merge requests ordered by `created_at`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `title`, `updated_at` or `merged_at` fields. Introduced in GitLab 14.8.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|with_labels_details|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response returns more details for each label in the labels field: `name`, `color`, `description`, `description_html`, `text_color`.|
|with_merge_status_recheck|query|boolean|false|If `true`, this projection requests (but does not guarantee) an asynchronous recalculation of the `merge_status` field. Enable the `restrict_merge_status_recheck` [feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) to ignore this attribute when requested by users without the Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests created on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests updated on or after the specified time.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests updated on or before the specified time.|
|merged_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests merged on or after the specified time.|
|merged_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests merged on or before the specified time.|
|view|query|string \| null|false|If `simple`, returns the `iid`, URL, title, description, and basic state of merge request.|
|scope|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests for the given scope. `reviews_for_me` returns merge requests where the current user is assigned as a reviewer.|
|source_branch|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given source branch.|
|source_project_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given source project ID.|
|target_branch|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given target branch.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Search merge requests against their `title` and `description`. Combine with the `in` attribute.|
|in|query|string \| null|false|Modify the scope of the `search` attribute to `title`, `description`, or `title,description`. If omitted, defaults to `title,description`.|
|wip|query|string \| null|false|Filter merge requests by their `wip` status. `yes` returns only draft merge requests, `no` returns non-draft merge requests. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/234098) in GitLab 19.0. Use `draft` instead. Mutually exclusive with `draft`.|
|draft|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only draft merge requests. If `false`, returns only non-draft merge requests. Mutually exclusive with `wip`.|
|not|query|object \| null|false|Return merge requests that do not match the parameters supplied. Accepts: `labels`, `milestone`, `author_id`, `author_username`, `assignee_id`, `assignee_username`, `reviewer_id`, `reviewer_username`, `my_reaction_emoji`.|
|not[author_id]|query|integer \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`.|
|not[author_username]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`.|
|not[assignee_id]|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`.|
|not[assignee_username]|query|[string]|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`.|
|not[reviewer_username]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_id]`.|
|not[labels]|query|[string]|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|not[milestone]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.|
|not[my_reaction_emoji]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction.|
|not[reviewer_id]|query|integer \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_username]`.|
|deployed_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed before the specified time.|
|deployed_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed after the specified time.|
|environment|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed to the given environment.|
|merge_user_id|query|integer \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given user `id`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_username`.|
|merge_user_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_id`.|
|approver_ids|query|string \| null \| array|false|Return merge requests that have all specified users as eligible approvers according to the approval rules. `None` returns merge requests with no eligible approvers, and `Any` returns merge requests with at least one eligible approver. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|approved_by_ids|query|string \| null \| array|false|Return merge requests approved by all the users with the given `id`, up to 5 users. `None` returns merge requests with no approvals, and `Any` returns merge requests with an approval. Mutually exclusive with `approved_by_usernames`.|
|approved_by_usernames|query|string \| null \| array|false|Return merge requests approved by all the users with the given `username`, up to 5 users. `None` returns merge requests with no approvals, and `Any` returns merge requests with an approval. Mutually exclusive with `approved_by_ids`.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|non_archived|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns merge requests from non-archived projects only.|

## Set the estimated time for a merge request

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidTimeEstimate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/time_estimate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "duration": "3h30m"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/time_estimate`

Sets an estimated time of work for a specified merge request.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "duration": "3h30m"
}
```

<h3 id="set-the-estimated-time-for-a-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|The internal ID of the merge_request.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidTimeEstimateRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidmergerequestsmergerequestiidtimeestimaterequest)|true|none|
|» duration|body|string \| null|true|Duration in human-readable format, for example `3h30m`.|

```json
  "time_estimate": 12600,
  "total_time_spent": 3600,
  "human_time_estimate": "3h 30m",

}
```

## Retrieve time tracking stats for a merge request


`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/time_stats`

|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|The internal ID of the merge_request|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "time_estimate": 12600,
  "total_time_spent": 3600,
  "human_time_estimate": "3h 30m",
  "human_total_time_spent": "1h"
}
```

## List all project merge requests

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequests"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests`

Lists all project merge requests.

<h3 id="list-all-project-merge-requests-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|author_id|query|integer \| null|false|Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`.|
|author_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.|
|assignee_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`.|
|assignee_username|query|[string]|false|Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`.|
|reviewer_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_id`.|
|labels|query|[string]|false|Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|milestone|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.|
|my_reaction_emoji|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction.|
|reviewer_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `reviewer_username`.|
|state|query|string|false|Filter merge requests by state.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Returns merge requests ordered by `created_at`, `label_priority`, `milestone_due`, `popularity`, `priority`, `title`, `updated_at` or `merged_at` fields. Introduced in GitLab 14.8.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|with_labels_details|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response returns more details for each label in the labels field: `name`, `color`, `description`, `description_html`, `text_color`.|
|with_merge_status_recheck|query|boolean|false|If `true`, this projection requests (but does not guarantee) an asynchronous recalculation of the `merge_status` field. Enable the `restrict_merge_status_recheck` [feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) to ignore this attribute when requested by users without the Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests created on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests updated on or after the specified time.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests updated on or before the specified time.|
|merged_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests merged on or after the specified time.|
|merged_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests merged on or before the specified time.|
|view|query|string \| null|false|If `simple`, returns the `iid`, URL, title, description, and basic state of merge request.|
|scope|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests for the given scope. `reviews_for_me` returns merge requests where the current user is assigned as a reviewer.|
|source_branch|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given source branch.|
|source_project_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given source project ID.|
|target_branch|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests with the given target branch.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Search merge requests against their `title` and `description`. Combine with the `in` attribute.|
|in|query|string \| null|false|Modify the scope of the `search` attribute to `title`, `description`, or `title,description`. If omitted, defaults to `title,description`.|
|wip|query|string \| null|false|Filter merge requests by their `wip` status. `yes` returns only draft merge requests, `no` returns non-draft merge requests. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/234098) in GitLab 19.0. Use `draft` instead. Mutually exclusive with `draft`.|
|draft|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only draft merge requests. If `false`, returns only non-draft merge requests. Mutually exclusive with `wip`.|
|not|query|object \| null|false|Return merge requests that do not match the parameters supplied. Accepts: `labels`, `milestone`, `author_id`, `author_username`, `assignee_id`, `assignee_username`, `reviewer_id`, `reviewer_username`, `my_reaction_emoji`.|
|not[author_id]|query|integer \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given user `id`. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`.|
|not[author_username]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`.|
|not[assignee_id]|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned merge requests. `Any` returns merge requests with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`.|
|not[assignee_username]|query|[string]|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`.|
|not[reviewer_username]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given `username`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Introduced in GitLab 13.8. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_id]`.|
|not[labels]|query|[string]|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests matching a comma-separated list of labels. `None` lists all merge requests with no labels. `Any` lists all merge requests with at least one label. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|not[milestone]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests for a specific milestone. `None` returns merge requests with no milestone. `Any` returns merge requests that have an assigned milestone.|
|not[my_reaction_emoji]|query|string \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests reacted by the authenticated user by the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues not given a reaction. `Any` returns issues given at least one reaction.|
|not[reviewer_id]|query|integer \| null|false|`<Negated>` Returns merge requests which have the user as a reviewer with the given user `id`. `None` returns merge requests with no reviewers. `Any` returns merge requests with any reviewer. Mutually exclusive with `not[reviewer_username]`.|
|deployed_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed before the specified time.|
|deployed_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed after the specified time.|
|environment|query|string \| null|false|Return merge requests deployed to the given environment.|
|merge_user_id|query|integer \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given user `id`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_username`.|
|merge_user_username|query|string \| null|false|Returns merge requests which have been merged by the user with the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `merge_user_id`.|
|approver_ids|query|string \| null \| array|false|Return merge requests that have all specified users as eligible approvers according to the approval rules. `None` returns merge requests with no eligible approvers, and `Any` returns merge requests with at least one eligible approver. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|approved_by_ids|query|string \| null \| array|false|Return merge requests approved by all the users with the given `id`, up to 5 users. `None` returns merge requests with no approvals, and `Any` returns merge requests with an approval. Mutually exclusive with `approved_by_usernames`.|
|approved_by_usernames|query|string \| null \| array|false|Return merge requests approved by all the users with the given `username`, up to 5 users. `None` returns merge requests with no approvals, and `Any` returns merge requests with an approval. Mutually exclusive with `approved_by_ids`.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|iids|query|[integer]|false|Return merge requests matching the provided internal IDs.|

## Create a merge request

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequests"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "title": "string",
    "source_branch": "string",
    "target_branch": "string",
    "target_project_id": 0,
    "assignee_id": 0,
    "assignee_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "reviewer_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "description": "string",
    "labels": [
      "string"
    ],
    "add_labels": [
      "string"
    ],
    "remove_labels": [
      "string"
    ],
    "milestone_id": 0,
    "milestone": "string",
    "remove_source_branch": true,
    "allow_collaboration": true,
    "allow_maintainer_to_push": true,
    "squash": true,
    "merge_after": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "approvals_before_merge": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests`

Creates a merge request for a project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "title": "string",
  "source_branch": "string",
  "target_branch": "string",
  "target_project_id": 0,
  "assignee_id": 0,
  "assignee_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "reviewer_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "description": "string",
  "labels": [
    "string"
  ],
  "add_labels": [
    "string"
  ],
  "remove_labels": [
    "string"
  ],
  "milestone_id": 0,
  "milestone": "string",
  "remove_source_branch": true,
  "allow_collaboration": true,
  "allow_maintainer_to_push": true,
  "squash": true,
  "merge_after": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "approvals_before_merge": 0
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidmergerequestsrequest)|true|none|
|» title|body|string \| null|true|Title of the merge request.|
|» source_branch|body|string \| null|true|Source branch.|
|» target_branch|body|string \| null|true|Target branch.|
|» target_project_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the target project for the merge request. If omitted, defaults to the source project.|
|» assignee_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the user to assign to the merge request. Set to `0` or leave empty to unassign all assignees.|
|» assignee_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of the users to assign to the merge request, as a comma-separated list. Set to `0` or leave empty to unassign all assignees.|
|» reviewer_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of the users to set as reviewers of the merge request, as a comma-separated list. If set to `0` or left empty, no reviewers are set.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the merge request. Limited to 1,048,576 characters.|
|» labels|body|[string]|false|Comma-separated label names for the merge request. If a label does not already exist, this creates a new project label and assigns it to the merge request. Set to an empty string to unassign all labels.|
|» add_labels|body|[string]|false|Comma-separated label names to add to the merge request. If a label does not already exist, this creates a new project label and assigns it to the merge request.|
|» remove_labels|body|[string]|false|Comma-separated label names to remove from the merge request.|
|» milestone_id|body|integer \| null|false|Global ID of a milestone to assign to the merge request. Set to `0` or leave empty to unassign the milestone. Mutually exclusive with `milestone`.|
|» milestone|body|string \| null|false|The title of a project or ancestor-group milestone to assign the merge request to. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_id`.|
|» remove_source_branch|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the source branch is removed when the merge request merges.|
|» allow_collaboration|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, allows commits from members who can merge to the target branch.|
|» allow_maintainer_to_push|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, allows commits from members who can merge to the target branch. Deprecated. Use `allow_collaboration` instead.|
|» squash|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, squashes all commits into a single commit on merge. When omitted, defaults to the [project's squash option setting](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/merge_requests/squash_and_merge/#configure-squash-options-for-a-project), which can override this value at merge time.|
|» merge_after|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Date after which the merge request can be merged. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/510992) in GitLab 17.8.|
|» approvals_before_merge|body|integer \| null|false|Number of approvals required before the merge request can be merged. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/353097) in GitLab 16.0. Premium and Ultimate only.|

## Retrieve a merge request

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIid"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}`

Retrieves a merge request for a specified project.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|render_html|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the response includes rendered HTML for title and description.|
|include_diverged_commits_count|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the response includes the commits behind the target branch.|
|include_rebase_in_progress|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the response includes whether a rebase operation is in progress.|

## Update a merge request

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIid"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "title": "string",
    "target_branch": "string",
    "state_event": "close",
    "discussion_locked": true,
    "assignee_id": 0,
    "assignee_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "reviewer_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "description": "string",
    "labels": [
      "string"
    ],
    "add_labels": [
      "string"
    ],
    "remove_labels": [
      "string"
    ],
    "milestone_id": 0,
    "milestone": "string",
    "remove_source_branch": true,
    "allow_collaboration": true,
    "allow_maintainer_to_push": true,
    "squash": true,
    "merge_after": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "approvals_before_merge": 0
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}`

Updates a merge request for a specified project.

```json
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

## Delete a merge request

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIid"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}`

Deletes a specified merge request for a project. Administrators and project Owners only.

<h3 id="delete-a-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|

<h3 id="delete-a-merge-request-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|No Content|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|
|412|Precondition Failed|Precondition failed|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/diffs`

Lists all merge request diffs.

<h3 id="list-all-merge-request-diffs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|unidiff|query|boolean|false|If `true`, presents diffs in the [unified diff](https://www.gnu.org/software/diffutils/manual/html_node/Detailed-Unified.html) format.|

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "diff": "@@ -71,6 +71,8 @@\\n...",
    "collapsed": true,
    "too_large": true,
    "new_path": "doc/update/5.4-to-6.0.md",
    "old_path": "doc/update/5.4-to-6.0.md",
    "a_mode": "100755",
    "b_mode": "100644",
    "new_file": true,
    "renamed_file": true,
    "deleted_file": true,
    "generated_file": true
  }
]
```

## Create a merge request pipeline

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidPipelines"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/pipelines \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "async": false
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/pipelines`

Creates a merge request pipeline. Pipelines created with this operation must configure `.gitlab-ci.yml` with `only: [merge_requests]` to create jobs.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "async": false
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-merge-request-pipeline-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidPipelinesRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidmergerequestsmergerequestiidpipelinesrequest)|false|none|
|» async|body|boolean|false|If `true`, creates the merge request pipeline asynchronously outside the API request, returning an empty response with a `202` status code. Pipeline creation can still fail after a `202` response.|

## Merge a merge request

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidMerge"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/merge \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "merge_commit_message": "string",
    "squash_commit_message": "string",
    "should_remove_source_branch": true,
    "merge_when_pipeline_succeeds": true,
    "auto_merge": true,
    "sha": "string",
    "squash": true,
    "skip_merge_train": true
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/merge`

Merges a merge request. Accepts and merges changes submitted with the merge request.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "merge_commit_message": "string",
  "squash_commit_message": "string",
  "should_remove_source_branch": true,
  "merge_when_pipeline_succeeds": true,
  "auto_merge": true,
  "sha": "string",
  "squash": true,
  "skip_merge_train": true
}
```

<h3 id="merge-a-merge-request-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidMergeRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidmergerequestsmergerequestiidmergerequest)|false|none|
|» merge_commit_message|body|string \| null|false|Custom merge commit message.|
|» squash_commit_message|body|string \| null|false|Custom squash commit message.|
|» should_remove_source_branch|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, removes the source branch.|
|» merge_when_pipeline_succeeds|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, merges the merge request automatically once the pipeline succeeds. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/521291) in GitLab 17.11. Use `auto_merge` instead.|
|» auto_merge|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the merge request merges when checks pass.|
|» sha|body|string \| null|false|SHA that must match the HEAD of the source branch, otherwise the merge fails. Use to ensure that only reviewed commits are merged. Required if the [require a commit SHA on the merge requests API](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/manage/#require-a-commit-sha-on-the-merge-requests-api) setting is enabled for the group or instance.|
|» squash|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, squashes all commits into a single commit on merge.|
|» skip_merge_train|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, skips the merge train restart when merging immediately in a project configured for merge trains.|

## Merge to default merge ref path

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidMergeRef"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/merge_ref \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/merge_ref`

Merges the changes between the merge request source and target branches into the `refs/merge-requests/:iid/merge` ref, of the target project repository, if possible. This ref has the state the target branch would have if a regular merge action was taken.

<h3 id="merge-to-default-merge-ref-path-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|

<h3 id="merge-to-default-merge-ref-path-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

## Cancel merge when pipeline succeeds

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidCancelMergeWhenPipelineSucceeds"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/cancel_merge_when_pipeline_succeeds \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/cancel_merge_when_pipeline_succeeds`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Cancels an automatic merge for a merge request that has been set to merge when the pipeline succeeds. This endpoint does not return the merge request. Deprecated in GitLab 19.5. Use POST /projects/:id/merge_requests/:merge_request_iid/cancel_auto_merge instead.

<h3 id="cancel-merge-when-pipeline-succeeds-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|

<h3 id="cancel-merge-when-pipeline-succeeds-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The status field of the response body is success when an auto-merge was canceled, and error when the merge request had none set|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|
|405|Method Not Allowed|Method not allowed|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Cancel auto merge

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidCancelAutoMerge"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/cancel_auto_merge \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/cancel_auto_merge`

Cancels an automatic merge for a merge request that has been set to merge automatically. Use this endpoint instead of `cancel_merge_when_pipeline_succeeds`, which returns a status hash rather than the merge request.

|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|

## Rebase a merge request

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidRebase"></a>

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/merge_requests/0/rebase \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "skip_ci": true
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}/rebase`

Rebases a merge request. Automatically rebases the `source_branch` of the merge request against its `target_branch`.

|» skip_ci|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, skips creating a CI pipeline.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-merge-trains">Merge trains</h1>

Use this API to retrieve the [merge trains](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/pipelines/merge_trains/) of a
project. These endpoints require the Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role, and support
[offset-based pagination](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/rest/#offset-based-pagination).

Each object in a response represents one merge request in a train, not an entire train. Requesting
merge trains without a target branch can return entries from more than one train in the project.

Responses do not include an explicit queue position, and return merge requests as a flat list rather
than grouped by train:

- For an exact queue position, sort by `id` in ascending order, or use the GraphQL API
  [`MergeTrainCar.index`](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/graphql/reference/objects/#mergetraincar) field.
- To group merge requests by train, use the `target_branch` attribute, or query the GraphQL API
  [`Project.mergeTrains`](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/graphql/reference/objects/#project) and
  [`MergeTrain.cars`](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/graphql/reference/objects/#mergetrain) fields.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_trains/">External documentation</a>

## List all merge trains for a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdMergeTrains"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/11/merge_trains \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_trains`

Lists all merge trains for a specified project.

<h3 id="list-all-merge-trains-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|scope|query|string \| null|false|Filter merge trains by scope.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order by `id`. A lower `id` value means the merge request was added to the train earlier.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|scope|active|
|scope|complete|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|target_branch|path|string|true|Target branch of the merge train.|
|scope|query|string \| null|false|Filter merge trains by scope.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order by `id`. A lower `id` value means the merge request was added to the train earlier.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|scope|active|
|scope|complete|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

## Add a merge request to a merge train

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdMergeTrainsMergeRequestsMergeRequestIid"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/11/merge_trains/merge_requests/0 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "sha": "string",
    "squash": true,
    "when_pipeline_succeeds": true,
    "auto_merge": true
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_trains/merge_requests/{merge_request_iid}`

Adds a specified merge request to a merge train.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "sha": "string",
  "squash": true,
  "when_pipeline_succeeds": true,
  "auto_merge": true
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-merge-request-to-a-merge-train-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|merge_request_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the merge request.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdMergeTrainsMergeRequestsMergeRequestIidRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidmergetrainsmergerequestsmergerequestiidrequest)|false|none|
|» sha|body|string \| null|false|SHA that must match the `HEAD` of the source branch, otherwise the merge fails.|
|» squash|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the commits are squashed into a single commit on merge.|
|» when_pipeline_succeeds|body|boolean \| null|false|[Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/521290) in GitLab 17.11. Use `auto_merge` instead.|
|» auto_merge|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the merge request is added to the merge train when checks pass. If `false` or unspecified, it is added to the merge train immediately.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-metadata">Metadata</h1>

Use this API to retrieve metadata about a GitLab instance, including its version, its revision,
whether it is Enterprise Edition, and the configuration of the
[GitLab agent server for Kubernetes (KAS)](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/clusters/kas/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/metadata/">External documentation</a>

## Retrieve metadata information for this GitLab instance

<a id="opIdgetApiV4Metadata"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/metadata \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/metadata`

Retrieves metadata information for the GitLab instance.

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "version": "15.2-pre",
  "revision": "c401a659d0c",
  "kas": {
    "enabled": true,
    "externalUrl": "grpc://gitlab.example.com:8150",
    "externalK8sProxyUrl": "https://gitlab.example.com:8150/k8s-proxy",
    "version": "15.0.0"
  },
  "enterprise": true,
  "plan": "ultimate"
}
```

|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-metric-images">Metric images</h1>

Use this API to upload, list, update, and delete the metric images attached to an issue, such as the
charts attached to an [incident](https://docs.gitlab.com/operations/incident_management/incidents/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/issues/">External documentation</a>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-metrics">Metrics</h1>

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/usage_data/">External documentation</a>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-migrations">Migrations</h1>

Use this API to mark GitLab database migrations as successful, so that a deployment can proceed
without re-running them.

These endpoints are available for GitLab Self-Managed and require administrator access to the instance.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/database_migrations/">External documentation</a>

## List all pending migrations

<a id="opIdgetApiV4AdminMigrationsPending"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/admin/migrations/pending \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/admin/migrations/pending`

Lists all pending migrations for the instance.

<h3 id="list-all-pending-migrations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|database|query|string|false|Database name to query.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|database|main|
|database|ci|
|database|sec|
|database|embedding|
|database|geo|

<h3 id="list-all-pending-migrations-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|

</aside>

## Update status of a migration

<a id="opIdpostApiV4AdminMigrationsTimestampMark"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/admin/migrations/0/mark \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "database": "main"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/admin/migrations/{timestamp}/mark`

Updates the status of a migration to indicate a successful execution. This prevent them from being executed by the `db:migrate` tasks. Use this API to skip failing migrations after you determine they are safe to skip.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "database": "main"
}
```

<h3 id="update-status-of-a-migration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|timestamp|path|integer|true|Version timestamp of the migration.|
|body|body|[postApiV4AdminMigrationsTimestampMarkRequest](#schemapostapiv4adminmigrationstimestampmarkrequest)|false|none|
|» database|body|string|false|Database name for which the migration is skipped.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» database|main|
|» database|ci|
|» database|sec|
|» database|embedding|
|» database|geo|

<h3 id="update-status-of-a-migration-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|201 Created|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|403 Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|404 Not found|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|You can mark only pending migrations|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-milestones">Milestones</h1>

Use this API to manage [milestones](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/milestones/) for both
projects and groups.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/milestones/">External documentation</a>

## List all project milestones

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdMilestones"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/milestones \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/milestones`

Lists all milestones for a specified project.

<h3 id="list-all-project-milestones-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|state|query|string|false|Return "active", "closed", or "all" milestones|
|iids|query|[integer]|false|Return only the milestones having the given `iid`. Ignored if `include_ancestors` is `true`.|
|title|query|string \| null|false|The title of the milestones|
|search|query|string \| null|false|The search criteria for the title or description of the milestone|
|search_title|query|string \| null|false|The search criteria for the title of the milestone|
|include_parent_milestones|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes milestones from all parent groups. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/433298). Use `include_ancestors` instead. Mutually exclusive with `include_ancestors`.|
|include_ancestors|query|boolean \| null|false|Include milestones from all parent groups. Mutually exclusive with `include_parent_milestones`.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones updated before the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones updated after the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|containing_date|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones where start_date <= containing_date <= due_date. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|start_date|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones where due_date >= start_date. Requires end_date. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|end_date|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones where start_date <= end_date. Requires start_date. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|sort|query|string|false|Return milestones sorted in the given order|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|state|active|
|state|closed|
|state|all|
|sort|due_date_asc|
|sort|due_date_desc|
|sort|start_date_asc|
|sort|start_date_desc|
|sort|name_asc|
|sort|name_desc|
|sort|created_asc|
|sort|created_desc|
|sort|updated_asc|
|sort|updated_desc|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 0,
  "iid": 0,
  "project_id": 0,
  "group_id": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "state": "string",
  "created_at": "string",
  "updated_at": "string",
  "due_date": "string",
  "start_date": "string",
  "expired": true,
  "web_url": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="list-all-project-milestones-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesMilestone](#schemaapientitiesmilestone)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">

## List all group milestones

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdMilestones"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/milestones \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/milestones`

Lists all group milestones for a specified group.

<h3 id="list-all-group-milestones-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|state|query|string|false|Return "active", "closed", or "all" milestones|
|iids|query|[integer]|false|Return only the milestones having the given `iid`. Ignored if `include_ancestors` is `true`.|
|title|query|string \| null|false|The title of the milestones|
|search|query|string \| null|false|The search criteria for the title or description of the milestone|
|search_title|query|string \| null|false|The search criteria for the title of the milestone|
|include_parent_milestones|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes milestones from all parent groups. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/433298). Use `include_ancestors` instead. Mutually exclusive with `include_ancestors`.|
|include_ancestors|query|boolean \| null|false|Include milestones from all parent groups. Mutually exclusive with `include_parent_milestones`.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones updated before the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones updated after the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|containing_date|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones where start_date <= containing_date <= due_date. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|start_date|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones where due_date >= start_date. Requires end_date. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|end_date|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return milestones where start_date <= end_date. Requires start_date. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|sort|query|string|false|Return milestones sorted in the given order|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|include_descendants|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes milestones for the group and its descendants.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|state|active|
|state|closed|
|state|all|
|sort|due_date_asc|
|sort|due_date_desc|
|sort|start_date_asc|
|sort|start_date_desc|
|sort|name_asc|
|sort|name_desc|
|sort|created_asc|
|sort|created_desc|
|sort|updated_asc|
|sort|updated_desc|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 0,
  "iid": 0,
  "project_id": 0,
  "group_id": "string",
  "title": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "state": "string",
  "created_at": "string",
  "updated_at": "string",
  "due_date": "string",
  "start_date": "string",
  "expired": true,
  "web_url": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="list-all-group-milestones-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesMilestone](#schemaapientitiesmilestone)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<a id="opIdputApiV4GroupsIdMilestonesMilestoneId"></a>

`PUT /api/v4/groups/{id}/milestones/{milestone_id}`

Updates the specified group milestone.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "title": "string",
  "state_event": "close",
  "description": "string",
  "due_date": "string",
  "start_date": "string"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|» state_event|body|string \| null|false|State event of the milestone. At least one of `title`, `description`, `start_date`, `due_date`, `state_event` must be provided.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|The description of the milestone. At least one of `title`, `description`, `start_date`, `due_date`, `state_event` must be provided.|
|» due_date|body|string \| null|false|Due date of the milestone, in ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DD`). At least one of `title`, `description`, `start_date`, `due_date`, `state_event` must be provided.|
|» start_date|body|string \| null|false|Start date of the milestone, in ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DD`). At least one of `title`, `description`, `start_date`, `due_date`, `state_event` must be provided.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-mobile-push-subscriptions">Mobile push subscriptions</h1>

Operations related to mobile push subscriptions.

## Register a mobile device for push notifications

<a id="opIdpostApiV4UserPushSubscriptions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/user/push_subscriptions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "device_token": "string",
    "platform": "ios",
    "apns_environment": "production",
    "bundle_id": "string",
    "device_name": "string",
    "app_version": "string",
    "locale": "string",
    "payload_mode": "full"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/user/push_subscriptions`

Idempotently registers the calling user's device token for APNs push notifications. Re-registering an existing token refreshes its attributes; a token previously owned by another user is reassigned to the calling user.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "device_token": "string",
  "platform": "ios",
  "apns_environment": "production",
  "bundle_id": "string",
  "device_name": "string",
  "app_version": "string",
  "locale": "string",
  "payload_mode": "full"
}
```

<h3 id="register-a-mobile-device-for-push-notifications-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4UserPushSubscriptionsRequest](#schemapostapiv4userpushsubscriptionsrequest)|true|none|
|» device_token|body|string \| null|true|The hexadecimal APNs device token|
|» platform|body|string \| null|false|The device platform|
|» apns_environment|body|string|false|The APNs environment the token was issued for|
|» bundle_id|body|string \| null|false|The application bundle identifier|
|» device_name|body|string \| null|false|A human-readable device name|
|» app_version|body|string \| null|false|The installed application version|
|» locale|body|string \| null|false|The device locale|
|» payload_mode|body|string \| null|false|Whether notifications carry the full content or only identifiers|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» platform|ios|
|» platform|macos|
|» apns_environment|production|
|» apns_environment|sandbox|
|» payload_mode|full|
|» payload_mode|id_only|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "created_at": "2026-07-30T12:00:00.000Z"
}
```

<h3 id="register-a-mobile-device-for-push-notifications-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesMobilePushSubscription](#schemaapientitiesmobilepushsubscription)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Update a namespace

<a id="opIdputApiV4NamespacesId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/namespaces/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "shared_runners_minutes_limit": 0,
    "extra_shared_runners_minutes_limit": 0,
    "additional_purchased_storage_size": 0,
    "additional_purchased_storage_ends_on": "1970-01-01",
    "gitlab_subscription_attributes": {
      "start_date": "1970-01-01",
      "seats": 0,
      "max_seats_used": 0,
      "plan_code": "string",
      "end_date": "1970-01-01",
      "auto_renew": true,
      "trial": true,
      "trial_ends_on": "1970-01-01",
      "trial_starts_on": "1970-01-01",
      "trial_extension_type": 0
    }
  }'
```

Deprecated in 17.8

```json
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-namespace-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the namespace.|
|body|body|[putApiV4NamespacesIdRequest](#schemaputapiv4namespacesidrequest)|false|none|
|» shared_runners_minutes_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Compute minutes quota for the namespace.|
|» extra_shared_runners_minutes_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Extra compute minutes quota for the namespace.|
|» additional_purchased_storage_size|body|integer \| null|false|Additional storage size purchased for the namespace.|
|» additional_purchased_storage_ends_on|body|string(date) \| null|false|End of subscription of the additional purchased storage.|
|» gitlab_subscription_attributes|body|object \| null|false|Object that contains information on the GitLab subscription.|
|» » start_date|body|string(date) \| null|false|Start date of the subscription.|
|» » seats|body|integer \| null|false|Number of seats in the subscription.|
|» » max_seats_used|body|integer \| null|false|Highest number of active users in the last month.|
|» » plan_code|body|string \| null|false|Subscription tier code.|
|» » end_date|body|string(date) \| null|false|End date of the subscription.|
|» » auto_renew|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the subscription renews automatically on the end date.|
|» » trial|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the subscription is a trial.|
|» » trial_ends_on|body|string(date) \| null|false|End date of the trial.|
|» » trial_starts_on|body|string(date) \| null|false|Start date of the trial.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-notes">Notes</h1>

Use this API to manage the comments and system records attached to GitLab content. You can:

- Create and modify comments on issues, merge requests, epics, snippets, commits, and wiki pages.
- Retrieve [system-generated notes](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/system_notes/) about object changes.
- Control visibility with confidential and internal flags.

Some system-generated notes are tracked as separate resource events instead, including
[label](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/resource_label_events/),
[state](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/resource_state_events/),
[milestone](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/resource_milestone_events/),
[weight](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/resource_weight_events/), and
[iteration](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/resource_iteration_events/) events.

By default, `GET` requests return 20 results at a time, because the results are
[paginated](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/rest/#pagination).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/notes/">External documentation</a>

```bash
  "confidential": true,
  "internal": false,
  "created_at": "string",
  "merge_request_diff_head_sha": "string"
```
```json
}
```

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-offline-transfers">Offline transfers</h1>

Use this API to start and track offline transfer exports and imports, which migrate data between
GitLab instances that cannot reach each other over a network.

## List all offline transfer exports

<a id="opIdgetApiV4OfflineExports"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/offline_exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/offline_exports`

Lists all offline transfer exports. For more information, see https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/import/offline_transfer_migrations/

<h3 id="list-all-offline-transfer-exports-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order by creation date.|
|status|query|string \| null|false|Return offline transfer exports with the specified status.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|
|status|created|
|status|started|
|status|finished|
|status|failed|

<h3 id="list-all-offline-transfer-exports-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Start a new offline transfer export

<a id="opIdpostApiV4OfflineExports"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/offline_exports \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "bucket": "string",
    "aws_s3_configuration": {
      "aws_access_key_id": "string",
      "aws_secret_access_key": "string",
      "region": "string",
      "path_style": false
    },
    "s3_compatible_configuration": {
      "aws_access_key_id": "string",
      "aws_secret_access_key": "string",
      "region": "string",
      "endpoint": "string",
      "path_style": true
    },
    "gcs_configuration": {
      "google_project": "string",
      "google_json_key_string": "string"
    },
    "gcs_hmac_configuration": {
      "google_storage_access_key_id": "string",
      "google_storage_secret_access_key": "string",
      "region": "string",
      "path_style": true
    },
    "gcs_adc_configuration": {
      "google_project": "string"
    },
    "entities": [
      {
        "full_path": "'\''source/full/path'\'' not '\''https://example.com/source/full/path'\''"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/offline_exports`

Initiates a new offline transfer export. For more information, see https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/import/offline_transfer_migrations/

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "bucket": "string",
  "aws_s3_configuration": {
    "aws_access_key_id": "string",
    "aws_secret_access_key": "string",
    "region": "string",
    "path_style": false
  },
  "s3_compatible_configuration": {
    "aws_access_key_id": "string",
    "aws_secret_access_key": "string",
    "region": "string",
    "endpoint": "string",
    "path_style": true
  },
  "gcs_configuration": {
    "google_project": "string",
    "google_json_key_string": "string"
  },
  "gcs_hmac_configuration": {
    "google_storage_access_key_id": "string",
    "google_storage_secret_access_key": "string",
    "region": "string",
    "path_style": true
  },
  "gcs_adc_configuration": {
    "google_project": "string"
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "full_path": "'source/full/path' not 'https://example.com/source/full/path'"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="start-a-new-offline-transfer-export-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4OfflineExportsRequest](#schemapostapiv4offlineexportsrequest)|true|none|
|» bucket|body|string \| null|true|Name of the object storage bucket where export data is stored.|
|» aws_s3_configuration|body|object \| null|false|AWS S3 object storage configuration. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|» » aws_access_key_id|body|string \| null|true|AWS S3 access key ID.|
|» » aws_secret_access_key|body|string \| null|true|AWS S3 secret access key.|
|» » region|body|string \| null|true|AWS S3 object storage region.|
|» » path_style|body|boolean|false|If `true`, uses path-style URLs instead of virtual-hosted-style URLs.|
|» s3_compatible_configuration|body|object \| null|false|MinIO or other S3-compatible object storage configuration. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|» » aws_access_key_id|body|string \| null|true|S3-compatible access key ID.|
|» » aws_secret_access_key|body|string \| null|true|S3-compatible secret access key.|
|» » region|body|string \| null|true|S3-compatible object storage region.|
|» » endpoint|body|string \| null|true|Object storage location endpoint.|
|» » path_style|body|boolean|false|If `true`, uses path-style URLs instead of virtual-hosted-style URLs.|
|» gcs_configuration|body|object \| null|false|Google Cloud Storage configuration using a service account JSON key. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|» » google_project|body|string \| null|true|Google Cloud project ID.|
|» » google_json_key_string|body|string \| null|true|Google Cloud service account JSON key contents.|
|» gcs_hmac_configuration|body|object \| null|false|Google Cloud Storage configuration using S3-interoperability HMAC keys. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|» » google_storage_access_key_id|body|string \| null|true|GCS HMAC access key ID.|
|» » google_storage_secret_access_key|body|string \| null|true|GCS HMAC secret.|
|» » region|body|string \| null|true|GCS bucket region.|
|» » path_style|body|boolean|false|If `true`, uses path-style URLs instead of virtual-hosted-style URLs.|
|» gcs_adc_configuration|body|object \| null|false|Google Cloud Storage configuration using Application Default Credentials. Available on GitLab Self-Managed or GitLab Dedicated, and must be enabled by an administrator. Only administrators can use these credentials, and the bucket name must start with "gitlab-offline-transfer-". For more information, see https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/settings/import_and_export_settings/#allow-application-default-credentials-for-offline-transfer. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|» » google_project|body|string \| null|true|Google Cloud project ID.|
|» entities|body|[object]|true|List of entities to export.|
|» » full_path|body|string \| null|true|Relative path of the entity to export.|

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/offline_imports \

    "bucket": "string",

      "endpoint": "string",
      "path_style": true
    },
    "gcs_configuration": {
      "google_project": "string",
      "google_json_key_string": "string"
    },
    "gcs_hmac_configuration": {

      "region": "string",
```

`POST /api/v4/offline_imports`

```json
{

    "aws_secret_access_key": "string",
    "region": "string",
    "endpoint": "string",
    "path_style": true
  },
  "gcs_configuration": {
    "google_project": "string",
    "google_json_key_string": "string"
  },
  "gcs_hmac_configuration": {
    "google_storage_access_key_id": "string",
    "google_storage_secret_access_key": "string",
    "region": "string",
    "path_style": true
  },
  "gcs_adc_configuration": {
    "google_project": "string"
  },
  "export_prefix": "string",
  "entities": [
    {
      "source_type": "group_entity",

      "destination_slug": "string"
    }
  ],
  "import_all": {
    "destination_namespace": "destination-group/subgroup"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="start-a-new-offline-transfer-import-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4OfflineImportsRequest](#schemapostapiv4offlineimportsrequest)|true|none|
|» bucket|body|string \| null|true|Name of the object storage bucket where export data is stored.|
|» aws_s3_configuration|body|object \| null|false|AWS S3 object storage configuration. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|» » aws_access_key_id|body|string \| null|true|AWS S3 access key ID.|
|» » aws_secret_access_key|body|string \| null|true|AWS S3 secret access key.|
|» » region|body|string \| null|true|AWS S3 object storage region.|
|» » path_style|body|boolean|false|If `true`, uses path-style URLs instead of virtual-hosted-style URLs.|
|» s3_compatible_configuration|body|object \| null|false|MinIO or other S3-compatible object storage configuration. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|» » aws_access_key_id|body|string \| null|true|S3-compatible access key ID.|
|» » aws_secret_access_key|body|string \| null|true|S3-compatible secret access key.|
|» » region|body|string \| null|true|S3-compatible object storage region.|
|» » endpoint|body|string \| null|true|Object storage location endpoint.|
|» » path_style|body|boolean|false|If `true`, uses path-style URLs instead of virtual-hosted-style URLs.|
|» gcs_configuration|body|object \| null|false|Google Cloud Storage configuration using a service account JSON key. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|» » google_project|body|string \| null|true|Google Cloud project ID.|
|» » google_json_key_string|body|string \| null|true|Google Cloud service account JSON key contents.|
|» gcs_hmac_configuration|body|object \| null|false|Google Cloud Storage configuration using S3-interoperability HMAC keys. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|» » google_storage_access_key_id|body|string \| null|true|GCS HMAC access key ID.|
|» » google_storage_secret_access_key|body|string \| null|true|GCS HMAC secret.|
|» » region|body|string \| null|true|GCS bucket region.|
|» » path_style|body|boolean|false|If `true`, uses path-style URLs instead of virtual-hosted-style URLs.|
|» gcs_adc_configuration|body|object \| null|false|Google Cloud Storage configuration using Application Default Credentials. Available on GitLab Self-Managed or GitLab Dedicated, and must be enabled by an administrator. Only administrators can use these credentials, and the bucket name must start with "gitlab-offline-transfer-". For more information, see https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/settings/import_and_export_settings/#allow-application-default-credentials-for-offline-transfer. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|» » google_project|body|string \| null|true|Google Cloud project ID.|
|» export_prefix|body|string \| null|true|Prefix of the export within the bucket.|
|» entities|body|[object]|false|List of entities to import. Exactly one of `entities`, `import_all` must be provided.|
|» » source_type|body|string|true|Type of the entity to import.|
|» » source_full_path|body|string \| null|true|Full path of the entity on the source instance.|
|» » destination_namespace|body|string \| null|true|Full path of the destination namespace.|
|» » destination_slug|body|string \| null|false|Destination slug for the imported entity.|
|» import_all|body|object \| null|false|Import every top-level group in the export, recreating the source instance structure. Exactly one of `entities`, `import_all` must be provided.|
|» » destination_namespace|body|string \| null|true|Full path of the destination namespace the source structure is recreated under. Use an empty string to recreate it at the instance root.|

|Parameter|Value|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-orbit">Orbit</h1>

Use this API to query [GitLab Orbit](https://docs.gitlab.com/orbit/),
which indexes a group's software development lifecycle.

> [!note]
> The availability of these endpoints is controlled by a feature flag, and GitLab Orbit is in beta.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/orbit/">External documentation</a>

## Execute a query

<a id="opIdpostApiV4OrbitQuery"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/orbit/query \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "query": {},
    "response_format": "raw",
    "source_type": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/orbit/query`

Executes a query against the Orbit gRPC service.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "query": {},
  "response_format": "raw",
  "source_type": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="execute-a-query-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4OrbitQueryRequest](#schemapostapiv4orbitqueryrequest)|true|none|
|» query|body|object \| null \| string \| null|true|JSON query object, or GQL text when enabled for the current user|
|» » *oneOf*|body|object \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» response_format|body|string|false|Response format: raw, llm, or gql|
|» source_type|body|string \| null|false|Optional frontend source subtype (e.g. code_intelligence)|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» response_format|raw|
|» response_format|llm|
|» response_format|gql|

<h3 id="execute-a-query-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<a id="opIdpostApiV4OrbitQueryName"></a>

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/orbit/query/string \

  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/orbit/query/{name}`

Executes a server-defined named query against the Orbit gRPC service. Requires a JSON request body: form encoding stringifies nested parameter values, which the per-query parameter schemas reject.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "parameters": {},
  "response_format": "raw",
  "source_type": "string"
}
```

|body|body|[postApiV4OrbitQueryNameRequest](#schemapostapiv4orbitquerynamerequest)|false|none|
|» parameters|body|object|false|Named query parameters|
|» response_format|body|string|false|Response format: raw, llm, or gql|
|» source_type|body|string \| null|false|Optional frontend source subtype (e.g. code_intelligence)|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» response_format|raw|
|» response_format|llm|
|» response_format|gql|

## Get entity context

<a id="opIdpostApiV4OrbitContext"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/orbit/context \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "tokens": [
      "string"
    ],
    "expand": false,
    "response_format": "raw"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/orbit/context`

Resolves one Orbit token to a PostgreSQL summary and, optionally, its graph neighborhood. Requests that reach token resolution count against the orbit_query rate limit; with expand, they run at most one billable graph query. Requires a JSON request body.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "tokens": [
    "string"
  ],
  "expand": false,
  "response_format": "raw"
}
```

<h3 id="get-entity-context-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4OrbitContextRequest](#schemapostapiv4orbitcontextrequest)|true|none|
|» tokens|body|[string]|true|Exactly one token: Type[id], a GID, an instance URL, path!iid, path#iid, or path&iid (epic)|
|» expand|body|boolean|false|Attach the graph neighborhood of the entity|
|» » *oneOf*|body|boolean|false|none|
|» response_format|body|string|false|Response format: raw or llm|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» response_format|raw|
|» response_format|llm|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "version": "1.1.0",
  "entities": [
    {
      "token": "MergeRequest[123]",
      "resolved_token": "MergeRequest[123]",
      "type": "MergeRequest",
      "id": "123",
      "found": true,
      "summary": {},
      "error": {},
      "expansion": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="get-entity-context-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesOrbitContext](#schemaapientitiesorbitcontext)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|
|429|Too Many Requests|Too many requests|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>
