## Create an organization

<a id="opIdpostApiV4Organizations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/organizations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'name=string' \
  -F 'path=string' \
  -F 'description=string' \
  -F 'visibility=private' \
  -F 'avatar=@/path/to/file'
```

`POST /api/v4/organizations`

Creates an organization. This feature was introduced in GitLab 17.5. This feature is behind the `allow_organization_creation` feature flag. In GitLab 18.3, the feature flag changed to `organization_switching`. In GitLab 19.4, the feature flag changed to `org_stage_experimental`.

> Body parameter

```yaml
name: string
path: string
description: string
visibility: private
avatar: string
```

<h3 id="create-an-organization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4OrganizationsRequest](#schemapostapiv4organizationsrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|The name of the organization|
|» path|body|string \| null|true|The path of the organization|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|The description of the organization|
|» visibility|body|string \| null|false|The visibility level of the organization|
|» avatar|body|string(binary) \| null|false|The avatar image for the organization|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» visibility|private|
|» visibility|public|

> 201 Response

```json
  "visibility": "public",

}
```

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-packages">Packages</h1>

Use this API to manage the [packages](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/package_registry/) stored
in a project or a group.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/packages/">External documentation</a>

## List all packages for a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdPackages"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/packages \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/packages`

Lists all packages for a specified project. All package types are included in results. Unauthenticated requests return only packages of public projects. By default, packages with `default`, `deprecated`, and `error` status are returned. Use the `status` parameter to view other packages.

<h3 id="list-all-packages-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|package_type|query|string \| null|false|Filter packages by type.|
|package_name|query|string \| null|false|Filter packages by name, using a fuzzy search.|
|package_version|query|string \| null|false|Filter packages by version. When used together with `include_versionless`, versionless packages are not returned.|
|include_versionless|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes versionless packages in the response.|
|status|query|string \| null|false|Filter packages by status.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|order_by|created_at|
|order_by|name|
|order_by|version|
|order_by|type|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|
|package_type|maven|
|package_type|npm|
|package_type|conan|
|package_type|nuget|
|package_type|pypi|
|package_type|composer|
|package_type|generic|
|package_type|golang|
|package_type|debian|
|package_type|rubygems|
|package_type|helm|
|package_type|terraform_module|
|package_type|rpm|
|package_type|ml_model|
|package_type|cargo|
|status|default|
|status|hidden|
|status|processing|
|status|error|
|status|pending_destruction|
|status|deprecated|

## List all package pipelines

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdPackagesPackageIdPipelines"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/packages/0/pipelines \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/packages/{package_id}/pipelines`

Lists all pipelines for a specified package. The results are sorted by `id` in descending order. The results are paginated and return up to 20 records per page. This feature was introduced in GitLab 16.1.

<h3 id="list-all-package-pipelines-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items per page|
|package_id|path|integer|true|ID of the package.|
|cursor|query|string \| null|false|Cursor for obtaining the next set of records.|

## List all packages for a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdPackages"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/packages \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/packages`

Lists all packages for a specified group. When accessed without authentication, only packages of public projects are returned. By default, packages with `default`, `deprecated`, and `error` status are returned. Use the `status` parameter to view other packages.

<h3 id="list-all-packages-for-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|exclude_subgroups|query|boolean|false|If `true`, excludes packages from subgroup projects.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|package_type|query|string \| null|false|Filter packages by type.|
|package_name|query|string \| null|false|Filter packages by name, using a fuzzy search.|
|package_version|query|string \| null|false|Filter packages by version. When used together with `include_versionless`, versionless packages are not returned.|
|include_versionless|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes versionless packages in the response.|
|status|query|string \| null|false|Filter packages by status.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|order_by|created_at|
|order_by|name|
|order_by|version|
|order_by|type|
|order_by|project_path|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|
|package_type|maven|
|package_type|npm|
|package_type|conan|
|package_type|nuget|
|package_type|pypi|
|package_type|composer|

|status|deprecated|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-packages-cargo">Packages: Cargo</h1>

Use this API to interact with the Cargo package registry, including its sparse index, registry
configuration, and crate downloads. Generally these endpoints are used by Cargo itself and are not
meant for manual consumption. For more information, see the
[package registry](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/package_registry/).

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-packages-composer">Packages: Composer</h1>

Use this API to interact with the [Composer package manager client](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/composer_repository/).

> [!warning]
> This API is used by the [Composer package manager client](https://getcomposer.org/)
> and is generally not meant for manual consumption.

These endpoints do not adhere to the standard API authentication methods.
See the [Composer package registry documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/composer_repository/)
for details on which headers and token types are supported. Undocumented authentication methods might be removed in the future.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/packages/composer/">External documentation</a>

## Create a package

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdPackagesComposer"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/packages/composer \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "branch": "release",
    "tag": "v1.0.0"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/packages/composer`

Creates a Composer package from a specified Git tag or branch for a project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "branch": "release",
  "tag": "v1.0.0"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-package-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdPackagesComposerRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidpackagescomposerrequest)|false|none|
|» branch|body|string \| null|false|Name of the branch to target for the package. Exactly one of `tag`, `branch` must be provided.|
|» tag|body|string \| null|false|Name of the tag to target for the package. Exactly one of `tag`, `branch` must be provided.|

<h3 id="create-a-package-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-packages-conan">Packages: Conan</h1>

> [!warning]
> The Conan registry is not FIPS compliant and is disabled when FIPS mode is enabled. These
> endpoints all return `404 Not Found`.

Use this API to interact with the Conan package manager for
[v1](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/conan_1_repository/) and
[v2](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/conan_2_repository/) repositories. The v1 endpoints work
for both projects and instances, and the availability of the v2 endpoints is controlled by a feature
flag. Generally these endpoints are used by the Conan package manager client and are not meant for
manual consumption.

> [!note]
> These endpoints do not adhere to the standard API authentication methods. See each route for
> details on how credentials are expected to be passed. Undocumented authentication methods might be
> removed in the future.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/packages/conan_v1/">External documentation</a>

<h3 id="retrieve-a-package-manifest-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|package_name|path|string|true|Name of the package.|
|package_version|path|string|true|Version of the package.|
|package_username|path|string|true|Conan username of the package. This is the `+`-separated full path of the project.|
|package_channel|path|string|true|Channel of the package.|
|conan_package_reference|path|string|true|Reference hash of the Conan package. Conan generates this value.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "package_urls": {
    "conan_package.tgz": "https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4/packages/conan/v1/files/my-package/1.0/my-group+my-project/stable/packages/103f6067a947f366ef91fc1b7da351c588d1827f/0/conan_package.tgz"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-a-package-manifest-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesPackagesConanPackageManifest](#schemaapientitiespackagesconanpackagemanifest)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

|package_revision|path|string|true|Revision of the package. GitLab does not yet support Conan revisions, so the default value of `0` is always used.|
|file_name|path|string|true|Name of the package file.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|file_name|conanfile.py|
|file_name|conanmanifest.txt|
|file_name|conan_sources.tgz|
|file_name|conan_export.tgz|
|file_name|conaninfo.txt|
|file_name|conan_package.tgz|

<h3 id="workhorse-authorize-the-conan-package-file-2-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-packages-debian">Packages: Debian</h1>

> [!warning]
> These endpoints are under development and are not ready for production use due to limited
> functionality. The package endpoints are used by Debian package clients such as
> [dput](https://manpages.debian.org/stable/dput-ng/dput.1.en.html) and
> [apt-get](https://manpages.debian.org/stable/apt/apt-get.8.en.html), and are generally not meant
> for manual consumption.

Use this API to manage [Debian distributions](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/debian_repository/)
for groups and projects, and to publish and retrieve Debian packages. The distribution endpoints are
behind a feature flag that is disabled by default. To use them, enable the
[group](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/packages/debian_group_distributions/#enable-the-debian-group-api) or
[project](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/packages/debian_project_distributions/#enable-the-debian-api)
Debian API.

> [!note]
> These endpoints do not adhere to the standard API authentication methods. For the supported headers
> and token types, see the [Debian registry documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/debian_repository/).
> Undocumented authentication methods might be removed in the future.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/packages/debian_group_distributions/">External documentation</a>

## List all Debian project distributions

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdDebianDistributions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/debian_distributions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/debian_distributions`

Lists all Debian distributions for a specified project.

<h3 id="list-all-debian-project-distributions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|codename|query|string \| null|false|Codename of the Debian distribution.|
|suite|query|string \| null|false|Suite of the Debian distribution.|
|origin|query|string \| null|false|Origin of the Debian distribution.|
|label|query|string \| null|false|Label of the Debian distribution.|
|version|query|string \| null|false|Version of the Debian distribution.|
|description|query|string \| null|false|Description of the Debian distribution.|
|valid_time_duration_seconds|query|integer \| null|false|Duration, in seconds, before the Release file is considered expired by the client.|
|components|query|[string]|false|List of components of the Debian distribution.|
|architectures|query|[string]|false|List of architectures of the Debian distribution.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "codename": "sid",
  "suite": "unstable",
  "origin": "Grep",
  "label": "grep.be",
  "version": "12",
  "description": "My description",
  "valid_time_duration_seconds": 604800,
  "components": [
    "main"
  ],
  "architectures": [
    "amd64"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-all-debian-project-distributions-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesPackagesDebianDistribution](#schemaapientitiespackagesdebiandistribution)|

|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

|components|query|[string]|false|List of components of the Debian distribution.|
|architectures|query|[string]|false|List of architectures of the Debian distribution.|

|» file|body|string(binary) \| null|true|The package file to be published (generated by Multipart middleware)|
|» distribution|body|string \| null|false|The Debian Codename or Suite|
|» component|body|string \| null|true|The Debian Component|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-packages-nuget">Packages: NuGet</h1>

Use this API to interact with the [NuGet package manager client](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/nuget_repository/).

> [!warning]
> This API is used by the [NuGet package manager client](https://www.nuget.org/)
> and is generally not meant for manual consumption.

These endpoints do not adhere to the standard API authentication methods.
See the [NuGet package registry documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/nuget_repository/)
for details on which headers and token types are supported. Undocumented authentication methods might be removed in the future.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/packages/nuget/">External documentation</a>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-packages-pypi">Packages: PyPi</h1>

Use this API to interact with the [PyPI package manager client](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/pypi_repository/).

> [!warning]
> This API is used by the [PyPI package manager client](https://pypi.org/)
> and is generally not meant for manual consumption.

These endpoints do not adhere to the standard API authentication methods.
See the [PyPI package registry documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/pypi_repository/)
for details on which headers and token types are supported. Undocumented authentication methods might be removed in the future.

> [!note]
> [Twine 3.4.2](https://twine.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html?highlight=FIPS#id28) or greater
> is recommended when FIPS mode is enabled.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/packages/pypi/">External documentation</a>

## Upload a package

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdPackagesPypi"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/packages/pypi \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'content=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'name=my.pypi.package' \
  -F 'requires_python=>=3.7' \
  -F 'md5_digest=900150983cd24fb0d6963f7d28e17f72' \
  -F 'sha256_digest=ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad' \
  -F 'metadata_version=2.3' \
  -F 'author_email=cschultz@example.com, snoopy@peanuts.com' \
  -F 'description=string' \
  -F 'description_content_type=text/markdown; charset=UTF-8; variant=GFM' \
  -F 'summary=A module for collecting votes from beagles.' \
  -F 'keywords=dog,puppy,voting,election'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/packages/pypi`

Uploads a PyPI package for a specified project.

> Body parameter

```yaml
content: string
name: my.pypi.package
requires_python: ">=3.7"
md5_digest: "900150983cd24fb0d6963f7d28e17f72"
sha256_digest: ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad
metadata_version: "2.3"
author_email: "cschultz@example.com, snoopy@peanuts.com"
description: string
description_content_type: "text/markdown; charset=UTF-8; variant=GFM"
summary: A module for collecting votes from beagles.
keywords: "dog,puppy,voting,election"
```

<h3 id="upload-a-package-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdPackagesPypiRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidpackagespypirequest)|true|none|
|» content|body|string(binary) \| null|true|The package file to be published (generated by Multipart middleware)|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the package|
|» requires_python|body|string \| null|false|PyPI version required for the package|
|» md5_digest|body|string \| null|false|MD5 checksum of the package|
|» sha256_digest|body|string \| null|false|SHA256 checksum of the package|
|» metadata_version|body|string \| null|false|Metadata version of the package|
|» author_email|body|string \| null|false|Email address for the package author|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the package|
|» description_content_type|body|string \| null|false|Type of content for the package description|
|» summary|body|string \| null|false|Short summary of the package|
|» keywords|body|string \| null|false|Keywords listed for the package|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-packages-rubygem">Packages: RubyGem</h1>

Use this API to interact with the [Ruby gems and Bundler package manager clients](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/rubygems_registry/).

> [!warning]
> This API is used by the Ruby gems and Bundler package manager clients and is generally not meant
> for manual consumption. This API is under development and is not ready for production use due to
> limited functionality.

These endpoints do not adhere to the standard API authentication methods.
See the [Ruby gems registry documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/rubygems_registry/)
for details on which headers and token types are supported. Undocumented authentication methods might be removed in the future.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/packages/rubygems/">External documentation</a>

## Create a pipeline schedule

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdPipelineSchedules"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/18/pipeline_schedules \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "Test schedule pipeline",
    "ref": "develop",
    "cron": "* * * * *",
    "cron_timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",
    "active": true,
    "inputs": [
      {
        "name": "deploy_strategy",
        "value": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/pipeline_schedules`

Creates a pipeline schedule.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "Test schedule pipeline",
  "ref": "develop",
  "cron": "* * * * *",
  "cron_timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",
  "active": true,
  "inputs": [
    {
      "name": "deploy_strategy",
      "value": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-pipeline-schedule-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdPipelineSchedulesRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidpipelineschedulesrequest)|true|none|
|» description|body|string \| null|true|Description of the pipeline schedule.|
|» ref|body|string \| null|true|Branch or tag name that triggers the pipeline. Accepts either short refs (`main`) or full refs (`refs/heads/main` or `refs/tags/main`). Short refs are automatically expanded to full refs, unless the value could match either a branch or a tag.|
|» cron|body|string \| null|true|Cron schedule, for example `0 1 * * *`.|
|» cron_timezone|body|string|false|Time zone supported by `ActiveSupport::TimeZone`, for example `Pacific Time (US & Canada)`, or `TZInfo::Timezone`, for example `America/Los_Angeles`.|
|» active|body|boolean|false|If `true`, activates the pipeline schedule. If `false`, the pipeline schedule is initially deactivated.|
|» inputs|body|[object]|false|Array of inputs to pass to the pipeline schedule. Each input has a `name` and a `value`, which can be a string, array, number, or boolean. To delete an existing input, include the `name` field and set `destroy` to `true`.|
|» » name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the input.|
|» » value|body|string \| null \| array \| number \| null \| boolean \| null|true|Value of the input.|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|array|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|number \| null|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|boolean \| null|false|none|

## Update a pipeline schedule

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdPipelineSchedulesPipelineScheduleId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/18/pipeline_schedules/13 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "Test schedule pipeline",
    "ref": "develop",
    "cron": "* * * * *",
    "cron_timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",
    "active": true,
    "inputs": [
      {
        "name": "deploy_strategy",
        "destroy": true,
        "value": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/pipeline_schedules/{pipeline_schedule_id}`

Updates a pipeline schedule for a project. After the update is done, it is rescheduled automatically.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "Test schedule pipeline",
  "ref": "develop",
  "cron": "* * * * *",
  "cron_timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",
  "active": true,
  "inputs": [
    {
      "name": "deploy_strategy",
      "destroy": true,
      "value": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-pipeline-schedule-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|pipeline_schedule_id|path|integer|true|ID of the pipeline schedule.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdPipelineSchedulesPipelineScheduleIdRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidpipelineschedulespipelinescheduleidrequest)|false|none|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the pipeline schedule.|
|» ref|body|string \| null|false|Branch or tag name that triggers the pipeline. Accepts either short refs (`main`) or full refs (`refs/heads/main` or `refs/tags/main`). Short refs are automatically expanded to full refs, unless the value could match either a branch or a tag.|
|» cron|body|string \| null|false|Cron schedule, for example `0 1 * * *`.|
|» cron_timezone|body|string \| null|false|Time zone supported by `ActiveSupport::TimeZone`, for example `Pacific Time (US & Canada)`, or `TZInfo::Timezone`, for example `America/Los_Angeles`.|
|» active|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, activates the pipeline schedule. If `false`, the pipeline schedule is initially deactivated.|
|» inputs|body|[object]|false|Array of inputs to pass to the pipeline schedule. Each input has a `name` and a `value`, which can be a string, array, number, or boolean. To delete an existing input, include the `name` field and set `destroy` to `true`.|
|» » name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the input.|
|» » destroy|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, deletes the input.|
|» » value|body|string \| null \| array \| number \| null \| boolean \| null|true|Value of the input.|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|array|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|number \| null|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|boolean \| null|false|none|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-pipelines">Pipelines</h1>

Use this API to manage [CI/CD pipelines](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/pipelines/) and the
[jobs](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/jobs/) they run.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipelines/">External documentation</a>

## List pipelines triggered by the authenticated user

<a id="opIdgetApiV4Pipelines"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/pipelines \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/pipelines`

Lists recently created pipelines across all projects that were triggered by the authenticated user. By default, child pipelines are not included in the results. To return child pipelines, set `source` to `parent_pipeline`. This endpoint only supports keyset pagination.

<h3 id="list-pipelines-triggered-by-the-authenticated-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|source|query|string \| null|false|The source of pipelines|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return pipelines created before the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return pipelines created after the specified datetime. Format: ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|
|order_by|query|string|false|Return pipelines ordered by `created_at`|
|sort|query|string|false|Return pipelines sorted in `desc` order|
|cursor|query|string \| null|false|Cursor for obtaining the next set of records|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items per page|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|source|unknown|
|source|push|
|source|web|
|source|trigger|
|source|schedule|
|source|api|
|source|external|
|source|pipeline|
|source|chat|
|source|webide|
|source|merge_request_event|
|source|external_pull_request_event|
|source|parent_pipeline|
|source|ondemand_dast_scan|
|source|ondemand_dast_validation|
|source|security_orchestration_policy|
|source|container_registry_push|
|source|duo_workflow|
|source|pipeline_execution_policy_schedule|
|source|dependency_management_security_update|
|order_by|created_at|
|sort|desc|

## List all project pipelines

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdPipelines"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/11/pipelines \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/pipelines`

Lists all pipelines in a project. By default, child pipelines are not included in the results. To return child pipelines, set `source` to `parent_pipeline`.

<h3 id="list-all-project-pipelines-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|scope|query|string \| null|false|Return pipelines in the specified scope.|
|status|query|string \| null|false|Return pipelines with the specified status.|
|ref|query|string \| null|false|Return pipelines for the specified branch or tag.|
|sha|query|string \| null|false|Return pipelines for the specified commit SHA.|
|yaml_errors|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only pipelines with invalid configurations.|
|username|query|string \| null|false|Return pipelines triggered by the specified username.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return pipelines updated on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return pipelines updated on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return pipelines created before the specified time.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return pipelines created after the specified time.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|source|query|string \| null|false|The source of pipelines|
|name|query|string \| null|false|Return pipelines with the specified name.|

## Create a pipeline

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdPipeline"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/11/pipeline \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "ref": "develop",
    "variables": [
      {
        "key": "UPLOAD_TO_S3",
        "value": "true",
        "variable_type": "env_var"
      }
    ],
    "inputs": {}
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/pipeline`

Creates a pipeline in the specified project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "ref": "develop",
  "variables": [
    {
      "key": "UPLOAD_TO_S3",
      "value": "true",
      "variable_type": "env_var"
    }
  ],
  "inputs": {}
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-pipeline-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdPipelineRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidpipelinerequest)|true|none|
|» ref|body|string \| null|true|Reference|
|» variables|body|[object]|false|Array of variables to make available in the pipeline. If `variable_type` is omitted, it defaults to `env_var`.|
|» » key|body|string \| null|false|Key of the variable.|
|» » value|body|string \| null|false|Value of the variable.|
|» » variable_type|body|string|false|Type of the variable.|
|» inputs|body|object \| null|false|Map of inputs, as key-value pairs, to use when creating the pipeline. [Generally available](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/536548) in GitLab 18.1. Feature flag `ci_inputs_for_pipelines` removed.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » variable_type|env_var|
|» » variable_type|file|

## Retrieve the latest pipeline

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/pipelines/latest`

Retrieves the latest pipeline for the most recent commit on a specified ref in a project. If no pipeline exists for the commit, a `403` status code is returned. Use the `page` and `per_page` pagination parameters to control the pagination of results.

## List all jobs by pipeline

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdPipelinesPipelineIdJobs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/11/pipelines/18/jobs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/jobs`

Lists all jobs for a specified pipeline.

<h3 id="list-all-jobs-by-pipeline-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-plan-limits">Plan limits</h1>

Use this API to retrieve and change the application limits of a subscription plan.

The available plans depend on the GitLab edition. In the Community Edition, only the `default` plan
exists. The Enterprise Edition has additional plans.

These endpoints require administrator access to the instance.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/plan_limits/">External documentation</a>

## Get current plan limits

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ApplicationPlanLimits"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/application/plan_limits \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/application/plan_limits`

List the current limits of a plan on the GitLab instance.

<h3 id="get-current-plan-limits-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|plan_name|query|string|false|Name of the plan to get the limits from.|

<h3 id="change-plan-limits-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[putApiV4ApplicationPlanLimitsRequest](#schemaputapiv4applicationplanlimitsrequest)|true|none|
|» plan_name|body|string|true|Name of the plan to update.|
|» cargo_max_file_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum Cargo package file size in bytes. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/33060) in GitLab 19.3.|
|» ci_instance_level_variables|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of instance-level CI/CD variables that can be defined.|
|» ci_pipeline_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of jobs in a single pipeline.|
|» ci_active_jobs|body|integer \| null|false|Total number of jobs in currently active pipelines.|
|» ci_project_subscriptions|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of pipeline subscriptions to and from a project.|
|» ci_pipeline_schedules|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of pipeline schedules.|
|» ci_needs_size_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of `needs` dependencies that a job can have.|
|» ci_registered_group_runners|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of runners created or active in a group during the past seven days.|
|» ci_registered_project_runners|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of runners created or active in a project during the past seven days.|
|» conan_max_file_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum Conan package file size in bytes.|
|» dotenv_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum size of a dotenv artifact in bytes. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/432529) in GitLab 17.1.|
|» dotenv_variables|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of variables in a dotenv artifact. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/432529) in GitLab 17.1.|
|» enforcement_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum storage size for root namespace limit enforcement, in MiB.|
|» generic_packages_max_file_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum generic package file size in bytes.|
|» helm_max_file_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum Helm chart file size in bytes.|
|» maven_max_file_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum Maven package file size in bytes.|
|» notification_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum storage size for root namespace limit notifications, in MiB.|
|» npm_max_file_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum npm package file size in bytes.|
|» nuget_max_file_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum NuGet package file size in bytes.|
|» pypi_max_file_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum PyPI package file size in bytes.|
|» service_desk_outbound_emails_per_hour|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of outbound Service Desk emails per hour, per top-level namespace. Set to `0` for unlimited. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/253087) in GitLab 19.4.|
|» service_desk_outbound_emails_per_day|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of outbound Service Desk emails per day, per top-level namespace. Set to `0` for unlimited. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/253087) in GitLab 19.4.|
|» terraform_module_max_file_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum Terraform module package file size in bytes.|
|» storage_size_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum storage size for the root namespace, in MiB.|
|» pipeline_hierarchy_size|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of downstream pipelines in a pipeline's hierarchy tree. The default is `1000`. Higher values are not recommended.|
|» web_hook_calls|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of times a webhook can be called per minute, per top-level namespace. Set to `0` for unlimited. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/571738) in GitLab 18.5.|
|» web_hook_calls_low|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of times a webhook can be called per minute, per top-level namespace. Set to `0` for unlimited. GitLab.com only.|
|» web_hook_calls_mid|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of times a webhook can be called per minute, per top-level namespace. Set to `0` for unlimited. GitLab.com only.|
|» max_pipelines_per_merge_train|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum number of parallel pipelines per merge train. The default is `20` and the minimum is `1`. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/374188) in GitLab 19.0.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» plan_name|default|
|» plan_name|free|
|» plan_name|bronze|
|» plan_name|silver|
|» plan_name|premium|
|» plan_name|gold|
|» plan_name|ultimate|
|» plan_name|ultimate_trial|
|» plan_name|ultimate_trial_paid_customer|
|» plan_name|premium_trial|
|» plan_name|opensource|

```json
  "cargo_max_file_size": 5368709120,

  "ci_project_subscriptions": 2,
  "ci_pipeline_schedules": 10,
```

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-project-alias">Project alias</h1>

Use this API to manage [project aliases](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/working_with_projects/#project-aliases).
After you create an alias for a project, users can clone the repository with that alias, which can be
helpful when migrating repositories.

All endpoints require administrator authorization.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_aliases/">External documentation</a>

## List all project aliases

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectAliases"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/project_aliases \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/project_aliases`

Lists all project aliases for the instance.

<h3 id="list-all-project-aliases-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "project_id": 1,
  "name": "gitlab"
}
```

<h3 id="list-all-project-aliases-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesProjectAlias](#schemaapientitiesprojectalias)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/project_aliases \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "project_id": "gitlab-org/gitlab",
    "name": "gitlab"
  }'
```

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-project-approvals">Project approvals</h1>

## Create or update approval configuration for a project

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdApprovals"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/approvals \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "approvals_before_merge": 0,
    "reset_approvals_on_push": true,
    "selective_code_owner_removals": true,
    "disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request": true,
    "merge_requests_author_approval": true,
    "merge_requests_disable_committers_approval": true,
    "require_password_to_approve": true,
    "require_reauthentication_to_approve": true
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/approvals`

Creates or updates the approval configuration for a project. The currently authenticated user must be an eligible approver.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "approvals_before_merge": 0,
  "reset_approvals_on_push": true,
  "selective_code_owner_removals": true,
  "disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request": true,
  "merge_requests_author_approval": true,
  "merge_requests_disable_committers_approval": true,
  "require_password_to_approve": true,
  "require_reauthentication_to_approve": true
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-update-approval-configuration-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdApprovalsRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidapprovalsrequest)|false|none|
|» approvals_before_merge|body|integer \| null|false|Number of approvals required before a merge request can be merged. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» reset_approvals_on_push|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, resets approvals on push. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» selective_code_owner_removals|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, resets approvals from Code Owners if their files change. To use this field, `reset_approvals_on_push` must be `false`. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, prevents overrides of approvers in a merge request. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» merge_requests_author_approval|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, authors can self-approve merge requests. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» merge_requests_disable_committers_approval|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, users who commit on the merge request cannot approve it. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» require_password_to_approve|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, requires approvers to authenticate before approving. Deprecated in GitLab 16.9. Use `require_reauthentication_to_approve` instead. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|» require_reauthentication_to_approve|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, requires approvers to authenticate before approving. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/431346) in GitLab 17.1. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-project-import">Project import</h1>

Use this API to [import repositories from external sources](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/import/)
and to [migrate a project](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/settings/import_export/) between
GitLab instances.

If you first migrate the parent group structure with the
[group import and export API](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_import_export/), you can preserve
relationships that span the group, such as connections between project issues and group epics.
After an import, use the [project-level CI/CD variables API](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_level_variables/)
to restore CI/CD variables. You must still migrate your
[container registry](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/container_registry/) over a series of
Docker pulls and pushes, and re-run any CI/CD pipelines to retrieve build artifacts.

The project relations export endpoints are used by the destination instance during
[group migration by direct transfer](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/import/) to migrate a
project structure, and you don't usually need to call them yourself. In this context, a relation is
an exportable item such as a merge request, including any related items such as a label.

> [!note]
> User contribution mapping is not supported when you import projects to a
> [personal namespace](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/namespace/#types-of-namespaces). All
> contributions are assigned to the personal namespace owner and cannot be reassigned.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_import_export/">External documentation</a>

## Import project resources

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsImportRelation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/import-relation \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'path=string' \
  -F 'file=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'relation=issues' \
  -F 'file.path=string' \
  -F 'file.name=string' \
  -F 'file.type=string' \
  -F 'file.size=0' \
  -F 'file.md5=string' \
  -F 'file.sha1=string' \
  -F 'file.sha256=string' \
  -F 'file.etag=string' \
  -F 'file.remote_id=string' \
  -F 'file.remote_url=string'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/import-relation`

Imports project resources included with a project archive. The type of item to import is controlled by the `relation` attribute. Skips items that were previously imported. This feature was introduced in GitLab 16.11.

> Body parameter

```yaml
path: string
file: string
relation: issues
file.path: string
file.name: string
file.type: string
file.size: 0
file.md5: string
file.sha1: string
file.sha256: string
file.etag: string
file.remote_id: string
file.remote_url: string
```

## Retrieve the status of a project resource import

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdRelationImports"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/relation-imports \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/relation-imports`

Retrieves the status of the most recent relation import for a specified project. Because only one relation import can be scheduled at a time, you can use this endpoint to check whether the previous import completed successfully. This feature was introduced in GitLab 16.11.

<h3 id="retrieve-the-status-of-a-project-resource-import-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/export`

## Import a repository from GitHub

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ImportGithub"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/import/github \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "personal_access_token": "string",
    "repo_id": 0,
    "new_name": "string",
    "target_namespace": "string",
    "github_hostname": "string",
    "optional_stages": {},
    "timeout_strategy": "optimistic",
    "pagination_limit": 1
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/import/github`

Imports a repository from GitHub to GitLab.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "personal_access_token": "string",
  "repo_id": 0,
  "new_name": "string",
  "target_namespace": "string",
  "github_hostname": "string",
  "optional_stages": {},
  "timeout_strategy": "optimistic",
  "pagination_limit": 1
}
```

<h3 id="import-a-repository-from-github-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4ImportGithubRequest](#schemapostapiv4importgithubrequest)|true|none|
|» personal_access_token|body|string \| null|true|GitHub personal access token.|
|» repo_id|body|integer \| null|true|GitHub repository ID.|
|» new_name|body|string \| null|false|Name of the new project. Also used as the new path, so it must not start or end with a special character and must not contain consecutive special characters.|
|» target_namespace|body|string \| null|true|Namespace to import the repository into. Supports subgroups, for example `/namespace/subgroup`. Must not be blank.|
|» github_hostname|body|string \| null|false|Custom GitHub Enterprise hostname. Do not set for GitHub.com. From GitLab 16.5 to GitLab 17.1, you must include the path `/api/v3`.|
|» optional_stages|body|object \| null|false|Additional items to import. For a list of items, see [select additional items to import](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/import/github/#select-additional-items-to-import).|
|» timeout_strategy|body|string \| null|false|Strategy for handling import timeouts. `optimistic` continues to the next stage of the import. `pessimistic` fails the import immediately. Defaults to `pessimistic`.|
|» pagination_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Number of items retrieved per API request to GitHub. If omitted, defaults to `100`. Use a lower number for large repositories to reduce the risk of GitHub API errors, though this increases migration time.|

#### Enumerated Values

`POST /api/v4/import/bitbucket_server`

Imports a repository from Bitbucket Server to GitLab. The Bitbucket Project Key is only used for finding the repository in Bitbucket. You must specify a `target_namespace` if you want to import the repository to a GitLab group.

```json
{

  "bitbucket_server_username": "string",
  "personal_access_token": "string",
  "bitbucket_server_project": "string",
  "bitbucket_server_repo": "string",

}
```

<h3 id="import-repository-from-bitbucket-server-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4ImportBitbucketServerRequest](#schemapostapiv4importbitbucketserverrequest)|true|none|
|» bitbucket_server_url|body|string \| null|true|URL of the Bitbucket Server instance.|
|» bitbucket_server_username|body|string \| null|true|Bitbucket Server username.|
|» personal_access_token|body|string \| null|true|Bitbucket Server personal access token or password.|
|» bitbucket_server_project|body|string \| null|true|Key of the Bitbucket Server project. Must contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, periods, or whitespace characters. Personal project keys start with `~`.|
|» bitbucket_server_repo|body|string \| null|true|Name of the Bitbucket Server repository. Must contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, periods, or whitespace characters.|
|» new_name|body|string \| null|false|Name of the new project. Also used as the new path, so it must not start or end with a special character and must not contain consecutive special characters.|
|» new_namespace|body|string \| null|false|Namespace to import the repository into.|
|» timeout_strategy|body|string \| null|false|Strategy for handling import timeouts. `optimistic` continues to the next stage of the import. `pessimistic` fails the import immediately. Defaults to `pessimistic`.|

## Update project pull mirroring settings

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdMirrorPull"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/mirror/pull \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "enabled": true,
    "url": "string",
    "auth_user": "string",
    "auth_password": "string",
    "mirror_trigger_builds": true,
    "only_mirror_protected_branches": true,
    "mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches": true,
    "mirror_branch_regex": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/mirror/pull`

Updates pull mirroring settings for a specified project. This feature was introduced in GitLab 17.5.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "url": "string",
  "auth_user": "string",
  "auth_password": "string",
  "mirror_trigger_builds": true,
  "only_mirror_protected_branches": true,
  "mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches": true,
  "mirror_branch_regex": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-project-pull-mirroring-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdMirrorPullRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidmirrorpullrequest)|false|none|
|» enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, enables pull mirroring on the project. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|» url|body|string \| null|false|URL of the remote repository being mirrored. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|» auth_user|body|string \| null|false|Username used to authenticate a project pull mirror. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|» auth_password|body|string \| null|false|Password used to authenticate a project pull mirror, or a personal access token with the `api` scope enabled. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|» mirror_trigger_builds|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, triggers pipelines for mirror updates. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|» only_mirror_protected_branches|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, limits mirroring to only protected branches. Mutually exclusive with `mirror_branch_regex`. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|» mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, overwrites diverged branches. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|» mirror_branch_regex|body|string \| null|false|Regular expression for branch names to mirror. Only branches with names matching the regex are mirrored. Requires `only_mirror_protected_branches` to be disabled. Mutually exclusive with `only_mirror_protected_branches`. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 101486,
  "update_status": "finished",
  "url": "https://*****:*****@gitlab.com/gitlab-org/security/gitlab.git",
  "last_error": "string",
  "last_update_at": "2020-01-06T17:32:02.823Z",
  "last_update_started_at": "2020-01-06T17:32:02.823Z",
  "last_successful_update_at": "2020-01-06T17:32:02.823Z",
  "enabled": false,
  "mirror_trigger_builds": false,
  "only_mirror_protected_branches": false,
  "mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches": false,
  "mirror_branch_regex": "branch_name"
}
```

<h3 id="update-project-pull-mirroring-settings-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesPullMirror](#schemaapientitiespullmirror)|
|400|Bad Request|Url is blocked: Only allowed schemes are http, https, ssh, git|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey

```bash
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/mirror/pull`

Starts the pull mirroring process for a specified project.

```json
{
  "action": "string",
  "pull_request.number": 0,
  "pull_request.head.ref": "string",
  "pull_request.head.sha": "string",
  "pull_request.head.repo.full_name": "string",
  "pull_request.base.ref": "string",

}
```

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-project-snapshots">Project snapshots</h1>

Use this API to download a snapshot of a project's repository, for use in salvaging a corrupt
repository.

These endpoints require administrator access to the instance.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/projects/">External documentation</a>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-project-templates">Project templates</h1>

Use this API to retrieve project-specific templates, in addition to the templates common to the
entire instance:

- [Dockerfile templates](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/templates/dockerfiles/)
- [Gitignore templates](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/templates/gitignores/)
- [GitLab CI/CD configuration templates](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/templates/gitlab_ci_ymls/)
- [Open source license templates](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/templates/licenses/)
- [Issue and merge request templates](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/description_templates/)

These endpoints supersede the instance template endpoints, which are scheduled for removal
in API version 5. [File templates for groups](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/manage/#group-file-templates)
are also supported.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_templates/">External documentation</a>

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdTemplatesTypeName"></a>

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/templates/{type}/{name}`

Retrieves a template of a specified type for a project.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-template-of-a-particular-type-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|

`POST /api/v4/topics/merge`

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-projects">Projects</h1>

Use this API to manage [projects](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/) and the resources they contain, including:

- Project settings, visibility, access permissions, and security settings.
- Archiving, transferring, [forking](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/repository/forking_workflow/), and [starring](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/working_with_projects/) projects.
- Project [issues](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/issues/), issue statistics, and project statistics.
- [Markdown uploads](https://docs.gitlab.com/security/user_file_uploads/) referenced in issues, merge requests, snippets, or wiki pages.
- Protection rules for [container image tags](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/container_registry/protected_container_tags/), container repositories, and [packages](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/package_registry/package_protection_rules/).

If a user is not a member of a private project, a `GET` request on that project results in a
`404` status code.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/projects/">External documentation</a>

## Update project security settings

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdSecuritySettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/security_settings \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "secret_push_protection_enabled": true,
    "pre_receive_secret_detection_enabled": true,
    "fast_dependency_paths_enabled": true
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/security_settings`

Updates project security settings for a specified project. You must have the Maintainer or Owner role for the project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "secret_push_protection_enabled": true,
  "pre_receive_secret_detection_enabled": true,
  "fast_dependency_paths_enabled": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-project-security-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdSecuritySettingsRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidsecuritysettingsrequest)|false|none|
|» secret_push_protection_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, enables secret push protection for the project. At least one of `secret_push_protection_enabled`, `pre_receive_secret_detection_enabled`, `fast_dependency_paths_enabled` must be provided.|
|» pre_receive_secret_detection_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, enables secret push protection for the project. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/514413) in GitLab 17.9. Use `secret_push_protection_enabled` instead. At least one of `secret_push_protection_enabled`, `pre_receive_secret_detection_enabled`, `fast_dependency_paths_enabled` must be provided.|
|» fast_dependency_paths_enabled|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, enables fast mode for dependency path graph builds, recording one path per dependency instead of all possible paths to reduce memory and processing time for large dependency graphs. Requires the `dependency_paths` feature flag to be enabled. At least one of `secret_push_protection_enabled`, `pre_receive_secret_detection_enabled`, `fast_dependency_paths_enabled` must be provided.|

|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

## List all personal projects for a user

<a id="opIdgetApiV4UsersUserIdProjects"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/users/string/projects \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/users/{user_id}/projects`

Lists all personal projects for a specified user. Does not return group or subgroup projects. If the user profile is private, returns only an empty list.

<h3 id="list-all-personal-projects-for-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|string|true|ID or username of the user.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Return projects ordered by field. storage_size, repository_size, wiki_size, packages_size are only available to admins. Similarity is available when searching and is limited to projects the user has access to.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|archived|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only archived projects.|
|visibility|query|string \| null|false|Return projects with the specified visibility.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return a list of projects with a `path`, `name`, or `description` matching the search criteria (case-insensitive, substring match). Multiple terms can be provided, separated by an escaped space, either `+` or `%20`, and are ANDed together. Example: `one+two` matches substrings `one` and `two` (in any order).|
|search_namespaces|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes ancestor namespaces when matching search criteria.|
|owned|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects explicitly owned by the current user.|
|starred|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects starred by the current user.|
|imported|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that were imported from external systems by the authenticated user.|
|membership|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that the current user is a member of.|
|with_issues_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the issues feature enabled.|
|with_merge_requests_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the merge requests feature enabled.|
|with_programming_language|query|string \| null|false|Return projects that use the given programming language.|
|min_access_level|query|integer \| null|false|Return results where the current user has at least the specified access level. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|id_after|query|integer \| null|false|Return projects with IDs greater than the specified ID.|
|id_before|query|integer \| null|false|Return projects with IDs less than the specified ID.|
|last_activity_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects with last activity after the specified time.|
|last_activity_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects with last activity before the specified time.|
|repository_storage|query|string \| null|false|Return projects stored on the specified repository storage shard. Administrators only.|
|topic|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of topics. Return projects having all topics.|
|topic_id|query|integer \| null|false|Filter projects by the given topic ID.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects last updated on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects last updated on or after the specified time.|
|include_pending_delete|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes projects that are pending deletion in the response. Administrators only.|
|marked_for_deletion_on|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return projects that are marked for deletion on this date. Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/463939) in GitLab 17.1.|
|active|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only projects that are not archived and not marked for deletion.|
|wiki_checksum_failed|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects whose wiki checksum calculation failed. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|repository_checksum_failed|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects whose repository checksum calculation failed. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|include_hidden|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes hidden projects. Administrators only. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|simple|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only limited fields for each project. Without authentication, only limited fields are returned regardless of this setting.|
|statistics|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes project statistics. Available only to users with the Reporter, Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|order_by|id|
|order_by|name|
|order_by|path|
|order_by|created_at|
|order_by|updated_at|
|order_by|last_activity_at|
|order_by|similarity|
|order_by|star_count|
|order_by|storage_size|
|order_by|repository_size|
|order_by|wiki_size|
|order_by|packages_size|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|
|visibility|private|
|visibility|internal|
|visibility|public|
|min_access_level|10|
|min_access_level|15|
|min_access_level|20|
|min_access_level|25|
|min_access_level|30|
|min_access_level|40|
|min_access_level|50|

## List all projects starred by a user

<a id="opIdgetApiV4UsersUserIdStarredProjects"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/users/string/starred_projects \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/users/{user_id}/starred_projects`

Lists all visible projects starred by a specified user. Unauthenticated requests return only public projects.

<h3 id="list-all-projects-starred-by-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|string|true|ID or username of the user.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Return projects ordered by field. storage_size, repository_size, wiki_size, packages_size are only available to admins. Similarity is available when searching and is limited to projects the user has access to.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|archived|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only archived projects.|
|visibility|query|string \| null|false|Return projects with the specified visibility.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return a list of projects with a `path`, `name`, or `description` matching the search criteria (case-insensitive, substring match). Multiple terms can be provided, separated by an escaped space, either `+` or `%20`, and are ANDed together. Example: `one+two` matches substrings `one` and `two` (in any order).|
|search_namespaces|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes ancestor namespaces when matching search criteria.|
|owned|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects explicitly owned by the current user.|
|starred|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects starred by the current user.|
|imported|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that were imported from external systems by the authenticated user.|
|membership|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that the current user is a member of.|
|with_issues_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the issues feature enabled.|
|with_merge_requests_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the merge requests feature enabled.|
|with_programming_language|query|string \| null|false|Return projects that use the given programming language.|
|min_access_level|query|integer \| null|false|Return results where the current user has at least the specified access level. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|id_after|query|integer \| null|false|Return projects with IDs greater than the specified ID.|
|id_before|query|integer \| null|false|Return projects with IDs less than the specified ID.|
|last_activity_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects with last activity after the specified time.|
|last_activity_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects with last activity before the specified time.|
|repository_storage|query|string \| null|false|Return projects stored on the specified repository storage shard. Administrators only.|
|topic|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of topics. Return projects having all topics.|
|topic_id|query|integer \| null|false|Filter projects by the given topic ID.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects last updated on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects last updated on or after the specified time.|
|include_pending_delete|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes projects that are pending deletion in the response. Administrators only.|
|marked_for_deletion_on|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return projects that are marked for deletion on this date. Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/463939) in GitLab 17.1.|
|active|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only projects that are not archived and not marked for deletion.|
|wiki_checksum_failed|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects whose wiki checksum calculation failed. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|repository_checksum_failed|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects whose repository checksum calculation failed. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|include_hidden|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes hidden projects. Administrators only. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|simple|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only limited fields for each project. Without authentication, only limited fields are returned regardless of this setting.|
|statistics|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes project statistics. Available only to users with the Reporter, Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role.|

|min_access_level|50|


`GET /api/v4/projects`

Lists all projects. Unauthenticated requests return only public projects with a limited subset of attributes. You can filter responses by custom attributes. To use the `updated_after` or `updated_before` filters, you must also set `order_by` to `updated_at`.

<h3 id="list-all-projects-parameters">Parameters</h3>
