|visibility|query|string \| null|false|Return projects with the specified visibility.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return a list of projects with a `path`, `name`, or `description` matching the search criteria (case-insensitive, substring match). Multiple terms can be provided, separated by an escaped space, either `+` or `%20`, and are ANDed together. Example: `one+two` matches substrings `one` and `two` (in any order).|
|search_namespaces|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes ancestor namespaces when matching search criteria.|
|owned|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects explicitly owned by the current user.|
|starred|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects starred by the current user.|
|imported|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that were imported from external systems by the authenticated user.|
|membership|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that the current user is a member of.|
|with_issues_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the issues feature enabled.|
|with_merge_requests_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the merge requests feature enabled.|
|with_programming_language|query|string \| null|false|Return projects that use the given programming language.|
|min_access_level|query|integer \| null|false|Return results where the current user has at least the specified access level. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|id_after|query|integer \| null|false|Return projects with IDs greater than the specified ID.|
|id_before|query|integer \| null|false|Return projects with IDs less than the specified ID.|
|last_activity_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects with last activity after the specified time.|
|last_activity_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects with last activity before the specified time.|
|repository_storage|query|string \| null|false|Return projects stored on the specified repository storage shard. Administrators only.|
|topic|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of topics. Return projects having all topics.|
|topic_id|query|integer \| null|false|Filter projects by the given topic ID.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects last updated on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects last updated on or after the specified time.|
|include_pending_delete|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes projects that are pending deletion in the response. Administrators only.|
|marked_for_deletion_on|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return projects that are marked for deletion on this date. Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/463939) in GitLab 17.1.|
|active|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only projects that are not archived and not marked for deletion.|
|wiki_checksum_failed|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects whose wiki checksum calculation failed. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|repository_checksum_failed|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects whose repository checksum calculation failed. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|include_hidden|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes hidden projects. Administrators only. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|simple|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only limited fields for each project. Without authentication, only limited fields are returned regardless of this setting.|
|statistics|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes project statistics. Available only to users with the Reporter, Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|

`POST /api/v4/projects`

Creates a project owned by the authenticated user. If your HTTP repository is not publicly accessible, add authentication information to the URL `https://username:password@gitlab.company.com/group/project.git`, where `password` is a public access key with the `api` scope.

<h3 id="create-a-project-for-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_id|path|integer|true|ID of the user to assign as the project owner.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsUserUserIdRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsuseruseridrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|The name of the project|
|» path|body|string \| null|false|The path of the repository|
|» default_branch|body|string \| null|false|The default branch of the project|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|The description of the project|

## List all groups available to invite to a project

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/0/share_locations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/share_locations`

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|search|query|string \| null|false|Return groups matching the search criteria.|

## Retrieve a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}`

Retrieves details on a specified project. This endpoint can be accessed without authentication if the project is publicly accessible.

<h3 id="retrieve-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|statistics|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes project statistics. Available only to users with the Reporter, Developer, Maintainer, or Owner role.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|
|license|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes the project license data in the response.|

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}`

Updates an existing project. If your HTTP repository is not publicly accessible, add authentication information to the URL `https://username:password@gitlab.company.com/group/project.git`, where `password` is a public access key with the `api` scope. At least one project attribute must be updated.

> Body parameter

```yaml
name: project
default_branch: main
path: group/project
description: string
build_git_strategy: fetch
build_timeout: 0
auto_cancel_pending_pipelines: disabled
ci_config_path: string
service_desk_enabled: true
issues_enabled: true
merge_requests_enabled: true
wiki_enabled: true
jobs_enabled: true
snippets_enabled: true
issues_access_level: disabled
repository_access_level: disabled
merge_requests_access_level: disabled
forking_access_level: disabled
wiki_access_level: disabled
builds_access_level: disabled
snippets_access_level: disabled
package_registry_access_level: disabled
pages_access_level: disabled
analytics_access_level: disabled
container_registry_access_level: disabled
security_and_compliance_access_level: disabled
```

<h3 id="update-a-project-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesProjectsWithCatalogSetting](#schemaapientitiesprojectswithcatalogsetting)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Unauthenticated|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Delete a project

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4ProjectsId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/projects/{id}`

Deletes a specified project.

<h3 id="delete-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|

<h3 id="delete-a-project-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|Accepted|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Unauthenticated|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Create a fork of a project

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdFork"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/fork \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "namespace": "gitlab",
    "namespace_id": 1,
    "namespace_path": "new_path/gitlab",
    "path": "fork",
    "name": "Fork",
    "description": "Description",
    "visibility": "private",
    "mr_default_target_self": true,
    "branches": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/fork`

Creates a fork of a project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "namespace": "gitlab",
  "namespace_id": 1,
  "namespace_path": "new_path/gitlab",
  "path": "fork",
  "name": "Fork",
  "description": "Description",
  "visibility": "private",
  "mr_default_target_self": true,
  "branches": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-fork-of-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdForkRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidforkrequest)|false|none|
|» namespace|body|string \| null|false|ID or path of the namespace to fork the new project into. Deprecated. Use `namespace_id` or `namespace_path` instead.|
|» namespace_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the namespace to fork the new project into.|
|» namespace_path|body|string \| null|false|Path of the namespace to fork the new project into.|
|» path|body|string \| null|false|Path assigned to the new project after forking.|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|Name assigned to the new project after forking.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description assigned to the new project after forking.|
|» visibility|body|string \| null|false|[Visibility level](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/projects/#project-visibility-level) assigned to the new project after forking.|
|» mr_default_target_self|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, merge requests from the forked project target this project. If `false`, they target the upstream project.|
|» branches|body|string \| null|false|Branches to fork. Leave empty to fork all branches.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» visibility|private|
|» visibility|internal|
|» visibility|public|

## List all forks of a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdForks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/forks \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/forks`

Lists all forks of a project.

<h3 id="list-all-forks-of-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Return projects ordered by field. storage_size, repository_size, wiki_size, packages_size are only available to admins. Similarity is available when searching and is limited to projects the user has access to.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|archived|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only archived projects.|
|visibility|query|string \| null|false|Return projects with the specified visibility.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return a list of projects with a `path`, `name`, or `description` matching the search criteria (case-insensitive, substring match). Multiple terms can be provided, separated by an escaped space, either `+` or `%20`, and are ANDed together. Example: `one+two` matches substrings `one` and `two` (in any order).|
|search_namespaces|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes ancestor namespaces when matching search criteria.|
|owned|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects explicitly owned by the current user.|
|starred|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects starred by the current user.|
|imported|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that were imported from external systems by the authenticated user.|
|membership|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that the current user is a member of.|
|with_issues_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the issues feature enabled.|
|with_merge_requests_enabled|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects that have the merge requests feature enabled.|
|with_programming_language|query|string \| null|false|Return projects that use the given programming language.|
|min_access_level|query|integer \| null|false|Return results where the current user has at least the specified access level. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|id_after|query|integer \| null|false|Return projects with IDs greater than the specified ID.|
|id_before|query|integer \| null|false|Return projects with IDs less than the specified ID.|
|last_activity_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects with last activity after the specified time.|
|last_activity_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects with last activity before the specified time.|
|repository_storage|query|string \| null|false|Return projects stored on the specified repository storage shard. Administrators only.|
|topic|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of topics. Return projects having all topics.|
|topic_id|query|integer \| null|false|Filter projects by the given topic ID.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects last updated on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return projects last updated on or after the specified time.|
|include_pending_delete|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, includes projects that are pending deletion in the response. Administrators only.|
|marked_for_deletion_on|query|string(date) \| null|false|Return projects that are marked for deletion on this date. Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/463939) in GitLab 17.1.|
|active|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only projects that are not archived and not marked for deletion.|
|wiki_checksum_failed|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects whose wiki checksum calculation failed. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|repository_checksum_failed|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only projects whose repository checksum calculation failed. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|include_hidden|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes hidden projects. Administrators only. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|simple|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only limited fields for each project. Without authentication, only limited fields are returned regardless of this setting.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|order_by|id|
|order_by|name|
|order_by|path|
|order_by|created_at|
|order_by|updated_at|
|order_by|last_activity_at|
|order_by|similarity|
|order_by|star_count|
|order_by|storage_size|
|order_by|repository_size|
|order_by|wiki_size|
|order_by|packages_size|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|
|visibility|private|
|visibility|internal|
|visibility|public|
|min_access_level|10|
|min_access_level|15|
|min_access_level|20|
|min_access_level|25|
|min_access_level|30|
|min_access_level|40|
|min_access_level|50|

## Unarchive a project

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdUnarchive"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/unarchive \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/unarchive`

## Unstar a project

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdUnstar"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/unstar \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/unstar`

Unstars a specified project.

<h3 id="unstar-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|

## List all users who starred a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdStarrers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/starrers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/starrers`

Lists all users who starred a specified project.

<h3 id="list-all-users-who-starred-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

## Share a project with a group

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdShare"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/share \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "group_id": 1,
    "group_access": 10,
    "expires_at": "1970-01-01",
    "member_role_id": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/share`

Shares a specified project with a group.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "group_id": 1,
  "group_access": 10,
  "expires_at": "1970-01-01",
  "member_role_id": 0
}
```

<h3 id="share-a-project-with-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdShareRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidsharerequest)|true|none|
|» group_id|body|integer \| null|true|ID of the group to share the project with.|
|» group_access|body|integer|true|Access level to grant to the invited group. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|» expires_at|body|string(date) \| null|false|Date when the share expires.|
|» member_role_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the member role to assign to the group.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» group_access|10|
|» group_access|15|
|» group_access|20|
|» group_access|25|
|» group_access|30|
|» group_access|40|
|» group_access|50|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "project_id": 1,
  "group_id": 1,
  "group_access": 10,
  "expires_at": "2016-09-26",
  "member_role_id": 12
}
```

## Import members

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdImportProjectMembersProjectId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/import_project_members/0 \
  -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/import_project_members/{project_id}`

Imports members from another project. If the role of the importing member for the target project is a Maintainer, then members with the Owner role for the source project are imported with the Maintainer role. If the importing member is an Owner, then members with the Owner role for the source project are imported with the Owner role.

<h3 id="import-members-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|project_id|path|integer|true|ID of the source project to import the members from.|

<h3 id="import-members-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden - Project|None|
|404|Not Found|Project Not Found|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Import failed|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## List all invited groups in a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdInvitedGroups"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/invited_groups \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/invited_groups`

Lists all invited groups in a project. Unauthenticated requests return only public invited groups. Limited to 60 requests a minute per user account for authenticated requires and per IP address for unauthenticated requests. Supports offset-based pagination (up to 50,000 projects) and keyset-based pagination (greater than 50,000 projects).

<h3 id="list-all-invited-groups-in-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|relation|query|[string]|false|Filter groups by relation.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Return the list of authorized groups matching the search criteria.|
|min_access_level|query|integer \| null|false|Return results where the current user has at least the specified access level. For a list of values, see [roles](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#default-roles).|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|relation|direct|
|relation|inherited|
|min_access_level|10|
|min_access_level|15|
|min_access_level|20|
|min_access_level|25|
|min_access_level|30|
|min_access_level|40|
|min_access_level|50|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 0,
    "web_url": "http://gitlab.example.com/groups/diaspora",
    "name": "Diaspora",
    "avatar_url": "http://gitlab.example.com/uploads/group/avatar/1/avatar.png",
    "full_name": "Foobar Group",
    "full_path": "foo-bar"
  }
]
```

|---|---|---|---|

```bash
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/packages/protection/rules`

Creates a package protection rule for a specified project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "package_name_pattern": "string",
  "package_type": "cargo",
  "minimum_access_level_for_delete": "owner",
  "minimum_access_level_for_push": "maintainer"
}
```

## Create a container repository protection rule

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdRegistryProtectionRepositoryRules"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/registry/protection/repository/rules \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "repository_path_pattern": "string",
    "minimum_access_level_for_push": "maintainer",
    "minimum_access_level_for_delete": "maintainer"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/registry/protection/repository/rules`

Creates a container repository protection rule for a specified project to control who can push or delete container images.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "repository_path_pattern": "string",
  "minimum_access_level_for_push": "maintainer",
  "minimum_access_level_for_delete": "maintainer"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-container-repository-protection-rule-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdRegistryProtectionRepositoryRulesRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidregistryprotectionrepositoryrulesrequest)|true|none|
|» repository_path_pattern|body|string \| null|true|Container repository path pattern protected by the protection rule, for example `flight/flight-*`. Wildcard character `*` is allowed.|
|» minimum_access_level_for_push|body|string \| null|false|Minimum GitLab access level required to push container images to the container registry. Must be provided when `minimum_access_level_for_delete` is not set. At least one of `minimum_access_level_for_push`, `minimum_access_level_for_delete` must be provided.|
|» minimum_access_level_for_delete|body|string \| null|false|Minimum GitLab access level required to delete container images in the container registry. Must be provided when `minimum_access_level_for_push` is not set. At least one of `minimum_access_level_for_push`, `minimum_access_level_for_delete` must be provided.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» minimum_access_level_for_push|maintainer|
|» minimum_access_level_for_push|owner|
|» minimum_access_level_for_push|admin|
|» minimum_access_level_for_delete|maintainer|
|» minimum_access_level_for_delete|owner|
|» minimum_access_level_for_delete|admin|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json

  "id": 1,
  "project_id": 1,
  "repository_path_pattern": "flightjs/flight0",
  "minimum_access_level_for_push": "maintainer",
  "minimum_access_level_for_delete": "maintainer"
}
```

|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable Entity|None|

## List all project issues

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdIssues"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues`

Lists all issues for a specified project. If the project is private, you need to provide credentials to authorize. In most cases, you should authenticate with a personal access token.

<h3 id="list-all-project-issues-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|with_labels_details|query|boolean|false|If `true`, the response returns more details for each label in the labels field: `name`, `color`, `description`, `description_html`, `text_color`.|
|state|query|string|false|Filter issues by state.|
|closed_by_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues closed by the user with the given ID.|
|order_by|query|string|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|due_date|query|string \| null|false|Return issues that have no due date, are overdue, or whose due date is this week, this month, or between two weeks ago and next month.|
|issue_type|query|string \| null|false|The type of the issue. Accepts: issue, incident, test_case, requirement, task, ticket|
|labels|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names. `None` means no labels are assigned. `Any` means at least one label is assigned. `No+Label` (deprecated) means no labels are assigned. Set to an empty string to unassign all labels. If a label does not already exist, this creates a new project label and assigns it to the issue. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|milestone|query|string \| null|false|Milestone title. `None` lists all issues with no milestone. `Any` lists all issues that have an assigned milestone. Support for `None` and `Any` is [planned for removal](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/336044). Use the `milestone_id` attribute instead. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_id`.|
|milestone_id|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to milestones with a given timebox value. `None` lists all issues with no milestone. `Any` lists all issues that have an assigned milestone. `Upcoming` lists all issues assigned to milestones due in the future. `Started` lists all issues assigned to open, started milestones. The logic for `Upcoming` and `Started` differs from the logic used in the [GraphQL API](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/milestones/#special-milestone-filters). Mutually exclusive with `milestone`.|
|iids|query|[integer]|false|Return only the issues having the given `iid`.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Search issues against their `title` and `description`.|
|in|query|string \| null|false|Modify the scope of the `search` attribute to `title`, `description`, or `title,description`. If omitted, defaults to `title,description`.|
|author_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues created by the given user ID. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`.|
|author_username|query|string \| null|false|Return issues created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.|
|assignee_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned issues and `Any` returns issues with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`.|
|assignee_username|query|[string]|false|Return issues assigned to the given username. In GitLab Community Edition, only a single value is accepted. Otherwise, an invalid parameter error is returned. When multiple usernames are given, only issues assigned to all of them are returned. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues created on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues updated on or after the specified time.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues updated on or before the specified time.|
|not|query|object \| null|false|Return issues that do not match the specified parameters.|
|not[labels]|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names.|
|not[milestone]|query|string \| null|false|Milestone title. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone_id]`.|
|not[milestone_id]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to milestones without the specified timebox value. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone]`.|
|not[iids]|query|[integer]|false|Internal IDs of issues to exclude.|
|not[author_id]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues not authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`.|
|not[author_username]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues not authored by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`.|
|not[assignee_id]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`.|
|not[assignee_username]|query|[string]|false|Return issues not assigned to the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`.|
|not[weight]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues that do not have the specified weight.|
|not[iteration_id]|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the iteration with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_title]`.|
|not[iteration_title]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the iteration with the given title. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_id]`.|
|scope|query|string \| null|false|Return issues for the given scope.|
|my_reaction_emoji|query|string \| null|false|Return issues reacted to by the authenticated user with the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues with no reaction and `Any` returns issues with at least one reaction.|
|confidential|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only confidential issues. If `false`, returns only public issues.|
|weight|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|The weight of the issue|
|epic_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues associated with the epic with the given ID. `None` returns issues that are not associated with an epic. `Any` returns issues that are associated with an epic. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|health_status|query|string \| null|false|The health status of the issue. Must be one of: on_track, needs_attention, at_risk, none, any|
|iteration_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the iteration with the given ID. `None` returns issues that do not belong to an iteration. `Any` returns issues that belong to an iteration. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_title`.|
|iteration_title|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the iteration with the given title. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_id`.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|cursor|query|string \| null|false|Cursor for obtaining the next set of records.|

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdIssues"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues \
  -X POST \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "title": "string",
    "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "merge_request_to_resolve_discussions_of": 0,
    "discussion_to_resolve": "string",
    "iid": 0,
    "description": "string",
    "assignee_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "assignee_id": 0,

      "string"

    ],

    ],

    "discussion_locked": true,
    "issue_type": "issue",

    "epic_id": 0,
    "epic_iid": 0
  }'
```

Creates an issue for a specified project.

```json
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "merge_request_to_resolve_discussions_of": 0,

  ],

  "epic_id": 0,
  "epic_iid": 0
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-issue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidissuesrequest)|true|none|
|» title|body|string \| null|true|Title of the issue.|
|» created_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Date and time the issue was created. Requires administrator or project/group owner rights.|
|» merge_request_to_resolve_discussions_of|body|integer \| null|false|Internal ID of a merge request for which to resolve discussions. This fills the issue with a default description and marks all discussions as resolved, unless a title or description is provided.|
|» discussion_to_resolve|body|string \| null|false|ID of a discussion to resolve. Use in combination with `merge_request_to_resolve_discussions_of`.|
|» iid|body|integer \| null|false|Internal ID to assign to the new issue. Administrators or project owners only.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the issue. Limited to 1,048,576 characters.|
|» assignee_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of the users to assign to the issue. Set to `0` or leave empty to unassign all assignees. Assigning more than one user is Premium and Ultimate only.|
|» assignee_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the user to assign the issue to. Available only on GitLab Free. Deprecated. Use `assignee_ids` instead.|
|» milestone_id|body|integer \| null|false|Global ID of a milestone to assign to the issue. Set to `0` or leave empty to unassign the milestone. Mutually exclusive with `milestone`.|
|» milestone|body|string \| null|false|The title of a project or ancestor-group milestone to assign the issue to. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_id`.|
|» labels|body|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names. `None` means no labels are assigned. `Any` means at least one label is assigned. `No+Label` (deprecated) means no labels are assigned. Set to an empty string to unassign all labels. If a label does not already exist, this creates a new project label and assigns it to the issue. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|» add_labels|body|[string]|false|Comma-separated label names to add to the issue. If a label does not already exist, this creates a new project label and assigns it to the issue.|
|» remove_labels|body|[string]|false|Comma-separated label names to remove from the issue.|
|» due_date|body|string \| null|false|Due date, in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`, for example `2016-03-11`.|
|» start_date|body|string \| null|false|Start date, in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`, for example `2016-03-11`. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/238041) in GitLab 19.1.|
|» confidential|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the issue is confidential.|
|» discussion_locked|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, locks the issue's discussion so only project members can add or edit comments.|
|» issue_type|body|string \| null|false|The type of the issue. Accepts: issue, incident, test_case, requirement, task, ticket|
|» severity|body|string \| null|false|The severity of the issue. Only applies to incidents. Accepts: unknown, low, medium, high, critical|
|» weight|body|integer \| null|false|The weight of the issue|
|» epic_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of an epic to associate the issue with. Must be `0` or greater. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `epic_iid`.|
|» epic_iid|body|integer \| null|false|Internal ID of an epic to associate the issue with. Must be `0` or greater. Deprecated and [scheduled for removal](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/35157) in API version 5. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `epic_id`.|

## Retrieve issues statistics for a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesStatistics"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues_statistics \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues_statistics`

Retrieves statistics for issues in a specified project.

<h3 id="retrieve-issues-statistics-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|labels|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names. `None` means no labels are assigned. `Any` means at least one label is assigned. `No+Label` (deprecated) means no labels are assigned. Set to an empty string to unassign all labels. If a label does not already exist, this creates a new project label and assigns it to the issue. Predefined names are case-insensitive.|
|milestone|query|string \| null|false|Milestone title. `None` lists all issues with no milestone. `Any` lists all issues that have an assigned milestone. Support for `None` and `Any` is [planned for removal](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/336044). Use the `milestone_id` attribute instead. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_id`.|
|milestone_id|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to milestones with a given timebox value. `None` lists all issues with no milestone. `Any` lists all issues that have an assigned milestone. `Upcoming` lists all issues assigned to milestones due in the future. `Started` lists all issues assigned to open, started milestones. The logic for `Upcoming` and `Started` differs from the logic used in the [GraphQL API](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/milestones/#special-milestone-filters). Mutually exclusive with `milestone`.|
|iids|query|[integer]|false|Return only the issues having the given `iid`.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Search issues against their `title` and `description`.|
|in|query|string \| null|false|Modify the scope of the `search` attribute to `title`, `description`, or `title,description`. If omitted, defaults to `title,description`.|
|author_id|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues created by the given user ID. Combine with `scope=all` or `scope=assigned_to_me`. Mutually exclusive with `author_username`.|
|author_username|query|string \| null|false|Return issues created by the given `username`. Mutually exclusive with `author_id`.|
|assignee_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the given user `id`. `None` returns unassigned issues and `Any` returns issues with an assignee. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_username`.|
|assignee_username|query|[string]|false|Return issues assigned to the given username. In GitLab Community Edition, only a single value is accepted. Otherwise, an invalid parameter error is returned. When multiple usernames are given, only issues assigned to all of them are returned. Mutually exclusive with `assignee_id`.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues created on or before the specified time.|
|updated_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues updated on or after the specified time.|
|updated_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return issues updated on or before the specified time.|
|not|query|object \| null|false|Return issues that do not match the specified parameters.|
|not[labels]|query|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of label names.|
|not[milestone]|query|string \| null|false|Milestone title. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone_id]`.|
|not[milestone_id]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to milestones without the specified timebox value. Mutually exclusive with `not[milestone]`.|
|not[iids]|query|[integer]|false|Internal IDs of issues to exclude.|
|not[author_id]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues not authored by the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_username]`.|
|not[author_username]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues not authored by the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[author_id]`.|
|not[assignee_id]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the user with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_username]`.|
|not[assignee_username]|query|[string]|false|Return issues not assigned to the user with the given username. Mutually exclusive with `not[assignee_id]`.|
|not[weight]|query|integer \| null|false|Return issues that do not have the specified weight.|
|not[iteration_id]|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the iteration with the given ID. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_title]`.|
|not[iteration_title]|query|string \| null|false|Return issues not assigned to the iteration with the given title. Mutually exclusive with `not[iteration_id]`.|
|scope|query|string \| null|false|Return issues for the given scope.|
|my_reaction_emoji|query|string \| null|false|Return issues reacted to by the authenticated user with the given `emoji`. `None` returns issues with no reaction and `Any` returns issues with at least one reaction.|
|confidential|query|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, returns only confidential issues. If `false`, returns only public issues.|
|weight|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|The weight of the issue|
|epic_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues associated with the epic with the given ID. `None` returns issues that are not associated with an epic. `Any` returns issues that are associated with an epic. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|health_status|query|string \| null|false|The health status of the issue. Must be one of: on_track, needs_attention, at_risk, none, any|
|iteration_id|query|integer \| null \| string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the iteration with the given ID. `None` returns issues that do not belong to an iteration. `Any` returns issues that belong to an iteration. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_title`.|
|iteration_title|query|string \| null|false|Return issues assigned to the iteration with the given title. Premium and Ultimate only. Mutually exclusive with `iteration_id`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|milestone_id|Any|
|milestone_id|None|
|milestone_id|Upcoming|
|milestone_id|Started|
|not[milestone_id]|Any|
|not[milestone_id]|None|
|not[milestone_id]|Upcoming|
|not[milestone_id]|Started|
|scope|created-by-me|
|scope|assigned-to-me|
|scope|created_by_me|
|scope|assigned_to_me|
|scope|all|
|health_status|on_track|
|health_status|needs_attention|
|health_status|at_risk|
|health_status|none|
|health_status|any|

## Update an issue

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIid"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "title": "string",
    "updated_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "state_event": "reopen",
    "description": "string",
    "assignee_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "assignee_id": 0,
    "milestone_id": 0,
    "milestone": "string",
    "labels": [
      "string"
    ],
    "add_labels": [
      "string"
    ],
    "remove_labels": [
      "string"
    ],
    "due_date": "string",
    "start_date": "string",
    "confidential": true,
    "discussion_locked": true,
    "issue_type": "issue",
    "severity": "unknown",
    "weight": 0,
    "epic_id": 0,
    "epic_iid": 0,
    "created_at": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues/{issue_iid}`

Updates a specified issue for a project. This request is also used to close or reopen an issue using the `state_event` parameter. At least one of the following parameters is required for the request to be successful: `assignee_id`, `assignee_ids`, `confidential`, `created_at`, `description`, `discussion_locked`, `due_date`, `issue_type`, `labels`, `milestone_id`, `state_event`, `title`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "title": "string",
  "updated_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "state_event": "reopen",
  "description": "string",
  "assignee_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "assignee_id": 0,
  "milestone_id": 0,
  "milestone": "string",
  "labels": [
    "string"
  ],
  "add_labels": [
    "string"
  ],
  "remove_labels": [
    "string"
  ],
  "due_date": "string",
  "start_date": "string",
  "confidential": true,
  "discussion_locked": true,
  "issue_type": "issue",
  "severity": "unknown",
  "weight": 0,
  "epic_id": 0,
  "epic_iid": 0,
  "created_at": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-issue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|issue_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the issue.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidissuesissueiidrequest)|false|none|
|» title|body|string \| null|false|Title of the issue. At least one of `assignee_id`, `assignee_ids`, `confidential`, `created_at`, `description`, `discussion_locked`, `due_date`, `start_date`, `labels`, `add_labels`, `remove_labels`, `milestone_id`, `milestone`, `severity`, `state_event`, `title`, `issue_type`, `weight`, `epic_id`, `epic_iid` must be provided.|
|» updated_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Date and time the issue was updated. Administrators or project owners only. Empty or null values are not accepted.|
|» state_event|body|string \| null|false|Event to change the state of the issue. At least one of `assignee_id`, `assignee_ids`, `confidential`, `created_at`, `description`, `discussion_locked`, `due_date`, `start_date`, `labels`, `add_labels`, `remove_labels`, `milestone_id`, `milestone`, `severity`, `state_event`, `title`, `issue_type`, `weight`, `epic_id`, `epic_iid` must be provided.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the issue. Limited to 1,048,576 characters. At least one of `assignee_id`, `assignee_ids`, `confidential`, `created_at`, `description`, `discussion_locked`, `due_date`, `start_date`, `labels`, `add_labels`, `remove_labels`, `milestone_id`, `milestone`, `severity`, `state_event`, `title`, `issue_type`, `weight`, `epic_id`, `epic_iid` must be provided.|
|» assignee_ids|body|[integer]|false|IDs of the users to assign to the issue. Set to `0` or leave empty to unassign all assignees. Assigning more than one user is Premium and Ultimate only. At least one of `assignee_id`, `assignee_ids`, `confidential`, `created_at`, `description`, `discussion_locked`, `due_date`, `start_date`, `labels`, `add_labels`, `remove_labels`, `milestone_id`, `milestone`, `severity`, `state_event`, `title`, `issue_type`, `weight`, `epic_id`, `epic_iid` must be provided.|
|» assignee_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the user to assign the issue to. Available only on GitLab Free. Deprecated. Use `assignee_ids` instead. At least one of `assignee_id`, `assignee_ids`, `confidential`, `created_at`, `description`, `discussion_locked`, `due_date`, `start_date`, `labels`, `add_labels`, `remove_labels`, `milestone_id`, `milestone`, `severity`, `state_event`, `title`, `issue_type`, `weight`, `epic_id`, `epic_iid` must be provided.|

## Update the order of an issue

<a id="opIdputApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidReorder"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues/0/reorder \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "move_after_id": 0,
    "move_before_id": 0
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues/{issue_iid}/reorder`

Updates the order of a specified issue in a project. You can see the results when sorting issues manually.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "move_after_id": 0,
  "move_before_id": 0
}
```

<h3 id="update-the-order-of-an-issue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|issue_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the issue.|
|body|body|[putApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidReorderRequest](#schemaputapiv4projectsidissuesissueiidreorderrequest)|false|none|
|» move_after_id|body|integer \| null|false|Global ID of the project issue to place this issue after. At least one of `move_after_id`, `move_before_id` must be provided.|
|» move_before_id|body|integer \| null|false|Global ID of the project issue to place this issue before. At least one of `move_after_id`, `move_before_id` must be provided.|

## Move an issue

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidMove"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues/0/move \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "to_project_id": 0
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues/{issue_iid}/move`

Moves a specified issue to a different project. If the target project is the source project or the user has insufficient permissions, an error message with status code `400` is returned. If a label or milestone with the same name also exists in the target project, it is then assigned to the issue being moved.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "to_project_id": 0
}
```

<h3 id="move-an-issue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|issue_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the issue.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidMoveRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidissuesissueiidmoverequest)|true|none|
|» to_project_id|body|integer \| null|true|ID of the new project.|

## Clone an issue

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidClone"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues/0/clone \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "to_project_id": 0,
    "with_notes": false
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues/{issue_iid}/clone`

Clones a specified issue to a project. Copies as much data as possible as long as the target project contains equivalent criteria, such as labels or milestones. If you have insufficient permissions, an error message with status code `400` is returned.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "to_project_id": 0,
  "with_notes": false
}
```

<h3 id="clone-an-issue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|issue_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the issue.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidCloneRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidissuesissueiidclonerequest)|true|none|
|» to_project_id|body|integer \| null|true|ID of the new project.|
|» with_notes|body|boolean|false|If `true`, clones the issue with its [notes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/notes/).|

## List all merge requests that close an issue on merge

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdIssuesIssueIidClosedBy"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/issues/0/closed_by \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues/{issue_iid}/closed_by`

Lists all merge requests that close a specified issue when merged. If the project is private or the issue is confidential, you need to provide credentials to authorize. In most cases, you should authenticate with a personal access token.

<h3 id="list-all-merge-requests-that-close-an-issue-on-merge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|issue_iid|path|integer|true|Internal ID of the issue.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-projects-job-token-scope">Projects job token scope</h1>

Use this API to interact with [CI/CD job token](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/jobs/ci_job_token/) scopes.

> [!note]
> All requests to the CI/CD job token scope API endpoint must be [authenticated](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/rest/authentication/).
> The authenticated user must have the Maintainer or Owner role for the project.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_job_token_scopes/">External documentation</a>

## Retrieve the CI/CD job token access settings for a project

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdJobTokenScope"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/job_token_scope \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/job_token_scope`

Retrieves the CI/CD job token access settings (job token scope) of a specified project.

<h3 id="retrieve-the-cicd-job-token-access-settings-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "inbound_enabled": true,
  "outbound_enabled": true
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-the-cicd-job-token-access-settings-for-a-project-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[APIEntitiesProjectJobTokenScope](#schemaapientitiesprojectjobtokenscope)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Update the CI/CD job token access settings for a project

<a id="opIdpatchApiV4ProjectsIdJobTokenScope"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/job_token_scope \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "enabled": true
  }'
```

`PATCH /api/v4/projects/{id}/job_token_scope`

Updates the **Authorized groups and projects** setting (job token scope) of a specified project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "enabled": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-the-cicd-job-token-access-settings-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[patchApiV4ProjectsIdJobTokenScopeRequest](#schemapatchapiv4projectsidjobtokenscoperequest)|true|none|
|» enabled|body|boolean \| null|true|Indicates CI/CD job tokens generated in other projects have restricted access to this project.|

<h3 id="update-the-cicd-job-token-access-settings-for-a-project-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|No Content|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-protected-branches">Protected branches</h1>

Use this API to manage [protected branches](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/repository/branches/protected/)
for a project, and the [protected branch settings](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/repository/branches/protected/#in-a-group)
that all projects in a group inherit.

GitLab Premium and GitLab Ultimate support more granular protections for pushing to branches.
Administrators can grant permission to modify and push to protected branches only to deploy keys,
instead of specific users.

> [!warning]
> Group protected branch settings are restricted to top-level groups. They support only
> [valid access levels](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_protected_branches/#valid-access-levels),
> and cannot name individual users or groups.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/protected_branches/">External documentation</a>

## List all protected branches

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdProtectedBranches"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/protected_branches \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/protected_branches`

Lists all protected branches from a group. If a wildcard is set, it is returned instead of the exact name of the branches that match that wildcard.

<h3 id="list-all-protected-branches-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Name or part of the name of protected branches to search for.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "main",
    "push_access_levels": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "access_level": 40,
        "access_level_description": "Maintainers",
        "deploy_key_id": 1,
        "user_id": 1,
        "group_id": 1,
        "member_role_id": 42,
        "member_role_name": "Lead Developer"
      }
    ],
    "merge_access_levels": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "access_level": 40,
        "access_level_description": "Maintainers",
        "deploy_key_id": 1,
        "user_id": 1,
        "group_id": 1,
        "member_role_id": 42,
        "member_role_name": "Lead Developer"
      }
    ],
    "allow_force_push": true,
    "unprotect_access_levels": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "access_level": 40,
        "access_level_description": "Maintainers",
        "deploy_key_id": 1,
        "user_id": 1,
        "group_id": 1,
        "member_role_id": 42,
        "member_role_name": "Lead Developer"
      }
    ],
    "code_owner_approval_required": true
  }
]
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

## Protect a repository branch

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdProtectedBranches"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/protected_branches \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "main",
    "push_access_level": 30,
    "merge_access_level": 30,
    "allow_force_push": false,
    "unprotect_access_level": 30,
    "allowed_to_push": [
      {}
    ],
    "allowed_to_merge": [
      {}
    ],
    "allowed_to_unprotect": [
      {}
    ],
    "code_owner_approval_required": true
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/protected_branches`

Protects a specified repository branch. Protect multiple branches by using a wildcard in the `name`.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "main",
  "push_access_level": 30,
  "merge_access_level": 30,
  "allow_force_push": false,
  "unprotect_access_level": 30,
  "allowed_to_push": [
    {}
  ],
  "allowed_to_merge": [
    {}
  ],
  "allowed_to_unprotect": [
    {}
  ],
  "code_owner_approval_required": true
}
```

<h3 id="protect-a-repository-branch-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdProtectedBranchesRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidprotectedbranchesrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the branch or wildcard.|
|» push_access_level|body|integer \| null|false|Access level allowed to push. Defaults to `40` (Maintainer role). Does not support custom roles. Use `allowed_to_push` with `member_role_id` instead.|
|» merge_access_level|body|integer \| null|false|Access level allowed to merge. Defaults to `40` (Maintainer role). Does not support custom roles. Use `allowed_to_merge` with `member_role_id` instead.|
|» allow_force_push|body|boolean|false|If `true`, members who can push to this branch can also force push.|
|» unprotect_access_level|body|integer \| null|false|Access level allowed to unprotect. Defaults to `40` (Maintainer role). Does not support custom roles. Use `allowed_to_unprotect` with `member_role_id` instead.|
|» allowed_to_push|body|[object]|false|Array of users, groups, deploy keys, or access levels allowed to push to protected branches|
|» allowed_to_merge|body|[object]|false|Array of users, groups, or access levels allowed to merge protected branches|
|» allowed_to_unprotect|body|[object]|false|Array of users, groups, or access levels allowed to unprotect protected branches|
|» code_owner_approval_required|body|boolean \| null|false|Prevent pushes to this branch if it matches an item in CODEOWNERS|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» push_access_level|30|
|» push_access_level|40|
|» push_access_level|60|
|» push_access_level|0|
|» merge_access_level|30|
|» merge_access_level|40|
|» merge_access_level|60|
|» merge_access_level|0|
|» unprotect_access_level|30|
|» unprotect_access_level|40|
|» unprotect_access_level|60|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "main",
  "push_access_levels": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "access_level": 40,
      "access_level_description": "Maintainers",
      "deploy_key_id": 1,
      "user_id": 1,
      "group_id": 1,
      "member_role_id": 42,
      "member_role_name": "Lead Developer"
    }
  ],
  "merge_access_levels": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "access_level": 40,
      "access_level_description": "Maintainers",
      "deploy_key_id": 1,
      "user_id": 1,
      "group_id": 1,
      "member_role_id": 42,
      "member_role_name": "Lead Developer"
    }
  ],
  "allow_force_push": true,
  "unprotect_access_levels": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "access_level": 40,
      "access_level_description": "Maintainers",
      "deploy_key_id": 1,
      "user_id": 1,
      "group_id": 1,
      "member_role_id": 42,
      "member_role_name": "Lead Developer"
    }
  ],
  "code_owner_approval_required": true
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesGroupProtectedBranch](#schemaapientitiesgroupprotectedbranch)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|401 Unauthorized|None|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-protected-environments">Protected environments</h1>

Use this API to manage [protected environments](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/environments/protected_environments/)
for a project, and [protected environments for a group](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/environments/protected_environments/#protected-environments-for-groups)
for a group.

> [!note]
> The project endpoints require CI/CD to be turned on for the project. If
> [CI/CD is turned off](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/settings/#turn-off-cicd-for-a-project),
> requests return `403 Forbidden`, even for users who otherwise have permission to manage protected
> environments.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/protected_environments/">External documentation</a>

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/protected_environments \
  -X POST \

  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \

    "name": "string",
    "required_approval_count": 0,
    "deploy_access_levels": [
      {
        "user_id": 0,
        "group_id": 0,
        "group_inheritance_type": 0,
        "access_level": 40
      }
    ],
    "approval_rules": [
      {
        "user_id": 0,
        "group_id": 0,
        "group_inheritance_type": 0,
        "id": 0,
        "_destroy": true,
        "access_level": 40,
        "required_approvals": 1
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/protected_environments`

Protects a specified environment for a project.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "required_approval_count": 0,
  "deploy_access_levels": [
    {
      "user_id": 0,
      "group_id": 0,
      "group_inheritance_type": 0,
      "access_level": 40
    }
  ],
  "approval_rules": [
    {
      "user_id": 0,
      "group_id": 0,
      "group_inheritance_type": 0,
      "id": 0,
      "_destroy": true,
      "access_level": 40,
      "required_approvals": 1
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="protect-an-environment-for-a-project-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdProtectedEnvironmentsRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidprotectedenvironmentsrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the environment.|
|» required_approval_count|body|integer|false|Number of approvals required to deploy to the environment. Values greater than `0` are rejected. Deprecated. Use `approval_rules` instead.|
|» deploy_access_levels|body|[object]|true|Array of access levels allowed to deploy to the environment, with each entry specifying a user, group, or access level.|
|» » user_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the user to grant access to.|
|» » group_id|body|integer \| null|false|ID of the group to grant access to.|
|» » group_inheritance_type|body|integer \| null|false|Whether to include inherited group membership. Use `0` for direct group membership only, or `1` to include inherited groups. Defaults to `0`.|
|» » access_level|body|integer \| null|false|Access level allowed to deploy to the environment.|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-provider-identities">Provider identities</h1>

Use this API to manage the SAML and SCIM identities linked to users in a group.

Prerequisites for the SCIM endpoints:

- You must enable [group SSO](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/saml_sso/).
- You must enable [SCIM for group SSO](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/saml_sso/scim_setup/).
- You must authenticate with a [personal access token](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/profile/personal_access_tokens/)
  or [group access token](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/settings/group_access_tokens/) that has the correct scope.

These endpoints get, check, update, and delete SCIM identities in groups, and do not implement
the [RFC7644 protocol](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7644). They differ from the
[internal group SCIM API](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/internal_api/#group-scim-api) and the
[internal instance SCIM API](https://docs.gitlab.com/development/internal_api/#instance-scim-api),
which implement RFC7644 for SCIM provider integration and require a SCIM token.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/saml/">External documentation</a>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-push-rules">Push rules</h1>

Use this API to manage [push rules](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/repository/push_rules/) for
a project, and [group push rules](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/repository/push_rules/#group-push-rules)
that apply to newly created projects in a group.

Managing group push rules requires the Owner role for the group, or administrator access to the
instance.

> [!note]
> GitLab uses [RE2 syntax](https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax) for all regular expressions in push rules.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_push_rules/">External documentation</a>

```json
  "branch_name_regex": "[a-z]",
  "author_email_regex": "^[A-Za-z0-9.]+@gitlab.com$",

  "deny_delete_tag": true,
  "member_check": true,
  "prevent_secrets": true,
  "max_file_size": 100,

}
```

## Update push rules of a group

<a id="opIdputApiV4GroupsIdPushRule"></a>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-releases">Releases</h1>

Use this API to manage [releases](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/releases/) for a project,
list the releases across a group, and manage the asset links attached to a release.

Asset links support the `http`, `https`, and `ftp` protocols.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/">External documentation</a>

## List all release links

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdReleasesTagNameAssetsLinks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/releases/string/assets/links \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/releases/{tag_name}/assets/links`

Lists all assets as links from a release.

<h3 id="list-all-release-links-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|tag_name|path|string|true|Tag associated with the release.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "app-v1.0.dmg",
    "url": "https://gitlab.example.com/root/app/-/jobs/688/artifacts/raw/bin/app-v1.0.dmg",
    "direct_asset_url": "https://gitlab.example.com/root/app/-/releases/v1.0/downloads/app-v1.0.dmg",
    "link_type": "other"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-release-links-responses">Responses</h3>

|---|---|---|---|

|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesReleasesLink](#schemaapientitiesreleaseslink)]|false|none|none|

## Create a release link

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdReleasesTagNameAssetsLinks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/releases/string/assets/links \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "url": "string",
    "direct_asset_path": "string",
    "filepath": "string",
    "link_type": "other"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/releases/{tag_name}/assets/links`

Creates an asset link for a specified release.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "direct_asset_path": "string",
  "filepath": "string",
  "link_type": "other"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-release-link-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|tag_name|path|string|true|Tag associated with the release.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdReleasesTagNameAssetsLinksRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidreleasestagnameassetslinksrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the link. Link names must be unique in the release.|
|» url|body|string \| null|true|URL of the link. Link URLs must be unique in the release.|
|» direct_asset_path|body|string \| null|false|Path for a [direct asset link](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/releases/release_fields/#permanent-links-to-release-assets).|
|» filepath|body|string \| null|false|Path for a direct asset link. Deprecated. Use `direct_asset_path` instead.|
|» link_type|body|string|false|Type of the link.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» link_type|other|
|» link_type|runbook|
|» link_type|image|
|» link_type|package|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "app-v1.0.dmg",
  "url": "https://gitlab.example.com/root/app/-/jobs/688/artifacts/raw/bin/app-v1.0.dmg",
  "direct_asset_url": "https://gitlab.example.com/root/app/-/releases/v1.0/downloads/app-v1.0.dmg",

}
```

## Create a release

<a id="opIdpostApiV4ProjectsIdReleases"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/releases \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "tag_name": "string",
    "tag_message": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "ref": "string",
    "assets": {
      "links": [
        {
          "name": "string",
          "url": "string",
          "direct_asset_path": "string",
          "filepath": "string",
          "link_type": "other"
        }
      ]
    },
    "milestones": [
      "string"
    ],
    "milestone_ids": "string",
    "released_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "legacy_catalog_publish": true
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/projects/{id}/releases`

Creates a release. Developer level access to the project is required to create a release.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "tag_name": "string",
  "tag_message": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "ref": "string",
  "assets": {
    "links": [
      {
        "name": "string",
        "url": "string",
        "direct_asset_path": "string",
        "filepath": "string",
        "link_type": "other"
      }
    ]
  },
  "milestones": [
    "string"
  ],
  "milestone_ids": "string",
  "released_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "legacy_catalog_publish": true
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-release-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4ProjectsIdReleasesRequest](#schemapostapiv4projectsidreleasesrequest)|true|none|
|» tag_name|body|string \| null|true|Tag the release is created from.|
|» tag_message|body|string \| null|false|Message to use if creating a new annotated tag.|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|Name of the release.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the release. You can use [Markdown](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/markdown/).|
|» ref|body|string \| null|false|If the tag named in `tag_name` doesn't exist, the release is created from this ref and tagged with `tag_name`. Can be a commit SHA, another tag name, or a branch name.|
|» assets|body|object \| null|false|Object that contains assets for the release.|
|» » links|body|[object]|false|Array of links to include as release assets.|
|» » » name|body|string \| null|true|Name of the link. Link names must be unique within the release.|
|» » » url|body|string \| null|true|URL of the link. Link URLs must be unique within the release.|
|» » » direct_asset_path|body|string \| null|false|Path for a direct asset link.|
|» » » filepath|body|string \| null|false|Deprecated: optional path for a direct asset link|
|» » » link_type|body|string|false|The type of the link.|
|» milestones|body|[string]|false|Title of each milestone the release is associated with. [GitLab Premium](https://about.gitlab.com/pricing/) customers can specify group milestones. Cannot be combined with the `milestone_ids` parameter. Mutually exclusive with `milestone_ids`.|
|» milestone_ids|body|string \| null \| integer \| null|false|ID of each milestone the release is associated with. GitLab Premium customers can specify group milestones. Cannot be combined with the `milestones` parameter. Mutually exclusive with `milestones`.|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string \| null|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|integer \| null|false|none|
|» released_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Date and time for the release. Defaults to the current time. Only provide this field when creating an [upcoming](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/releases/#upcoming-releases) or [historical](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/releases/#historical-releases) release.|
|» legacy_catalog_publish|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, publishes the release to the CI catalog. This parameter is for internal use only and is planned for removal in a future release. If the `ci_release_cli_catalog_publish_option` feature flag is disabled, this parameter is ignored and the release publishes to the CI catalog as before.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » » link_type|other|
|» » » link_type|runbook|
|» » » link_type|package|
|» » » link_type|image|
