## List all users

<a id="opIdgetApiV4Users"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/users \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/users`

Lists all users on the instance. This endpoint supports keyset pagination. In GitLab 17.0 and later, keyset pagination is used by default.

<h3 id="list-all-users-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|username|query|string \| null|false|Return a single user with the specified username.|
|extern_uid|query|string \| null|false|Return a single user with the specified external authentication provider UID. Use with `provider`. Administrators only. All or none of `extern_uid`, `provider` must be provided.|
|public_email|query|string \| null|false|Return a single user with the specified public email.|
|provider|query|string \| null|false|Name of the external authentication provider. All or none of `extern_uid`, `provider` must be provided.|
|search|query|string \| null|false|Search for users by name, username, or public email.|
|active|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only active users.|
|humans|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only regular users that are not bot or internal users.|
|external|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only external users.|
|blocked|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only blocked users.|
|created_after|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return users created on or after the specified time.|
|created_before|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Return users created on or before the specified time.|
|without_projects|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only users that do not have any projects.|
|without_project_bots|query|boolean|false|If `true`, excludes project bot users from the results.|
|admins|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only administrators.|
|two_factor|query|string \| null|false|Filter users by Two-factor authentication.|
|exclude_active|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only users that are not active.|
|exclude_external|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only users that are not external.|
|exclude_humans|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only bot or internal users.|
|exclude_internal|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only users that are not internal.|
|order_by|query|string \| null|false|Sort results by the specified field.|
|sort|query|string \| null|false|Sort results in ascending or descending order.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|
|with_custom_attributes|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) in the response. Administrators only.|
|custom_attributes|query|object \| null|false|Filter by [custom attributes](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/custom_attributes/) that match all of the specified key and value pairs. Administrators only.|
|skip_ldap|query|boolean|false|If `true`, excludes LDAP users from the results.|
|auditors|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only auditor users.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|order_by|id|
|order_by|name|
|order_by|username|
|order_by|created_at|
|order_by|updated_at|
|sort|asc|
|sort|desc|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "username": "admin",
    "public_email": "john@example.com",
    "name": "Administrator",
    "state": "active",
    "locked": true,
    "avatar_url": "https://gravatar.com/avatar/1",
    "avatar_path": "/user/avatar/28/The-Big-Lebowski-400-400.png",
    "custom_attributes": [
      {
        "key": "foo",
        "value": "bar"
      }
    ],
    "web_url": "https://gitlab.example.com/root"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-users-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|

<h3 id="list-all-users-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesUserBasic](#schemaapientitiesuserbasic)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## Create a user

<a id="opIdpostApiV4Users"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/users \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'email=string' \
  -F 'password=string' \
  -F 'reset_password=true' \
  -F 'skip_confirmation=true' \
  -F 'force_random_password=true' \
  -F 'name=string' \
  -F 'username=string' \
  -F 'linkedin=string' \
  -F 'twitter=string' \
  -F 'discord=string' \
  -F 'website_url=string' \
  -F 'github=string' \
  -F 'organization=string' \
  -F 'projects_limit=0' \
  -F 'extern_uid=string' \
  -F 'provider=string' \
  -F 'bio=string' \
  -F 'location=string' \
  -F 'pronouns=string' \
  -F 'public_email=string' \
  -F 'commit_email=string' \
  -F 'admin=true' \
  -F 'can_create_group=true' \
  -F 'external=true' \
  -F 'avatar=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'theme_id=0' \
  -F 'color_scheme_id=0' \
  -F 'private_profile=true' \
  -F 'note=string' \
  -F 'view_diffs_file_by_file=true' \
  -F 'policy_advanced_editor=true' \
  -F 'shared_runners_minutes_limit=0' \
  -F 'extra_shared_runners_minutes_limit=0' \
  -F 'group_id_for_saml=0' \
  -F 'auditor=true'
```

`POST /api/v4/users`

Creates a user. Administrators only.

> Body parameter

```yaml
email: string
password: string
reset_password: true
skip_confirmation: true
force_random_password: true
name: string
username: string
linkedin: string
twitter: string
discord: string
website_url: string
github: string
organization: string
projects_limit: 0
extern_uid: string
provider: string
bio: string
location: string
pronouns: string
public_email: string
commit_email: string
admin: true
can_create_group: true
external: true
avatar: string
theme_id: 0
color_scheme_id: 0
private_profile: true
note: string
view_diffs_file_by_file: true
policy_advanced_editor: true
shared_runners_minutes_limit: 0
extra_shared_runners_minutes_limit: 0
group_id_for_saml: 0
auditor: true
```

<h3 id="create-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4UsersRequest](#schemapostapiv4usersrequest)|true|none|
|» email|body|string \| null|true|Email address to add to the user account.|
|» password|body|string \| null|false|The password of the new user. At least one of `password`, `reset_password`, `force_random_password` must be provided.|
|» reset_password|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating the user will be sent a password reset token. At least one of `password`, `reset_password`, `force_random_password` must be provided.|
|» skip_confirmation|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating the account is confirmed|
|» force_random_password|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating a random password will be set. At least one of `password`, `reset_password`, `force_random_password` must be provided.|
|» name|body|string \| null|true|The name of the user|
|» username|body|string \| null|true|The username of the user|
|» linkedin|body|string \| null|false|The LinkedIn username|
|» twitter|body|string \| null|false|The Twitter username|
|» discord|body|string \| null|false|The Discord user ID|
|» website_url|body|string \| null|false|The website of the user|
|» github|body|string \| null|false|The GitHub username|
|» organization|body|string \| null|false|The organization of the user. Empty string or nil clears the field.|
|» projects_limit|body|integer \| null|false|The number of projects a user can create|
|» extern_uid|body|string \| null|false|The external authentication provider UID. All or none of `extern_uid`, `provider` must be provided.|
|» provider|body|string \| null|false|Name of the external authentication provider. All or none of `extern_uid`, `provider` must be provided.|
|» bio|body|string \| null|false|The biography of the user|
|» location|body|string \| null|false|The location of the user|
|» pronouns|body|string \| null|false|The pronouns of the user|
|» public_email|body|string \| null|false|The public email of the user|
|» commit_email|body|string \| null|false|The commit email, _private for private commit email|
|» admin|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating the user is an administrator|
|» can_create_group|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating the user can create groups|
|» external|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating the user is an external user|
|» avatar|body|string(binary) \| null|false|Avatar image for user|
|» theme_id|body|integer \| null|false|The GitLab theme for the user|
|» color_scheme_id|body|integer \| null|false|The color scheme for the file viewer|
|» private_profile|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating the user has a private profile|
|» note|body|string \| null|false|Admin note for this user|
|» view_diffs_file_by_file|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the user sees only one file diff per page.|
|» policy_advanced_editor|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating that advanced editor is enabled|
|» shared_runners_minutes_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Compute minutes quota for this user|
|» extra_shared_runners_minutes_limit|body|integer \| null|false|(admin-only) Extra compute minutes quota for this user|
|» group_id_for_saml|body|integer \| null|false|ID for group where SAML has been configured|
|» auditor|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating auditor status of the user|

## Update a user

<a id="opIdputApiV4UsersId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/users/0 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'email=string' \
  -F 'password=string' \
  -F 'skip_reconfirmation=true' \
  -F 'name=string' \
  -F 'username=string' \
  -F 'linkedin=string' \
  -F 'twitter=string' \
  -F 'discord=string' \
  -F 'website_url=string' \
  -F 'github=string' \
  -F 'organization=string' \
  -F 'projects_limit=0' \
  -F 'extern_uid=string' \
  -F 'provider=string' \
  -F 'bio=string' \
  -F 'location=string' \
  -F 'pronouns=string' \
  -F 'public_email=string' \
  -F 'commit_email=string' \
  -F 'admin=true' \
  -F 'can_create_group=true' \
  -F 'external=true' \
  -F 'avatar=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'theme_id=0' \
  -F 'color_scheme_id=0' \
  -F 'private_profile=true' \
  -F 'note=string' \
  -F 'view_diffs_file_by_file=true' \
  -F 'policy_advanced_editor=true' \
  -F 'shared_runners_minutes_limit=0' \
  -F 'extra_shared_runners_minutes_limit=0' \
  -F 'group_id_for_saml=0' \
  -F 'auditor=true'
```

`PUT /api/v4/users/{id}`

Updates the details of a specified user.

> Body parameter

```yaml
email: string
password: string
skip_reconfirmation: true
name: string
username: string
linkedin: string
twitter: string
discord: string
website_url: string
github: string
organization: string
projects_limit: 0
extern_uid: string
provider: string
bio: string
location: string
pronouns: string
public_email: string
commit_email: string
admin: true
can_create_group: true
external: true
avatar: string
theme_id: 0
color_scheme_id: 0
private_profile: true
note: string
view_diffs_file_by_file: true
policy_advanced_editor: true
shared_runners_minutes_limit: 0
extra_shared_runners_minutes_limit: 0
group_id_for_saml: 0
auditor: true
```

<h3 id="update-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|ID of the user.|
|body|body|[putApiV4UsersIdRequest](#schemaputapiv4usersidrequest)|false|none|
|» email|body|string \| null|false|Email address to add to the user account.|
|» password|body|string \| null|false|The password of the new user|
|» skip_reconfirmation|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating the account skips the confirmation by email|
|» name|body|string \| null|false|The name of the user|
|» username|body|string \| null|false|The username of the user|
|» linkedin|body|string \| null|false|The LinkedIn username|
|» twitter|body|string \| null|false|The Twitter username|
|» discord|body|string \| null|false|The Discord user ID|
|» website_url|body|string \| null|false|The website of the user|
|» github|body|string \| null|false|The GitHub username|
|» organization|body|string \| null|false|The organization of the user. Empty string or nil clears the field.|
|» projects_limit|body|integer \| null|false|The number of projects a user can create|
|» extern_uid|body|string \| null|false|The external authentication provider UID. All or none of `extern_uid`, `provider` must be provided.|
|» provider|body|string \| null|false|Name of the external authentication provider. All or none of `extern_uid`, `provider` must be provided.|
|» bio|body|string \| null|false|The biography of the user|
|» location|body|string \| null|false|The location of the user|
|» pronouns|body|string \| null|false|The pronouns of the user|
|» public_email|body|string \| null|false|The public email of the user|
|» commit_email|body|string \| null|false|The commit email, _private for private commit email|
|» admin|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating the user is an administrator|
|» can_create_group|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating the user can create groups|
|» external|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating the user is an external user|
|» avatar|body|string(binary) \| null|false|Avatar image for user|
|» theme_id|body|integer \| null|false|The GitLab theme for the user|
|» color_scheme_id|body|integer \| null|false|The color scheme for the file viewer|
|» private_profile|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating the user has a private profile|
|» note|body|string \| null|false|Admin note for this user|
|» view_diffs_file_by_file|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the user sees only one file diff per page.|
|» policy_advanced_editor|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating that advanced editor is enabled|
|» shared_runners_minutes_limit|body|integer \| null|false|Compute minutes quota for this user|
|» extra_shared_runners_minutes_limit|body|integer \| null|false|(admin-only) Extra compute minutes quota for this user|
|» group_id_for_saml|body|integer \| null|false|ID for group where SAML has been configured|
|» auditor|body|boolean \| null|false|Flag indicating auditor status of the user|

## Add an email address for a user

<a id="opIdpostApiV4UsersIdEmails"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/users/0/emails \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "email": "string",
    "skip_confirmation": true
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/users/{id}/emails`

Adds an email address for a specified user account. Administrators only.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "email": "string",
  "skip_confirmation": true
}
```

<h3 id="add-an-email-address-for-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|ID of the user.|
|body|body|[postApiV4UsersIdEmailsRequest](#schemapostapiv4usersidemailsrequest)|true|none|
|» email|body|string \| null|true|Email address to add to the user account.|
|» skip_confirmation|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, skips email confirmation and assumes the email is verified.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "confirmed_at": "string"
}
```

<a id="opIdputApiV4UserPreferences"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/user/preferences \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \

  -d '{
    "view_diffs_file_by_file": true,

    "policy_advanced_editor": true,
    "emoji_skin_tone": "default"
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v4/user/preferences`

Updates your user preferences.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "view_diffs_file_by_file": true,
  "show_whitespace_in_diffs": true,
  "pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt": true,
  "policy_advanced_editor": true,
  "emoji_skin_tone": "default"
}
```

<h3 id="update-your-user-preferences-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[putApiV4UserPreferencesRequest](#schemaputapiv4userpreferencesrequest)|false|none|
|» view_diffs_file_by_file|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the user sees only one file diff per page. At least one of `view_diffs_file_by_file`, `show_whitespace_in_diffs`, `pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt`, `policy_advanced_editor`, `emoji_skin_tone` must be provided.|
|» show_whitespace_in_diffs|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the user sees whitespace changes in diffs. At least one of `view_diffs_file_by_file`, `show_whitespace_in_diffs`, `pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt`, `policy_advanced_editor`, `emoji_skin_tone` must be provided.|
|» pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, passes the user's external identities to CI jobs as part of a JSON web token. This attribute is internal to GitLab and must not be passed to third-party services. For more information, see [Token Payload](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/secrets/id_token_authentication/#token-payload). At least one of `view_diffs_file_by_file`, `show_whitespace_in_diffs`, `pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt`, `policy_advanced_editor`, `emoji_skin_tone` must be provided.|
|» policy_advanced_editor|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, enables the advanced editor. At least one of `view_diffs_file_by_file`, `show_whitespace_in_diffs`, `pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt`, `policy_advanced_editor`, `emoji_skin_tone` must be provided.|
|» emoji_skin_tone|body|string \| null|false|Default skin tone for emoji that have skin tone variants. One of `default`, `light`, `medium_light`, `medium`, `medium_dark`, or `dark`. At least one of `view_diffs_file_by_file`, `show_whitespace_in_diffs`, `pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt`, `policy_advanced_editor`, `emoji_skin_tone` must be provided.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» emoji_skin_tone|default|
|» emoji_skin_tone|light|
|» emoji_skin_tone|medium_light|
|» emoji_skin_tone|medium|
|» emoji_skin_tone|medium_dark|
|» emoji_skin_tone|dark|

> Example responses

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "user_id": "string",
  "view_diffs_file_by_file": "string",
  "show_whitespace_in_diffs": "string",
  "pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt": "string",
```

Create a new runner

```json
  "locked": false,
  "access_level": "not_protected",
  "run_untagged": true,
  "tag_list": [
    "string"
  ],

}
```

<h3 id="create-a-runner-owned-by-currently-authenticated-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[postApiV4UserRunnersRequest](#schemapostapiv4userrunnersrequest)|true|none|
|» runner_type|body|string|true|Scope of the runner.|
|» group_id|body|integer \| null|true|ID of the group to create the runner in. Required if `runner_type` is `group_type`.|
|» project_id|body|integer \| null|true|ID of the project to create the runner in. Required if `runner_type` is `project_type`.|
|» description|body|string \| null|false|Description of the runner.|
|» maintenance_note|body|string \| null|false|Free-form maintenance notes for the runner. Limited to 1024 characters.|
|» paused|body|boolean \| null|false|If `true`, the runner ignores new jobs.|
|» locked|body|boolean|false|Specifies if the runner should be locked for the current project.|
|» access_level|body|string \| null|false|Access level of the runner.|
|» run_untagged|body|boolean|false|Specifies if the runner should handle untagged jobs.|
|» tag_list|body|[string]|false|Comma-separated list of runner tags.|
|» maximum_timeout|body|integer \| null|false|Maximum time, in seconds, that runners can spend running a job.|
|» token_expires_at|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Expiration time for the runner authentication token in ISO 8601 format. Must be between 5 minutes and 21 days in the future and cannot exceed instance, group, or project-level limits. Only applies to the initial token. Rotated tokens use the computed expiry from settings. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|» token_rotation_deadline|body|string(date-time) \| null|false|Deadline after which token rotation requests are rejected. Requires `token_expires_at` and must be less than or equal to it. Setting both to the same value disables token rotation. Cleared on successful rotation. Premium and Ultimate only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» runner_type|instance_type|
|» runner_type|group_type|
|» runner_type|project_type|
|» access_level|not_protected|
|» access_level|ref_protected|

```json
}
```

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-vulnerabilities">Vulnerabilities</h1>

> [!warning]
> These endpoints are in the process of being deprecated and are considered unstable.
> The response payload may be subject to change or breakage across GitLab releases. Use the
> [GraphQL API](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/graphql/reference/queries/#vulnerabilities) instead.
> For more information, see [replace vulnerability REST API with GraphQL](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/vulnerabilities/#replace-vulnerability-rest-api-with-graphql).

Use this API to manage [vulnerabilities](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/application_security/vulnerabilities/),
retrieve vulnerability findings, and export [vulnerability reports](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/application_security/vulnerability_report/)
for a project, group, or instance.

Every call to these endpoints must be [authenticated](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/rest/authentication/).
If a user isn't a member of a private project, requests return a `404 Not Found` status code. If a
user does not have permission to [view the vulnerability report](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/permissions/#project-application-security),
requests return a `403 Forbidden` status code.

> [!note]
> The former Vulnerabilities API was renamed to the Vulnerability Findings API, and the
> Vulnerabilities name now serves [vulnerability objects](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/13561).
> To fix a broken integration with the former API, change the `vulnerabilities` URL part to
> `vulnerability_findings`.

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/vulnerabilities/">External documentation</a>

## Create a project-level vulnerability export

<a id="opIdpostApiV4SecurityProjectsIdVulnerabilityExports"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/security/projects/string/vulnerability_exports \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "export_format": "csv",
    "send_email": false,
    "report_data": {},
    "filters": {}
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/security/projects/{id}/vulnerability_exports`

Creates a vulnerability export for a project. Returns status code `403` if the authenticated user does not have permission to create a vulnerability.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "export_format": "csv",
  "send_email": false,
  "report_data": {},
  "filters": {}
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-project-level-vulnerability-export-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4SecurityProjectsIdVulnerabilityExportsRequest](#schemapostapiv4securityprojectsidvulnerabilityexportsrequest)|false|none|
|» export_format|body|string|false|Format of the generated report|
|» send_email|body|boolean|false|If `true`, sends an email notification to the requesting user when the export completes.|
|» report_data|body|object|false|Hash of report components mapped to frontend data assets to use in the export, for example `{ project_vulnerabilities_history: '<svg>some report asset</svg>' }`. Unsupported keys are discarded, and mismatched components are ignored with an error logged.|
|» » project_vulnerabilities_history|body|object \| null|false|Data for rendering the project vulnerabilities history in PDF reports. Must include an SVG asset.|
|» » group_vulnerabilities_over_time|body|object \| null|false|Data for rendering the group vulnerabilities over time in PDF reports. Must include an SVG asset.|
|» » project_security_status|body|object \| null|false|Data for rendering the project grades summary in PDF reports.|
|» » total_risk_score|body|object \| null|false|Data for rendering the total risk score in PDF reports.|
|» » open_vulnerabilities_over_time|body|object \| null|false|Data for rendering the open vulnerabilities over time in PDF reports.|
|» » vulnerabilities_by_age|body|object \| null|false|Data for rendering the vulnerabilities by age in PDF reports.|
|» » vulnerabilities_by_severity_count|body|object \| null|false|Data for rendering the vulnerabilities by severity count in PDF reports.|
|» » » critical|body|object \| null|false|Count, median age, and color for critical severity vulnerabilities|
|» » » » count|body|integer \| null|false|Number of vulnerabilities|
|» » » » medianAge|body|number \| null|false|Median age in days|
|» » » » color|body|string \| null|false|Severity color hex code|
|» » » high|body|object \| null|false|Count, median age, and color for high severity vulnerabilities|
|» » » » count|body|integer \| null|false|Number of vulnerabilities|
|» » » » medianAge|body|number \| null|false|Median age in days|
|» » » » color|body|string \| null|false|Severity color hex code|
|» » » medium|body|object \| null|false|Count, median age, and color for medium severity vulnerabilities|
|» » » » count|body|integer \| null|false|Number of vulnerabilities|
|» » » » medianAge|body|number \| null|false|Median age in days|
|» » » » color|body|string \| null|false|Severity color hex code|
|» » » low|body|object \| null|false|Count, median age, and color for low severity vulnerabilities|
|» » » » count|body|integer \| null|false|Number of vulnerabilities|
|» » » » medianAge|body|number \| null|false|Median age in days|
|» » » » color|body|string \| null|false|Severity color hex code|
|» » » unknown|body|object \| null|false|Count, median age, and color for unknown severity vulnerabilities|
|» » » » count|body|integer \| null|false|Number of vulnerabilities|
|» » » » medianAge|body|number \| null|false|Median age in days|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|body|body|[postApiV4VulnerabilitiesIdIssueLinksRequest](#schemapostapiv4vulnerabilitiesidissuelinksrequest)|true|none|
|» target_issue_iid|body|integer \| null|true|Internal ID of the issue to relate to the vulnerability.|
|» target_project_id|body|string \| null|false|The ID of the target project|
|» link_type|body|string|false|Link type|

## Delete a link between an issue and a vulnerability

<a id="opIddeleteApiV4VulnerabilitiesIdIssueLinksIssueLinkId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/vulnerabilities/0/issue_links/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/v4/vulnerabilities/{id}/issue_links/{issue_link_id}`

Deletes a link between an issue and a vulnerability.

<h3 id="delete-a-link-between-an-issue-and-a-vulnerability-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|ID of the vulnerability.|
|issue_link_id|path|integer|true|ID of the vulnerability-issue link.|

## List all project vulnerability findings

<a id="opIdgetApiV4ProjectsIdVulnerabilityFindings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/projects/string/vulnerability_findings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/vulnerability_findings`

Lists all vulnerability findings for a specified project. Responses are paginated and return 20 results by default.

<h3 id="list-all-project-vulnerability-findings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the project.|
|report_type|query|[string]|false|Return vulnerability findings belonging to the specified report type, such as `sast`, `dast`, `dependency_scanning`, or `container_scanning`.|
|scope|query|string|false|Return vulnerability findings for the given scope.|
|severity|query|[string]|false|Return vulnerability findings belonging to the specified severity level: `info`, `unknown`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, or `critical`.|
|pipeline_id|query|string \| null|false|Filter vulnerability findings by pipeline.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page number of results to retrieve.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Number of items to list per page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|report_type|sast|
|report_type|dependency_scanning|
|report_type|container_scanning|
|report_type|dast|
|report_type|secret_detection|
|report_type|coverage_fuzzing|
|report_type|api_fuzzing|
|report_type|cluster_image_scanning|
|report_type|container_scanning_for_registry|
|report_type|sarif|
|report_type|generic|
|scope|all|
|scope|dismissed|
|severity|info|
|severity|unknown|
|severity|low|
|severity|medium|
|severity|high|
|severity|critical|

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-web-commits">Web commits</h1>

Use this API to retrieve the public key that GitLab uses to sign the commits created with the
[web editor](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/repository/web_editor/).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/web_commits/">External documentation</a>

## Retrieve the public signing key

<a id="opIdgetApiV4WebCommitsPublicKey"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/web_commits/public_key \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/web_commits/public_key`

Retrieves the GitLab public key for signing web commits. This feature was introduced in GitLab 17.4.

<h3 id="retrieve-the-public-signing-key-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|404|Not Found|Public key not found.|None|
|503|Service Unavailable|The git server, Gitaly, is not available at this time. Please contact your administrator.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-wikis">Wikis</h1>

Use this API to manage [group wikis](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/wiki/group/).
An API for [project wikis](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/wikis/) is also available.

Comments on a wiki page are called `notes`. To interact with them, use the [notes API](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/notes/#group-wikis).

<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_wikis/">External documentation</a>

## List all wiki pages for a group

<a id="opIdgetApiV4GroupsIdWikis"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/wikis \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/groups/{id}/wikis`

Lists all wiki pages for a specified group.

<h3 id="list-all-wiki-pages-for-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group or project.|
|with_content|query|boolean|false|If `true`, includes the content of each wiki page.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "format": "markdown",
    "slug": "deploy",
    "title": "deploy",
    "wiki_page_meta_id": 123
  }
]
```

<h3 id="list-all-wiki-pages-for-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|

<h3 id="list-all-wiki-pages-for-a-group-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[APIEntitiesWikiPageBasic](#schemaapientitieswikipagebasic)]|false|none|none|

## Create a wiki page for a group

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdWikis"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/wikis \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "title": "string",
    "front_matter": {
      "title": "string"
    },
    "content": "string",
    "format": "markdown"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v4/groups/{id}/wikis`

Creates a wiki page for a specified group. Requests can define the title, slug, and content.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "title": "string",
  "front_matter": {
    "title": "string"
  },
  "content": "string",
  "format": "markdown"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-wiki-page-for-a-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string \| integer|true|ID or URL-encoded path of the group or project.|
|body|body|[postApiV4GroupsIdWikisRequest](#schemapostapiv4groupsidwikisrequest)|true|none|
|» title|body|string \| null|true|Title of the wiki page.|
|» front_matter|body|object \| null|false|YAML front matter of the wiki page.|
|» » title|body|string \| null|false|Title in the front matter of the wiki page.|
|» content|body|string \| null|true|Content of the wiki page.|
|» format|body|string|false|Format of the wiki page.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» format|markdown|
|» format|rdoc|
|» format|asciidoc|
|» format|org|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "format": "markdown",
  "slug": "deploy",
  "title": "deploy",
  "wiki_page_meta_id": 123,
  "content": "Here is an instruction how to deploy this project.",
  "encoding": "UTF-8",
  "front_matter": {
    "title": "deploy"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-wiki-page-for-a-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Created|[APIEntitiesWikiPage](#schemaapientitieswikipage)|
|400|Bad Request|Validation error|None|
|404|Not Found|Not found|None|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Unprocessable entity|None|

## Upload an attachment to a group wiki

<a id="opIdpostApiV4GroupsIdWikisAttachments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/groups/string/wikis/attachments \
```

> 201 Response

```json

  "link": {
    "url": "uploads/6a061c4cf9f1c28cb22c384b4b8d4e3c/dk.png",
```

```json
  "file_path": "uploads/6a061c4cf9f1c28cb22c384b4b8d4e3c/dk.png",
```

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-workspaces">Workspaces</h1>

Use this API to retrieve agent information and authorize user access for the agent that runs
[workspaces](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/workspace/).

These endpoints are internal and used by GitLab components.

## Gets agentw info

<a id="opIdgetApiV4InternalAgentsAgentwAgentInfo"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/internal/agents/agentw/agent_info \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/internal/agents/agentw/agent_info`

Retrieves agent info for agentw for the given workspace token

<h3 id="gets-agentw-info-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Agentw info retrieved successfully|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

## authorize_user_access

<a id="opIdgetApiV4InternalAgentsAgentwAuthorizeUserAccess"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/internal/agents/agentw/authorize_user_access?workspace_host=string&user_id=0' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/internal/agents/agentw/authorize_user_access`

Returns whether the user is authorized to access the workspace.

<h3 id="authorizeuseraccess-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|workspace_host|query|string \| null|true|Host of the workspace being accessed.|
|user_id|query|integer \| null|true|ID of the user accessing the workspace.|

<h3 id="authorizeuseraccess-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|User access authorization info retrieved successfully|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

<h1 id="gitlab-rest-api-default">Default</h1>

## List Gitaly object pool members

<a id="opIdgetApiV4InternalGitalyObjectPoolMembers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4/api/v4/internal/gitaly/object_pool_members?disk_paths=string&storage=string' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/v4/internal/gitaly/object_pool_members`

<h3 id="list-gitaly-object-pool-members-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|disk_paths|query|[string]|true|On-disk paths of the pool repositories. Limited to 500.|
|storage|query|string \| null|true|Name of the storage shard.|
|upstream_only|query|boolean|false|If `true`, returns only the upstream repository.|

<h3 id="list-gitaly-object-pool-members-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
http, oauth2, apiKey
</aside>

|selective_code_owner_removals|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, resets approvals from Code Owners if their files change. To use this field, `reset_approvals_on_push` must be `false`. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|

At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|
|merge_requests_disable_committers_approval|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, users who commit on the merge request cannot approve it. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|

At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|

At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.|

|apply_security_scan_profiles|boolean|false|none|Apply security scan profiles.|
|admin_merge_request|boolean|false|none|Allows approval of merge requests.|

|delete_security_scan_profiles|boolean|false|none|Delete security scan profiles.|

|admin_ai_catalog_item|boolean|false|none|Create, edit, and delete custom agents and flows in the AI catalog.|
|admin_compliance_framework|boolean|false|none|Create, read, update, and delete compliance frameworks. Users with this permission can also assign a compliance framework label to a project, and set the default framework of a group.|
|admin_cicd_variables|boolean|false|none|Create, read, update, and delete CI/CD variables.|
|manage_deploy_tokens|boolean|false|none|Manage deploy tokens at the group or project level.|
|manage_group_access_tokens|boolean|false|none|Create, read, update, and delete group access tokens. When creating a token, users with this custom permission must select a role for that token that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for the custom role.|
|admin_group_member|boolean|false|none|Add or remove users in a group, and assign roles to users. When assigning a role, users with this custom permission must select a role that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for their custom role.|
|admin_integrations|boolean|false|none|Create, read, update, and delete integrations with external applications.|
|manage_merge_request_settings|boolean|false|none|Configure merge request settings at the group or project level. Group actions include managing merge checks and approval settings. Project actions include managing MR configurations, approval rules and settings, and branch targets. In order to enable Suggested reviewers, the "Manage project access tokens" custom permission needs to be enabled.|
|manage_project_access_tokens|boolean|false|none|Create, read, update, and delete project access tokens. When creating a token, users with this custom permission must select a role for that token that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for the custom role.|
|admin_protected_branch|boolean|false|none|Create, read, update, and delete protected branches for a project.|
|admin_protected_environments|boolean|false|none|Create, read, update, and delete protected environments|
|admin_push_rules|boolean|false|none|Configure push rules for repositories at the group or project level.|
|admin_runners|boolean|false|none|Create, view, edit, and delete group or project Runners. Includes configuring Runner settings.|
|admin_security_attributes|boolean|false|none|Manage the security categories and attributes. Also requires the `read_security_attribute` permission.|
|admin_terraform_state|boolean|false|none|Execute terraform commands, lock/unlock terraform state files, and remove file versions.|
|admin_vulnerability|boolean|false|none|Edit the status, linked issue, and severity of a vulnerability object. Also requires the `read_vulnerability` permission.|
|admin_web_hook|boolean|false|none|Manage webhooks|
|read_agent_artifacts|boolean|false|none|Read GitLab Duo Agent Platform artifacts, including audit events and session metadata, that are exposed through the agent artifacts dashboard.|
|read_compliance_dashboard|boolean|false|none|Read compliance capabilities including adherence, violations, and frameworks for groups and projects.|
|read_security_scan_profiles|boolean|false|none|Read security scan profiles.|
|read_virtual_registry|boolean|false|none|Allows read access to virtual registries at the group level. Enables users to resolve packages through the virtual registry without requiring broader group membership permissions. Only works on top level groups.|
|update_sec_ai_workflow_settings|boolean|false|none|Update security AI workflow settings such as SAST Vulnerability Resolution. Also requires the `read_vulnerability` permission.|
|update_security_scan_profiles|boolean|false|none|Update security scan profiles.|
|read_admin_cicd|boolean|false|none|Read CI/CD details for runners and jobs in the Admin Area.|
|read_crm_contact|boolean|false|none|Read CRM contact.|
|read_dependency|boolean|false|none|Allows read-only access to the dependencies and licenses.|
|read_admin_groups|boolean|false|none|Read group details in the Admin Area.|
|read_admin_projects|boolean|false|none|Read project details in the Admin Area.|
|read_code|boolean|false|none|Allows read-only access to the source code in the user interface. Does not allow users to edit or download repository archives, clone or pull repositories, view source code in an IDE, or view merge requests for private projects. You can download individual files because read-only access inherently grants the ability to make a local copy of the file.|
|read_runners|boolean|false|none|Allows read-only access to group or project runners, including the runner fleet dashboard.|
|read_security_attribute|boolean|false|none|Allows read-only access to the security categories and attributes.|
|read_admin_subscription|boolean|false|none|Read subscription details in the Admin area.|
|read_admin_monitoring|boolean|false|none|Read system information such as background migrations, health checks, and Gitaly in the Admin Area.|
|read_admin_users|boolean|false|none|Read the user list and user details in the Admin area.|
|read_vulnerability|boolean|false|none|Read vulnerability reports and security dashboards.|

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "url": "string",
  "auth_user": "string",
  "auth_password": "string",
  "mirror_trigger_builds": true,

}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, enables pull mirroring on the project. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|url|string \| null|false|none|URL of the remote repository being mirrored. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|auth_user|string \| null|false|none|Username used to authenticate a project pull mirror. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|auth_password|string \| null|false|none|Password used to authenticate a project pull mirror, or a personal access token with the `api` scope enabled. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|mirror_trigger_builds|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, triggers pipelines for mirror updates. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|only_mirror_protected_branches|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, limits mirroring to only protected branches. Mutually exclusive with `mirror_branch_regex`. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, overwrites diverged branches. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|
|mirror_branch_regex|string \| null|false|none|Regular expression for branch names to mirror. Only branches with names matching the regex are mirrored. Requires `only_mirror_protected_branches` to be disabled. Mutually exclusive with `only_mirror_protected_branches`. At least one of `enabled`, `url`, `auth_user`, `auth_password`, `mirror_overwrites_diverged_branches`, `mirror_trigger_builds`, `only_mirror_protected_branches`, `mirror_branch_regex` must be provided.|

```json
{
```

```json
  "files_max_capacity": 10,
  "repos_max_capacity": 10,

  "container_repositories_max_capacity": 2,
  "sync_object_storage": false,
  "selective_sync_type": "string",
  "selective_sync_shards": [
    "string"
  ],
  "selective_sync_namespace_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "selective_sync_organization_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "minimum_reverification_interval": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_report_threshold": 0,
  "checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes": 0,
  "blob_download_timeout": 28800
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|primary|boolean|false|none|If `true`, the site is the primary Geo site.|
|enabled|boolean|false|none|If `true`, the Geo site is enabled.|
|name|string \| null|true|none|Unique identifier for the Geo site. Must match `geo_node_name` if it is set in `gitlab.rb`, otherwise it must match `external_url`.|
|url|string \| null|true|none|User-facing URL of the Geo site.|
|internal_url|string \| null|false|none|URL defined on the primary site that secondary sites use to contact it. Returns `url` if not set.|
|files_max_capacity|integer|false|none|Maximum concurrency of LFS and attachment backfill for the secondary site.|
|repos_max_capacity|integer|false|none|Maximum concurrency of repository backfill for the secondary site.|
|verification_max_capacity|integer|false|none|Maximum concurrency of verification for the site.|
|container_repositories_max_capacity|integer|false|none|Maximum concurrency of container repository sync for the site.|
|sync_object_storage|boolean|false|none|If `true`, the secondary Geo site replicates blobs in object storage.|
|selective_sync_type|string \| null|false|none|Limit syncing to only specific groups, or shards. Valid values: `"namespaces"`, `"shards"`, or `null`|
|selective_sync_shards|[string]|false|none|Repository storages to sync projects from if `selective_sync_type` is `shards`.|
|selective_sync_namespace_ids|[integer]|false|none|IDs of groups to sync if `selective_sync_type` is `namespaces`.|
|selective_sync_organization_ids|[integer]|false|none|IDs of organizations to sync if `selective_sync_type` is `organizations`.|
|minimum_reverification_interval|integer \| null|false|none|Interval, in days, after which verification expires and is repeated. Has no effect when set on a secondary site.|
|checksum_mismatch_report_threshold|integer \| null|false|none|Number of consecutive checksum mismatches on a secondary site before it reports the resource to the primary for self-heal re-verification. Read from the secondary site, and has no effect when set on the primary.|
|checksum_mismatch_self_heal_cooldown_minutes|integer \| null|false|none|Minimum time, in minutes, between self-heal re-verification triggers for the same resource. The primary and each secondary site use their own value. Secondary sites use it to throttle re-reporting the same resource, and the primary uses it to throttle re-verifying an already-verified resource.|
|blob_download_timeout|integer|false|none|Maximum time (in seconds) for blob downloads during Geo sync.|

|checksum_mismatch_report_threshold|integer \| null|false|none|Number of consecutive checksum mismatches on a secondary node before it reports the resource to the primary for self-heal re-verification. Read from the secondary node, and has no effect when set on the primary.|

|pre_receive_secret_detection_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, enables secret push protection for the project. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/514413) in GitLab 17.9. Use `secret_push_protection_enabled` instead. At least one of `secret_push_protection_enabled`, `pre_receive_secret_detection_enabled`, `fast_dependency_paths_enabled` must be provided.|
|fast_dependency_paths_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, enables fast mode for dependency path graph builds, recording one path per dependency instead of all possible paths to reduce memory and processing time for large dependency graphs. Requires the `dependency_paths` feature flag to be enabled. At least one of `secret_push_protection_enabled`, `pre_receive_secret_detection_enabled`, `fast_dependency_paths_enabled` must be provided.|

|pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, passes the user's external identities to CI jobs as part of a JSON web token. This attribute is internal to GitLab and must not be passed to third-party services. For more information, see [Token Payload](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/secrets/id_token_authentication/#token-payload). At least one of `view_diffs_file_by_file`, `show_whitespace_in_diffs`, `pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt`, `policy_advanced_editor`, `emoji_skin_tone` must be provided.|
|policy_advanced_editor|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, enables the advanced editor. At least one of `view_diffs_file_by_file`, `show_whitespace_in_diffs`, `pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt`, `policy_advanced_editor`, `emoji_skin_tone` must be provided.|
|emoji_skin_tone|string \| null|false|none|Default skin tone for emoji that have skin tone variants. One of `default`, `light`, `medium_light`, `medium`, `medium_dark`, or `dark`. At least one of `view_diffs_file_by_file`, `show_whitespace_in_diffs`, `pass_user_identities_to_ci_jwt`, `policy_advanced_editor`, `emoji_skin_tone` must be provided.|

|name|string \| null|true|none|Name of the application.|
|redirect_uri|string \| null|true|none|Redirect URI of the application.|
|scopes|string \| null|true|none|Scopes available to the application. Separate multiple scopes with a space.|
|confidential|boolean|false|none|If `true`, the application can securely store client credentials, such as the client secret. Non-confidential applications (such as native mobile apps and Single Page Apps) might expose client credentials.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|admin_mode|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, requires administrators to re-authenticate before performing potentially dangerous administrative operations.|
|admin_notification_email|string \| null|false|none|If set, [abuse reports](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/review_abuse_reports/) are sent to this address. Abuse reports are always available in the **Admin** area. Deprecated. Use `abuse_notification_email` instead.|
|abuse_notification_email|string \| null|false|none|If set, [abuse reports](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/review_abuse_reports/) are sent to this address. Abuse reports are always available in the **Admin** area.|
|after_sign_up_text|string \| null|false|none|Text shown after sign up.|
|after_sign_out_path|string \| null|false|none|Users are redirected to this page after they sign out.|
|akismet_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, helps prevent bots from creating issues. Requires `akismet_api_key`.|
|akismet_api_key|string \| null|false|none|Generate API key at http://www.akismet.com|
|asset_proxy_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable proxying of assets|
|asset_proxy_url|string \| null|false|none|URL of the asset proxy server|
|asset_proxy_secret_key|string \| null|false|none|Shared secret with the asset proxy server|
|asset_proxy_whitelist|[string]|false|none|Assets that match these domains are not proxied. Wildcards allowed. Your GitLab installation URL is automatically allowlisted. GitLab restart is required to apply changes. Deprecated. Use `asset_proxy_allowlist` instead.|
|asset_proxy_allowlist|[string]|false|none|Assets that match these domains are not proxied. Wildcards allowed. Your GitLab installation URL is automatically allowlisted. GitLab restart is required to apply changes.|
|authn_data_retention_cleanup_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, runs cleanup workers that permanently delete authentication login history older than one year, and previously revoked OAuth access tokens and grants older than one month. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/579002) in GitLab 18.7.|
|container_registry_token_expire_delay|integer \| null|false|none|Duration, in minutes, that container registry authorization tokens remain valid.|
|oauth_access_token_expires_in|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum lifetime in seconds of all new OAuth access tokens issued by the instance. Minimum value: `300` (5 minutes). Default value: `7200` (2 hours). If blank or `null`, uses default value. Does not affect existing OAuth access tokens.|
|decompress_archive_file_timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Timeout for decompressing archived files, in seconds. Set to `0` to disable the timeout.|
|default_artifacts_expire_in|string \| null|false|none|Set the default expiration time for each job's artifacts.|
|default_ci_config_path|string \| null|false|none|Default CI/CD configuration file and path for new projects. If empty, new projects use `.gitlab-ci.yml`.|
|default_project_creation|integer \| null|false|none|Default minimum role required to create projects. Can take: `0` _(No one)_, `1` _(Maintainers)_, `2` _(Developers)_, `3` _(Administrators)_, or `4` _(Owners)_.|
|default_remove_source_branch_after_merge|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable the delete source branch option by default for new projects|
|default_branch_protection|integer \| null|false|none|Level of protection for the default branch. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/408314) in GitLab 17.0. Use `default_branch_protection_defaults` instead.|
|default_branch_protection_defaults|object \| null|false|none|Default branch protection settings. For available options, see [Options for `default_branch_protection_defaults`](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/groups/#options-for-default_branch_protection_defaults). [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/408314) in GitLab 17.0.|
|default_group_visibility|string \| null|false|none|What visibility level new groups receive. Default is `private`. Cannot be set to any levels in `restricted_visibility_levels`.|
|default_project_visibility|string \| null|false|none|What visibility level new projects receive. Default is `private`. Cannot be set to any levels in `restricted_visibility_levels`.|
|default_projects_limit|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum number of personal projects per user. Default is `100000`.|
|default_snippet_visibility|string \| null|false|none|What visibility level new snippets receive. Default is `private`.|
|dependency_management_settings|object \| null|false|none|Dependency management settings. Set `security_update_scheduler_max_concurrency` (integer) to cap the number of security update scheduler jobs that run concurrently across the Sidekiq fleet. Default: `30`. Capped at `200`. Set to `0` to remove the concurrency limit. Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/239173) in GitLab 19.1.|
|disable_admin_oauth_scopes|boolean \| null|false|none|Stop administrators from connecting to non-trusted OAuth applications.|
|disable_feed_token|boolean \| null|false|none|Disable display of RSS/Atom and Calendar `feed_tokens`|
|disabled_oauth_sign_in_sources|[string]|false|none|OAuth sign-in sources to disable.|
|domain_denylist_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, enables the domain denylist for sign-ups. Requires `domain_denylist`.|
|domain_denylist|[string]|false|none|Users with e-mail addresses that match these domain(s) will NOT be able to sign-up. Wildcards allowed. Enter multiple entries on separate lines. Ex: domain.com, *.domain.com|
|domain_allowlist|[string]|false|none|Only users with email addresses that match these domains can sign up. Wildcards allowed. For example, `domain.com` or `*.domain.com`. If empty, all domains are allowed.|
|outbound_local_requests_whitelist|[string]|false|none|List of trusted domains or IP addresses to which local requests are allowed when local requests for webhooks and integrations are disabled.|
|email_otp_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, enables email-based one-time passwords (OTP) as a multi-factor authentication method. Requires `require_email_verification_on_account_locked` to be `true`.|
|iframe_rendering_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, allows rendering of iframes in Markdown.|
|iframe_rendering_allowlist|[string]|false|none|IDs of embed providers users can embed content from. Enter multiple entries separated by commas or on separate lines.|
|iframe_rendering_allowlist_raw|string \| null|false|none|Raw newline- or comma-separated list of IDs of embed providers users can embed content from.|
|eks_integration_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable integration with Amazon EKS|
|eks_account_id|string \| null|false|none|Amazon account ID for EKS integration.|
|eks_access_key_id|string \| null|false|none|Access key ID for the EKS integration IAM user.|
|eks_secret_access_key|string \| null|false|none|Secret access key for the EKS integration IAM user.|
|email_author_in_body|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, includes the name of the issue, merge request, or comment author in the email body. Useful when email servers do not support overriding the sender name.|
|email_confirmation_setting|string \| null|false|none|Specifies whether users must confirm their email address before signing in. `off` does not require confirmation, `soft` allows sign-in during a confirmation period, and `hard` requires confirmation before sign-in.|
|enabled_git_access_protocol|string \| null|false|none|Protocol allowed for Git access. Set to `all` to allow both SSH and HTTP(S).|
|gitpod_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, enables [Ona integration](https://docs.gitlab.com/integration/gitpod/). Requires `gitpod_url`.|
|gitpod_url|string \| null|false|none|Ona instance URL for the integration.|
|gitaly_timeout_default|integer \| null|false|none|Default Gitaly timeout, in seconds. Set to `0` to disable timeouts.|
|gitaly_timeout_fast|integer \| null|false|none|Gitaly fast operation timeout, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable timeouts.|
|gitaly_timeout_medium|integer \| null|false|none|Medium Gitaly timeout, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable timeouts.|
|grafana_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, enables Grafana.|
|grafana_url|string \| null|false|none|Grafana URL.|

|home_page_url|string \| null|false|none|Users who are not signed in are redirected to this page.|

All or none of `housekeeping_full_repack_period`, `housekeeping_gc_period`, `housekeeping_incremental_repack_period` must be provided.|

All or none of `housekeeping_full_repack_period`, `housekeeping_gc_period`, `housekeeping_incremental_repack_period` must be provided.|
|housekeeping_incremental_repack_period|integer \| null|false|none|Number of Git pushes after which an incremental `git repack` is run. Deprecated. All or none of `housekeeping_full_repack_period`, `housekeeping_gc_period`, `housekeeping_incremental_repack_period` must be provided.|
|housekeeping_optimize_repository_period|integer \| null|false|none|Number of Git pushes after which Gitaly is asked to optimize a repository. Exactly one of `housekeeping_incremental_repack_period`, `housekeeping_optimize_repository_period` must be provided.|
|html_emails_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, sends emails in both HTML and plain text formats. If `false`, sends emails in plain text only. Defaults to `true`.|

|invisible_captcha_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, enables Invisible CAPTCHA spam detection during account creation.|

|group_audit_events_api_limit|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum number of requests per minute per user per group to the group audit events API.|
|group_owners_can_manage_default_branch_protection|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, allows group owners to manage default branch protection in their groups. If `false`, group owners cannot override the instance default branch protection. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.|
|maintenance_mode|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, puts the instance into maintenance mode. Non-administrator users can sign in with read-only access and make read-only API requests. Premium and Ultimate only.|

|lock_duo_custom_flows_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, enforces the custom flows enabled setting for all groups. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/594615) in GitLab 19.0.|

|lock_duo_external_agents_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, enforces the external agents enabled setting for all groups. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/594615) in GitLab 19.0.|

```json
{
  "runner_type": "instance_type",
  "group_id": 1,
  "project_id": 1,
  "description": "string",
  "maintenance_note": "string",
  "paused": true,
  "locked": false,
  "access_level": "not_protected",
  "run_untagged": true,
  "tag_list": [
    "string"
  ],
  "maximum_timeout": 0,
  "token_expires_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "token_rotation_deadline": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|runner_type|string|true|none|Scope of the runner.|
|group_id|integer \| null|true|none|ID of the group to create the runner in. Required if `runner_type` is `group_type`.|
|project_id|integer \| null|true|none|ID of the project to create the runner in. Required if `runner_type` is `project_type`.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|Description of the runner.|
|maintenance_note|string \| null|false|none|Free-form maintenance notes for the runner. Limited to 1024 characters.|
|paused|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the runner ignores new jobs.|
|locked|boolean|false|none|Specifies if the runner should be locked for the current project.|
|access_level|string \| null|false|none|Access level of the runner.|
|run_untagged|boolean|false|none|Specifies if the runner should handle untagged jobs.|
|tag_list|[string]|false|none|Comma-separated list of runner tags.|
|maximum_timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum time, in seconds, that runners can spend running a job.|
|token_expires_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Expiration time for the runner authentication token in ISO 8601 format. Must be between 5 minutes and 21 days in the future and cannot exceed instance, group, or project-level limits. Only applies to the initial token. Rotated tokens use the computed expiry from settings. Premium and Ultimate only.|
|token_rotation_deadline|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Deadline after which token rotation requests are rejected. Requires `token_expires_at` and must be less than or equal to it. Setting both to the same value disables token rotation. Cleared on successful rotation. Premium and Ultimate only.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|runner_type|instance_type|
|runner_type|group_type|
|runner_type|project_type|
|access_level|not_protected|
|access_level|ref_protected|

<h2 id="tocS_postApiV4HooksRequest">postApiV4HooksRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostapiv4hooksrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_postApiV4HooksRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSpostapiv4hooksrequest"></a>
<a id="tocspostapiv4hooksrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "url": "http://example.com/hook",
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "token": "string",
  "signing_token": "string",
  "push_events": true,
  "tag_push_events": true,
  "merge_requests_events": true,
  "repository_update_events": true,
  "enable_ssl_verification": true,
  "push_events_branch_filter": "string",
  "branch_filter_strategy": "wildcard",
  "custom_webhook_template": "string",
  "url_variables": [
    {
      "key": "token",
      "value": "123"
    }
  ],
  "custom_headers": [
    {
      "key": "X-Custom-Header",
      "value": "value"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string \| null|true|none|Webhook URL.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|Name of the hook. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/460887) in GitLab 17.1.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|Description of the hook. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/460887) in GitLab 17.1.|
|token|string \| null|false|none|Secret token used to validate received payloads. Not returned in the response, and changing the hook URL resets it.|
|signing_token|string \| null|false|none|HMAC signing token used to compute the `webhook-signature` header. Must be in `whsec_<base64>` format encoding a 32-byte key, and is not returned in the response. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/231325) in GitLab 19.0.|
|push_events|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, triggers the system hook on push events.|
|tag_push_events|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, triggers the system hook on tag push events.|
|merge_requests_events|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, triggers the system hook on merge request events.|
|repository_update_events|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, triggers the system hook on repository update events.|
|enable_ssl_verification|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, verifies the SSL certificate when the hook is triggered.|
|push_events_branch_filter|string \| null|false|none|Filter push events by branch name.|
|branch_filter_strategy|string \| null|false|none|Filter push events by branch. Defaults to `wildcard`.|
|custom_webhook_template|string \| null|false|none|Custom template for the system hook request payload.|
|url_variables|[object]|false|none|URL variables for interpolation.|
|custom_headers|[object]|false|none|Custom headers for the hook.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|branch_filter_strategy|wildcard|
|branch_filter_strategy|regex|
|branch_filter_strategy|all_branches|

<a id="tocSpostapiv4projectsidrepositorychangelogrequest"></a>
<a id="tocspostapiv4projectsidrepositorychangelogrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "from": "ed899a2f4b50b4370feeea94676502b42383c746",
  "to": "6104942438c14ec7bd21c6cd5bd995272b3faff6",
  "date": "2021-09-20T11:50:22.001+00:00",
  "trailer": "Changelog",
  "config_file": ".gitlab/changelog_config.yml",
  "config_file_ref": "main",
  "branch": "main",
  "file": "CHANGELOG.md",
  "message": "Initial commit"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|string \| null|false|none|First commit in the range of commits, as a SHA, to use for the changelog. This commit is not included in the changelog. If omitted, the most recent stable version tag before `version` is used.|
|to|string \| null|false|none|Last commit in the range of commits, as a SHA, to use for the changelog. This commit is included in the changelog. If omitted, uses the latest commit on the default branch. For the Add changelog data to file operation, uses the latest commit on `branch` instead. The range can contain at most 15,000 commits.|
|date|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Date and time of the release. Defaults to the current time.|
|trailer|string|false|none|Git trailer to use for including commits. Case-sensitive: `Example` does not match `example` or `eXaMpLE`.|
|config_file|string \| null|false|none|Path to the changelog configuration file in the project's Git repository. If omitted, uses `.gitlab/changelog_config.yml`.|
|config_file_ref|string \| null|false|none|Git reference, for example a branch, where the changelog configuration file is defined. Defaults to the default branch of the repository.|
|branch|string \| null|false|none|Name of the branch to commit the changelog changes to. If omitted, defaults to the project's default branch.|
|file|string|false|none|File to commit the changes to.|
|message|string \| null|false|none|Commit message to use when committing the changelog changes. If omitted, defaults to `Add changelog for version X`, where `X` is the value of the `version` parameter.|

|s3_compatible_configuration|object \| null|false|none|MinIO or other S3-compatible object storage configuration. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|gcs_configuration|object \| null|false|none|Google Cloud Storage configuration using a service account JSON key. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|gcs_hmac_configuration|object \| null|false|none|Google Cloud Storage configuration using S3-interoperability HMAC keys. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|gcs_adc_configuration|object \| null|false|none|Google Cloud Storage configuration using Application Default Credentials. Available on GitLab Self-Managed or GitLab Dedicated, and must be enabled by an administrator. Only administrators can use these credentials, and the bucket name must start with "gitlab-offline-transfer-". For more information, see https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/settings/import_and_export_settings/#allow-application-default-credentials-for-offline-transfer. Exactly one of `aws_s3_configuration`, `s3_compatible_configuration`, `gcs_configuration`, `gcs_hmac_configuration`, `gcs_adc_configuration` must be provided.|
|entities|[object]|true|none|List of entities to export.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string \| null|true|none|The URL to the Jira project which is being linked to this GitLab project (for example, `https://jira.example.com`).|
|api_url|string \| null|false|none|The base URL to the Jira instance API. Web URL value is used if not set (for example, `https://jira-api.example.com`).|
|jira_auth_type|integer \| null|false|none|The authentication method to use with Jira. Use `0` for basic authentication, `1` for Jira personal access token, and `2` for Jira Cloud service accounts. Defaults to `0`.|
|username|string \| null|false|none|The email or username to use with Jira. Use an email for Jira Cloud, and a username for Jira Data Center and Jira Server. Required when using basic authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`).|
|password|string \| null|true|none|The Jira API token, password, or personal access token to use with Jira. When using Basic Authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`), use an API token for Jira Cloud, and a password for Jira Data Center or Jira Server. For a Jira personal access token (`jira_auth_type` is `1`), use the personal access token.|
|jira_issue_regex|string \| null|false|none|Regular expression to match Jira issue keys.|
|jira_issue_prefix|string \| null|false|none|Prefix to match Jira issue keys.|
|jira_issue_transition_id|string \| null|false|none|The ID of one or more transitions for [custom issue transitions](../integration/jira/issues.md#custom-issue-transitions).Ignored when `jira_issue_transition_automatic` is enabled. Defaults to a blank string,which disables custom transitions.|
|issues_enabled|string \| null|false|none|Enable viewing Jira issues in GitLab.|
|project_keys|[string]|false|none|Keys of Jira projects to display. When `issues_enabled` is `true`, this setting filters which Jira projects are shown in GitLab. It does not restrict the API token's access.|
|vulnerabilities_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Turn on Jira issue creation for GitLab vulnerabilities.|
|vulnerabilities_issuetype|string \| null|false|none|Jira issue type to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.|
|project_key|string \| null|false|none|Key of the project to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.This parameter is required if using the integration to create Jira issues from vulnerabilities.|
|customize_jira_issue_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|When set to `true`, opens a prefilled form on the Jira instancewhen creating a Jira issue from a vulnerability.|
|jira_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist before allowing the push.|
|jira_exists_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify the Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist in Jira.|
|jira_assignee_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify the committer is the assignee of the Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|jira_status_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify the status of Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|jira_allowed_statuses_as_string|string \| null|false|none|Comma-separated list of allowed Jira issue statuses.|
|comment_on_event_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable comments inside Jira issues on each GitLab event (commit / merge request)|
|commit_events|boolean \| null|false|none|Trigger event when a commit is created or updated.|
|merge_requests_events|boolean \| null|false|none|Trigger event when a merge request is created, updated, or merged.|
|use_inherited_settings|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates whether to inherit the default settings. Defaults to `false`.|

```json
{
```
```json
  "url": "string",
```
