```json
  "jira_auth_type": 0,
  "username": "string",
  "password": "string",
  "jira_issue_regex": "string",
  "jira_issue_prefix": "string",
  "jira_issue_transition_id": "string",
  "issues_enabled": "string",
  "project_keys": [
    "string"
  ],
  "vulnerabilities_enabled": true,
  "vulnerabilities_issuetype": "string",
  "project_key": "string",
  "customize_jira_issue_enabled": true,
  "jira_check_enabled": true,
  "jira_exists_check_enabled": true,
  "jira_assignee_check_enabled": true,
  "jira_status_check_enabled": true,
  "jira_allowed_statuses_as_string": "string",
  "comment_on_event_enabled": true,
  "commit_events": true,
  "merge_requests_events": true,
  "use_inherited_settings": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string \| null|true|none|The URL to the Jira project which is being linked to this GitLab project (for example, `https://jira.example.com`).|
|api_url|string \| null|false|none|The base URL to the Jira instance API. Web URL value is used if not set (for example, `https://jira-api.example.com`).|
|jira_auth_type|integer \| null|false|none|The authentication method to use with Jira. Use `0` for basic authentication, `1` for Jira personal access token, and `2` for Jira Cloud service accounts. Defaults to `0`.|
|username|string \| null|false|none|The email or username to use with Jira. Use an email for Jira Cloud, and a username for Jira Data Center and Jira Server. Required when using basic authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`).|
|password|string \| null|true|none|The Jira API token, password, or personal access token to use with Jira. When using Basic Authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`), use an API token for Jira Cloud, and a password for Jira Data Center or Jira Server. For a Jira personal access token (`jira_auth_type` is `1`), use the personal access token.|
|jira_issue_regex|string \| null|false|none|Regular expression to match Jira issue keys.|
|jira_issue_prefix|string \| null|false|none|Prefix to match Jira issue keys.|
|jira_issue_transition_id|string \| null|false|none|The ID of one or more transitions for [custom issue transitions](../integration/jira/issues.md#custom-issue-transitions).Ignored when `jira_issue_transition_automatic` is enabled. Defaults to a blank string,which disables custom transitions.|
|issues_enabled|string \| null|false|none|Enable viewing Jira issues in GitLab.|
|project_keys|[string]|false|none|Keys of Jira projects to display. When `issues_enabled` is `true`, this setting filters which Jira projects are shown in GitLab. It does not restrict the API token's access.|
|vulnerabilities_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Turn on Jira issue creation for GitLab vulnerabilities.|
|vulnerabilities_issuetype|string \| null|false|none|Jira issue type to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.|
|project_key|string \| null|false|none|Key of the project to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.This parameter is required if using the integration to create Jira issues from vulnerabilities.|
|customize_jira_issue_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|When set to `true`, opens a prefilled form on the Jira instancewhen creating a Jira issue from a vulnerability.|
|jira_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist before allowing the push.|
|jira_exists_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify the Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist in Jira.|
|jira_assignee_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify the committer is the assignee of the Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|jira_status_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify the status of Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|jira_allowed_statuses_as_string|string \| null|false|none|Comma-separated list of allowed Jira issue statuses.|
|comment_on_event_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable comments inside Jira issues on each GitLab event (commit / merge request)|
|commit_events|boolean \| null|false|none|Trigger event when a commit is created or updated.|
|merge_requests_events|boolean \| null|false|none|Trigger event when a merge request is created, updated, or merged.|
|use_inherited_settings|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates whether to inherit the default settings. Defaults to `false`.|

```json
  ],

  "merge_requests_events": true,

}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string \| null|true|none|The URL to the Jira project which is being linked to this GitLab project (for example, `https://jira.example.com`).|
|api_url|string \| null|false|none|The base URL to the Jira instance API. Web URL value is used if not set (for example, `https://jira-api.example.com`).|
|jira_auth_type|integer \| null|false|none|The authentication method to use with Jira. Use `0` for basic authentication, `1` for Jira personal access token, and `2` for Jira Cloud service accounts. Defaults to `0`.|
|username|string \| null|false|none|The email or username to use with Jira. Use an email for Jira Cloud, and a username for Jira Data Center and Jira Server. Required when using basic authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`).|
|password|string \| null|true|none|The Jira API token, password, or personal access token to use with Jira. When using Basic Authentication (`jira_auth_type` is `0`), use an API token for Jira Cloud, and a password for Jira Data Center or Jira Server. For a Jira personal access token (`jira_auth_type` is `1`), use the personal access token.|
|jira_issue_regex|string \| null|false|none|Regular expression to match Jira issue keys.|
|jira_issue_prefix|string \| null|false|none|Prefix to match Jira issue keys.|
|jira_issue_transition_id|string \| null|false|none|The ID of one or more transitions for [custom issue transitions](../integration/jira/issues.md#custom-issue-transitions).Ignored when `jira_issue_transition_automatic` is enabled. Defaults to a blank string,which disables custom transitions.|
|issues_enabled|string \| null|false|none|Enable viewing Jira issues in GitLab.|
|project_keys|[string]|false|none|Keys of Jira projects to display. When `issues_enabled` is `true`, this setting filters which Jira projects are shown in GitLab. It does not restrict the API token's access.|
|vulnerabilities_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Turn on Jira issue creation for GitLab vulnerabilities.|
|vulnerabilities_issuetype|string \| null|false|none|Jira issue type to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.|
|project_key|string \| null|false|none|Key of the project to use when creating issues from vulnerabilities.This parameter is required if using the integration to create Jira issues from vulnerabilities.|
|customize_jira_issue_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|When set to `true`, opens a prefilled form on the Jira instancewhen creating a Jira issue from a vulnerability.|
|jira_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist before allowing the push.|
|jira_exists_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify the Jira issues referenced in commit messages exist in Jira.|
|jira_assignee_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify the committer is the assignee of the Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|jira_status_check_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Verify the status of Jira issues referenced in commit messages.|
|jira_allowed_statuses_as_string|string \| null|false|none|Comma-separated list of allowed Jira issue statuses.|
|comment_on_event_enabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable comments inside Jira issues on each GitLab event (commit / merge request)|
|commit_events|boolean \| null|false|none|Trigger event when a commit is created or updated.|
|merge_requests_events|boolean \| null|false|none|Trigger event when a merge request is created, updated, or merged.|
|use_inherited_settings|boolean \| null|false|none|Indicates whether to inherit the default settings. Defaults to `false`.|

<h2 id="tocS_postApiV4ImportGithubRequest">postApiV4ImportGithubRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostapiv4importgithubrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_postApiV4ImportGithubRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSpostapiv4importgithubrequest"></a>
<a id="tocspostapiv4importgithubrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "personal_access_token": "string",
  "repo_id": 0,
  "new_name": "string",
  "target_namespace": "string",
  "github_hostname": "string",
  "optional_stages": {},
  "timeout_strategy": "optimistic",
  "pagination_limit": 1
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|personal_access_token|string \| null|true|none|GitHub personal access token.|
|repo_id|integer \| null|true|none|GitHub repository ID.|
|new_name|string \| null|false|none|Name of the new project. Also used as the new path, so it must not start or end with a special character and must not contain consecutive special characters.|
|target_namespace|string \| null|true|none|Namespace to import the repository into. Supports subgroups, for example `/namespace/subgroup`. Must not be blank.|
|github_hostname|string \| null|false|none|Custom GitHub Enterprise hostname. Do not set for GitHub.com. From GitLab 16.5 to GitLab 17.1, you must include the path `/api/v3`.|
|optional_stages|object \| null|false|none|Additional items to import. For a list of items, see [select additional items to import](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/import/github/#select-additional-items-to-import).|
|timeout_strategy|string \| null|false|none|Strategy for handling import timeouts. `optimistic` continues to the next stage of the import. `pessimistic` fails the import immediately. Defaults to `pessimistic`.|
|pagination_limit|integer \| null|false|none|Number of items retrieved per API request to GitHub. If omitted, defaults to `100`. Use a lower number for large repositories to reduce the risk of GitHub API errors, though this increases migration time.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|timeout_strategy|optimistic|
|timeout_strategy|pessimistic|

```json
  "value": "string",
  "key": "percentage_of_actors",
  "feature_group": "string",
  "user": "string",

  "namespace": "string",
  "project": "string",

}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|value|string \| null \| integer \| null|true|none|Value to set for the feature flag. Use `true` or `false` to enable or disable it, or an integer for the percentage of time it should be enabled.|
|key|string \| null|false|none|Rollout strategy for a percentage `value`. Omit it to apply the percentage to time. Mutually exclusive with `feature_group`, `user`, `group`, `namespace`, `project`, `organization`, `repository`, `runner`, `endpoint`.|
|feature_group|string \| null|false|none|Name of the feature group. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|user|string \| null|false|none|GitLab username or a comma-separated list of usernames. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|group|string \| null|false|none|GitLab group path, for example `gitlab-org`, or a comma-separated list of group paths. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|namespace|string \| null|false|none|GitLab group or user namespace path, for example `john-doe`, or a comma-separated list of namespace paths. Introduced in GitLab 15.0. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|project|string \| null|false|none|Project path, for example `gitlab-org/gitlab-foss`, or a comma-separated list of project paths. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|organization|string \| null|false|none|Organization ID or path, for example `1` or `default`, or a comma-separated list of organization IDs or paths. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|repository|string \| null|false|none|Repository path, for example `gitlab-org/gitlab-test.git`, `gitlab-org/gitlab-test.wiki.git`, or `snippets/21.git`. Use commas to separate multiple repository paths. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|runner|string \| null|false|none|Runner ID or a comma-separated list of runner IDs. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|endpoint|string \| null|false|none|Caller ID identifying a code path, for example `GET /api/v4/projects/:id` or `ProjectsController#show`. Use a comma to separate multiple endpoint paths. Mutually exclusive with `key`.|
|force|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, skips feature flag validation checks, such as a YAML definition.|

|Property|Value|

|key|percentage_of_time|

<h2 id="tocS_postApiV4ProjectsIdStatusesShaRequest">postApiV4ProjectsIdStatusesShaRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostapiv4projectsidstatusessharequest"></a>
<a id="schema_postApiV4ProjectsIdStatusesShaRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSpostapiv4projectsidstatusessharequest"></a>
<a id="tocspostapiv4projectsidstatusessharequest"></a>

```json
{
  "state": "pending",
  "ref": "develop",
  "target_url": "https://gitlab.example.com/janedoe/gitlab-foss/builds/91",
  "description": "string",
  "name": "coverage",
  "context": "coverage",
  "coverage": 100,
  "pipeline_id": 0
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|state|string|true|none|State of the status.|
|ref|string \| null|false|none|Branch or tag that the status refers to. Must be 255 characters or fewer.|
|target_url|string \| null|false|none|Target URL to associate with this status. Must be 255 characters or fewer.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|Short description of the status. Must be 255 characters or fewer.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|String label to differentiate this status from the status of other systems.|
|context|string \| null|false|none|String label to differentiate this status from the status of other systems.|
|coverage|number \| null|false|none|Total code coverage.|
|pipeline_id|integer \| null|false|none|ID of the pipeline to set the status for. Use when multiple pipelines exist for the same commit SHA.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|state|pending|
|state|running|
|state|success|
|state|failed|
|state|canceled|
|state|skipped|

<h2 id="tocS_postApiV4ProjectsIdVariablesRequest">postApiV4ProjectsIdVariablesRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostapiv4projectsidvariablesrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_postApiV4ProjectsIdVariablesRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSpostapiv4projectsidvariablesrequest"></a>
<a id="tocspostapiv4projectsidvariablesrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "key": "string",
  "value": "string",
  "protected": true,
  "masked": true,
  "masked_and_hidden": true,
  "raw": true,
  "variable_type": "env_var",
  "environment_scope": "string",
  "description": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|key|string \| null|true|none|Key of the project variable. Must be 255 characters or fewer and contain only `A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, and `_`.|
|value|string \| null|true|none|Value of the variable.|
|protected|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the variable is protected.|
|masked|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the variable is masked.|
|masked_and_hidden|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the variable is masked and hidden. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/29674) in GitLab 17.4.|
|raw|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the variable is treated as a raw string. If `false`, the value is [expanded](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/variables/#allow-cicd-variable-expansion).|
|variable_type|string|false|none|The type of the variable.|
|environment_scope|string \| null|false|none|Environment scope of the variable. Defaults to `*`.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|Description of the variable. Limited to 255 characters.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|variable_type|env_var|
|variable_type|file|

<h2 id="tocS_postApiV4ProjectsIdPipelineSchedulesRequest">postApiV4ProjectsIdPipelineSchedulesRequest</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapostapiv4projectsidpipelineschedulesrequest"></a>
<a id="schema_postApiV4ProjectsIdPipelineSchedulesRequest"></a>
<a id="tocSpostapiv4projectsidpipelineschedulesrequest"></a>
<a id="tocspostapiv4projectsidpipelineschedulesrequest"></a>

```json
{
  "description": "Test schedule pipeline",
  "ref": "develop",
  "cron": "* * * * *",
  "cron_timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",
  "active": true,
  "inputs": [
    {
      "name": "deploy_strategy",
      "value": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|description|string \| null|true|none|Description of the pipeline schedule.|
|ref|string \| null|true|none|Branch or tag name that triggers the pipeline. Accepts either short refs (`main`) or full refs (`refs/heads/main` or `refs/tags/main`). Short refs are automatically expanded to full refs, unless the value could match either a branch or a tag.|
|cron|string \| null|true|none|Cron schedule, for example `0 1 * * *`.|
|cron_timezone|string|false|none|Time zone supported by `ActiveSupport::TimeZone`, for example `Pacific Time (US & Canada)`, or `TZInfo::Timezone`, for example `America/Los_Angeles`.|
|active|boolean|false|none|If `true`, activates the pipeline schedule. If `false`, the pipeline schedule is initially deactivated.|

|info|object \| null|false|none|Runner's metadata|
|active|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the runner is allowed to receive new jobs. Deprecated. Use `paused` instead. Mutually exclusive with `paused`.|
|paused|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the runner ignores new jobs. Mutually exclusive with `active`.|
|locked|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the runner is locked for the current project.|
|access_level|string \| null|false|none|Access level of the runner.|
|run_untagged|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the runner handles untagged jobs.|

```json
{

  "paused": true,

    "string"
  ],

  "maximum_timeout": 0,
  "maintenance_note": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|description|string \| null|false|none|Description of the runner. At least one of `description`, `active`, `paused`, `tag_list`, `run_untagged`, `locked`, `access_level`, `maximum_timeout`, `maintenance_note` must be provided.|
|active|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the runner is allowed to receive jobs. Deprecated. Use `paused` instead. Mutually exclusive with `paused`. At least one of `description`, `active`, `paused`, `tag_list`, `run_untagged`, `locked`, `access_level`, `maximum_timeout`, `maintenance_note` must be provided.|
|paused|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the runner ignores new jobs. Mutually exclusive with `active`. At least one of `description`, `active`, `paused`, `tag_list`, `run_untagged`, `locked`, `access_level`, `maximum_timeout`, `maintenance_note` must be provided.|
|tag_list|[string]|false|none|List of tags for the runner. At least one of `description`, `active`, `paused`, `tag_list`, `run_untagged`, `locked`, `access_level`, `maximum_timeout`, `maintenance_note` must be provided.|
|run_untagged|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the runner can execute untagged jobs. At least one of `description`, `active`, `paused`, `tag_list`, `run_untagged`, `locked`, `access_level`, `maximum_timeout`, `maintenance_note` must be provided.|
|locked|boolean \| null|false|none|If `true`, the runner is locked. At least one of `description`, `active`, `paused`, `tag_list`, `run_untagged`, `locked`, `access_level`, `maximum_timeout`, `maintenance_note` must be provided.|
|access_level|string \| null|false|none|Access level of the runner. At least one of `description`, `active`, `paused`, `tag_list`, `run_untagged`, `locked`, `access_level`, `maximum_timeout`, `maintenance_note` must be provided.|
|maximum_timeout|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum time, in seconds, that runners can spend running a job. At least one of `description`, `active`, `paused`, `tag_list`, `run_untagged`, `locked`, `access_level`, `maximum_timeout`, `maintenance_note` must be provided.|
|maintenance_note|string \| null|false|none|Free-form maintenance notes for the runner. Limited to 1024 characters. At least one of `description`, `active`, `paused`, `tag_list`, `run_untagged`, `locked`, `access_level`, `maximum_timeout`, `maintenance_note` must be provided.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|access_level|not_protected|
|access_level|ref_protected|

|dotenv_variables|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum number of variables in a dotenv artifact. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/432529) in GitLab 17.1.|

|helm_max_file_size|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum Helm chart file size in bytes.|
|maven_max_file_size|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum Maven package file size in bytes.|
|notification_limit|integer \| null|false|none|Maximum storage size for root namespace limit notifications, in MiB.|
